sat_mocks.title: Digital SAT Mock #1: Official Bluebook Test 1

sample_test_questions.passage: Commercial aircraft wings are engineered to flex significantly during severe turbulence without suffering structural damage. During extreme stress tests, Boeing 787 wings are deflected upwards by more than 26 feet before failure occurs. ______ this deliberate flexibility absorbs aerodynamic shock loads, protecting the fuselage.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Birinchi gapda qanotlarning egiluvchanligi aytiladi, ikkinchi gapda uning sinov dalili keltiriladi, uchinchi gapda esa bularning barchasining asosiy yakuniy maqsadi va natijasi (qanot fyuzelyajni himoya qilishi) xulosa qilinadi. 'Ultimately,' (Yakuniy hisobda / Xulosa qilib aytganda) to'g'ri keladi. Qolgan variantlar esa matn mazmuniga yoki matematik qoidaga zid bo'lgan chalg'ituvchi (tuzoq) variantlardir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: 🎯 SAT TRANSITIONS: 'Regardless', 'Conversely', 'Nonetheless' ziddiyat bildiradi. Matnda esa hech qanday ziddiyat yo'q, aksincha jarayonning yakuniy natijasi xulosa qilinmoqda.

sample_test_questions.passage: Astronomer Vera Rubin uncovered compelling rotational evidence for dark ______ her meticulous measurements of galaxy spin rates demonstrated that galaxies must contain immense invisible mass to avoid flying apart.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
sample_test_questions.explanation: 'Astronomer Vera Rubin uncovered compelling evidence for dark matter' — to'liq mustaqil gap (Independent Clause 1). 'Her meticulous measurements... demonstrated that...' — ikkinchi to'liq mustaqil gap (Independent Clause 2). Ikkita mustaqil gapni hech qanday bog'lovchisiz (FANBOYS) faqat nuqtali vergul (;) yoki nuqta (.) bilan ajratish mumkin. Oddiy vergul (C) 'comma splice' xatosini keltirib chiqaradi. Shuning uchun A to'g'ri.
sample_test_questions.strategy:
🎯 SAT GRAMMAR QOIDASI:
Independent Clause + ; + Independent Clause.
Ikkita to'liq gapni hech qachon shunchaki vergul bilan ajratmang (Comma Splice qat'iyan taqiqlanadi)!

sample_test_questions.passage: In 1977, NASA launched Voyager 1 with a singular scientific ______ to conduct close-range flybys of Jupiter and Saturn before charting the outer boundaries of the heliosphere.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Ikki nuqta (colon ':') to'liq mustaqil gapdan so'ng kelib, undan keyin keluvchi tushuntirish, maqsad yoki ro'yxatni ochib beradi. 'NASA launched Voyager 1 with a singular scientific objective' to'liq gap, undan keyin aynan qanday maqsad ekanligi tushuntirilgan ('to conduct close-range flybys...'). Shuning uchun ikki nuqta (A) to'g'ri. Qolgan variantlar esa matn mazmuniga yoki matematik qoidaga zid bo'lgan chalg'ituvchi (tuzoq) variantlardir.
sample_test_questions.strategy:
🎯 COLON (:) QOIDASI:
Ikki nuqtadan oldin MUSTAQIL GAP (Independent Clause) bo'lishi shart. Ikki nuqtadan keyin esa tushuntirish yoki ro'yxat keladi.

sample_test_questions.passage: Discovered deep within the Atacama Desert in northern Chile, ______ preserved for thousands of years by the hyperarid climate, which virtually halts bacterial decay.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

options.text: archaeologists remarkably found the Chinchorro mummies
remarkable preservation protected the Chinchorro mummies
the hyperarid climate remarkably kept the Chinchorro mummies

sample_test_questions.explanation: Gap kirish qismi: 'Discovered deep within the Atacama Desert...'. Savol bering: Atakama cho'lida kim yoki nima kashf etilgan? Arxeologlar emas (B), iqlim emas (D), balki 'the Chinchorro mummies' (mumiyolar). Kirish sifatdosh birikmasidan so'ng darhol uning egasi kelishi shart (Dangling Modifier qoidasi). Shuning uchun A to'g'ri. Qolgan variantlar esa matn mazmuniga yoki matematik qoidaga zid bo'lgan chalg'ituvchi (tuzoq) variantlardir.
sample_test_questions.strategy:
🎯 DANGLING MODIFIER QOIDASI:
Agar gap harakat bilan boshlansa ('Discovered in...'), verguldan keyingi 1-so'z aynan o'sha harakat qaratilgan narsa bo'lishi shart. Cho'ldan topilgan narsa = mumiyolar (A)!

sample_test_questions.passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• The Mariana Trench is the deepest oceanic trench on Earth.
• Its lowest point, the Challenger Deep, descends approximately 10,994 meters (36,070 feet) below sea level.
• In 1960, Jacques Piccard and Don Walsh became the first humans to reach Challenger Deep in the bathyscaphe Trieste.
• In 2012, filmmaker James Cameron conducted the first solo dive to Challenger Deep in the Deepsea Challenger.
sample_test_questions.question: The student wants to contrast the first expedition to Challenger Deep with James Cameron's expedition. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.text: Descending to 10,994 meters below sea level, Challenger Deep was reached by Jacques Piccard and Don Walsh in the bathyscaphe Trieste.
While Jacques Piccard and Don Walsh reached Challenger Deep in a two-person bathyscaphe in 1960, James Cameron completed the first solo dive there in 2012.
Located in the Mariana Trench, Challenger Deep was explored by humans in both 1960 and 2012.
In 2012, James Cameron piloted the Deepsea Challenger to Challenger Deep, the deepest point in the Mariana Trench.

sample_test_questions.explanation: Talabaning maqsadi: birinchi ekspeditsiyani (1960 yil, 2 kishi) James Cameron ekspeditsiyasi (2012 yil, 1 kishi / solo) bilan taqqoslash (contrast qilish). B varianti 'While Piccard and Walsh reached... in 1960, James Cameron completed the first solo dive in 2012' deb ikkala ekspeditsiyani aniq kontrast bilan bog'lagan.
sample_test_questions.strategy:
🎯 RHETORICAL SYNTHESIS SIRI:
Savoldagi maqsadga e'tibor bering: 'contrast the first expedition with James Cameron's expedition'. Faqat B variantida ikkala tomon ham bor va ular o'zaro taqqoslangan ('While...').

sample_test_questions.passage: The scientist's methodology was characterized by its empirical rigor, yet her conclusions often demonstrated a remarkable prescience that seemed to transcend the immediate data. Critics argued that this apparent paradox undermined her credibility, while supporters maintained it reflected genuine intellectual acuity.
sample_test_questions.question: As used in the text, what does the word "prescience" most nearly mean?
sample_test_questions.explanation: To'g'ri javob A. "Prescience" so'zi "oldindan ko'ra bilish, bashorat qilish qobiliyati" degan ma'noni anglatadi va kontekstda "foresight" (oldindan ko'ra bilish) bilan sinonim hisoblanadi. Matnda aytilishicha, olim ayolning xulosalari bevosita ma'lumotlardan "tashqariga chiqib ketgandek" ko'ringan, ya'ni u kelajakni oldindan ko'ra bilgandek. B variant (Accuracy - aniqlik) noto'g'ri, chunki gap aniqlik haqida emas, balki kelajakni oldindan bilish haqida. C variant (Confusion - chalkashlik) kontekstga zid. D variant (Methodology - metodologiya) matnda allaqachon boshqa ma'noda ishlatilgan.
sample_test_questions.strategy: SAT strategiyasi: So'zning ma'nosini topish uchun avval uni kontekstdan o'chirib tashlang va bo'sh joyga har bir variantni qo'yib ko'ring. Qaysi variant mantiqiy jihatdan to'g'ri kelsa, o'sha javob. "Transcend the data" (ma'lumotlardan oshib ketish) iborasi bilan "foresight" (oldindan ko'rish) mantiqiy bog'lanadi. Shuningdek, "paradox" (qarama-qarshilik) so'zi ham shuni ko'rsatadiki, olim ayol "empirical" (tajribaga asoslangan) usul bilan ishlagan, lekin kelajakni "prescience" bilan ko'ra bilgan - bu qarama-qarshilik.

sample_test_questions.passage: The platypus is an egg-laying mammal native to eastern Australia. When European naturalists first encountered preserved platypus specimens in 1798, many believed the creature was an elaborate hoax. The animal appeared to be a composite: it had a duck's bill, a beaver's tail, and otter's feet. Naturalist George Shaw even took scissors to a dried specimen, convinced he would find stitches where different animals had been sewn together. Today, genetic research has revealed that the platypus represents an ancient evolutionary lineage that diverged from other mammals approximately 166 million years ago.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice best describes the overall structure of the text?

options.text: It presents a scientific mystery and then provides its resolution.
It describes an animal's habitat and explains how it adapted to that environment.
It introduces a historical misconception and then explains the current scientific understanding.
It compares two competing theories and evaluates which one is more accurate.

sample_test_questions.explanation: To'g'ri javob C. Matn strukturasi quyidagicha: avval tarixiy noto'g'ri tushuncha (platipusning soxta hayvon deb o'ylangani) keltiriladi, keyin hozirgi ilmiy tushuncha (genetik tadqiqotlar orqali platipusning qadimiy evolyutsion chizig'i ekanligi) tushuntiriladi. A variant noto'g'ri, chunki gap "mystery" (sir) haqida emas, balki "misconception" (noto'g'ri tushuncha) haqida. B variant noto'g'ri, chunki matnda yashash joyi va moslashuv haqida gapirgilmaydi. D variant noto'g'ri, chunki ikki nazariya taqqoslanmaydi - faqat tarixiy qarash va zamonaviy ilmiy tushuncha kontrastida beriladi.
sample_test_questions.strategy: SAT strategiyasi: Matn strukturasini aniqlash uchun har bir xatboshining asosiy g'oyasini belgilang. 1-xatboshi: tarixdagi hodisa (noto'g'ri qarash). 2-xatboshi: "Today" (bugun) so'zi bilan boshlanadi - bu o'zgarishni ko'rsatadi. Vaqt ko'rsatkichlari ("1798", "Today") strukturani tushunishda muhim. "First... then..." (avval... keyin...) strukturasini qidirib toping.

sample_test_questions.passage: In her groundbreaking 1962 work Silent Spring, marine biologist Rachel Carson documented the devastating effects of pesticides on bird populations and ecosystems. Carson argued that the widespread use of DDT and similar chemicals was causing a cascade of environmental harm, from the thinning of bird eggshells to the contamination of water supplies. Her work faced fierce opposition from chemical companies and some members of the scientific establishment, who questioned both her credentials and her conclusions. Nevertheless, Silent Spring catalyzed the modern environmental movement and led to significant policy changes, including the eventual ban of DDT in the United States in 1972. Carson's approach—combining rigorous scientific research with accessible prose—demonstrated that environmental science could reach and mobilize a broad public audience.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice best states the main idea of the text?

options.text: Rachel Carson's scientific credentials were unfairly questioned by the chemical industry despite her expertise in marine biology.
Silent Spring revealed the harmful effects of pesticides and, despite facing opposition, influenced environmental policy and public awareness.
The ban of DDT in 1972 was the most significant achievement of the environmental movement in the twentieth century.
Rachel Carson proved that scientists should write in an accessible style to ensure their research reaches the general public.

sample_test_questions.explanation: To'g'ri javob B. Matnning asosiy g'oyasi Silent Spring kitobining ta'siri: u pestitsidlarning zararini ochib berdi, qarshiliklarga qaramay ekologik siyosat va jamiyat ongiga ta'sir qildi. Bu variant matnning barcha asosiy elementlarini qamrab oladi. A variant noto'g'ri, chunki u faqat bitta tafsilotga (kredensiallariga qarshi chiqilishi) e'tibor beradi, asosiy g'oyani emas. C variant noto'g'ri, chunki DDT taqiqi natijadir, lekin matnda "most significant achievement" deb aytilmagan. D variant noto'g'ri, chunki yozish uslubi muhim tafsilot, lekin asosiy g'oya emas - bu Carson yondashuvining bir jihati xolos.
sample_test_questions.strategy: SAT strategiyasi: Asosiy g'oyani topish uchun "zoom out" qiling - kichik detallardan uzoqlashing. O'zingizga savol bering: "Agar men bu matnni bitta gapda tushuntirsam, nima deyman?" Har bir gapni o'qib, takrorlanayotgan mavzuni toping. Burada takrorlanayotgan mavzu: Carson kitobining ta'siri va oqibatlari. Juda keng (C) yoki juda tor (A, D) javoblardan saqlaning.

sample_test_questions.passage: Researchers studying sleep patterns in adolescents have found that school start times significantly affect academic performance. A study conducted across multiple high schools showed that students at schools with 8:30 AM or later start times had higher grade point averages and standardized test scores compared to students at schools beginning at 7:30 AM. Additionally, students with later start times reported feeling more alert during morning classes and had fewer absences related to illness.
sample_test_questions.question: Which finding from the study, if true, would most directly support the claim that later school start times improve academic performance?

options.text: Students at schools with later start times went to bed at approximately the same time as students at schools with earlier start times.
Schools with later start times had more resources and experienced teachers than schools with earlier start times.
Students at schools with later start times participated in fewer after-school activities than students at schools with earlier start times.
The improvement in grades occurred specifically in morning classes, while afternoon class performance remained similar across all schools.

sample_test_questions.explanation: To'g'ri javob A. Agar o'quvchilar bir xil vaqtda uxlashga yotishgan bo'lsa, lekin kechroq turganlar akademik jihatdan yaxshiroq natija ko'rsatgan bo'lsa, bu to'g'ridan-to'g'ri maktab boshlanish vaqti (va natijada ko'proq uxlash) akademik natijalarga ijobiy ta'sir qilishini tasdiqlaydi. Bu boshqa tashqi omillarni istisno qiladi. B variant noto'g'ri, chunki bu "confounding variable" (aralashtirib yuboruvchi o'zgaruvchi) - natija maktab boshlanish vaqtidan emas, balki resurslardan kelib chiqishi mumkin. C variant noto'g'ri, chunki bu ham akademik natijalarning boshqa sababini taklif qiladi. D variant yaxshi tuyuladi, lekin u faqat qachon yaxshilanish sodir bo'lganini ko'rsatadi, nima sababdan ekanligini isbotlamaydi.
sample_test_questions.strategy: SAT strategiyasi: "Command of Evidence" savollari uchun causation vs correlation (sababiyat va bog'liqlik) ni farqlang. To'g'ri dalil boshqa omillarni istisno qilishi va to'g'ridan-to'g'ri sababiy bog'lanishni ko'rsatishi kerak. B va C variantlardagi kabi "alternative explanations" (muqobil tushuntirishlar) dan ehtiyot bo'ling - bular noto'g'ri javoblar bo'lishi mumkin.

sample_test_questions.passage: Artist Frida Kahlo produced approximately 200 paintings during her lifetime, of which 55 are self-portraits. In letters to friends, Kahlo explained that she painted herself because she was often alone and because she was the subject she knew best. While many critics have interpreted her self-portraits as purely autobiographical expressions of physical and emotional pain, recent scholarship suggests a more complex reading. Kahlo deliberately incorporated symbols from Mexican indigenous culture and challenged European artistic conventions, positioning herself within a broader cultural and political context rather than simply recording personal experience.
sample_test_questions.question: Based on the text, what can most reasonably be inferred about recent scholarly interpretations of Kahlo's self-portraits?

options.text: They reject the idea that Kahlo's personal experiences influenced her artwork.
They recognize dimensions of Kahlo's work beyond personal autobiography, including cultural and political commentary.
They argue that Kahlo was primarily interested in European artistic traditions rather than Mexican culture.
They suggest that Kahlo's letters to friends provide an incomplete account of her artistic motivations.

sample_test_questions.explanation: To'g'ri javob B. Matnda "recent scholarship suggests a more complex reading" (so'nggi tadqiqotlar murakkabroq talqinni taklif qiladi) deyiladi va Kahloning o'z-o'zidan portretlarini nafaqat shaxsiy avtobiografik iboralar sifatida, balki Meksika madaniyati ramzlarini va Yevropa an'analariga qarshi chiqishni o'z ichiga olgan keng madaniy va siyosiy kontekstda ko'rish kerakligi ta'kidlanadi. A variant noto'g'ri, chunki yangi talqinlar shaxsiy tajribani inkor etmaydi, balki "qo'shimcha" jihatlarni qo'shadi. C variant matn ma'nosiga zid - Kahlo Yevropa an'analariga "qarshi chiqdi", ularni qabul qilmadi. D variant matnda aytilmagan - xatlarda nima yozilgani to'g'risida baholash berilmagan.
sample_test_questions.strategy: SAT strategiyasi: "Inference" (xulosa chiqarish) savollari uchun matnda bevosita aytilmagan, lekin mantiqan kelib chiqadigan narsani toping. Haddan tashqari katta xulosa chiqarmang. "More complex" (murakkabroq) so'zi kalit - bu eskiroq qarash (faqat avtobiografik) hali ham to'g'ri, lekin to'liq emas degan ma'noni anglatadi. "Rather than simply" (oddiy ravishda emas) iborasi qo'shimcha qatlamlarni ko'rsatadi.

sample_test_questions.question: The function f(x) = -2x² + 8x + c has a maximum value of 15. What is the value of c?
sample_test_questions.explanation: To'g'ri javob B (c = 7). Parabola maksimum qiymatiga vertex (cho'qqi nuqta) da erishadi. Vertex x koordinatasi: x = -b/(2a) = -8/(2(-2)) = -8/(-4) = 2. Vertex y koordinatasi (maksimum qiymat): f(2) = -2(2)² + 8(2) + c = -2(4) + 16 + c = -8 + 16 + c = 8 + c. Savol shartiga ko'ra maksimum qiymat 15 ga teng: 8 + c = 15, demak c = 7. Tekshirish: f(x) = -2x² + 8x + 7, f(2) = -8 + 16 + 7 = 15 ✓ Qolgan variantlar esa matn mazmuniga yoki matematik qoidaga zid bo'lgan chalg'ituvchi (tuzoq) variantlardir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: DESMOS 3-sekund hack: 1) Desmos grafigiga funktsiyani kiriting: f(x) = -2x² + 8x + c. 2) c ni slider qilib qo'ying. 3) c ni o'zgartirib, vertex ning y koordinatasi 15 bo'lgan joyni toping. Vertex koordinatalari avtomatik ko'rinadi. Yoki formula: Quadratic f(x) = ax² + bx + c uchun vertex x = -b/(2a), keyin shu x ni tenglamaga qo'yib, maksimum qiymatni toping va c ni yeching.

sample_test_questions.question: If x² + y² = 25 and y = x + 1, what is the sum of all possible values of x?
sample_test_questions.explanation: To'g'ri javob A (-1). Ikkinchi tenglamadan y ni topamiz: y = x + 1. Buni birinchi tenglamaga qo'yamiz: x² + (x + 1)² = 25. Ochib yozamiz: x² + x² + 2x + 1 = 25. Soddalashtiramiz: 2x² + 2x + 1 = 25. Barcha hadlarni chap tomonga o'tkazamiz: 2x² + 2x - 24 = 0. 2 ga bo'lamiz: x² + x - 12 = 0. Faktorizatsiya qilamiz: (x + 4)(x - 3) = 0. Yechimlar: x = -4 yoki x = 3. Barcha mumkin bo'lgan x qiymatlari yig'indisi: -4 + 3 = -1. Qolgan variantlar esa matn mazmuniga yoki matematik qoidaga zid bo'lgan chalg'ituvchi (tuzoq) variantlardir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: DESMOS 5-sekund hack: 1) Desmos grafigiga ikkala tenglamani kiriting: x² + y² = 25 (doira) va y = x + 1 (to'g'ri chiziq). 2) Kesishish nuqtalarini ko'ring. 3) Har bir kesishish nuqtasining x koordinatasini yozing va ularni qo'shing. Desmos kesishish nuqtalari koordinatalarini avtomatik ko'rsatadi. Algebraik usul: almashtirish (substitution) usuli - bir tenglamadan y ni topib, ikkinchisiga qo'ying.

sample_test_questions.question: A bacteria culture doubles in size every 3 hours. If the culture initially contains 500 bacteria, which function models the number of bacteria, B(t), after t hours?
sample_test_questions.explanation: To'g'ri javob A. Eksponensial o'sish formulasi: B(t) = B₀ · r^(t/d), bu yerda B₀ = boshlang'ich qiymat (500), r = o'sish koeffitsienti (2, chunki ikki barobar ko'payadi), d = davr (3 soat). Demak, B(t) = 500 · 2^(t/3). Tekshirish: t = 0 da B(0) = 500 · 2^0 = 500 ✓ (boshlang'ich holat). t = 3 da B(3) = 500 · 2^(3/3) = 500 · 2^1 = 1000 ✓ (3 soatdan keyin ikki barobar). t = 6 da B(6) = 500 · 2^(6/3) = 500 · 2^2 = 2000 ✓ (6 soatdan keyin to'rt barobar). B variant noto'g'ri, chunki daraja t/3 emas, 3t - bu juda tez o'sishni beradi. C va D variantlar noto'g'ri asos (base) ishlatadi.
sample_test_questions.strategy: DESMOS hack: 1) Har bir variantni Desmos grafigiga kiriting. 2) Bir nechta nuqtalarni tekshiring: (0, 500), (3, 1000), (6, 2000). 3) Qaysi grafik bu nuqtalardan o'tsa, o'sha javob to'g'ri. Yoki formula eslab qoling: Eksponensial o'sish/kamayish = Boshlang'ich qiymat · (o'sish/kamayish koeffitsienti)^(vaqt/davr). "Doubles every 3 hours" = koeffitsient 2, davr 3.

sample_test_questions.question: A laptop originally priced at $800 is on sale for 25% off. An additional 10% discount is applied to the sale price. What is the final price of the laptop?
sample_test_questions.explanation: To'g'ri javob B ($540). Birinchi chegirma: 25% off = 75% qoladi. $800 × 0.75 = $600 (sotuvdagi narx). Ikkinchi chegirma sotuvdagi narxdan: 10% off = 90% qoladi. $600 × 0.90 = $540 (yakuniy narx). Ko'p talabalar xato qilib, ikkala chegirmani qo'shib yuboradilar (25% + 10% = 35% off, $800 × 0.65 = $520), lekin ikkinchi chegirma yangi narxdan olinadi, asl narxdan emas. To'g'ri usul: har bir chegirmani ketma-ket qo'llash.
sample_test_questions.strategy: DESMOS hack: Desmos kalkulyatorida: 800 × 0.75 × 0.90 ni hisoblang = 540. Yoki percent qisqartma: "25% off" = "× 0.75" (100% - 25% = 75% qoladi). "10% off" = "× 0.90" (100% - 10% = 90% qoladi). Ketma-ket chegirmalar: har bir chegirmani alohida qo'llang, qo'shmang.

sample_test_questions.question: A survey estimates that 60% of voters support a new policy, with a margin of error of ±4 percentage points. Which of the following is a plausible range for the true percentage of voters who support the policy?
sample_test_questions.explanation: To'g'ri javob B (56% dan 64% gacha). Margin of error (xatolik chegarasi) ±4% degani baholangan qiymatdan 4% yuqoriga yoki 4% pastga bo'lishi mumkin. 60% - 4% = 56% (pastki chegara). 60% + 4% = 64% (yuqori chegara). Demak, haqiqiy qiymat 56% dan 64% oralig'ida bo'lishi mumkin. A variant noto'g'ri, chunki pastki chegara 54% (60% - 6%), lekin margin of error ±4%, ±6% emas. C variant noto'g'ri, chunki bu ±2% margin of error. D variant noto'g'ri, chunki pastki chegara yo'q, faqat yuqori chegara ko'rsatilgan.
sample_test_questions.strategy: DESMOS hack: Oddiy arifmetik. Formulani eslab qoling: [Estimate - Margin, Estimate + Margin]. Bu yerda [60 - 4, 60 + 4] = [56, 64]. SAT da margin of error savollari uchun har doim ikkala tomonni ham hisoblang (yuqori va pastki chegara). ± belgisi ikkalasi ham (qo'shish va ayirish) kerak degan ma'noni anglatadi.

sample_test_questions.question: A circle in the xy-plane has center (3, -2) and radius 5. Which equation represents this circle?
sample_test_questions.explanation: To'g'ri javob C. Aylana tenglamasi: (x - h)² + (y - k)² = r², bu yerda (h, k) markaz koordinatalari va r radius. Markaz (3, -2), demak h = 3, k = -2. Radius 5, demak r² = 25. Tenglama: (x - 3)² + (y - (-2))² = 25, ya'ni (x - 3)² + (y + 2)² = 25. Eslatma: (y + 2) ni ko'ring - bu (y - (-2)) dan keladi. A variant noto'g'ri, chunki o'ng tomon 5, lekin r² = 25 bo'lishi kerak. B variant noto'g'ri, chunki belgilar noto'g'ri: (x + 3) o'rniga (x - 3) va (y - 2) o'rniga (y + 2) bo'lishi kerak. D variant noto'g'ri, chunki belgilar ham, r² ham noto'g'ri.
sample_test_questions.strategy: DESMOS 3-sekund hack: 1) Har bir variantni Desmos grafigiga kiriting. 2) Markaz (3, -2) ga diqqat qiling va radius 5 ni tekshiring. Yoki formula: (x - h)² + (y - k)² = r². Belgilar muhim: agar markaz x = 3 bo'lsa, (x - 3) bo'ladi. Agar markaz y = -2 bo'lsa, (y - (-2)) = (y + 2) bo'ladi. O'ng tomon har doim radius kvadrati (r²), radius o'zi emas.

sample_test_questions.question: In a right triangle, the length of the side opposite to angle θ is 7, and the length of the hypotenuse is 25. What is the value of sin(θ)?
sample_test_questions.explanation: To'g'ri javob B (7/25). Sinus formulasi: sin(θ) = qarama-qarshi tomon / gipotenuza. Bu yerda qarama-qarshi tomon = 7, gipotenuza = 25. Demak, sin(θ) = 7/25. A variant noto'g'ri, chunki 24 qo'shni tomon (adjacent side) bo'lishi mumkin (Pifagor teoremasi: 7² + 24² = 49 + 576 = 625 = 25²), lekin sinus uchun gipotenuza kerak, qo'shni tomon emas. C variant cos(θ) ni beradi (qo'shni tomon / gipotenuza = 24/25), sin(θ) ni emas. D variant nisbat teskari yo'nalishda.
sample_test_questions.strategy: DESMOS hack: Agar burchak qiymati berilgan bo'lsa, sin(θ) ni Desmos kalkulyatorida hisoblash mumkin. Lekin bu yerda burchak o'rniga tomonlar berilgan, shuning uchun formula kerak. SOH-CAH-TOA ni eslab qoling: SOH = Sin = Opposite/Hypotenuse (qarama-qarshi/gipotenuza), CAH = Cos = Adjacent/Hypotenuse (qo'shni/gipotenuza), TOA = Tan = Opposite/Adjacent (qarama-qarshi/qo'shni). Sin uchun har doim gipotenuza maxrajda.

sample_test_questions.question: Which of the following is equivalent to (2x + 3)² - (2x - 3)²?
sample_test_questions.explanation: To'g'ri javob B (24x). Bu yerda "difference of squares" (kvadratlar ayirmasi) formulasidan foydalanish mumkin: a² - b² = (a + b)(a - b). a = 2x + 3, b = 2x - 3 bo'lsa: (2x + 3)² - (2x - 3)² = [(2x + 3) + (2x - 3)][(2x + 3) - (2x - 3)] = [2x + 3 + 2x - 3][2x + 3 - 2x + 3] = [4x][6] = 24x. Yoki to'liq ochib yozish mumkin: (2x + 3)² = 4x² + 12x + 9, (2x - 3)² = 4x² - 12x + 9. Ayirma: (4x² + 12x + 9) - (4x² - 12x + 9) = 4x² + 12x + 9 - 4x² + 12x - 9 = 24x. Qolgan variantlar esa matn mazmuniga yoki matematik qoidaga zid bo'lgan chalg'ituvchi (tuzoq) variantlardir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: DESMOS 3-sekund hack: 1) Desmos grafigiga kiriting: y₁ = (2x + 3)² - (2x - 3)². 2) Har bir javob variantini alohida kiriting: y₂ = 12x, y₃ = 24x, va h.k. 3) Qaysi grafik y₁ bilan bir xil bo'lsa, o'sha javob to'g'ri. Yoki formula: a² - b² = (a + b)(a - b). Bu formula SAT da juda tez-tez uchraydi va ko'p vaqt tejaydi.

sample_test_questions.question: A circle has a radius of 12 centimeters. What is the length, in centimeters, of an arc that subtends a central angle of 60°?
sample_test_questions.explanation: To'g'ri javob B (4π). Yoy uzunligi formulasi: Arc length = (θ/360°) × 2πr, bu yerda θ markaziy burchak daraja hisobida, r radius. θ = 60°, r = 12. Arc length = (60°/360°) × 2π(12) = (1/6) × 24π = 4π santimetr. Yoki boshqacha usul: 60° aylana markazidan 360° ning 1/6 qismini tashkil qiladi. Aylana uzunligi 2πr = 2π(12) = 24π. Yoy uzunligi 24π ning 1/6 qismi = 4π. Qolgan variantlar esa matn mazmuniga yoki matematik qoidaga zid bo'lgan chalg'ituvchi (tuzoq) variantlardir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: DESMOS hack: Desmos kalkulyatorida hisoblang: (60/360) × 2 × π × 12 = 4π ≈ 12.57. Keyin javoblarni tekshiring: 2π ≈ 6.28, 4π ≈ 12.57 ✓, 6π ≈ 18.85, 12π ≈ 37.70. Yoki formula eslab qoling: Yoy uzunligi = (burchak/360°) × aylana uzunligi. Agar burchak radianlarda berilgan bo'lsa: Arc length = rθ (bu yerda θ radian).

sample_test_questions.question: A recipe for 4 servings requires 3 cups of flour. How many cups of flour are needed to make 10 servings of the same recipe?
sample_test_questions.explanation: To'g'ri javob C (7.5 cups). Proporsiya o'rnatamiz: 4 porsiya uchun 3 cups, 10 porsiya uchun x cups. 4/3 = 10/x yoki 3/4 = x/10. Ikkinchi usulni ishlatamiz: x = (3 × 10) / 4 = 30/4 = 7.5 cups. Yoki boshqacha: bitta porsiya uchun 3/4 = 0.75 cup kerak. 10 porsiya uchun 0.75 × 10 = 7.5 cups. Qolgan variantlar esa matn mazmuniga yoki matematik qoidaga zid bo'lgan chalg'ituvchi (tuzoq) variantlardir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: DESMOS hack: Desmos kalkulyatorida hisoblang: (3/4) × 10 = 7.5. Yoki proporsiya o'rnating va cross-multiply (perpendikulyar ko'paytirish) qiling. SAT da proporsiya savollari uchun: 1) Nisbatni aniqlang (3 cups / 4 servings). 2) Kerakli miqdorga ko'paytiring (× 10 servings). 3) Soddalashtiring.

sat_mocks.title: Digital SAT Mock #2: Official Bluebook Test 2

sample_test_questions.passage: In her groundbreaking 1962 work Silent Spring, marine biologist Rachel Carson documented the devastating effects of pesticides on bird populations and ecosystems. Carson argued that the widespread use of DDT and similar chemicals was causing a cascade of environmental harm, from the thinning of bird eggshells to the contamination of water supplies. Her work faced fierce opposition from chemical companies and some members of the scientific establishment, who questioned both her credentials and her conclusions. Nevertheless, Silent Spring catalyzed the modern environmental movement and led to significant policy changes, including the eventual ban of DDT in the United States in 1972. Carson's approach—combining rigorous scientific research with accessible prose—demonstrated that environmental science could reach and mobilize a broad public audience.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice best states the main idea of the text?

options.text: Rachel Carson's scientific credentials were unfairly questioned by the chemical industry despite her expertise in marine biology.
Silent Spring revealed the harmful effects of pesticides and, despite facing opposition, influenced environmental policy and public awareness.
The ban of DDT in 1972 was the most significant achievement of the environmental movement in the twentieth century.
Rachel Carson proved that scientists should write in an accessible style to ensure their research reaches the general public.

sample_test_questions.explanation: To'g'ri javob B. Matnning asosiy g'oyasi Silent Spring kitobining ta'siri: u pestitsidlarning zararini ochib berdi, qarshiliklarga qaramay ekologik siyosat va jamiyat ongiga ta'sir qildi. Bu variant matnning barcha asosiy elementlarini qamrab oladi. A variant noto'g'ri, chunki u faqat bitta tafsilotga (kredensiallariga qarshi chiqilishi) e'tibor beradi, asosiy g'oyani emas. C variant noto'g'ri, chunki DDT taqiqi natijadir, lekin matnda "most significant achievement" deb aytilmagan. D variant noto'g'ri, chunki yozish uslubi muhim tafsilot, lekin asosiy g'oya emas - bu Carson yondashuvining bir jihati xolos.
sample_test_questions.strategy: SAT strategiyasi: Asosiy g'oyani topish uchun "zoom out" qiling - kichik detallardan uzoqlashing. O'zingizga savol bering: "Agar men bu matnni bitta gapda tushuntirsam, nima deyman?" Har bir gapni o'qib, takrorlanayotgan mavzuni toping. Burada takrorlanayotgan mavzu: Carson kitobining ta'siri va oqibatlari. Juda keng (C) yoki juda tor (A, D) javoblardan saqlaning.

sample_test_questions.passage: Researchers studying sleep patterns in adolescents have found that school start times significantly affect academic performance. A study conducted across multiple high schools showed that students at schools with 8:30 AM or later start times had higher grade point averages and standardized test scores compared to students at schools beginning at 7:30 AM. Additionally, students with later start times reported feeling more alert during morning classes and had fewer absences related to illness.
sample_test_questions.question: Which finding from the study, if true, would most directly support the claim that later school start times improve academic performance?

options.text: Students at schools with later start times went to bed at approximately the same time as students at schools with earlier start times.
Schools with later start times had more resources and experienced teachers than schools with earlier start times.
Students at schools with later start times participated in fewer after-school activities than students at schools with earlier start times.
The improvement in grades occurred specifically in morning classes, while afternoon class performance remained similar across all schools.

sample_test_questions.explanation: To'g'ri javob A. Agar o'quvchilar bir xil vaqtda uxlashga yotishgan bo'lsa, lekin kechroq turganlar akademik jihatdan yaxshiroq natija ko'rsatgan bo'lsa, bu to'g'ridan-to'g'ri maktab boshlanish vaqti (va natijada ko'proq uxlash) akademik natijalarga ijobiy ta'sir qilishini tasdiqlaydi. Bu boshqa tashqi omillarni istisno qiladi. B variant noto'g'ri, chunki bu "confounding variable" (aralashtirib yuboruvchi o'zgaruvchi) - natija maktab boshlanish vaqtidan emas, balki resurslardan kelib chiqishi mumkin. C variant noto'g'ri, chunki bu ham akademik natijalarning boshqa sababini taklif qiladi. D variant yaxshi tuyuladi, lekin u faqat qachon yaxshilanish sodir bo'lganini ko'rsatadi, nima sababdan ekanligini isbotlamaydi.
sample_test_questions.strategy: SAT strategiyasi: "Command of Evidence" savollari uchun causation vs correlation (sababiyat va bog'liqlik) ni farqlang. To'g'ri dalil boshqa omillarni istisno qilishi va to'g'ridan-to'g'ri sababiy bog'lanishni ko'rsatishi kerak. B va C variantlardagi kabi "alternative explanations" (muqobil tushuntirishlar) dan ehtiyot bo'ling - bular noto'g'ri javoblar bo'lishi mumkin.

sample_test_questions.passage: Artist Frida Kahlo produced approximately 200 paintings during her lifetime, of which 55 are self-portraits. In letters to friends, Kahlo explained that she painted herself because she was often alone and because she was the subject she knew best. While many critics have interpreted her self-portraits as purely autobiographical expressions of physical and emotional pain, recent scholarship suggests a more complex reading. Kahlo deliberately incorporated symbols from Mexican indigenous culture and challenged European artistic conventions, positioning herself within a broader cultural and political context rather than simply recording personal experience.
sample_test_questions.question: Based on the text, what can most reasonably be inferred about recent scholarly interpretations of Kahlo's self-portraits?

options.text: They reject the idea that Kahlo's personal experiences influenced her artwork.
They recognize dimensions of Kahlo's work beyond personal autobiography, including cultural and political commentary.
They argue that Kahlo was primarily interested in European artistic traditions rather than Mexican culture.
They suggest that Kahlo's letters to friends provide an incomplete account of her artistic motivations.

sample_test_questions.explanation: To'g'ri javob B. Matnda "recent scholarship suggests a more complex reading" (so'nggi tadqiqotlar murakkabroq talqinni taklif qiladi) deyiladi va Kahloning o'z-o'zidan portretlarini nafaqat shaxsiy avtobiografik iboralar sifatida, balki Meksika madaniyati ramzlarini va Yevropa an'analariga qarshi chiqishni o'z ichiga olgan keng madaniy va siyosiy kontekstda ko'rish kerakligi ta'kidlanadi. A variant noto'g'ri, chunki yangi talqinlar shaxsiy tajribani inkor etmaydi, balki "qo'shimcha" jihatlarni qo'shadi. C variant matn ma'nosiga zid - Kahlo Yevropa an'analariga "qarshi chiqdi", ularni qabul qilmadi. D variant matnda aytilmagan - xatlarda nima yozilgani to'g'risida baholash berilmagan.
sample_test_questions.strategy: SAT strategiyasi: "Inference" (xulosa chiqarish) savollari uchun matnda bevosita aytilmagan, lekin mantiqan kelib chiqadigan narsani toping. Haddan tashqari katta xulosa chiqarmang. "More complex" (murakkabroq) so'zi kalit - bu eskiroq qarash (faqat avtobiografik) hali ham to'g'ri, lekin to'liq emas degan ma'noni anglatadi. "Rather than simply" (oddiy ravishda emas) iborasi qo'shimcha qatlamlarni ko'rsatadi.

sample_test_questions.passage: The conference will address three critical topics______climate change mitigation strategies, renewable energy infrastructure, and international policy coordination.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
sample_test_questions.explanation: To'g'ri javob A. Colon (:) ishlatiladi, chunki undan keyin ro'yxat keladi va ro'yxat oldingi gapni tushuntiradi yoki kengaytiradi. "Three critical topics" so'zidan keyin o'sha mavzular sanab o'tiladi. B variant (vergul) noto'g'ri, chunki oddiy vergul ro'yxatni kiritish uchun yetarli emas - ro'yxatni kiritadigan so'zlar ("such as", "including") bo'lishi kerak yoki colon ishlatilishi kerak. C variant (nuqtali vergul) noto'g'ri, chunki semicolon ikkita mustaqil gapni ajratish uchun ishlatiladi, ro'yxatni kiritish uchun emas. D variant (tire) mumkin, lekin colon ro'yxatlarni kiritish uchun standart va rasmiyroq tanlov.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Grammatika qoidasi (O'zbek tilida): Colon (:) ishlatish qoidalari: 1) Ro'yxatni kiritishdan oldin ("three topics:" singari so'zlar bo'lsa). 2) Tushuntirishni kiritishda. 3) Colondan oldin to'liq gap (independent clause) bo'lishi shart. SAT da colondan oldin "following", "these", "this" singari so'zlar bo'lsa, colon ishlatish to'g'ri ekanligini bilib oling. Agar siz ro'yxatni ko'rsangiz va undan oldin ro'yxatni tanishtiruvchi so'zlar bo'lsa ("three topics"), colon tanlang.

sample_test_questions.passage: The research team, which includes scientists from twelve countries, ______ planning to publish their findings next month.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
sample_test_questions.explanation: To'g'ri javob B. Subject "the research team" birlik (singular) otdir, shuning uchun "is" fe'li kerak. "Which includes scientists from twelve countries" qismi faqat qo'shimcha ma'lumot beruvchi relative clause (bog'lovchi ergash gap) bo'lib, u asosiy fe'lga ta'sir qilmaydi. Ko'p talabalar "scientists" so'ziga aldanib, ko'plik fe'l (are) tanlaydilar, lekin asosiy subject "team" (birlik). A variant (are) noto'g'ri, chunki "team" birlik. C variant (were) noto'g'ri, chunki zamon noto'g'ri - "next month" kelajakni ko'rsatadi, shuning uchun hozirgi zamon kerak. D variant (have been) noto'g'ri, chunki birlik subject bilan mos kelmaydi.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Grammatika qoidasi (O'zbek tilida): Subject-Verb Agreement (Kesim va ega mosligi). 1) Vergullar orasidagi so'zlarni o'chirib tashlang - bu sizga asosiy subjectni topishga yordam beradi. 2) Collective nouns (team, committee, group, class) odatda birlik hisoblanadi. 3) "Which", "who", "that" bilan boshlanadigan qismlar asosiy fe'lga ta'sir qilmaydi. SAT hack: Gapni soddalashtiring - "The team __ planning" - endi javob ravshan.

sample_test_questions.passage: Solar panels have become increasingly affordable over the past decade, with costs dropping by more than 80%. ______ many homeowners still hesitate to install them due to concerns about long-term maintenance and efficiency in cloudy climates.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
sample_test_questions.explanation: To'g'ri javob C. "Nevertheless" (shunga qaramay) kontrastni ko'rsatadi. Birinchi gapda ijobiy narsa (narxlar tushdi) aytiladi, ikkinchi gapda salbiy haqiqat (odamlar hali ham o'rnatishdan tortinishadi) keladi - bu qarama-qarshilikdir. A variant (Furthermore - bundan tashqari) noto'g'ri, chunki u qo'shimcha ijobiy ma'lumot qo'shish uchun ishlatiladi, kontrast uchun emas. B variant (Consequently - natijada) noto'g'ri, chunki ikkinchi gap birinchi gapning natijasi emas - aksincha, kutilmagan vaziyat. D variant (For instance - masalan) noto'g'ri, chunki ikkinchi gap misol emas, balki ziddiyatli haqiqatdir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Transition strategiyasi (O'zbek tilida): Ikki gapning munosabatini aniqlang. 1) Bir xil yo'nalish = Furthermore, Additionally, Moreover. 2) Kontrast/Qarama-qarshilik = Nevertheless, However, In contrast. 3) Sabab-natija = Consequently, Therefore, Thus. 4) Misol = For instance, For example. SAT hack: Agar birinchi gap ijobiy, ikkinchi gap salbiy (yoki aksincha) bo'lsa, kontrast transition kerak (Nevertheless, However).

sample_test_questions.passage:
While researching the history of jazz music, a student took the following notes:

• Jazz originated in New Orleans in the early 1900s, blending African rhythms with European harmonic structures.
• Louis Armstrong pioneered the solo improvisation style in the 1920s.
• Duke Ellington composed over 1,000 pieces and led his orchestra for 50 years.
• Both Armstrong and Ellington transformed jazz from entertainment music into a respected art form.
• Armstrong was known primarily as a performer, while Ellington was known as both a composer and bandleader.

The student wants to emphasize a difference between Armstrong's and Ellington's contributions to jazz. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.text: Both Louis Armstrong and Duke Ellington transformed jazz from entertainment music into a respected art form in the early twentieth century.
While Armstrong pioneered solo improvisation and was known primarily as a performer, Ellington composed over 1,000 pieces and was known as both a composer and bandleader.
Jazz music originated in New Orleans, where Louis Armstrong and Duke Ellington both contributed to the genre's development.
Duke Ellington led his orchestra for 50 years and composed over 1,000 pieces of music.

sample_test_questions.explanation: To'g'ri javob B. Talaba maqsadi Armstrongning va Ellingtonning jazz musiqasiga qo'shgan hissalari orasidagi farqni ta'kidlash edi. B variant bu maqsadni to'liq amalga oshiradi: Armstrong solo improvizatsiya uslubini yaratgan va asosan ijrochi sifatida tanilgan, Ellington esa 1000 dan ortiq asar yaratgan va bastakor hamda orkestr rahbari sifatida tanilgan. "While" so'zi kontrastni aniq ko'rsatadi. A variant noto'g'ri, chunki u o'xshashlikni ta'kidlaydi, farqni emas. C variant noto'g'ri, chunki u umumiy ma'lumot beradi va farqni ko'rsatmaydi. D variant noto'g'ri, chunki u faqat Ellington haqida gap qiladi, taqqoslash yo'q.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Rhetorical Synthesis strategiyasi (O'zbek tilida): 1) Savoldagi maqsadni aniq o'qing ("emphasize a difference" - farqni ta'kidlash). 2) Notes (eslatmalar) dan faqat shu maqsadga mos keladigan ma'lumotlarni toping. 3) Kontrast so'zlarini ("while", "whereas", "unlike") qidirib toping - ular odatda farqni ko'rsatishda ishlatiladi. 4) Har ikkala kishini ham eslatib o'tadigan va ularning farqini aniq ko'rsatadigan variantni tanlang.

sample_test_questions.passage: The diplomat's speech, though ostensibly conciliatory in tone, contained several veiled references that astute observers recognized as thinly disguised criticisms of the opposing delegation's recent actions.
sample_test_questions.question: As used in the text, what does the word "ostensibly" most nearly mean?
sample_test_questions.explanation: To'g'ri javob A. "Ostensibly" so'zi "ko'rinishida, zohirda, go'yoki" degan ma'noni anglatadi va "apparently" (ko'rinib turibdiki) bilan sinonimdir. Kontekstda diplomat nutqi zohirda tinchlik taklif qilayotgandek tuyuldi (conciliatory), lekin aslida tanqid edi - bu "ostensibly" so'zining ma'nosini tasdiqlaydi: tashqi ko'rinish va ichki haqiqat o'rtasidagi farq. B variant (Secretly - yashirin) noto'g'ri, chunki "ostensibly" yashirinlikni emas, balki tashqi ko'rinishni bildiradi. C variant (Aggressively - tajovuzkor) kontekstga zid - "conciliatory" tinchlik taklif qiluvchi demak. D variant (Deliberately - qasddan) mumkin tuyuladi, lekin "ostensibly" niyat haqida emas, balki tashqi ko'rinish haqida.
sample_test_questions.strategy: SAT strategiyasi: "Ostensibly" so'zi ko'pincha "aslida boshqacha, lekin ko'rinishida shunday" ma'nosini anglatadi. Kontekstda "though" va "thinly disguised" (yupqa niqob ostidagi) iboralari paradoksni ko'rsatadi - bu "ostensibly" so'zining ma'nosini tushunishga yordam beradi. So'zning ildiziga e'tibor bering: "ostensible" = "apparent" (ko'rinadigan).

sample_test_questions.passage: Honeybees perform a "waggle dance" to communicate the location of food sources to other members of the hive. The angle of the dance relative to the vertical indicates the direction of the food source relative to the sun, while the duration of the waggle portion correlates with the distance. Researchers have found that bees are more likely to perform the dance for high-quality food sources, such as those with high sugar concentrations, than for lower-quality sources.
sample_test_questions.question: Based on the text, what can most reasonably be inferred about the waggle dance?

options.text: It is performed only when food sources are located far from the hive.
It conveys information about both the location and quality of food sources.
It is more effective at communicating direction than distance.
It requires bees to have memorized the position of the sun throughout the day.

sample_test_questions.explanation: To'g'ri javob B. Matnda ikkita ma'lumot berilgan: 1) Raqsning burchagi va davomiyligi oziq-ovqat manbaining joylashuvi (yo'nalish va masofa) haqida ma'lumot beradi. 2) Asalarilar yuqori sifatli oziq-ovqat (yuqori shakar konsentratsiyasi) uchun raqsni ko'proq ijro etadilar. Bu ikki ma'lumotni birlashtirish orqali xulosa chiqarish mumkin: raqsning ikkita funktsiyasi bor - joylashuv va sifat haqida ma'lumot berish. A variant noto'g'ri, chunki matnda faqat uzoq masofalar haqida emas, balki har qanday masofa haqida gap boradi. C variant noto'g'ri, chunki matnda qaysi ma'lumot samaraliroq ekanligi aytilmagan. D variant noto'g'ri, chunki quyosh pozitsiyasini eslab qolish haqida hech narsa aytilmagan.
sample_test_questions.strategy: SAT strategiyasi: Inference (xulosa) savollari uchun matnda aytilgan ma'lumotlarni birlashtiring, lekin yangi ma'lumot qo'shmang. Bu yerda ikkita fakt: 1) raqsning yo'nalish/masofa komponenti, 2) yuqori sifatli oziq-ovqat uchun ko'proq raqslash. Bu ikki faktni birlashtiring: raqsning joylashuv VA sifat funktsiyasi bor. "Only" (faqat), "always" (har doim) kabi haddan tashqari so'zlar mavjud javoblardan ehtiyot bo'ling.

sample_test_questions.passage: The renovation project was completed on time______the contractors worked evenings and weekends to meet the deadline.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
sample_test_questions.explanation: To'g'ri javob B (nuqtali vergul ;). Bu yerda ikkita mustaqil gap (independent clauses) bir-biri bilan bog'lanmoqda. Birinchi gap: "The renovation project was completed on time" (to'liq gap). Ikkinchi gap: "the contractors worked evenings and weekends to meet the deadline" (to'liq gap). Ikkita mustaqil gapni bog'lash uchun nuqtali vergul (semicolon) yoki koordinatsion bog'lovchi (and, but, so) + vergul ishlatiladi. Bu yerda bog'lovchi yo'q, shuning uchun nuqtali vergul kerak. A variant (vergul) noto'g'ri, chunki bu "comma splice" xatosiga olib keladi - ikkita mustaqil gapni oddiy vergul bilan bog'lab bo'lmaydi. C variant (colon) noto'g'ri, chunki colon tushuntirish yoki ro'yxat uchun ishlatiladi, ikkinchi mustaqil gapni kiritish uchun emas. D variant (tire) mumkin, lekin semicolon standart va to'g'riroq tanlov.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Grammatika qoidasi (O'zbek tilida): Ikkita mustaqil gap (har biri o'z-o'zidan to'liq ma'noga ega) ni bog'lash usullari: 1) Nuqta (.). 2) Nuqtali vergul (;). 3) Vergul + bog'lovchi (, and / , but / , so). 4) Tire (—) ba'zi hollarda. SAT hack: Agar ikkita gap ham to'liq bo'lsa va bog'lovchi yo'q bo'lsa, semicolon tanlang. Har bir gapni alohida o'qib, to'liq-to'liqligini tekshiring.

sample_test_questions.question: In the xy-plane, the equation x^2 + y^2 + 6x - 14y - 42 = 0 defines a circle. What is the radius of the circle?
sample_test_questions.explanation: To'la kvadratga ajratamiz: (x^2 + 6x + 9) + (y^2 - 14y + 49) = 42 + 9 + 49. (x + 3)^2 + (y - 7)^2 = 100. Standart tenglama (x - h)^2 + (y - k)^2 = r^2 bo'lgani uchun r^2 = 100 => r = 10. To'g'ri javob: A (10). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (100) — r^2 ni radius deb adashish klassik tuzog'i; C (7) — markazning y koordinatasi; D (14) — y koeffitsiyenti bilan adashtirishdagi xato variant.

sample_test_questions.question: How many integers satisfy the absolute value inequality |2x - 5| <= 9?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Tengsizlikni ochamiz: -9 <= 2x - 5 <= 9. Har bir tomonga 5 qo'shamiz: -4 <= 2x <= 14. 2 ga bo'lamiz: -2 <= x <= 7. Butun sonlar: -2, -1, 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7. Jami butun sonlar miqdori: 7 - (-2) + 1 = 10 ta. To'g'ri javob: A (10). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (9) — oxirgi 1 ni qo'shishni unutib 7 - (-2) = 9 deb qoldirish tuzog'i; C (8) va D (11) — sanashdagi adashish natijasidagi xato variantlar.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ BUTUN SONLARNI SANASH: [a, b] oralig'idagi butun sonlar soni = b - a + 1. 7 - (-2) + 1 = 10 ta!

sample_test_questions.question: If 4x + 12 = 36, what is the value of 2x + 6?
sample_test_questions.explanation: 2x + 6 ifodani 4x + 12 bilan solishtiramiz: 4x + 12 = 2(2x + 6). Demak 2(2x + 6) = 36 bo'lsa, 2x + 6 = 36 / 2 = 18. To'g'ri javob: A (18). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (6) — x ning qiymatini topib (x = 6) adashib belgilash klassik SAT tuzog'i; C (12) — 2x ning qiymati; D (24) — 36 dan 12 ni ayirib qo'yishdagi xato variant.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ SAT TUZOG'I: Savol x ni emas, 2x + 6 ni so'ragan. 4x+12 ni 2 ga bo'lsangiz 18 chiqadi!

sample_test_questions.question: A bakery sells custom gift boxes containing chocolate cookies and almond biscotti. Chocolate cookies cost \.50 each and almond biscotti cost \.00 each. A customer purchases a total of 18 items and spends exactly \.00. How many chocolate cookies did the customer purchase?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Chiziqli tenglamalar sistemasi tuzamiz: c — shokoladli pechenyelar soni, b — biskotti soni. 1) Jami mahsulotlar: c + b = 18 => b = 18 - c. 2) Jami summa: 2.50c + 3.00b = 49.00. Ikkinchi tenglamaga b ning ifodasini qo'yamiz: 2.50c + 3.00(18 - c) = 49 => 2.50c + 54 - 3.00c = 49 => -0.50c = -5 => c = 10 ta shokoladli pechenye. To'g'ri javob: A (10). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (8) — biskotti sonini (b = 8) belgilab qo'yish klassik tuzog'i; C (12) va D (6) — hisoblashdagi xato variantlardir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ DESMOS USULI: Desmosga x + y = 18 va 2.5x + 3y = 49 tenglamalarini yozing. Kesishish nuqtasi (10, 8). x = 10 darhol chiqadi!

sample_test_questions.question: What is the set of all real solutions to the radical equation sqrt(2x + 15) = x?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Ikkala tomonni kvadratga ko'taramiz: 2x + 15 = x^2 => x^2 - 2x - 15 = 0 => (x - 5)(x + 3) = 0. Nomzodlar: x = 5 va x = -3. Tekshiramiz: 1) x = 5: sqrt(25) = 5 to'g'ri. 2) x = -3: sqrt(9) = 3 != -3 (chet ildiz, noto'g'ri). Shuning uchun yagona haqiqiy yechim {5}. To'g'ri javob: A ({5}). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B ({-3, 5}) — chet ildizni tekshirmasdan belgilashdagi eng xavfli tuzoq; C ({-3}) — faqat chet ildizni olish xatosi; D — haqiqiy yechim yo'q deb noto'g'ri xulosa chiqarish.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ KVADRAT ILDIZ QOIDASI: Tenglamaning o'ng tomoni x bo'lgani uchun x >= 0 bo'lishi shart! Manfiy x = -3 avtomatik bekor bo'ladi.

sample_test_questions.question: To'pning t soniyadagi yerdan balandligi h(t) = -5t² + 20t + 2 (metr) funksiya bilan modellashtiriladi. To'p erishadigan maksimal balandlik necha metr?
sample_test_questions.explanation:
Parabolaning cho'qqisi (vertex) vaqti: t = -b / (2a) = -20 / (2 * (-5)) = 2 soniya.
Maksimal balandlik: h(2) = -5(2)² + 20(2) + 2 = -20 + 40 + 2 = 22 metr.
B variant (20) — tezlik yoki vaqt bilan adashtiruvchi chalg'ituvchidir.
sample_test_questions.strategy:
⚡ DESMOS HACK (5 soniya):
Desmosga y = -5x^2 + 20x + 2 ni yozing. Parabolaning cho'qqi nuqtasini bosing: (2, 22). y qiymati = 22 — bu maksimal balandlik!

sample_test_questions.question: Which of the following is equivalent to the expression (4x^2 - 9) / (2x^2 + 5x - 12) for all values of x where the expression is defined?
sample_test_questions.explanation:
Surat va maxrajni ko'paytuvchilarga ajratamiz:
Surat: 4x^2 - 9 = (2x - 3)(2x + 3) (kvadratlar ayirmasi).
Maxraj: 2x^2 + 5x - 12 = 2x^2 + 8x - 3x - 12 = 2x(x + 4) - 3(x + 4) = (2x - 3)(x + 4).
Kasrni qisqartiramiz: (2x - 3)(2x + 3) / [(2x - 3)(x + 4)] = (2x + 3) / (x + 4)... To'xtang! Suratda (2x+3) qoladi, lekin variantlarga qarasak A da (2x - 3)/(x + 4) yoki B da (2x + 3)/(x + 4). Keling aniq ko'paytiramiz: agar surat (2x-3)(2x+3) bo'lsa va maxrajda (2x-3)(x+4) bo'lsa, qisqargach (2x+3)/(x+4) qoladi. Demak to'g'ri javob B!
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ DESMOS TEST-NUMBER: x ga ixtiyoriy son bering (masalan x = 5). Asl ifoda: (100-9)/(50+25-12) = 91/63 = 13/9 ≈ 1.444. B varianti: (2*5+3)/(5+4) = 13/9 ≈ 1.444. Aniq va xatosiz tekshiruv!

sample_test_questions.question: A vehicle travels at a constant speed of 60 miles per hour. What is the vehicle's speed in feet per second? (1 mile = 5,280 feet, 1 hour = 3,600 seconds)
sample_test_questions.explanation: Birliklarni bosqichma-bosqich o'zgartiramiz: Tezlik = 60 mil / soat = (60 * 5,280 fut) / (3,600 soniya) = 316,800 / 3,600 = 88 fut/soniya. To'g'ri javob: A (88). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (60) — o'zgarishsiz qoldirish xatosi; C (120) va D (44) — ko'paytirish va bo'lishdagi xato hisob-kitoblarga asoslangan chalg'ituvchi variantlar.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ BIRLIK KO'PAYTUVCHISI: 60 mil/soat * (5280 / 3600) = 60 * (22 / 15) = 4 * 22 = 88 fut/soniya.

sample_test_questions.question: A laboratory culture of bacteria doubles in population every 6 hours. If the initial population is 500 bacteria, which function P(t) models the population after t hours?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Eksponensial o'sish formulasi: P(t) = P0 * (asos)^(t / davr). Bu yerda P0 = 500, ikki barobar ortish asosi = 2, davri = 6 soat. Funksiya: P(t) = 500 * (2)^(t/6). To'g'ri javob: A. Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B — davrni darajaga ko'paytirib qo'yish tuzog'i; C — kamayish (0.5) formulasini qo'llash xatosi; D — boshlang'ich sonni adashtirishdagi xato variant.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ QIYMAT TEKSHIRISH: t = 6 soatda populyatsiya ikki barobar (1000) bo'lishi kerak. A da: 500 * 2^(6/6) = 1000 to'g'ri chiqadi!

sample_test_questions.question: Maktabdagi 200 nafar o'quvchi o'rtasida o'tkazilgan so'rovnomada 120 nafari sport to'garagiga, 80 nafari musiqa to'garagiga a'zo ekanligi ma'lum bo'ldi. Har ikkala to'garakka qatnashadigan o'quvchilar soni 30 nafar. Tasodifiy tanlangan sport to'garagi a'zosining ayni paytda musiqa to'garagiga ham qatnashishi ehtimolligi (conditional probability) nechaga teng?
sample_test_questions.explanation:
Shartli ehtimollik: P(Musiqa | Sport) = n(Sport va Musiqa) / n(Sport).
Diqqat: jami 200 nafar emas, tanlangan o'quvchi 'sport to'garagi a'zosi' ekanligi oldindan ma'lum!
Demak maxraj: 120.
Surat: 30.
Ehtimollik = 30 / 120 = 1/4 = 0.25 (25%).
B variant (3/20 = 30/200) — savol shartini o'qimay barcha o'quvchilarga nisbatan hisoblaganlar uchun tuzoq!
sample_test_questions.strategy:
🎯 SAT TAKTIKASI:
'Given that' yoki 'Tasodifiy tanlangan [Guruh] a'zosining...' deyilganda, umumiy o'quvchilar soni (200) bekor bo'ladi. Yangi maxraj faqat o'sha guruh (120) bo'ladi: 30 / 120 = 1/4!

sat_mocks.title: Digital SAT Mock #3: Official Bluebook Test 3

sample_test_questions.passage: The diplomat's speech, though ostensibly conciliatory in tone, contained several veiled references that astute observers recognized as thinly disguised criticisms of the opposing delegation's recent actions.
sample_test_questions.question: As used in the text, what does the word "ostensibly" most nearly mean?
sample_test_questions.explanation: To'g'ri javob A. "Ostensibly" so'zi "ko'rinishida, zohirda, go'yoki" degan ma'noni anglatadi va "apparently" (ko'rinib turibdiki) bilan sinonimdir. Kontekstda diplomat nutqi zohirda tinchlik taklif qilayotgandek tuyuldi (conciliatory), lekin aslida tanqid edi - bu "ostensibly" so'zining ma'nosini tasdiqlaydi: tashqi ko'rinish va ichki haqiqat o'rtasidagi farq. B variant (Secretly - yashirin) noto'g'ri, chunki "ostensibly" yashirinlikni emas, balki tashqi ko'rinishni bildiradi. C variant (Aggressively - tajovuzkor) kontekstga zid - "conciliatory" tinchlik taklif qiluvchi demak. D variant (Deliberately - qasddan) mumkin tuyuladi, lekin "ostensibly" niyat haqida emas, balki tashqi ko'rinish haqida.
sample_test_questions.strategy: SAT strategiyasi: "Ostensibly" so'zi ko'pincha "aslida boshqacha, lekin ko'rinishida shunday" ma'nosini anglatadi. Kontekstda "though" va "thinly disguised" (yupqa niqob ostidagi) iboralari paradoksni ko'rsatadi - bu "ostensibly" so'zining ma'nosini tushunishga yordam beradi. So'zning ildiziga e'tibor bering: "ostensible" = "apparent" (ko'rinadigan).

sample_test_questions.passage: Honeybees perform a "waggle dance" to communicate the location of food sources to other members of the hive. The angle of the dance relative to the vertical indicates the direction of the food source relative to the sun, while the duration of the waggle portion correlates with the distance. Researchers have found that bees are more likely to perform the dance for high-quality food sources, such as those with high sugar concentrations, than for lower-quality sources.
sample_test_questions.question: Based on the text, what can most reasonably be inferred about the waggle dance?

options.text: It is performed only when food sources are located far from the hive.
It conveys information about both the location and quality of food sources.
It is more effective at communicating direction than distance.
It requires bees to have memorized the position of the sun throughout the day.

sample_test_questions.explanation: To'g'ri javob B. Matnda ikkita ma'lumot berilgan: 1) Raqsning burchagi va davomiyligi oziq-ovqat manbaining joylashuvi (yo'nalish va masofa) haqida ma'lumot beradi. 2) Asalarilar yuqori sifatli oziq-ovqat (yuqori shakar konsentratsiyasi) uchun raqsni ko'proq ijro etadilar. Bu ikki ma'lumotni birlashtirish orqali xulosa chiqarish mumkin: raqsning ikkita funktsiyasi bor - joylashuv va sifat haqida ma'lumot berish. A variant noto'g'ri, chunki matnda faqat uzoq masofalar haqida emas, balki har qanday masofa haqida gap boradi. C variant noto'g'ri, chunki matnda qaysi ma'lumot samaraliroq ekanligi aytilmagan. D variant noto'g'ri, chunki quyosh pozitsiyasini eslab qolish haqida hech narsa aytilmagan.
sample_test_questions.strategy: SAT strategiyasi: Inference (xulosa) savollari uchun matnda aytilgan ma'lumotlarni birlashtiring, lekin yangi ma'lumot qo'shmang. Bu yerda ikkita fakt: 1) raqsning yo'nalish/masofa komponenti, 2) yuqori sifatli oziq-ovqat uchun ko'proq raqslash. Bu ikki faktni birlashtiring: raqsning joylashuv VA sifat funktsiyasi bor. "Only" (faqat), "always" (har doim) kabi haddan tashqari so'zlar mavjud javoblardan ehtiyot bo'ling.

sample_test_questions.passage: The renovation project was completed on time______the contractors worked evenings and weekends to meet the deadline.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
sample_test_questions.explanation: To'g'ri javob B (nuqtali vergul ;). Bu yerda ikkita mustaqil gap (independent clauses) bir-biri bilan bog'lanmoqda. Birinchi gap: "The renovation project was completed on time" (to'liq gap). Ikkinchi gap: "the contractors worked evenings and weekends to meet the deadline" (to'liq gap). Ikkita mustaqil gapni bog'lash uchun nuqtali vergul (semicolon) yoki koordinatsion bog'lovchi (and, but, so) + vergul ishlatiladi. Bu yerda bog'lovchi yo'q, shuning uchun nuqtali vergul kerak. A variant (vergul) noto'g'ri, chunki bu "comma splice" xatosiga olib keladi - ikkita mustaqil gapni oddiy vergul bilan bog'lab bo'lmaydi. C variant (colon) noto'g'ri, chunki colon tushuntirish yoki ro'yxat uchun ishlatiladi, ikkinchi mustaqil gapni kiritish uchun emas. D variant (tire) mumkin, lekin semicolon standart va to'g'riroq tanlov.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Grammatika qoidasi (O'zbek tilida): Ikkita mustaqil gap (har biri o'z-o'zidan to'liq ma'noga ega) ni bog'lash usullari: 1) Nuqta (.). 2) Nuqtali vergul (;). 3) Vergul + bog'lovchi (, and / , but / , so). 4) Tire (—) ba'zi hollarda. SAT hack: Agar ikkita gap ham to'liq bo'lsa va bog'lovchi yo'q bo'lsa, semicolon tanlang. Har bir gapni alohida o'qib, to'liq-to'liqligini tekshiring.

sample_test_questions.passage: Renewable energy sources like solar and wind power have become more cost-effective in recent years. ______ fossil fuel prices have remained relatively stable, making the transition to renewables economically competitive.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
sample_test_questions.explanation: To'g'ri javob B (Meanwhile - shu bilan birga, o'sha paytda). Birinchi gapda qayta tiklanuvchi energiya narxlari tushayotgani aytiladi. Ikkinchi gapda bir vaqtning o'zida fossil fuel (qazilma yoqilg'i) narxlari barqaror qolayotgani aytiladi - bu ikki hodisa parallel vaqtda sodir bo'layotganini ko'rsatadi. "Meanwhile" parallel voqealarni bog'laydi. A variant (In contrast) noto'g'ri, chunki ikki gap qarama-qarshi emas - ular bir-birini to'ldiradi. C variant (As a result) noto'g'ri, chunki fossil fuel narxlarining barqaror qolishi qayta tiklanuvchi energiya narxlarining tushishining natijasi emas - bu ikkita alohida trend. D variant (For example) noto'g'ri, chunki ikkinchi gap misol emas.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Transition strategiyasi (O'zbek tilida): "Meanwhile" bir vaqtning o'zida sodir bo'layotgan ikki hodisani bog'laydi. Bu yerda ikkala narx tendentsiyasi ham bir vaqtda sodir bo'lmoqda. SAT hack: Gaplarning vaqt munosabatini aniqlang. Agar ikki hodisa parallel vaqtda sodir bo'lsa, "Meanwhile", "At the same time" kabilar to'g'ri. Agar biri ikkinchisining natijasi bo'lsa, "Therefore", "Consequently" kabilar kerak.

sample_test_questions.passage: A study examined the relationship between study hours per week and final exam scores for 200 students. The data showed that students who studied 10-15 hours per week had an average exam score of 78, while students who studied 20-25 hours per week had an average score of 85. However, students who studied more than 30 hours per week had an average score of 82, suggesting a possible decrease in effectiveness beyond a certain threshold.
sample_test_questions.question: Which statement is best supported by the data presented?

options.text: Studying more hours always results in higher exam scores.
The relationship between study hours and exam scores is linear throughout all ranges.
There appears to be an optimal range of study hours for maximizing exam performance.
Students who study less than 10 hours per week perform better than those who study more than 30 hours.

sample_test_questions.explanation: To'g'ri javob C. Ma'lumotlarga ko'ra: 10-15 soat = 78 ball, 20-25 soat = 85 ball (oshish), 30+ soat = 82 ball (kamayish). Bu ma'lumotlar optimal o'qish soati diapazoni (20-25 soat) borligini ko'rsatadi - bu nuqtadan keyin natijalar yaxshilanmaydi, balki hatto pasayadi. A variant noto'g'ri, chunka "always" (har doim) so'zi juda kuchli - 30+ soat o'qigan talabalar kamroq o'qiganlardan past ball olganlar. B variant noto'g'ri, chunki munosabat chiziqli (linear) emas - 20-25 soatdan keyin ball pasayadi. D variant noto'g'ri, chunki 10 soatdan kam o'qiganlar haqida ma'lumot berilmagan.
sample_test_questions.strategy: SAT strategiyasi: Quantitative Evidence (miqdoriy dalil) savollari uchun barcha raqamlarni diqqat bilan o'qing va ularning trendini aniqlang. Bu yerda trend: oshadi (78 → 85), keyin kamayadi (85 → 82) - bu "inverted U" yoki "optimal point" (optimal nuqta) ni ko'rsatadi. "Always" yoki "never" kabi haddan tashqari so'zlar mavjud javoblardan ehtiyot bo'ling - ular odatda noto'g'ri.

sample_test_questions.passage: Neither the director nor the actors ______ satisfied with the final cut of the film.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
sample_test_questions.explanation: To'g'ri javob B (were). "Neither... nor..." konstruksiyasida fe'l ikkinchi subjectga mos kelishi kerak (proximity rule). Bu yerda ikkinchi subject "the actors" (ko'plik), shuning uchun ko'plik fe'l "were" kerak. Zamon o'tmish (past tense), chunki kontekst "final cut" (tayyor film) haqida - bu allaqachon tugallangan ish. A variant (was) noto'g'ri, chunki "actors" ko'plik. C va D variantlar (is, are) noto'g'ri, chunki ular hozirgi zamon, lekin kontekst o'tmish zamon talab qiladi.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Grammatika qoidasi (O'zbek tilida): "Neither... nor..." yoki "Either... or..." da Proximity Rule (yaqinlik qoidasi): fe'l ikkinchi subjectga mos keladi. Agar ikkinchi subject ko'plik bo'lsa, fe'l ko'plik; birlik bo'lsa, fe'l birlik. Zamonni kontekstdan aniqlang. SAT hack: "Neither... nor..." ni ko'rganingizda, ikkinchi subjectni toping va fe'lni shu subjectga moslang.

sample_test_questions.passage: Engineers designing off-grid electrical systems in remote mountainous villages opted against experimental solid-state batteries in favor of well-tested lead-acid cells. Although the older batteries offered lower energy density, the engineers prioritized a ______ solution that local technicians could readily repair and maintain without specialized tools.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Matn muhandislarning yangi va sinovdan o'tmagan batareyalar o'rniga, qishloq sharoitida oson ta'mirlanadigan amaliy va ishonchli yechimni tanlaganini tushuntiradi. 'Pragmatic' (amaliy, qulay va real hayotga mos) kontekstga to'liq mos tushadi. Visionary (xayoliy/ulkan), precarious (xatarli/beqaror), theoretical (nazariy) zid ma'no beradi. Qolgan variantlar esa matn mazmuniga yoki matematik qoidaga zid bo'lgan chalg'ituvchi (tuzoq) variantlardir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: 🎯 SAT TAKTIKASI: 'local technicians could readily repair and maintain without specialized tools' (mahalliy ustalar maxsus asboblarsiz oson ta'mirlay oladigan) degan izoh amaliy yondashuvni bildiradi. Shuning uchun 'pragmatic' eng to'g'ri tanlov.

sample_test_questions.passage: For decades, paleoclimatologists hypothesized that sudden volcanic super-eruptions triggered Pleistocene glaciation events. However, lacking high-resolution ice-core sulfate markers, researchers were unable to ______ their causal claims until advanced mass spectrometry became available.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Matnda tadqiqotchilar o'zlarining taxminlarini (claims) ilgari surgan bo'lsa-da, yetarli asbob-uskuna bo'lmagani sababli ularni dalillar bilan isbotlay olmaganliklari (unable to substantiate) aytiladi. 'Substantiate' dalillar bilan asoslamoq, isbotlamoq deganidir. Disseminate (tarqatmoq), relinquish (voz kechmoq), fabricate (to'qib chiqarmoq) mos kelmaydi. Qolgan variantlar esa matn mazmuniga yoki matematik qoidaga zid bo'lgan chalg'ituvchi (tuzoq) variantlardir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: 🎯 SAT TAKTIKASI: 'claims' (da'vo/nazariya) so'zi bilan birga 'substantiate' (dalil bilan tasdiqlash) tushunchasi College Board ning eng sevimli akademik juftligidir.

sample_test_questions.passage: Unlike perennial desert shrubs whose extensive taproots anchor them through years of severe drought, annual desert wildflowers exhibit a strictly ______ life cycle, germinating rapidly following sporadic winter rainstorms and withering within days after dispersing their seeds.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Matnda ko'p yillik o'simliklarga (perennial) qarama-qarshi o'laroq, sahro yovvoyi gullari yomg'irdan keyin tez o'sib, bir necha kunda urug'ini sochib qurib qolishi aytilgan. 'Ephemeral' juda qisqa muddatli, o'tkinchi deganidir. Interminable (cheksiz/tugamas), monolithic (bir butun/yaxlit), indomitable (yengilmas) ma'noga ziddir. Qolgan variantlar esa matn mazmuniga yoki matematik qoidaga zid bo'lgan chalg'ituvchi (tuzoq) variantlardir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: 🎯 SAT TAKTIKASI: 'Unlike perennial' (ko'p yillikdan farqli o'laroq) va 'withering within days' (bir necha kun ichida quriydigan) iboralariga e'tibor bering. Bular to'g'ridan-to'g'ri 'ephemeral' (qisqa umrli) so'zini talab qiladi.

sample_test_questions.passage: Before the discovery of hydrothermal vents in 1977, biological dogma asserted that all complex multicellular ecosystems ultimately depend upon photosynthetic solar energy. Deep-sea vent communities completely upended this assumption: surrounded by pitch-black, superheated mineral waters, giant tube worms and vent shrimp flourish without sunlight. Instead of utilizing chlorophyll, primary producers in these benthic communities rely upon chemosynthesis, oxidizing toxic hydrogen sulfide expelled from Earth's crust to synthesize organic carbon.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice best states the main idea of the text?

options.text: The discovery of hydrothermal vents proved that thriving ecosystems can be sustained through chemosynthesis without reliance on solar energy.
Photosynthesis is significantly more efficient than chemosynthesis in deep benthic marine environments.
Giant tube worms are the only marine organisms capable of surviving toxic concentrations of hydrogen sulfide.
Biological dogma accurately predicted the nutritional strategies of vent-dwelling shrimp prior to 1977.

sample_test_questions.explanation: Matnning asosiy g'oyasi: 1977-yilgacha barcha hayot quyosh nuri va fotosintezga tayanadi degan dogma mavjud edi, biroq gidrotermal manbalardagi ekotizim quyosh nurisiz, xemasintez hisobiga hayot kechira olishini isbotlab, bu qarashni tubdan o'zgartirdi (A variant). B matnda yo'q, C 'only organisms' deb xato umumlashtiradi, D esa dogma bashorat qilmaganini inkor qiladi.
sample_test_questions.strategy: 🎯 SAT TAKTIKASI: Asosiy g'oyani topishda 'upended this assumption' (bu qarashni ag'dar-to'ntar qildi) kabi o'zgarish jumlalariga qarang. Matn eski qarash va yangi kashfiyot o'rtasidagi farqni ko'rsatadi.

sample_test_questions.question: If 3x + 9 = 24, what is x?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Chiziqli tenglamani yechish: 3x + 9 = 24 => 3x = 15 => x = 5 (A to'g'ri). B (6), C (7) va D (8) hisoblash xatolariga asoslangan tuzoqlardir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ DESMOS USULI: 1-qator: y = 3x + 9; 2-qator: y = 24. Graflar kesishgan absissasi x = 5.

sample_test_questions.question: If 4(3x - 5) + 6 = 2(x + 8), what is the value of x?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Qadam-baqadam yechim: Qavslarni ochamiz: 12x - 20 + 6 = 2x + 16, ya'ni 12x - 14 = 2x + 16. O'xshash hadlarni birlashtirsak: 12x - 2x = 16 + 14 => 10x = 30 => x = 3. To'g'ri javob: A. B varianti (5) ishoralarni noto'g'ri ko'chirganda kelib chiqadi (xato). C va D variantlari arifmetik xatoliklar natijasida paydo bo'ladigan chalg'ituvchi variantlardir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Desmos hack: Chap tomonni y1 = 4(3x - 5) + 6 va o'ng tomonni y2 = 2(x + 8) deb kiriting. Ikki to'g'ri chiziqning kesishish nuqtasi x koordinatasini ko'ring: x = 3.

sample_test_questions.question: A line in the xy-plane has an x-intercept of (-6, 0) and a y-intercept of (0, 9). Which of the following is an equation of the line?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Qadam-baqadam tahlil: Nishab (slope) m = (9 - 0) / (0 - (-6)) = 9/6 = 3/2. Tenglama y = (3/2)x + 9 ko'rinishida bo'ladi. Ikkala tomonni 2 ga ko'paytirsak: 2y = 3x + 18. Hadlarni qayta joylashtirsak: 3x - 2y = -18 hosil bo'ladi. Shuning uchun to'g'ri javob A. B varianti noto'g'ri chunki unda nishab teskari (2/3) olingan. C va D variantlarida esa interceptlarning ishoralari xato qo'llangan.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Desmos hack: Berilgan 4 ta variantni birma-bir Desmosga kiriting va (-6, 0) hamda (0, 9) nuqtalardan qaysi to'g'ri chiziq o'tishini vizual tekshiring. Faqat A to'g'ri keladi.

sample_test_questions.question: The linear function f is defined by f(x) = cx + d, where c and d are constants. If f(2) = 11 and f(5) = 26, what is the value of f(-1)?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Qadam-baqadam yechim: Funksiya chiziqli bo'lgani uchun burchak koeffitsienti c = (26 - 11) / (5 - 2) = 15 / 3 = 5. Demak, f(x) = 5x + d. f(2) = 11 bo'lgani uchun 5(2) + d = 11 => d = 1. Funksiya formulasi: f(x) = 5x + 1. Endi f(-1) ni hisoblaymiz: f(-1) = 5(-1) + 1 = -5 + 1 = -4. To'g'ri javob: A. B varianti d ning qiymati bo'lib, x=-1 qo'yilmagan xato variant. C va D variantlari esa nishabni xato topganda kelib chiqadigan chalg'ituvchi javoblardir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Desmos hack: Desmosda jadval (table) yarating va (2, 11), (5, 26) nuqtalarni kiriting. Keyin y1 ~ m*x1 + b regressiyasini yozing. m=5, b=1 chiqadi. f(-1) = 5(-1)+1 = -4.

sample_test_questions.question: The system of equations 6x - 9y = 15 and 4x - ky = 7 has no solution. What is the value of the constant k?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Qadam-baqadam tahlil: Chiziqli tenglamalar sistemasi yechimga ega bo'lmasligi (no solution) uchun to'g'ri chiziqlar parallel bo'lishi, ya'ni x va y oldidagi koeffitsientlar nisbati teng bo'lib, ozod hadlar nisbatiga teng bo'lmasligi kerak: a1/a2 = b1/b2 != c1/c2. Demak, 6/4 = (-9)/(-k). 6/4 = 9/k => 6k = 36 => k = 6. Ozod hadlar nisbati 15/7 != 1.5 bo'lgani uchun sistema haqiqatan ham yechimga ega emas. To'g'ri javob: A. B varianti (-6) ishora xatosidan kelib chiqadi. C va D variantlari xato mutanosiblik olinganda paydo bo'ladi.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Desmos hack: Birinchi tenglama 6x - 9y = 15 ni kiriting. Ikkinchi qatorga 4x - ky = 7 ni yozib, k slayderini oching. Chiziqlar qachon parallel bo'lishini ko'ring: k = 6 da chiziqlar hech qachon kesishmaydi.

sample_test_questions.question: Which of the following points (x, y) is NOT a solution to the system of inequalities y > 2x - 3 and 3x + 2y <= 12?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Qadam-baqadam tekshirish: Har bir nuqtani tengsizliklar sistemasiga qo'yamiz. A varianti (3, 2): 1-tengsizlik: 2 > 2(3) - 3 => 2 > 3 (BU NOTO'G'RI, chunki 2 soni 3 dan katta emas!). Ikkinchi tengsizlik: 3(3) + 2(2) = 9 + 4 = 13 <= 12 ham yolg'on. Demak (3, 2) yechim emas va savol shartiga ko'ra to'g'ri javob A dir. B, C, D variantlaridagi nuqtalar har ikkala tengsizlikni qanoatlantiradi, shuning uchun ular xato javob hisoblanadi.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Desmos hack: Ikkala tengsizlikni Desmosga kiriting: y > 2x - 3 va 3x + 2y <= 12. So'ngra variantlardagi 4 ta nuqtani belgilang. Qaysi nuqta bo'yalgan umumiy maydondan tashqarida qolishini darhol ko'rasiz (3, 2).

sample_test_questions.question: In the system of equations 5x + py = 20 and 15x + 12y = q, the system has infinitely many solutions. What is the value of p + q?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Qadam-baqadam yechim: Sistemaning cheksiz ko'p yechimga ega bo'lishi (infinitely many solutions) uchun ikkala tenglama aynan bir xil to'g'ri chiziqni ifodalashi lozim: 15/5 = 12/p = q/20. 15/5 = 3 bo'lgani uchun: 12/p = 3 => p = 4. q/20 = 3 => q = 60. Bizdan p + q so'ralgan: p + q = 4 + 60 = 64. Shuning uchun to'g'ri javob A. B (56) va C (44) variantlari qo'shish yoki ko'paytirishdagi arifmetik xatolardan kelib chiqadi. D varianti (60) faqat q ning qiymati bo'lib, p qo'shilmagan tuzoqdir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Desmos hack: 15x + 12y = 60 ni chizing. Birinchi tenglamani 5x + py = 20 deb kiritib p=4 qilganda chiziqlar ustma-ust tushishini ko'rasiz. p=4, q=60 => 64.

sample_test_questions.question: A catering service charges a fixed delivery fee of $45 plus $18 per guest. If the total bill for an event was $765, how many guests were catered for?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Qadam-baqadam tahlil: Mehmonlar sonini g deb belgilaymiz. Umumiy xarajat tenglamasi: 18g + 45 = 765. Ikkala tomondan 45 ni ayiramiz: 18g = 720. g = 720 / 18 = 40. Demak 40 nafar mehmon bo'lgan. To'g'ri javob: A. B, C, D variantlari hisoblashda 45 ni ayirish o'rniga qo'shish yoki bo'lishdagi xatolar tufayli yuzaga keladigan noto'g'ri chalg'ituvchilardir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Desmos hack: Desmos qidiruv satriga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri (765 - 45) / 18 deb yozsangiz, javob 40 chiqadi.

sample_test_questions.question: A water tank originally contains 320 gallons of water. Water begins draining at a constant rate such that after 8 minutes, 248 gallons remain. In how many total minutes from the start will the tank be completely empty?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Qadam-baqadam tahlil: 8 daqiqada oqib ketgan suv miqdori: 320 - 248 = 72 gallon. Bir daqiqadagi oqish tezligi (rate of change): 72 / 8 = 9 gallon/daqiqa. Idish butunlay bo'shashi uchun barcha 320 gallon oqib ketishi kerak: t = 320 / 9 = 35.55... daqiqa (yoki 35 5/9 daqiqa). Shuning uchun to'g'ri javob A. B varianti (40) agar tezlik 8 gal/min deb yanglish hisoblansa chiqadigan noto'g'ri variant. C va D variantlari esa 248 ni 9 ga bo'lganda (qolgan vaqt) kelib chiqadigan chalg'ituvchi tuzoqlardir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Desmos hack: W(t) = 320 - 9t funksiyasini kiriting. X o'qi bilan kesishish nuqtasini bosing: (35.556, 0).

sample_test_questions.question: Which of the following is equivalent to the expression 16x^4 - 81y^2?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Qadam-baqadam yechim: Kvadratlar ayirmasi formulasi a^2 - b^2 = (a - b)(a + b). Bu yerda a = 4x^2, chunki (4x^2)^2 = 16x^4; b = 9y, chunki (9y)^2 = 81y^2. Shuning uchun ifoda (4x^2 - 9y)(4x^2 + 9y) ga teng. To'g'ri javob: A. B va C variantlarida ikkilangan ko'paytma (-72x^2*y) qolib ketadi (xato). D varianti esa to'g'ri ko'paytuvchilarga ajratilmagan.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Desmos hack: Asl ifodaga x=2, y=3 qo'yib hisoblang: 16(16) - 81(9) = 256 - 729 = -473. Variantlarga ham x=2, y=3 qo'ying. Faqat A varianti (16-27)(16+27) = (-11)(43) = -473 beradi.

sat_mocks.title: Digital SAT Mock #4: Official Bluebook Test 4

sample_test_questions.passage: For decades, paleoclimatologists hypothesized that sudden volcanic super-eruptions triggered Pleistocene glaciation events. However, lacking high-resolution ice-core sulfate markers, researchers were unable to ______ their causal claims until advanced mass spectrometry became available.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Matnda tadqiqotchilar o'zlarining taxminlarini (claims) ilgari surgan bo'lsa-da, yetarli asbob-uskuna bo'lmagani sababli ularni dalillar bilan isbotlay olmaganliklari (unable to substantiate) aytiladi. 'Substantiate' dalillar bilan asoslamoq, isbotlamoq deganidir. Disseminate (tarqatmoq), relinquish (voz kechmoq), fabricate (to'qib chiqarmoq) mos kelmaydi. Qolgan variantlar esa matn mazmuniga yoki matematik qoidaga zid bo'lgan chalg'ituvchi (tuzoq) variantlardir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: 🎯 SAT TAKTIKASI: 'claims' (da'vo/nazariya) so'zi bilan birga 'substantiate' (dalil bilan tasdiqlash) tushunchasi College Board ning eng sevimli akademik juftligidir.

sample_test_questions.passage: Unlike perennial desert shrubs whose extensive taproots anchor them through years of severe drought, annual desert wildflowers exhibit a strictly ______ life cycle, germinating rapidly following sporadic winter rainstorms and withering within days after dispersing their seeds.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Matnda ko'p yillik o'simliklarga (perennial) qarama-qarshi o'laroq, sahro yovvoyi gullari yomg'irdan keyin tez o'sib, bir necha kunda urug'ini sochib qurib qolishi aytilgan.
