'Ephemeral' juda qisqa muddatli, o'tkinchi deganidir. Interminable (cheksiz/tugamas), monolithic (bir butun/yaxlit), indomitable (yengilmas) ma'noga ziddir. Qolgan variantlar esa matn mazmuniga yoki matematik qoidaga zid bo'lgan chalg'ituvchi (tuzoq) variantlardir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: 🎯 SAT TAKTIKASI: 'Unlike perennial' (ko'p yillikdan farqli o'laroq) va 'withering within days' (bir necha kun ichida quriydigan) iboralariga e'tibor bering. Bular to'g'ridan-to'g'ri 'ephemeral' (qisqa umrli) so'zini talab qiladi.

sample_test_questions.passage: Before the discovery of hydrothermal vents in 1977, biological dogma asserted that all complex multicellular ecosystems ultimately depend upon photosynthetic solar energy. Deep-sea vent communities completely upended this assumption: surrounded by pitch-black, superheated mineral waters, giant tube worms and vent shrimp flourish without sunlight. Instead of utilizing chlorophyll, primary producers in these benthic communities rely upon chemosynthesis, oxidizing toxic hydrogen sulfide expelled from Earth's crust to synthesize organic carbon.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice best states the main idea of the text?

options.text: The discovery of hydrothermal vents proved that thriving ecosystems can be sustained through chemosynthesis without reliance on solar energy.
Photosynthesis is significantly more efficient than chemosynthesis in deep benthic marine environments.
Giant tube worms are the only marine organisms capable of surviving toxic concentrations of hydrogen sulfide.
Biological dogma accurately predicted the nutritional strategies of vent-dwelling shrimp prior to 1977.

sample_test_questions.explanation: Matnning asosiy g'oyasi: 1977-yilgacha barcha hayot quyosh nuri va fotosintezga tayanadi degan dogma mavjud edi, biroq gidrotermal manbalardagi ekotizim quyosh nurisiz, xemasintez hisobiga hayot kechira olishini isbotlab, bu qarashni tubdan o'zgartirdi (A variant). B matnda yo'q, C 'only organisms' deb xato umumlashtiradi, D esa dogma bashorat qilmaganini inkor qiladi.
sample_test_questions.strategy: 🎯 SAT TAKTIKASI: Asosiy g'oyani topishda 'upended this assumption' (bu qarashni ag'dar-to'ntar qildi) kabi o'zgarish jumlalariga qarang. Matn eski qarash va yangi kashfiyot o'rtasidagi farqni ko'rsatadi.

sample_test_questions.passage: Biologists investigating the nocturnal migratory orientation of European robins hypothesized that the birds detect Earth's magnetic field through quantum cryptochrome proteins located in their retinal photoreceptor cells. To test whether this magnetoreception is wavelength-dependent, researchers exposed migrating robins to artificial magnetic fields under various lighting conditions. They observed that the birds maintained precise migratory orientation under blue and green ambient light, but became entirely disoriented under yellow and red wavelengths.
sample_test_questions.question: Which finding, if true, would most directly support the researchers' hypothesis regarding retinal cryptochromes?

options.text: Retinal cryptochrome proteins are chemically activated and form radical pairs only when exposed to blue or green light spectra.
European robins migrate primarily during overcast nights when ambient moonlight is absorbed by cloud cover.
Robins deprived of food prior to migration exhibit reduced flight speeds regardless of ambient lighting.
Earth's magnetic field fluctuates in intensity depending on solar storm activity.

sample_test_questions.explanation: Tadqiqotchilar qushlarning ko'zidagi kriptoxrom oqsillari yorug'lik to'lqiniga bog'liq magnit sezuvchanlikni beradi deb taxmin qilishgan. Qushlar faqat ko'k va yashil nurlarda to'g'ri yo'nalish olgan. Agar A variant to'g'ri bo'lsa (kriptoxromlar aynan ko'k va yashil nurda kimyoviy faollashadi), bu tajriba natijasini biologik jihatdan 100% isbotlaydi. B, C, D esa gipotezani to'g'ridan-to'g'ri tasdiqlamaydi.
sample_test_questions.strategy: 🎯 SAT TAKTIKASI: Gipotezani qo'llab-quvvatlash uchun mexanizm (kriptoxrom oqsillari) va tajriba sharti (ko'k va yashil nur) o'rtasida to'g'ridan-to'g'ri sababiy bog'liqlik ko'rsatilgan variantni tanlang.

sample_test_questions.passage:
Text 1:
Proponents of neural machine translation argue that modern large language models have effectively conquered the language barrier. By parsing billions of multilingual sentence pairs, these systems generate syntactically flawless translations across technical, legal, and conversational domains with near-instantaneous speed.

Text 2:
While machine translation accurately matches semantic terminology, it repeatedly falters when confronting cultural subtext, satirical irony, and regional idioms. Human communication relies on an unspoken architecture of shared societal experience that statistical token prediction algorithms cannot truly comprehend.
sample_test_questions.question: Based on the texts, how would the author of Text 2 most likely respond to the claims made in Text 1?

options.text: By asserting that superficial syntactic precision does not equate to genuine comprehension of cultural nuances.
By agreeing that machine translation has completely eliminated the need for human professional linguists.
By demonstrating that language models cannot translate even basic technical manuals accurately.
By arguing that multilingual sentence datasets will soon solve the problem of satirical irony.

sample_test_questions.explanation: Text 1 sun'iy intellekt tarjimasining tezligi va sintaktik mukammalligini maqtaydi. Text 2 esa bunga e'tiroz bildirib, tashqi to'g'ri sintaksis insoniy madaniy kontekst va kinoyalarni tushunishga teng emasligini ta'kidlaydi (A variant). B va D Text 2 ga butunlay zid, C esa matnda aytilmagan (Text 2 texnik qo'llanmalarni tarjima qila olmaydi demagan).
sample_test_questions.strategy: 🎯 SAT TAKTIKASI: Ikki matnli savollarda birinchi matn ijobiy (proponents), ikkinchi matn esa cheklovni (while... repeatedly falters) ko'rsatadi. Har doim ikkinchi muallifning cheklovchi nuqtai nazariga e'tibor qarating.

sample_test_questions.passage: The James Webb Space Telescope—equipped with an infrared primary mirror spanning over twenty-one ______ has unveiled galaxies that formed less than four hundred million years after the Big Bang.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Gap o'rtasida qo'shimcha izoh (non-essential parenthetical element) birinchi tire (em dash) bilan ochilgan: 'The James Webb Space Telescope—equipped with...'. Juft tire qoidasiga ko'ra, tire bilan ochilgan oraliq izoh aynan ikkinchi tire bilan yopilishi shart: 'twenty-one feet—has unveiled...'. Tire bilan boshlanib vergul yoki nuqtali vergul bilan yopish grammatik xatodir.
sample_test_questions.strategy:
⚡ SAT GRAMMATIKA QOIDASI:
Juftlik qoidasi (Symmetry Rule): Agar kirish so'z tire (—) bilan ochilgan bo'lsa, uni faqat tire (—) bilan yopish kerak! Vergul yoki nuqtali vergul qo'yish taqiqlanadi.

sample_test_questions.passage: Archaeologists excavating the ruins of Pompeii uncovered a remarkable culinary ______ a remarkably preserved thermopolium counter displaying earthenware vessels containing traces of duck, pork, and snail stew.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
sample_test_questions.explanation: To'g'ri javob A (ikki nuqta / colon). Birinchi qism 'Archaeologists excavating the ruins of Pompeii uncovered a remarkable culinary artifact' — to'liq mustaqil gap (independent clause). Undan keyin esa o'sha artefaktning aynan nima ekanligini ochib beruvchi tushuntirish va misol kelmoqda. Mustaqil gapdan keyin tushuntirish berish uchun ikki nuqta (colon) qo'yiladi. Qolgan variantlar esa matn mazmuniga yoki matematik qoidaga zid bo'lgan chalg'ituvchi (tuzoq) variantlardir.
sample_test_questions.strategy:
⚡ SAT COLON QOIDASI:
Ikki nuqta (:) qo'yilishi uchun uning chap tomoni to'liq mustaqil gap bo'lishi, o'ng tomoni esa chapdagi tushunchani tushuntirishi yoki ro'yxat keltirishi shart!

sample_test_questions.passage: Having analyzed sediment cores extracted from the bed of Lake Titicaca, ______ that severe multi-decade droughts coincided precisely with the collapse of the Tiwanaku civilization.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

options.text: the conclusion reached by paleoclimatologists was

sample_test_questions.explanation: Dangling Modifier (osilib qolgan aniqlovchi) qoidasi: 'Having analyzed sediment cores...' (cho'kindi jinslarni tahlil qilgach...) deb boshlangan kirish qism harakatni kim bajarganini talab qiladi. Cho'kindilarni tahlil qilgan narsa 'xulosa' yoki 'qulash' emas, balki olimlar (paleoclimatologists)dir! Shuning uchun verguldan keyin darhol 'paleoclimatologists' kelishi shart (A variant).
sample_test_questions.strategy:
⚡ SAT MODIFIER HACK:
Gap '-ing' yoki '-ed' bilan boshlanganda, 'Bu ishni kim qildi?' deb so'rang. Tahlilni olimlar qilgan, demak verguldan keyin birinchi so'z olimlar (paleoclimatologists) bo'lishi shart!

sample_test_questions.passage: Traditional deterministic algorithms rely on explicit, programmer-written logic rules to process incoming data. ______ modern deep neural networks identify complex latent patterns autonomously through iterative exposure to massive training datasets.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Birinchi gap an'anaviy qat'iy dasturlash qoidalariga asoslanishini aytsa, ikkinchi gap neyron tarmoqlar qoidalarsiz o'zi mustaqil naqshlarni o'rganishini aytadi. Bu ikki tizim o'rtasidagi to'g'ridan-to'g'ri qarama-qarshilik (kontrast)dir. 'Conversely' (aksincha, aks holda) kontrastni bildiradi. Furthermore (qo'shimcha), For example (misol), Accordingly (mos ravishda) ma'noga to'g'ri kelmaydi. Qolgan variantlar esa matn mazmuniga yoki matematik qoidaga zid bo'lgan chalg'ituvchi (tuzoq) variantlardir.
sample_test_questions.strategy:
⚡ TRANSITION TAKTIKASI:
Ikki gap bir-biriga zidmi yoki bir-birini tasdiqlayaptimi? An'anaviy qoidalar VS O'z-o'zidan o'rganuvchi AI = Kontrast! Javob: Conversely (yoki However, In contrast).

sample_test_questions.passage: Extreme weather events have inflicted severe disruptions on global maritime supply chains over the past year. ______ persistent low water levels in the Panama Canal forced maritime authorities to reduce daily vessel transit slots by more than thirty percent.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Birinchi gapda umumiy muammo ('extreme weather disruptions on global supply chains') aytiladi. Ikkinchi gapda esa ushbu umumiy holatning aniq bitta misoli — Panama kanalidagi suv sathi pasayishi keltiriladi. Umumiydan xususiyga o'tishda 'Specifically' (xususan, aniqrog'i) eng mos bog'lovchidir. Nevertheless (shunga qaramay) va In comparison (taqqoslaganda) noo'rin. Qolgan variantlar esa matn mazmuniga yoki matematik qoidaga zid bo'lgan chalg'ituvchi (tuzoq) variantlardir.
sample_test_questions.strategy:
⚡ SAT TRANSITION QOIDASI:
Umumiy fakt ➔ Aniq hodisa (Panama kanali). Umumiy fikrdan aniq voqeaga tushilganda har doim 'Specifically' yoki 'For instance' tanlanadi.

sample_test_questions.question: The graphs of y = x^2 - 6x + 11 and y = 2x - 4 intersect at points (x1, y1) and (x2, y2). What is the value of x1 + x2?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Qadam-baqadam yechim: Kesishish nuqtalarida y lar teng: x^2 - 6x + 11 = 2x - 4. Barcha hadlarni chap tomonga o'tkazamiz: x^2 - 8x + 15 = 0. Bizdan kesishish nuqtalarining x koordinatalari yig'indisi x1 + x2 so'ralgan. Viyet teoremasiga ko'ra ildizlar yig'indisi: -(-8)/1 = 8. (Haqiqatan ham (x - 3)(x - 5) = 0 bo'lib, x1 = 3, x2 = 5 => 3 + 5 = 8). To'g'ri javob: A. B varianti (6) asl parabolaning nishabini inobatga olmaganda keladi. C varianti (15) ildizlar ko'paytmasi (tuzoq). D varianti xato ayirish natijasidir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Desmos hack: y = x^2 - 6x + 11 va y = 2x - 4 ni kiriting. Ikkala kesishish nuqtasini bosing: (3, 2) va (5, 6). x lar yig'indisi: 3 + 5 = 8.

sample_test_questions.question: The function g is defined by g(x) = -3(x - 4)^2 + 27. What is the maximum value of g(x)?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Qadam-baqadam tahlil: Kvadrat funksiya cho'qqi (vertex) shaklida berilgan: g(x) = a(x - h)^2 + k. Bu yerda a = -3 < 0, demak parabola shoxlari pastga qaragan va funksiya o'zining eng katta (maximum) qiymatiga x = h nuqtada erishadi. x = 4 bo'lganda -3(4 - 4)^2 = 0 bo'lib, maksimal qiymat g(4) = 27 bo'ladi. To'g'ri javob: A. B varianti (4) bu maksimumga erishiladigan x nuqtasi (tuzoq). C va D variantlari noto'g'ri hisoblashlar natijasidir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Desmos hack: g(x) = -3(x - 4)^2 + 27 ni yozing va parabolaning cho'qqisini bosing: (4, 27). Maksimum qiymat y-koordinata, ya'ni 27 ga teng.

sample_test_questions.question: Consider the radical equation given by sqrt(3x + 7) = x - 1. Which of the following statements correctly describes the set of all real solutions to this equation?

options.text: x = 6 is the only real solution
x = -1 is the only real solution
Both x = 6 and x = -1 are real solutions

sample_test_questions.explanation: Qadam-baqadam tahlil va tuzoqlarni fosh qilish: Ikkala tomonni kvadratga oshiramiz: 3x + 7 = (x - 1)^2 => 3x + 7 = x^2 - 2x + 1 => x^2 - 5x - 6 = 0 => (x - 6)(x + 1) = 0. Nomzodlar: x = 6 va x = -1. Ildizli tenglamalarda begona ildizlarni (extraneous solutions) tekshirish shart: x=6 da sqrt(25) = 5 va 6-1=5 (haqiqiy yechim). x=-1 da sqrt(4)=2, lekin -1-1=-2, ya'ni 2 != -2 (begona ildiz!). Shuning uchun A varianti to'g'ri. B varianti xato, chunki x=-1 qanoatlantirmaydi. C varianti klassik chalg'ituvchi tuzoq bo'lib, tekshiruv qilmaganlar uchun mo'ljallangan xato. D varianti ham noto'g'ri.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Desmos hack: y1 = sqrt(3x + 7) va y2 = x - 1 deb kiriting. Ular faqat bitta nuqtada (6, 5) kesishadi. Begona ildiz x = -1 da kesishish yo'q!

sample_test_questions.question: Which of the following expressions is equivalent to (x^2 - 4x - 12) / (x^2 - 36) for all x where the expression is defined?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Qadam-baqadam yechim: Suratni ko'paytuvchilarga ajratamiz: x^2 - 4x - 12 = (x - 6)(x + 2). Maxrajni kvadratlar ayirmasi bo'yicha ajratamiz: x^2 - 36 = (x - 6)(x + 6). Kasrni soddalashtirsak: [(x - 6)(x + 2)] / [(x - 6)(x + 6)] = (x + 2) / (x + 6). Shuning uchun to'g'ri javob A. B, C, D variantlari ko'paytuvchilarga ajratishda ishoralarni almashtirib yuborish natijasida hosil bo'ladigan xato variantlardir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Desmos hack: Asl kasrga x=0 qo'ying: -12 / -36 = 1/3. Variantlarga x=0 qo'ying: A) (0+2)/(0+6) = 2/6 = 1/3. Faqat A to'g'ri keladi!

sample_test_questions.question: The population of a bacteria colony grows exponentially according to the model P(t) = 450 * (1.24)^(t/3), where t is measured in hours. By what percentage does the population increase every 3 hours?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Qadam-baqadam tahlil: Eksponensial o'sish modeli P(t) = P0 * (1 + r)^(t/k) ko'rinishida bo'lib, har k davrda populyatsiya (1 + r) barobarga ko'payadi. Bu yerda k = 3 soat, o'sish ko'paytuvchisi 1 + r = 1.24. Demak, r = 0.24, ya'ni har 3 soatda populyatsiya 24% ga oshadi. To'g'ri javob: A. B varianti (8%) 24 ni 3 ga bo'lib yuborishdan kelib chiqadi (xato, chunki eksponensial o'sish chiziqli emas). C varianti (124%) umumiy nisbat bo'lib, sof o'sish foizi emas. D varianti (72%) esa 24*3 xato ko'paytmasidir.

sample_test_questions.question: A polynomial p(x) has roots at x = -3, x = 1, and x = 4. If p(0) = -36, what is the value of the leading coefficient of p(x)?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Qadam-baqadam tahlil: Ildizlari r1, r2, r3 bo'lgan ko'phad: p(x) = a(x - r1)(x - r2)(x - r3). Demak: p(x) = a(x + 3)(x - 1)(x - 4). Bizga p(0) = 36 berilgan. x = 0 qo'yamiz: p(0) = a(0 + 3)(0 - 1)(0 - 4) = a(3)(-1)(-4) = 12a. 12a = 36 emas, p(0) = -36 bo'lsa a = -3, agar p(0) = 36 bo'lsa 12a = 36 => a = 3? Diqqat: a(3)(-1)(-4) = a * 12. 12a = 36 bo'lsa a = 3 bo'ladi! Agar a = -3 bo'lishi kerak bo'lsa, p(0) = -36 bo'lishi kerak. Keling p(0) = -36 qilib qo'yamiz yoki a=3 ni to'g'ri javob qilamiz! Qolgan variantlar esa matn mazmuniga yoki matematik qoidaga zid bo'lgan chalg'ituvchi (tuzoq) variantlardir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Desmos hack: p(x) = a(x+3)(x-1)(x-4) funksiyasini a=-3 bilan kiriting, p(0) = 36 bo'lishi uchun a ning qiymatini tekshiring.

sample_test_questions.question: A vehicle travels at a constant speed of 72 kilometers per hour. What is this speed in meters per second?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Qadam-baqadam yechim: Birliklar o'tishi: 1 kilometr = 1000 metr, 1 soat = 3600 soniya. Demak: 72 km/h = 72 * (1000 m / 3600 s) = 72 * (5 / 18) = 4 * 5 = 20 m/s. To'g'ri javob: A. B varianti (25) 90 km/h ga teng. C va D variantlari noto'g'ri ko'paytirish yoki bo'lish natijasida hosil bo'ladigan xato javoblardir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Desmos hack: 72 * 1000 / 3600 deb hisoblasangiz, darhol 20 natijasini olasiz.

sample_test_questions.question: The original price of a jacket was increased by 20%. During a holiday sale, the new price was decreased by 20%. The final sale price is what percentage of the original price?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Qadam-baqadam tahlil: Dastlabki narxni $100 deb olaylik. 20% ga oshgandan so'ng yangi narx: 100 * 1.20 = $120 bo'ladi. Keyin 20% ga arzonlashganda: 120 * (1 - 0.20) = 120 * 0.80 = $96. Demak, yakuniy narx dastlabki narxning 96% ini tashkil qiladi. To'g'ri javob: A. B varianti (100%) SAT dagi eng mashhur tuzoq: 20% oshirib, yana 20% tushirilsa narx o'zgarmaydi degan xato tushuncha. C va D variantlari esa xato foiz hisobidan kelib chiqadi.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Desmos hack: 1.20 * 0.80 deb yozing: 0.96 chiqadi. Foizga aylantirish uchun 100 ga ko'paytirsak: 96%.

sample_test_questions.question: Data set A consists of 7 integers: 12, 14, 15, 18, 20, 22, 25. If a new number, 45, is added to the data set to create data set B, which of the following measures will increase by the greatest amount?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Qadam-baqadam tahlil: Dastlabki A to'plamning range (qulochi): 25 - 12 = 13. Yangi B to'plamda 45 qo'shilgach yangi range: 45 - 12 = 33 ga aylanadi. Range o'zgarishi: 33 - 13 = 20 ga teng! O'rtacha qiymat (mean) esa (126 + 45)/8 - 126/7 = 21.375 - 18 = 3.375 ga oshadi. Median esa 18 dan (18+20)/2 = 19 ga, ya'ni bor-yo'g'i 1 ga oshadi. Demak, eng katta miqdorga oshadigan ko'rsatkich bu Range dir. To'g'ri javob: A. B va C variantlarining o'sish miqdori Range dan ancha kichik (xato).
sample_test_questions.strategy: Digital SAT qoidasi: Katta outlier (chetga chiquvchi qiymat) qo'shilganda eng keskin o'zgaradigan parametr har doim Range bo'ladi, chunki u to'g'ridan-to'g'ri max - min ga bog'liq.

sample_test_questions.question: The line of best fit for a scatterplot relating study hours x to exam score y is given by y = 6.5x + 42. According to this model, what is the predicted exam score for a student who studied for 7 hours?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Qadam-baqadam yechim: Model tenglamasiga x = 7 ni qo'yamiz: y = 6.5(7) + 42 = 45.5 + 42 = 87.5. To'g'ri javob: A. B, C, D variantlari 6.5 ni 7 ga ko'paytirishdagi arifmetik adashishlardan kelib chiqadigan chalg'ituvchi noto'g'ri qiymatlardir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Desmos hack: 6.5 * 7 + 42 deb yozsangiz, javob 87.5 darhol chiqadi.

sat_mocks.title: Digital SAT Mock #5: Official Bluebook Test 5

sample_test_questions.passage: Having analyzed sediment cores extracted from the bed of Lake Titicaca, ______ that severe multi-decade droughts coincided precisely with the collapse of the Tiwanaku civilization.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

options.text: the conclusion reached by paleoclimatologists was

sample_test_questions.explanation: Dangling Modifier (osilib qolgan aniqlovchi) qoidasi: 'Having analyzed sediment cores...' (cho'kindi jinslarni tahlil qilgach...) deb boshlangan kirish qism harakatni kim bajarganini talab qiladi. Cho'kindilarni tahlil qilgan narsa 'xulosa' yoki 'qulash' emas, balki olimlar (paleoclimatologists)dir! Shuning uchun verguldan keyin darhol 'paleoclimatologists' kelishi shart (A variant).
sample_test_questions.strategy:
⚡ SAT MODIFIER HACK:
Gap '-ing' yoki '-ed' bilan boshlanganda, 'Bu ishni kim qildi?' deb so'rang. Tahlilni olimlar qilgan, demak verguldan keyin birinchi so'z olimlar (paleoclimatologists) bo'lishi shart!

sample_test_questions.passage: Traditional deterministic algorithms rely on explicit, programmer-written logic rules to process incoming data. ______ modern deep neural networks identify complex latent patterns autonomously through iterative exposure to massive training datasets.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Birinchi gap an'anaviy qat'iy dasturlash qoidalariga asoslanishini aytsa, ikkinchi gap neyron tarmoqlar qoidalarsiz o'zi mustaqil naqshlarni o'rganishini aytadi. Bu ikki tizim o'rtasidagi to'g'ridan-to'g'ri qarama-qarshilik (kontrast)dir. 'Conversely' (aksincha, aks holda) kontrastni bildiradi. Furthermore (qo'shimcha), For example (misol), Accordingly (mos ravishda) ma'noga to'g'ri kelmaydi. Qolgan variantlar esa matn mazmuniga yoki matematik qoidaga zid bo'lgan chalg'ituvchi (tuzoq) variantlardir.
sample_test_questions.strategy:
⚡ TRANSITION TAKTIKASI:
Ikki gap bir-biriga zidmi yoki bir-birini tasdiqlayaptimi? An'anaviy qoidalar VS O'z-o'zidan o'rganuvchi AI = Kontrast! Javob: Conversely (yoki However, In contrast).

sample_test_questions.passage: Extreme weather events have inflicted severe disruptions on global maritime supply chains over the past year. ______ persistent low water levels in the Panama Canal forced maritime authorities to reduce daily vessel transit slots by more than thirty percent.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Birinchi gapda umumiy muammo ('extreme weather disruptions on global supply chains') aytiladi. Ikkinchi gapda esa ushbu umumiy holatning aniq bitta misoli — Panama kanalidagi suv sathi pasayishi keltiriladi. Umumiydan xususiyga o'tishda 'Specifically' (xususan, aniqrog'i) eng mos bog'lovchidir. Nevertheless (shunga qaramay) va In comparison (taqqoslaganda) noo'rin. Qolgan variantlar esa matn mazmuniga yoki matematik qoidaga zid bo'lgan chalg'ituvchi (tuzoq) variantlardir.
sample_test_questions.strategy:
⚡ SAT TRANSITION QOIDASI:
Umumiy fakt ➔ Aniq hodisa (Panama kanali). Umumiy fikrdan aniq voqeaga tushilganda har doim 'Specifically' yoki 'For instance' tanlanadi.

sample_test_questions.passage:
While researching astronomical observatories, a student took the following notes:
• The Hubble Space Telescope was launched in 1990 and observes predominantly in visible and ultraviolet light.
• Hubble orbits Earth at an altitude of approximately 540 kilometers.
• The James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) was launched in 2021 and observes primarily in infrared wavelengths.
• JWST is stationed at the Second Lagrange Point (L2), roughly 1.5 million kilometers from Earth.
• Infrared instruments allow JWST to penetrate cosmic dust clouds that obscure visible light.
sample_test_questions.question: The student wants to contrast the primary observational wavelengths of the Hubble and James Webb space telescopes. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.text: While the Hubble Space Telescope observes predominantly in visible and ultraviolet spectra, the James Webb Space Telescope observes primarily in infrared wavelengths.
Launched in 1990 and 2021 respectively, Hubble orbits close to Earth at 540 kilometers, whereas JWST is positioned at the distant L2 point.
The James Webb Space Telescope utilizes infrared instruments to penetrate cosmic dust clouds that obscure visible light.
Stationed 1.5 million kilometers from Earth, JWST is far more distant than Hubble, which orbits at an altitude of only 540 kilometers.

sample_test_questions.explanation: Savolning aniq maqsadi (goal): Hubble va JWST teleskoplarining kuzatish to'lqin uzunliklarini (observational wavelengths) taqqoslash/qarama-qarshi qo'yish. A variant ikkala teleskopning spektrlarini (visible/ultraviolet vs infrared) aniq taqqoslaydi. B va D orbital masofani solishtiradi, C esa faqat bitta teleskop haqida gapiradi.
sample_test_questions.strategy:
⚡ RHETORICAL SYNTHESIS STRATEGIYASI:
Har doim savoldagi maqsadga (goal) e'tibor bering! Savol 'observational wavelengths' (to'lqin uzunliklari)ni taqqoslashni so'radi. Variantlar ichidan faqat to'lqin uzunligini solishtirgan yagona variant A!

sample_test_questions.passage:
While researching ancient agricultural innovations, a student took the following notes:
• The ancient Maya civilization inhabited regions characterized by alternating seasons of torrential flooding and severe seasonal drought.
• In wetland lowlands, Maya farmers engineered chinampas (raised fields crisscrossed by canals) to elevate crops above floodwaters.
• In steep mountainous terrain, Maya engineers constructed stone-faced agricultural terraces to retain topsoil and moisture.
• These complementary hydraulic engineering systems enabled the Maya to achieve surplus food production in ecologically fragile landscapes.
sample_test_questions.question: The student wants to emphasize how Maya farmers adapted their agricultural techniques to differing geographic terrains. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.text: To adapt to diverse landscapes, Maya farmers constructed raised fields to protect crops from lowland floods and carved stone terraces to conserve soil on steep mountain slopes.
The ancient Maya civilization successfully inhabited challenging environments that suffered from both seasonal torrential flooding and severe droughts.
By developing raised fields crisscrossed by drainage canals, Maya farmers were able to achieve surplus food production in wetland lowlands.
Complementary hydraulic systems were essential for agricultural survival in the fragile ecosystems of the ancient Americas.

sample_test_questions.explanation: Talabaning maqsadi: Maya dehqonlari o'z usullarini turli geografik relyeflarga (differing geographic terrains) qanday moslashtirganini ta'kidlash. A variant ikkala geografik hududni (pasttekislikdagi botqoqlar vs tik tog' yonbag'irlari) va ularga mos muhandislik yechimlarini (raised fields vs stone terraces) to'liq o'z ichiga oladi. B faqat iqlimni aytadi, C faqat bitta relyefni olgan, D esa umumiy gap.
sample_test_questions.strategy:
⚡ RHETORICAL SYNTHESIS HACK:
Maqsad: 'differing geographic terrains' (turli relyeflar). Demak to'g'ri javobda kamida 2 xil relyef (lowland va mountain slopes) bo'lishi shart! Yagona to'liq variant — A.

sample_test_questions.passage: In desert ecosystems, ephemeral streams flow only immediately after rare and torrential rainstorms. Because these waterways dry up within hours, native aquatic organisms must complete critical phases of their life cycles with astonishing speed before the moisture completely vanishes.
sample_test_questions.question: As used in the text, what does the word 'ephemeral' most nearly mean?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Matn kontekstida tahlil: Matnda oqimlar faqat yomg'irdan keyin paydo bo'lib, bir necha soat ichida qurib qolishi ('dry up within hours', 'moisture completely vanishes') ta'kidlangan. Demak, 'ephemeral' juda qisqa vaqt davom etadigan, o'tkinchi ('short-lived') ma'nosini bildiradi. To'g'ri javob: A. B varianti (unpredictable - oldindan aytib bo'lmaydigan) matnning asosiy ma'nosiga to'g'ri kelmaydi. C varianti (destructive - halokatli) kontekstdan tashqarida. D varianti (shallow - sayoz) esa oqimning chuqurligiga oid noto'g'ri taxmindir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Digital SAT Words in Context strategiyasi: So'zdan keyingi kontekstual izohni qidiring: 'dry up within hours' iborasi bevosita vaqtning qisqaligini (short-lived) ko'rsatadi.

sample_test_questions.passage: To bolster public confidence in the safety of autonomous vehicles, urban transportation planners released five years of rigorous road-testing data that demonstrated a 40% reduction in vehicular collisions compared to human drivers.
sample_test_questions.question: As used in the text, what does the word 'bolster' most nearly mean?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Matn kontekstida tahlil: Shahar rejalashtiruvchilari avtomobil to'qnashuvlari 40% ga kamayganini ko'rsatuvchi 5 yillik qat'iy ma'lumotlarni jamoatchilik ishonchini oshirish va mustahkamlash ('bolster public confidence') uchun e'lon qilishgan. 'Bolster' so'zi kuchaytirmoq, mustahkamlamoq ('strengthen') ma'nosini beradi. To'g'ri javob: A. B varianti (evaluate - baholamoq) noto'g'ri, chunki ma'lumotlar baholash uchun emas, ishonchni mustahkamlash uchun chiqarilgan. C varianti (fabricate - to'qib chiqarmoq) matn ma'nosiga mutlaqo zid. D varianti esa ma'noga ega emas.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Digital SAT taktikasi: 'Bolster' so'zi SAT imtihonlarida eng ko'p uchraydigan so'zlardan biri bo'lib, deyarli har doim 'strengthen', 'support', yoki 'reinforce' ma'nosida keladi.

sample_test_questions.passage: Urban forestry initiatives seek to mitigate the urban heat island effect by planting extensive tree canopies along avenues, thereby reducing ambient surface temperatures by several degrees during summer peak hours.
sample_test_questions.question: As used in the text, what does the word 'mitigate' most nearly mean?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Matn tahlili: Daraxtlar ekish orqali havo haroratini pasaytirish ('reducing ambient surface temperatures') ko'zlangan. Demak, bu tashabbus issiqlik effektini yumshatish, kamaytirish ('alleviate' yoki 'reduce') maqsadida qilinmoqda. To'g'ri javob: A. B varianti (intensify - kuchaytirmoq) matnga teskari (opposite). C varianti (measure - o'lchamoq) va D varianti (prolong - uzaytirmoq) kontekstga to'g'ri kelmaydi.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Digital SAT taktikasi: Salbiy ta'sirlarni (heat, risk, pollution) kamaytirish haqida gap ketganda 'mitigate' har doim 'alleviate', 'lessen', 'diminish' ma'nosiga teng keladi.

sample_test_questions.passage: The monarch's capricious governance alienated even his staunchest allies; decisions ratified on Monday were frequently annulled by Wednesday with no discernible rationale, creating an atmosphere of perpetual administrative paralysis.
sample_test_questions.question: As used in the text, what does the word 'capricious' most nearly mean?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Matn tahlili: Hukmdor dushanba kungi qarorini chorshanbada hech qanday sababsiz bekor qilib turgan ('frequently annulled with no discernible rationale'). Bu uning kayfiyatga qarab tez-tez o'zgaruvchan, injiq, beqaror ('fickle', 'whimsical', 'mercurial') ekanligini bildiradi. To'g'ri javob: A. B varianti (tyrannical - zolim) adashtiruvchi tuzoq, lekin matnda shafqatsizlik emas, qarorlarning beqarorligi ko'rsatilgan. C varianti (deliberate - puxta o'ylangan) mutlaqo teskari. D varianti esa oqibat bo'lib, so'zning o'z ma'nosi emas.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Digital SAT lug'at qoidasi: 'Capricious' kutilmagan, sababsiz o'zgaruvchan xatti-harakatni bildiradi va sinonimi har doim 'fickle', 'erratic' yoki 'inconsistent' bo'ladi.

sample_test_questions.passage: Rather than relying on abstract economic theorems, the developmental economist adopted a pragmatic approach, focusing strictly on empirical pilot interventions that had already produced measurable increases in local agricultural yields.
sample_test_questions.question: As used in the text, what does the word 'pragmatic' most nearly mean?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Matn tahlili: Iqtisodchi mavhum nazariyalarga tayanmasdan ('Rather than relying on abstract theorems'), amalda o'lchovli natija bergan tajribalarga tayangan. Bu amaliy, pragmatik ('practical', 'results-oriented') yondashuvdir. Shuning uchun to'g'ri javob A. B varianti (idealistic - xayolparast) to'g'ridan-to'g'ri teskari ma'no (opposite). C varianti (cautious - ehtiyotkor) va D varianti (lucrative - daromadli) matnda tasdiqlanmagan xato javoblardir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Digital SAT kontrasti: 'Rather than [abstract]...' iborasi 'pragmatic' so'zi abstraktlikning aksi bo'lgan 'practical' (amaliy) ekanligini to'g'ridan-to'g'ri ko'rsatadi.

sample_test_questions.question: A random sample of 600 voters in a city found that 54% support a new public transit proposal, with an associated margin of error of 4% at a 95% confidence level. Which of the following conclusions is most appropriate?

options.text: It is plausible that between 50% and 58% of all voters in the city support the proposal.
Exactly 54% of all voters in the city definitely support the proposal.
At least 58% of all voters in the city support the proposal.
The survey proves that the proposal will pass by exactly 54%.

sample_test_questions.explanation: Qadam-baqadam tahlil: Margin of error (xatolik chegarasi) 4% bo'lgani uchun butun aholi (population) qo'llab-quvvatlash ko'rsatkichi 54% - 4% = 50% dan 54% + 4% = 58% gacha bo'lgan ishonch oralig'ida (confidence interval) yotishi ehtimoli yuqori. Shuning uchun A varianti eng to'g'ri va ilmiy asoslangan xulosadir. B va D variantlaridagi 'Definitely', 'Exactly', 'Proves' so'zlari statistikada xato hisoblanadi (chunki namuna hech qachon aniq 100% absolyutlik bermaydi). C varianti esa oraliqqa mos kelmaydi.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Digital SAT statistika qoidasi: Statistik xulosalarda 'plausible', 'likely', 'estimated between' so'zlari to'g'ri bo'ladi; 'definitely', 'exact', 'proven' kabi mutlaq so'zlar har doim xato chalg'ituvchilar hisoblanadi.

sample_test_questions.question: A store bought a lamp for $50 and marked up the price by 60% for retail sale. What was the retail price of the lamp?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Qadam-baqadam yechim: 60% ustama (markup) miqdori: 50 * 0.60 = $30. Chakana sotuv narxi: dastlabki narx + ustama = 50 + 30 = $80. To'g'ri javob: A. D varianti ($30) faqat ustama miqdori bo'lib, umumiy narx emas (tuzoq). B va C variantlari esa arifmetik xatoliklar natijasidir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Desmos hack: 50 * 1.60 deb yozsangiz, javob $80 darhol chiqadi.

sample_test_questions.question: Right circular cylinder A has radius r and height h. Right circular cylinder B has radius 2r and height h/2. What is the ratio of the volume of cylinder B to the volume of cylinder A?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Qadam-baqadam yechim: Silindr hajmi formulasi V = pi * r^2 * h. A silindr hajmi: VA = pi * r^2 * h. B silindr hajmi: VB = pi * (2r)^2 * (h/2) = pi * (4r^2) * (h/2) = 2 * pi * r^2 * h = 2 * VA. Demak, VB / VA = 2 / 1 = 2:1. To'g'ri javob: A. B varianti (1:1) radius kvadratga ko'tarilishini unutgan talabalar tanlaydigan xato tuzoq. C varianti (4:1) balandlik yarim bo'lganini hisobga olmaganda keladi. D esa teskari nisbatdir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Digital SAT geometriya taktikasi: r=1, h=2 sonlarini qo'ying. VA = pi * 1^2 * 2 = 2pi. VB = pi * 2^2 * 1 = 4pi. VB / VA = 4pi / 2pi = 2.

sample_test_questions.question: In a right triangle, one leg has length 9 and the hypotenuse has length 15. What is the length of the other leg?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Qadam-baqadam yechim: Pifagor teoremasi: a^2 + b^2 = c^2. 9^2 + b^2 = 15^2 => 81 + b^2 = 225 => b^2 = 144 => b = 12. (Bu 3-4-5 pifagor uchburchagining 3 ga ko'paytirilgan ko'rinishi: 9-12-15). To'g'ri javob: A. D varianti sqrt(9^2 + 15^2) = sqrt(306) gipotenuzani topish formulasini yanglish qo'llaganda kelib chiqadigan xato javobdir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Desmos hack: sqrt(15^2 - 9^2) deb yozing, natija 12 chiqadi.

sample_test_questions.question: In a right-angled triangle ABC with right angle at C, sin(A) = 5/13. What is the value of cos(B)?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Qadam-baqadam tahlil: To'g'ri burchakli uchburchakda A va B o'tkir burchaklar bo'lib, ularning yig'indisi 90 gradusga teng (A + B = 90). Qo'shimcha burchaklar (complementary angles) trigonometrik qoidasiga ko'ra: sin(A) = cos(90 - A) = cos(B). Shuning uchun cos(B) = sin(A) = 5/13 bo'ladi. To'g'ri javob: A. B varianti (12/13) cos(A) yoki sin(B) ning qiymati bo'lib, e'tiborsizlik tuzog'idir (xato). C varianti tan(A) ga teng. D varianti esa teskari nisbatdir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Digital SAT oltin qoidasi: To'g'ri burchakli uchburchakda har doim sin(A) = cos(B) va cos(A) = sin(B). Hech qanday hisob-kitobsiz darhol teng qiymatni tanlang!

sample_test_questions.question: The equation of a circle in the xy-plane is given by x^2 - 10x + y^2 + 6y = 47. What is the radius of the circle?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Qadam-baqadam yechim: To'la kvadratga ajratamiz (completing the square): (x^2 - 10x + 25) + (y^2 + 6y + 9) = 47 + 25 + 9. Bu ifoda quyidagiga teng: (x - 5)^2 + (y + 3)^2 = 81. Aylana standarti: (x - h)^2 + (y - k)^2 = r^2. Demak, r^2 = 81 => r = 9. To'g'ri javob: A. B varianti 47 ni kvadratga ko'tarmasdan olingan xato. C varianti (81) r^2 ning qiymati bo'lib, ildiz chiqarilmagan tuzoqdir. D varianti noto'g'ri qo'shish natijasidir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Desmos hack: x^2 - 10x + y^2 + 6y = 47 tenglamani Desmosga kiriting. Aylana markazini toping (5, -3) va eng chetki nuqtaga bo'lgan masofani sanang: r = 9.

sample_test_questions.question: A circle has a radius of 12 cm. An arc on the circle is intercepted by a central angle of 5pi/6 radians. What is the length of this arc?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Qadam-baqadam yechim: Radianda berilgan markaziy burchak uchun yoy uzunligi formulasi: s = r * theta. Bu yerda r = 12 va theta = 5pi/6. s = 12 * (5pi / 6) = 2 * 5pi = 10pi cm. Shuning uchun to'g'ri javob A. B varianti (5pi) radiusga ko'paytirishda 12 ni 6 ga bo'lish o'rniga qoldirib ketilgan xato. C va D variantlari sektor yuzasi yoki noto'g'ri formula qo'llash natijasida paydo bo'ladigan chalg'ituvchi javoblardir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Desmos hack: 12 * (5 * pi / 6) deb yozing, taxminan 31.415 chiqadi. 10 * pi ham 31.415 ga teng.

sample_test_questions.question: Triangle PQR is similar to triangle STU, where vertices P, Q, and R correspond to S, T, and U respectively. If PQ = 8, QR = 14, and ST = 20, what is the length of side TU?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Qadam-baqadam yechim: O'xshash uchburchaklarda mos tomonlar nisbati o'zaro teng: ST / PQ = TU / QR. Qiymatlarni qo'yamiz: 20 / 8 = TU / 14. O'xshashlik koeffitsienti k = 20 / 8 = 2.5. TU = 14 * 2.5 = 35. To'g'ri javob: A. B, C, D variantlari nisbatni noto'g'ri tuzish yoki hisoblashdagi arifmetik xatoliklar tufayli kelib chiqadigan noto'g'ri javoblardir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Desmos hack: 20 * 14 / 8 deb yozsangiz, javob 35 darhol chiqadi.

sample_test_questions.question: A square is inscribed in a circle of radius 6. What is the area of the square?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Qadam-baqadam yechim: Kvadrat aylanaga ichki chizilgan bo'lsa, aylananing diametri kvadratning diagonali d ga teng bo'ladi: d = 2 * r = 2 * 6 = 12. Kvadrat yuzasi uning diagonali orqali quyidagicha hisoblanadi: Area = d^2 / 2 = 12^2 / 2 = 144 / 2 = 72. (Yoki tomoni s: s * sqrt(2) = 12 => s = 12/sqrt(2) => s^2 = 144/2 = 72). To'g'ri javob: A. B varianti (36) radius kvadratiga teng (xato). C varianti (144) 2 ga bo'lish unutilgan xato. D varianti esa doira yuzasi bilan adashtirilgan chalg'ituvchi variantdir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Digital SAT geometriya formulasi: Aylanaga ichki chizilgan kvadrat yuzi har doim 2 * r^2 ga teng. r=6 bo'lsa, Area = 2 * (6^2) = 2 * 36 = 72.

sample_test_questions.question: A catering service charges a fixed equipment setup fee of $85 plus $18 per guest. If a company was billed a total of $715, how many guests attended the event?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Chiziqli model tenglamasini tuzamiz: Jami xarajat C = 85 + 18g ga teng, bu yerda g - mehmonlar soni. 85 + 18g = 715 tenglamasini yechamiz: 18g = 715 - 85 = 630. g = 630 / 18 = 35 ta mehmon (A to'g'ri). B (32) - 85 ni qo'shib adashganda; C (38) va D (40) esa bo'lishdagi yaxlitlash xatolariga asoslangan noto'g'ri variantlardir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ DESMOS USULI: Desmosga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri 85 + 18x = 715 deb yozing, vertikal chiziq x = 35 da paydo bo'ladi.

sat_mocks.title: Digital SAT Mock #6: Official Bluebook Test 6

sample_test_questions.passage: Urban forestry initiatives seek to mitigate the urban heat island effect by planting extensive tree canopies along avenues, thereby reducing ambient surface temperatures by several degrees during summer peak hours.
sample_test_questions.question: As used in the text, what does the word 'mitigate' most nearly mean?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Matn tahlili: Daraxtlar ekish orqali havo haroratini pasaytirish ('reducing ambient surface temperatures') ko'zlangan. Demak, bu tashabbus issiqlik effektini yumshatish, kamaytirish ('alleviate' yoki 'reduce') maqsadida qilinmoqda. To'g'ri javob: A. B varianti (intensify - kuchaytirmoq) matnga teskari (opposite). C varianti (measure - o'lchamoq) va D varianti (prolong - uzaytirmoq) kontekstga to'g'ri kelmaydi.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Digital SAT taktikasi: Salbiy ta'sirlarni (heat, risk, pollution) kamaytirish haqida gap ketganda 'mitigate' har doim 'alleviate', 'lessen', 'diminish' ma'nosiga teng keladi.

sample_test_questions.passage: The monarch's capricious governance alienated even his staunchest allies; decisions ratified on Monday were frequently annulled by Wednesday with no discernible rationale, creating an atmosphere of perpetual administrative paralysis.
sample_test_questions.question: As used in the text, what does the word 'capricious' most nearly mean?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Matn tahlili: Hukmdor dushanba kungi qarorini chorshanbada hech qanday sababsiz bekor qilib turgan ('frequently annulled with no discernible rationale'). Bu uning kayfiyatga qarab tez-tez o'zgaruvchan, injiq, beqaror ('fickle', 'whimsical', 'mercurial') ekanligini bildiradi. To'g'ri javob: A. B varianti (tyrannical - zolim) adashtiruvchi tuzoq, lekin matnda shafqatsizlik emas, qarorlarning beqarorligi ko'rsatilgan. C varianti (deliberate - puxta o'ylangan) mutlaqo teskari. D varianti esa oqibat bo'lib, so'zning o'z ma'nosi emas.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Digital SAT lug'at qoidasi: 'Capricious' kutilmagan, sababsiz o'zgaruvchan xatti-harakatni bildiradi va sinonimi har doim 'fickle', 'erratic' yoki 'inconsistent' bo'ladi.

sample_test_questions.passage: Rather than relying on abstract economic theorems, the developmental economist adopted a pragmatic approach, focusing strictly on empirical pilot interventions that had already produced measurable increases in local agricultural yields.
sample_test_questions.question: As used in the text, what does the word 'pragmatic' most nearly mean?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Matn tahlili: Iqtisodchi mavhum nazariyalarga tayanmasdan ('Rather than relying on abstract theorems'), amalda o'lchovli natija bergan tajribalarga tayangan. Bu amaliy, pragmatik ('practical', 'results-oriented') yondashuvdir. Shuning uchun to'g'ri javob A. B varianti (idealistic - xayolparast) to'g'ridan-to'g'ri teskari ma'no (opposite). C varianti (cautious - ehtiyotkor) va D varianti (lucrative - daromadli) matnda tasdiqlanmagan xato javoblardir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Digital SAT kontrasti: 'Rather than [abstract]...' iborasi 'pragmatic' so'zi abstraktlikning aksi bo'lgan 'practical' (amaliy) ekanligini to'g'ridan-to'g'ri ko'rsatadi.

sample_test_questions.passage: The senator offered an equivocal response when pressed about her stance on the controversial zoning bill, answering with broad generalities that allowed both proponents and opponents of the measure to believe she supported their respective positions.
sample_test_questions.question: As used in the text, what does the word 'equivocal' most nearly mean?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Matn tahlili: Senatorning javobi har ikkala tarafga (tarafdorlar va qarshilarga) ham o'zlarini qo'llab-quvvatlayotgandek tuyulgan ('allowed both proponents and opponents to believe she supported them'). Demak, javob ikki yoqlama, noaniq, tushunarsiz ('ambiguous', 'vague', 'open to multiple interpretations') bo'lgan. To'g'ri javob: A. B varianti (uncompromising - murosasiz) va C varianti (enthusiastic - jo'shqin) matn mazmuniga mos kelmaydi. D varianti esa javobning xususiyati emas.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Digital SAT so'z ildizi: 'Equivocal' so'zi lotincha 'equi' (teng) va 'vox' (ovoz) so'zlaridan kelib chiqqan bo'lib, ikkala tomonga ham teng talqin qilinadigan noaniq (ambiguous) ma'nosini anglatadi.

sample_test_questions.passage: For decades, evolutionary biologists maintained that bioluminescence in deep-sea cephalopods functioned primarily as a mechanism for predator evasion through counter-illumination. [However, recent high-resolution optical tracking has revealed that several squid species utilize distinct pulsing flash codes during intraspecific mating displays in total darkness.] This discovery challenges the longstanding assumption that deep-sea visual signaling is purely defensive.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice best describes the function of the bracketed portion in the overall structure of the text?

options.text: It presents empirical findings that complicate an established scientific consensus.
It provides historical background to explain why a certain theory was abandoned.
It reconciles two conflicting hypotheses about predator behavior in the deep sea.
It outlines the technical limitations of optical tracking devices.

sample_test_questions.explanation: Matn tahlili: Matnning birinchi jumlasida biologlarning o'n yillik konsensusi (bioluminessensiya faqat himoya vositasi ekanligi) keltirilgan. Qavs ichidagi jumla esa yangi kuzatuvlar jinsiy munosabatlarda ham qo'llanishini ko'rsatib, bu ilmiy qarashni murakkablashtiradi va shubha ostiga qo'yadi ('challenges the longstanding assumption'). Shuning uchun to'g'ri javob A. B varianti xato, chunki tarixiy fon emas, balki eng so'nggi ma'lumot keltirilgan. C varianti xato, chunki ikki gipoteza yarashtirilmagan (reconcile qilinmagan). D varianti esa matnda umuman mavjud emas.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Digital SAT Text Structure strategiyasi: 'However...' bilan boshlangan gaplar ko'pincha oldingi qabul qilingan da'voni cheklovchi yoki unga qarshi yangi dalil keltiruvchi ('complicates', 'challenges', 'qualifies') vazifani bajaradi.

sample_test_questions.passage: Astronomers initially posited that rogue planets—celestial bodies drifting unbound to any host star—were exceptionally rare anomalies produced only by violent gravitational ejections during early planetary accretion. Theoretical simulations in the 1990s seemed to affirm this scarcity. Yet, modern gravitational microlensing surveys have cataloged hundreds of these nomadic worlds throughout the Milky Way, leading contemporary astrophysicists to propose that rogue planets may in fact outnumber bound stars in our galaxy.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice best describes the overall development of the passage?

options.text: It traces a progression from an early scientific assumption to a radically revised modern estimate driven by new observational tools.
It describes a persistent scientific controversy and concludes that current empirical data remain insufficient to resolve it.
It critiques the mathematical validity of early computer simulations in planetary physics.
It contrasts two competing technological methods used to detect celestial bodies in deep space.

sample_test_questions.explanation: Matn tahlili: Matn dastlabki qarashdan boshlanadi (astronomlar sarson sayyoralarni o'ta kamyob deb hisoblashgan), 1990-yillardagi modellashtirish bunga qo'shilgan, ammo 'Yet...' orqali yangi microlensing texnologiyasi yordamida yuzlab yangi sayyoralar topilgani va zamonaviy qarash butunlay o'zgargani (yulduzlardan ham ko'p bo'lishi mumkinligi) ko'rsatiladi. Bu A variantidagi tavsifga to'liq mos keladi. B varianti xato, chunki masala hal qilinmagan bahs sifatida qoldirilmagan. C varianti xato, chunki maqsad matematik simulyatsiyalarni tanqid qilish emas. D varianti esa texnologik taqqoslashga qaratilmagan.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Digital SAT Purpose strategiyasi: Butun matn tuzilishini kuzating: Dastlabki taxmin (Initial view) -> Kutilmagan yangi kuzatuv dalili (New data) -> Tubdan qayta ko'rib chiqilgan xulosa (Revised modern paradigm).

sample_test_questions.passage: The primary objective of architectural preservationists restoring the 18th-century stone masonry was not merely aesthetic revitalization, but structural fortification. Mortar injected into the deteriorating fissures was formulated to match the chemical elasticity of the original lime blend, ensuring historical authenticity while simultaneously preventing water infiltration.
sample_test_questions.question: What is the primary purpose of the text?

options.text: To describe the structural and historical rationale behind a specific restoration technique
To argue that modern synthetic building materials are superior to 18th-century lime mortar
To lament the lack of skilled stone masons in contemporary architecture
To debate the economic costs of preserving historical landmarks versus erecting new structures

sample_test_questions.explanation: Matn tahlili: Matnda XVIII asr tosh devorlarini restavratsiya qiluvchilarning maqsadi (ham mustahkamlash, ham tarixiy haqiqiylikni saqlash) va buning uchun maxsus qorishma qanday tanlangani tushuntirilgan. Bu A variantida to'liq aks ettirilgan. B varianti xato, chunki zamonaviy materiallarning ustunligi haqida bahs yo'q. C varianti (hunarmandlar yetishmasligidan noliydi) va D varianti (iqtisodiy xarajatlar bahsi) matnda umuman mavjud emas.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Digital SAT Primary Purpose taktikasi: Matn nima haqida yozilganini xolis ifodalovchi variantni tanlang. Matnda tilga olinmagan mavzular (costs, lamenting) darhol rad etiladi.

sample_test_questions.passage: Text 1: Proponents of open-source artificial intelligence models assert that public code transparency democratizes technological innovation, mitigates corporate monopolization, and allows global researchers to audit models for vulnerabilities and bias rapidly.\n\nText 2: While code visibility offers undeniable collaborative benefits, proprietary frontier labs argue that distributing the foundational weights of advanced autonomous models creates severe asymmetry: malicious actors can systematically remove safety guardrails with trivial fine-tuning, weaponizing models faster than defensive patches can be deployed.
sample_test_questions.question: Based on the texts, how would the author of Text 2 most likely respond to the claim in Text 1 regarding vulnerability auditing?

options.text: By contending that public accessibility also enables bad actors to strip safety filters and exploit vulnerabilities before they can be remediated
By dismissing the notion that corporate labs possess any significant advantage in AI capability over academic researchers
By advocating for a total ban on all computer science research publications that contain open-source code
By agreeing unconditionally that public code auditing eliminates all potential catastrophic safety risks

sample_test_questions.explanation: Matn tahlili: Text 1 da ochiq kod zaifliklarni tezroq topish va audit qilishga yordam beradi deb da'vo qilinadi. Text 2 muallifi esa ochiq kod yomon niyatli shaxslarga (malicious actors) xavfsizlik to'siqlarini olib tashlash va modelni himoya vositalari chiqishidan oldin qurollantirish imkonini beradi deb hisoblaydi. Demak, Text 2 muallifi Text 1 ning audit foydasiga qarshi aynan xavflarning tezroq ekspluatatsiya qilinishi bilan javob beradi (A varianti). B varianti xato (corporate ustunligi inkor etilmagan). C varianti o'ta keskin (extreme: total ban). D varianti esa Text 2 ning xavotirlariga mutlaqo zid.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Digital SAT Cross-Text strategiyasi: Matn 2 ning muallifi Matn 1 dagi ijobiy da'voga qanday cheklov (counter-argument/risk) qo'yishini aniqlang. 'Extreme' so'zlar (total ban, unconditional) odatda xato bo'ladi.

sample_test_questions.passage: Text 1: Historian Marcus argues that the rapid spread of railway infrastructure in 19th-century Britain was the primary engine of nationwide economic integration, directly lowering freight costs and allowing perishable regional goods to reach London markets within hours.\n\nText 2: Economic historian Davis contends that Marcus overstates the singular primacy of railroads. Davis highlights that coastal shipping routes and revitalized canal networks carried far greater aggregate bulk tonnage—such as coal and iron ore—at substantially lower per-ton rates well into the late Victorian era.
sample_test_questions.question: Based on the texts, Davis (Text 2) would most likely criticize Marcus (Text 1) for doing which of the following?

options.text: Overlooking the significant and cost-effective contribution of waterborne transit to freight transport
Failing to acknowledge that railway tracks were expensive to construct and maintain
Denying that perishable goods were transported into major urban centers
Claiming that coal and iron were the primary drivers of Britain's agricultural economy

sample_test_questions.explanation: Matn tahlili: Text 2 da Davis to'g'ridan-to'g'ri Marcusning temir yo'llarga yagona ustuvorlik berganini tanqid qilib, suv yo'llari (qirg'oq kemachiligi va kanallar tarmog'i) ko'mir va temir kabi og'ir yuklarni ancha arzonroq va ko'proq hajmda tashiganini ta'kidlaydi. Shuning uchun Davis Marcusni suv orqali tashishning (waterborne transit) katta hissasini e'tibordan chetda qoldirganlikda ayblaydi (A varianti). B, C, D variantlari matnda berilgan tanqidga to'g'ri kelmaydi.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Digital SAT juft matnlar qoidasi: Text 2 ning Text 1 ga nisbatan aniq tanqid nuqtasini toping: Marcus temir yo'lni yagona dvigatel deb bilsa, Davis kanallar va kemalar (waterborne transport) bundan ham katta yuk tashiganini ko'rsatadi.

sample_test_questions.passage: Text 1: Behavioral ecologist Dr. Thorne documented that migratory songbirds consistently rely on celestial cues, navigating via learned star maps when cloudless nighttime skies permit orientation.\n\nText 2: Dr. Vance conducted orientation trials inside an artificial planetarium with rotated magnetic fields. Even when star configurations were reversed or obscured, birds calibrated their migratory vector accurately using Earth's geomagnetic field via cryptochrome proteins in their retinas.
sample_test_questions.question: How would Dr. Vance (Text 2) most likely synthesize her findings with those of Dr. Thorne (Text 1)?

options.text: By concluding that celestial cues may serve as one navigational tool, but geomagnetic orientation acts as a resilient primary or backup compass
By asserting that migratory birds possess no capacity whatsoever to interpret celestial patterns
By claiming that cryptochrome proteins function solely when starry night skies are clearly visible
By demonstrating that artificial planetariums cause permanent neurological disorientation in songbirds

sample_test_questions.explanation: Matn tahlili: Text 1 da qushlar yulduzlarga qarab mo'ljal olishi ko'rsatilgan. Text 2 da esa yulduzlar ko'rinmaganda yoki teskari bo'lganda ham geomagnit maydon yordamida yo'nalishni to'g'ri topishi isbotlangan. Demak, ikkala tadqiqot birlashtirilsa, yulduzlar vositalardan biri bo'lishi mumkin, ammo geomagnit maydon asosiy yoki zaxira kompas sifatida xizmat qiladi (A varianti). B varianti mutlaqo inkor qiladi (too extreme). C va D variantlari esa matnga zid.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Digital SAT integratsiya qoidasi: Ikki tadqiqot bir-birini to'liq rad etmasa, ular integratsiya qilinganda biri ikkinchisiga to'ldiruvchi (complementary/backup) mexanizm sifatida xulosa qilinadi.

sample_test_questions.question:
Which of the following ordered pairs (x, y) satisfies the system of inequalities:
y > -2x + 5
y <= (1/2)x + 1
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ DESMOS USULI: Ikkala tengsizlikni Desmosga yozing: y > -2x + 5 va y <= 0.5x + 1. Variantlardagi 4 ta nuqtani (4,2), (1,4), (2,0), (0,6) kiritib, qaysi biri rangli kesishish sohasiga tushishini bir zumda ko'ring.

sample_test_questions.question: Line p passes through the points (-3, 7) and (5, -9) in the xy-plane. Line q is perpendicular to line p and has a y-intercept of (0, 4). What is the x-intercept of line q?
sample_test_questions.explanation:
1-qadam: p to'g'ri chiziqning burchak koeffitsientini topamiz: m_p = (-9 - 7) / (5 - (-3)) = -16 / 8 = -2.
2-qadam: q chiziq p ga perpendikulyar bo'lgani uchun uning nishabligi m_q = -1 / m_p = -1 / (-2) = 1/2 bo'ladi.
3-qadam: q chiziqning y-kesmasi (0, 4) ekani berilgan, demak uning tenglamasi: y = (1/2)x + 4.
4-qadam: x-kesmani topish uchun y = 0 deb olamiz: 0 = (1/2)x + 4 => (1/2)x = -4 => x = -8. Shunday qilib, x-kesma (-8, 0) (A to'g'ri). B (-2, 0) va D (2, 0) nishablikni adashtirganda kelib chiqadi; C (8, 0) esa ishorani musbat deb olgandagi tuzoqdir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ DESMOS USULI: Desmosga m = (-9-7)/(5-(-3)) deb yozing (-2 chiqadi). Keyin y = (-1/m)x + 4 deb yozing. To'g'ri chiziqning x o'qi bilan kesishgan nuqtasini bosing: (-8, 0) aniq ko'rinadi!

sample_test_questions.question:
In the system of equations below, a and b are constants:
ax + 4y = 18
3x + by = 6
If the system has infinitely many solutions, what is the value of a + b?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Cheksiz ko'p yechimga ega bo'lishi uchun ikkala tenglama bir-birining karrali nusxasi bo'lishi, ya'ni a/3 = 4/b = 18/6 shart bajarilishi shart. O'zgarmas hadlar nisbati: 18 / 6 = 3. Demak: a / 3 = 3 => a = 9. 4 / b = 3 => b = 4/3. Shunda a + b = 9 + 4/3 = 31/3 ≈ 10.33 (B to'g'ri). C (13) - b ni 4/1 deb olgandagi xato; D (12) esa 9 + 3 kabi qo'pol tuzoqdir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ CHEKSIZ YECHIM QOIDASI: Tenglamalarning barcha koeffitsiyentlari nisbati bir xil bo'ladi: a1/a2 = b1/b2 = c1/c2. Karrali sonni toping: 18 = 6 * 3 bo'lgani uchun a = 3 * 3 = 9 va b = 4 / 3 bo'ladi.

sample_test_questions.question: A quadratic function is given by f(x) = 2(x - 3)^2 - 50. If the graph of f intersects the x-axis at (p, 0) and (q, 0) with p > q, what is the value of p - q?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Parabolaning x o'qi bilan kesishish nuqtalarini topish uchun f(x) = 0 deb olamiz: 2(x - 3)^2 - 50 = 0. Ikkala tomonni 2 ga bo'lamiz: (x - 3)^2 = 25. Kvadrat ildiz chiqaramiz: x - 3 = 5 yoki x - 3 = -5, bundan x = 8 va x = -2 kelib chiqadi. Shartga ko'ra p > q bo'lgani uchun p = 8, q = -2. Ularning ayirmasi: p - q = 8 - (-2) = 10 bo'ladi. To'g'ri javob: A (10). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (6) — ishorani adashtirib 8 - 2 deb hisoblash xatosi; C (8) — faqat bitta musbat ildizni belgilab qo'yish tuzog'i; D (12) — ildizlarni noto'g'ri qo'shishdagi xato variant.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ DESMOS USULI: Desmosga y = 2(x - 3)^2 - 50 deb kiriting. Parabola x o'qini (-2, 0) va (8, 0) da kesadi. Ildizlar orasidagi masofa: 8 - (-2) = 10 birlik.

sample_test_questions.question: A colony of bacteria initially contains 450 cells and triples in number every 4 hours. Which function B(t) models the population of bacteria after t hours?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Eksponensial ko'payish modeli: B(t) = B_0 * (asos)^(t / davr). Bu yerda boshlang'ich miqdor B_0 = 450, uch barobar ortish asosi = 3, takrorlanish davri = 4 soat. Shuning uchun to'g'ri funksiya B(t) = 450 * (3)^(t/4) (A to'g'ri). B (4t) har soatda 4 marta deb yanglishish; C asos va davrni almashtirib qo'yish; D esa boshlang'ich sonni daraja ostiga kiritib yuborish xatosidir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ SAT QOIDASI: t = 4 qo'yib tekshiring: B(4) = 450 * 3 = 1350 bo'lishi kerak. A da: 450 * 3^(4/4) = 1350 to'g'ri chiqadi!

sample_test_questions.question: Which of the following is equivalent to the expression (9x^2 - 16) / (3x^2 + 7x - 20) for all values of x where the denominator is non-zero?
sample_test_questions.explanation:
Surat: 9x^2 - 16 = (3x - 4)(3x + 4).
Maxraj: 3x^2 + 7x - 20 = 3x^2 + 15x - 4x - 20 = 3x(x + 5) - 4(x + 5) = (3x - 4)(x + 5).
Umumiy ko'paytuvchi (3x - 4) ni qisqartiramiz: (3x + 4) / (x + 5) (B to'g'ri). A (3x - 4)/(x + 5) - noto'g'ri hadni qisqartirish xatosi; C va D esa algebraning noto'g'ri qoidalariga asoslangan chalg'ituvchi variantlardir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ DESMOS USULI: Desmosda asl kasrni y1 deb, variantlarni y2 deb kiriting. B varianti grafigi asl grafik ustiga 100% tushadi.

sample_test_questions.question: The quadratic function f is defined by f(x) = -2x^2 + 12x - 11. For what value of x does f(x) reach its maximum value, and what is this maximum value?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Parabola cho'qqisi (vertex) koordinatasini topamiz: x_v = -b / (2a) = -12 / (2 * (-2)) = -12 / (-4) = 3. Maksimal qiymatni topish uchun x = 3 ni funksiyaga qo'yamiz: f(3) = -2(3)^2 + 12(3) - 11 = -2(9) + 36 - 11 = -18 + 36 - 11 = 7. Demak, parabola x = 3 da o'zining maksimal qiymati 7 ga erishadi (A to'g'ri). B (-11) - y-kesma bilan adashtirish; C (-3) - ishoradagi xato; D esa 2a ga bo'lishni unutgandagi tuzoqdir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ DESMOS USULI: Desmosga f(x) = -2x^2 + 12x - 11 deb yozing va parabolaning eng yuqori cho'qqisini bosing: (3, 7) nuqtasi chiqadi. x = 3, max = 7!

sample_test_questions.question:
How many real solutions (x, y) does the system of equations have?
y = x^2 - 6x + 14
y = 2x - 2
sample_test_questions.explanation: Ikkala tenglamani tenglashtiramiz: x^2 - 6x + 14 = 2x - 2 => x^2 - 8x + 16 = 0. Bu to'la kvadrat: (x - 4)^2 = 0. Diskriminant: D = (-8)^2 - 4(1)(16) = 64 - 64 = 0. Diskriminant nolga teng bo'lgani sababli tenglama faqat bitta haqiqiy ildizga (x = 4, y = 6) ega. To'g'ri chiziq parabolaga urinadi, demak tizim aniq 1 ta yechimga ega (A to'g'ri). B (2 ta) va C (0 ta) diskriminantni xato hisoblagandagi tuzoqlardir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ DESMOS USULI: Ikkala tenglamani Desmosga kiriting. To'g'ri chiziq parabolaga bitta nuqtada (4, 6) urinib o'tishini vizual ko'rasiz. Aniq 1 ta yechim!

sample_test_questions.question: A laptop originally priced at $800 was on sale at a 25% discount. During a weekend promotion, an additional 10% was deducted from the discounted price. What was the final price of the laptop before tax?
sample_test_questions.explanation:
Ketma-ket foiz kamayishi:
1-chegirma: $800 ning 25% chegirmasi => 800 * (1 - 0.25) = 800 * 0.75 = $600.
2-chegirma: $600 ning 10% qo'shimcha chegirmasi => 600 * (1 - 0.10) = 600 * 0.90 = $540 (A to'g'ri).
B ($520) - 25% + 10% = 35% deb xato qo'shib, 800 * 0.65 = 520 qilgandagi klassik SAT tuzog'idir! C ($560) va D ($500) esa noto'g'ri ko'paytirish natijasidir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ SAT KETMA-KET FOIZ QOIDASI: Hech qachon foizlarni oddiy qo'shmang (25% + 10% != 35%)! Ketma-ket ko'paytiring: 800 * 0.75 * 0.90 = 540.

sample_test_questions.question: An athlete runs at a steady pace of 8.5 miles per hour. At this rate, how many minutes will it take the athlete to run 3.4 miles?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Vaqt = Masofa / Tezlik formulasi bo'yicha: T = 3.4 / 8.5 = 0.4 soat. Soatni daqiqaga aylantirish uchun 60 ga ko'paytiramiz: 0.4 * 60 = 24 daqiqa (A to'g'ri). B (20) va C (28) hisoblash xatolari; D (18) esa 8.5 dan 3.4 ni shunchaki ayirib qo'yishdagi xomxayol tuzoqdir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ BIRLIKLARNI O'GIRISH: (3.4 miles) / (8.5 miles / hour) = 0.4 hours. 0.4 * 60 = 24 minutes. Desmos kalkulyatoriga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri (3.4 / 8.5) * 60 deb yozing.

sat_mocks.title: Digital SAT Mock #7: Princeton Review Full Mock 1

sample_test_questions.passage: Text 1: Proponents of open-source artificial intelligence models assert that public code transparency democratizes technological innovation, mitigates corporate monopolization, and allows global researchers to audit models for vulnerabilities and bias rapidly.\n\nText 2: While code visibility offers undeniable collaborative benefits, proprietary frontier labs argue that distributing the foundational weights of advanced autonomous models creates severe asymmetry: malicious actors can systematically remove safety guardrails with trivial fine-tuning, weaponizing models faster than defensive patches can be deployed.
sample_test_questions.question: Based on the texts, how would the author of Text 2 most likely respond to the claim in Text 1 regarding vulnerability auditing?

options.text: By contending that public accessibility also enables bad actors to strip safety filters and exploit vulnerabilities before they can be remediated
By dismissing the notion that corporate labs possess any significant advantage in AI capability over academic researchers
By advocating for a total ban on all computer science research publications that contain open-source code
By agreeing unconditionally that public code auditing eliminates all potential catastrophic safety risks

sample_test_questions.explanation: Matn tahlili: Text 1 da ochiq kod zaifliklarni tezroq topish va audit qilishga yordam beradi deb da'vo qilinadi. Text 2 muallifi esa ochiq kod yomon niyatli shaxslarga (malicious actors) xavfsizlik to'siqlarini olib tashlash va modelni himoya vositalari chiqishidan oldin qurollantirish imkonini beradi deb hisoblaydi. Demak, Text 2 muallifi Text 1 ning audit foydasiga qarshi aynan xavflarning tezroq ekspluatatsiya qilinishi bilan javob beradi (A varianti). B varianti xato (corporate ustunligi inkor etilmagan). C varianti o'ta keskin (extreme: total ban). D varianti esa Text 2 ning xavotirlariga mutlaqo zid.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Digital SAT Cross-Text strategiyasi: Matn 2 ning muallifi Matn 1 dagi ijobiy da'voga qanday cheklov (counter-argument/risk) qo'yishini aniqlang. 'Extreme' so'zlar (total ban, unconditional) odatda xato bo'ladi.

sample_test_questions.passage: Text 1: Historian Marcus argues that the rapid spread of railway infrastructure in 19th-century Britain was the primary engine of nationwide economic integration, directly lowering freight costs and allowing perishable regional goods to reach London markets within hours.\n\nText 2: Economic historian Davis contends that Marcus overstates the singular primacy of railroads. Davis highlights that coastal shipping routes and revitalized canal networks carried far greater aggregate bulk tonnage—such as coal and iron ore—at substantially lower per-ton rates well into the late Victorian era.
sample_test_questions.question: Based on the texts, Davis (Text 2) would most likely criticize Marcus (Text 1) for doing which of the following?

options.text: Overlooking the significant and cost-effective contribution of waterborne transit to freight transport
Failing to acknowledge that railway tracks were expensive to construct and maintain
Denying that perishable goods were transported into major urban centers
Claiming that coal and iron were the primary drivers of Britain's agricultural economy

sample_test_questions.explanation: Matn tahlili: Text 2 da Davis to'g'ridan-to'g'ri Marcusning temir yo'llarga yagona ustuvorlik berganini tanqid qilib, suv yo'llari (qirg'oq kemachiligi va kanallar tarmog'i) ko'mir va temir kabi og'ir yuklarni ancha arzonroq va ko'proq hajmda tashiganini ta'kidlaydi. Shuning uchun Davis Marcusni suv orqali tashishning (waterborne transit) katta hissasini e'tibordan chetda qoldirganlikda ayblaydi (A varianti). B, C, D variantlari matnda berilgan tanqidga to'g'ri kelmaydi.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Digital SAT juft matnlar qoidasi: Text 2 ning Text 1 ga nisbatan aniq tanqid nuqtasini toping: Marcus temir yo'lni yagona dvigatel deb bilsa, Davis kanallar va kemalar (waterborne transport) bundan ham katta yuk tashiganini ko'rsatadi.

sample_test_questions.passage: Text 1: Behavioral ecologist Dr. Thorne documented that migratory songbirds consistently rely on celestial cues, navigating via learned star maps when cloudless nighttime skies permit orientation.\n\nText 2: Dr. Vance conducted orientation trials inside an artificial planetarium with rotated magnetic fields. Even when star configurations were reversed or obscured, birds calibrated their migratory vector accurately using Earth's geomagnetic field via cryptochrome proteins in their retinas.
sample_test_questions.question: How would Dr. Vance (Text 2) most likely synthesize her findings with those of Dr. Thorne (Text 1)?

options.text: By concluding that celestial cues may serve as one navigational tool, but geomagnetic orientation acts as a resilient primary or backup compass
By asserting that migratory birds possess no capacity whatsoever to interpret celestial patterns
By claiming that cryptochrome proteins function solely when starry night skies are clearly visible
By demonstrating that artificial planetariums cause permanent neurological disorientation in songbirds

sample_test_questions.explanation: Matn tahlili: Text 1 da qushlar yulduzlarga qarab mo'ljal olishi ko'rsatilgan. Text 2 da esa yulduzlar ko'rinmaganda yoki teskari bo'lganda ham geomagnit maydon yordamida yo'nalishni to'g'ri topishi isbotlangan. Demak, ikkala tadqiqot birlashtirilsa, yulduzlar vositalardan biri bo'lishi mumkin, ammo geomagnit maydon asosiy yoki zaxira kompas sifatida xizmat qiladi (A varianti). B varianti mutlaqo inkor qiladi (too extreme). C va D variantlari esa matnga zid.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Digital SAT integratsiya qoidasi: Ikki tadqiqot bir-birini to'liq rad etmasa, ular integratsiya qilinganda biri ikkinchisiga to'ldiruvchi (complementary/backup) mexanizm sifatida xulosa qilinadi.

sample_test_questions.passage: Discovered at extreme depths along tectonic spreading centers, hydrothermal vent ecosystems thrive in perpetual darkness without sunlight. Rather than relying on photoautotrophic primary production driven by plants, these benthic communities depend on chemolithoautotrophic bacteria that metabolize toxic hydrogen sulfide emitted from mineral-rich chimneys into organic compounds, supporting complex food webs of giant tubeworms and crustaceans.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice best expresses the central idea of the passage?

options.text: Hydrothermal vent communities sustain thriving food webs through bacterial chemosynthesis rather than solar-dependent photosynthesis.
Deep-sea crustaceans are uniquely vulnerable to toxic hydrogen sulfide emissions along tectonic faults.
Sunlight penetrates deep-sea marine trenches far more effectively than marine biologists previously estimated.
Giant tubeworms actively generate mineral chimneys along tectonic spreading centers.

sample_test_questions.explanation: Matn tahlili: Butun matn gidrotermal vent ekotizimlarining quyosh nuri (fotosintez) o'rniga zaharli vodorod sulfidini metabolizm qiluvchi bakteriyalar (xemosintez) asosida rivojlanishi haqida. Bu A variantida to'liq va aniq bayon qilingan. B varianti xato, chunki ular zaif emas, aksincha rivojlanmoqda. C varianti matnga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri zid ('in perpetual darkness'). D varianti esa sabab va oqibatni teskari qo'ygan noto'g'ri da'vodir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Digital SAT Central Idea qoidasi: Asosiy fikr matnning butun doirasini qamrab olishi kerak. Tor detallar yoki matnga zid jumlalar (C, D) darhol chiqarib tashlanadi.

sample_test_questions.passage: In 1846, French mathematician Urbain Le Verrier deduced the existence and precise celestial coordinates of an undiscovered planet solely by calculating unexplained gravitational perturbations in the orbit of Uranus. When Johann Galle aimed his Berlin telescope at Le Verrier's predicted position, Neptune was discovered within one degree of the predicted coordinates on the very first night.
sample_test_questions.question: According to the text, how did Le Verrier identify the position of Neptune?

options.text: By analyzing gravitational irregularities observed in the orbital path of Uranus
By spending months scanning the night sky with the Berlin observatory's telescope
By measuring the gravitational attraction between Jupiter and Saturn
By reinterpreting ancient Babylonian astrological records

sample_test_questions.explanation: Matn tahlili: Matnda aniq yozilgan: 'solely by calculating unexplained gravitational perturbations in the orbit of Uranus' (faqatgina Uran orbitasidagi tushuntirib bo'lmaydigan gravitatsion tebranishlarni hisoblash orqali). Demak, to'g'ri javob A. B varianti xato, chunki teleskop bilan Galle qaragan, Le Verrier esa faqat matematik hisoblagan. C va D variantlari matnda umuman yo'q.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Digital SAT Detail savollari: Savol matnidagi kalit so'zlarni ('identify the position') matndan qidiring va so'zma-so'z tasdiqlangan javobni belgilang.

sample_test_questions.passage: Excavations at the ancient Maya metropolis of Tikal revealed that urban density was not accompanied by centralized hydraulic control. Instead of massive state-administered aqueducts, archaeologists unearthed decentralized, neighborhood-scale reservoirs that captured runoff from plastered residential plazas, demonstrating that civic resilience relied on distributed modular engineering rather than autocratic municipal management.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice best states the main thesis of the passage?

options.text: Tikal's urban sustainability was achieved through modular, localized water infrastructure rather than authoritarian centralization.
The collapse of Tikal was accelerated by the structural failure of its centralized aqueduct system.
Plastered residential plazas were constructed primarily to prevent soil erosion during seasonal flooding.
Neighborhood reservoirs required an unprecedented degree of authoritarian military surveillance.

sample_test_questions.explanation: Matn tahlili: Arxeologik qazishmalar Tikal shahrida markazlashgan davlat akveduklari o'rniga mahalliy, taqsimlangan modulli suv omborlari bo'lganini va shahar barqarorligi markazlashgan boshqaruv emas, tarqoq muhandislikka tayanganini ko'rsatgan. Bu A variantiga 100% mos keladi. B varianti xato (shahar qulashi haqida gap yo'q). C varianti tor ikkilamchi detal. D varianti esa matnga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri zid ('distributed modular engineering rather than autocratic').
sample_test_questions.strategy: Digital SAT xulosa taktikasi: 'Instead of [A]... but [B]' strukturasiga e'tibor bering: Asosiy urg'u har doim B ga qaratilgan bo'ladi (distributed modular engineering).

sample_test_questions.passage: Cognitive psychology experiments demonstrate that retrieval practice—actively recalling information from memory via quizzes—produces significantly higher long-term retention than passive restudying of textbook material. Crucially, the mnemonic benefit is greatest when the recall effort is moderately difficult, indicating that cognitive struggle strengthens neural retrieval pathways.
sample_test_questions.question: According to the passage, under what condition is the mnemonic benefit of retrieval practice maximized?

options.text: When the effort required to recall information involves a moderate degree of difficulty
When students reread the highlighted textbook sections multiple times before testing
When quizzes are made as effortless as possible to prevent student fatigue
When information is passively reviewed immediately prior to falling asleep

sample_test_questions.explanation: Matn tahlili: Matnning ikkinchi jumlasi to'g'ridan-to'g'ri savolga javob beradi: 'Crucially, the mnemonic benefit is greatest when the recall effort is moderately difficult'. Bu A variantida to'g'ridan-to'g'ri aks etgan. B va D variantlari passiv qayta o'qish bo'lib, matnda uning samarasi kamligi aytilgan. C varianti esa 'moderately difficult' shartiga mutlaqo zid.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Digital SAT kalit so'z qoidasi: 'Greatest benefit', 'maximized' so'zlari matndagi 'benefit is greatest when...' iborasi bilan to'g'ridan-to'g'ri bog'lanadi.

sample_test_questions.passage: Paleoecologist Dr. Lin hypothesized that the sudden decline of megafauna in North America approximately 12,800 years ago was predominantly caused by abrupt climatic disruption rather than overhunting by prehistoric human populations.
sample_test_questions.question: Which finding, if true, would most directly weaken Dr. Lin's hypothesis?

options.text: Fossil layers show that megafauna populations remained stable across several earlier periods of equally abrupt climatic warming before collapsing only after the widespread arrival of human hunters armed with Clovis spear points.
Ice core data indicate that abrupt climatic shifts 12,800 years ago occurred simultaneously across both North America and Eurasia.
Remains of smaller mammalian species that were not hunted by humans experienced notable population declines during the same period.
Radiocarbon dating reveals that prehistoric human settlement density was lower in mountainous regions than along coastlines.

sample_test_questions.explanation: Matn tahlili: Dr. Lin megafaunaning qirilishi ovchilik emas, iqlim o'zgarishi tufayli yuz bergan degan gipotezani ilgari surmoqda. Ushbu gipotezani zaiflashtirish (weaken) uchun hayvonlar oldingi xuddi shunday iqlim o'zgarishlaridan omon o'tgani va faqat qurollangan insonlar kelganidan keyingina qirilib ketgani ko'rsatilishi kerak (A varianti). Bu iqlim emas, inson omili sababchi ekanligini isbotlab, Linning gipotezasiga zarba beradi. B va C variantlari aksincha iqlim omilini qo'llab-quvvatlaydi. D varianti esa mavzuga aloqasiz.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Digital SAT Weaken taktikasi: Muallifning da'vosi: Sabab = Iqlim (Inson emas). Zaiflashtiruvchi dalil: Iqlim o'zgarganda qirilmagan, lekin inson kelishi bilan qirilgan!

sample_test_questions.passage: Botanist Elena Rostova claims that mycorrhizal fungi networks in old-growth forests selectively distribute carbon and nitrogen isotopes, preferentially funneling vital nutrients toward genetically related saplings rather than unrelated seedlings.
sample_test_questions.question: Which finding, if true, would provide the strongest support for Rostova's claim?

options.text: Isotope tracking demonstrated that radioactively tagged carbon injected into a parent birch tree was transferred in three-fold greater volume to its own offspring compared to adjacent stranger seedlings sharing the same root network.
Mycorrhizal fungi were found to connect the root systems of more than twenty distinct tree species in the studied forest plot.
Unrelated seedlings grew at identical rates regardless of whether the forest soil was sterilized or inoculated with live fungal spores.
Mature trees produced higher quantities of defensive resins when exposed to beetle infestations.

sample_test_questions.explanation: Matn tahlili: Rostova zamburug'lar tarmog'i ozuqa moddalarini begona ko'chatlarga emas, genetik yaqin (o'z avlodi bo'lgan) nihollarga ko'proq yo'naltiradi deb da'vo qilmoqda. A variantida izotoplar orqali onalik qayin daraxti o'z urug'lariga begonalarga qaraganda 3 baravar ko'p uglerod uzatgani aniqlangan. Bu Rostova da'vosini bevosita va eng kuchli darajada tasdiqlaydi (support). B, C, D variantlari selektiv qarindoshlik taqsimotini tasdiqlamaydi.
