sample_test_questions.strategy: Digital SAT Support dalilini topish: Da'voning barcha shartlariga mos keladigan tajribaviy o'lchovni (parent -> offspring vs stranger) toping.

sample_test_questions.passage: Linguist Dr. Aris Thorne contends that bilingualism in early childhood accelerates executive function development, particularly cognitive flexibility and inhibitory control, by forcing the brain to continuously resolve linguistic competition between two active lexical systems.
sample_test_questions.question: Which finding, if true, would best substantiate Dr. Thorne's contention?

options.text: Neuroimaging studies reveal that bilingual children exhibit significantly faster response times and lower prefrontal cortex strain during non-verbal task-switching trials than monolingual peers.
Bilingual children acquire passive listening vocabulary at the exact same chronological pace as monolingual children.
Adults who learn a second language in late adulthood show minimal structural change in auditory cortex density.
Children enrolled in bilingual immersion programs demonstrate high retention of mathematical multiplication tables.

sample_test_questions.explanation: Matn tahlili: Dr. Thorne ikki tillilik kognitiv egiluvchanlik (cognitive flexibility) va nazoratni rivojlantiradi deb hisoblaydi. A variantida ikki tilli bolalar noverbal vazifalarni almashtirishda (task-switching) bir tilli tengdoshlariga qaraganda ancha tezroq ekanligi va miyaning prefrontal qismida yuqori samaradorlik ko'rsatgani keltirilgan. Bu Thorne kontensiyasini to'liq tasdiqlaydi. B, C, D variantlari ijro etuvchi funksiyalar (executive function) rivojlanishiga bevosita dalil bo'lolmaydi.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Digital SAT tushunchalar mosligi: 'Cognitive flexibility' bevosita 'task-switching' (vazifalarni tezkor almashtirish) qobiliyatiga tengdir.

sample_test_questions.question: A dataset contains seven positive integers: 12, 14, 15, 18, 20, 22, and x. If the mean of the dataset equals the median, and x is the largest integer in the dataset, what is the value of x?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Agar x eng katta son bo'lsa, tartiblangan qator: 12, 14, 15, 18, 20, 22, x. 7 ta sonning medianasi 4-o'rindagi son, ya'ni 18 ga teng. O'rtacha arifmetik (mean) ham 18 ga teng bo'lishi kerak: (12 + 14 + 15 + 18 + 20 + 22 + x) / 7 = 18. Yig'indi: 101 + x = 7 * 18 = 126 => x = 126 - 101 = 25 (A to'g'ri). B (28), C (24) va D (30) o'rtacha qiymatni hisoblashdagi arifmetik xatolarga asoslangan chalg'ituvchi variantlardir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ STATISTIKA QOIDASI: Toq sondagi tartiblangan qiymatlarda mediana o'rtadagi sondir (bu yerda 18). Yig'indi = O'rtacha * Sonlar soni: 18 * 7 = 126.

sample_test_questions.passage: A research institute surveyed a representative random sample of 1,200 registered voters in a city. The survey found that 54% of respondents supported building a new public transit line, with a margin of error of 2.8% at a 95% confidence level.
sample_test_questions.question: Which of the following conclusions is most strongly supported by the survey results?

options.text: It is plausible that between 51.2% and 56.8% of all registered voters in the city support the transit line.
Exactly 54% of all registered voters in the city support the transit line.
Increasing the sample size to 2,400 would double the margin of error to 5.6%.
Every resident in the city supports the project with a 95% probability.

sample_test_questions.explanation: Xatolik chegarasi (Margin of error) 2.8% bo'lsa, ishonchlilik oraliq oralig'i: 54% - 2.8% = 51.2% dan 54% + 2.8% = 56.8% gacha bo'ladi. Demak, butun shahar saylovchilari orasida qo'llab-quvvatlash darajasi 51.2% va 56.8% oralig'ida bo'lishi haqiqatga eng yaqin xulosadir (A to'g'ri). B - tanlanma natijasi butun populyatsiyaga mutlaq aniq 'exactly' teng bo'la olmaydi; C - tanlanma hajmi oshsa, xatolik chegarasi kamayadi (ikki barobar oshmaydi); D - jami shahar aholisi haqida asossiz haddan ortiq umumlashtirishdir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ MARGIN OF ERROR QOIDASI: Margin of error (MOE) o'rtacha qiymat atrofida interval hosil qiladi [p - MOE, p + MOE]. SAT'da 'exactly' so'zi qatnashgan javoblar deyarli doimo xato bo'ladi!

sample_test_questions.question: A scatterplot displays the relationship between the number of hours spent practicing per week, h, and the score achieved on a competitive exam, S. The line of best fit is given by S = 28.5h + 410. What does the value 28.5 represent in this model?

options.text: The predicted increase in exam score for each additional hour spent practicing per week
The exam score achieved by a student who practices 0 hours per week
The total number of hours required to achieve a passing score
The maximum possible exam score that any student can achieve

sample_test_questions.explanation: Chiziqli model S = 28.5h + 410 da 28.5 burchak koeffitsienti (slope) hisoblanadi. Slope har doim erkli o'zgaruvchi (h) bir birlikka oshganda erksiz o'zgaruvchining (S) qanchaga o'zgarishini ko'rsatadi: har bir qo'shimcha mashg'ulot soati uchun ballning taxminiy 28.5 ballga oshishi (A to'g'ri). B - y-kesma (410) ma'nosi; C va D esa mutlaqo asossiz mantiqsiz talqinlardir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ SLOPE TALQINI: Chiziqli modelda nishablik (slope) = 'rate of change' (har bir qo'shimcha x birligi uchun y ning o'zgarishi).

sample_test_questions.question: A circle in the xy-plane has the equation (x - 4)^2 + (y + 7)^2 = 64. What are the coordinates of the center and the radius of the circle?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Aylana tenglamasining standart ko'rinishi: (x - h)^2 + (y - k)^2 = r^2. Bu yerda h = 4, k = -7 bo'lgani uchun markaz koordinatasi (4, -7). Radius r = sqrt(64) = 8. Shuning uchun to'g'ri javob A. B va D variantlarida markaz ishoralari almashtirib yuborilgan, C da esa radius ildiz ostiga olinmagan (64 qoldirilgan).
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ DESMOS USULI: Tenglamani to'g'ridan-to'g'ri Desmosga yozing: (x-4)^2 + (y+7)^2 = 64. Markaz nuqtasi (4, -7) ekanini va diametri 16 (radiusi 8) ekanini darhol ko'rasiz.

sample_test_questions.question: In right triangle ABC, angle C is 90 degrees. If the length of side AC is 12 and the length of side BC is 16, what is the length of hypotenuse AB?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Pifagor teoremasini qo'llaymiz: AB^2 = AC^2 + BC^2 = 12^2 + 16^2 = 144 + 256 = 400. AB = sqrt(400) = 20 (A to'g'ri). Shuningdek bu 3-4-5 pifagor uchburchagining 4 ga ko'paytirilgan karrali shaklidir (3*4=12, 4*4=16, 5*4=20). B (28) katetlarni shunchaki qo'shib qo'yish xatosi; C va D esa hisoblashdagi noaniqliklardir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ PIFAGOR TRIPLET: 3-4-5 uchligini eslang: 12:16 = 3:4, demak gipotenuza 5 * 4 = 20 bo'ladi.

sample_test_questions.question: For acute angles A and B in a right triangle, sin(A) = 7/25. What is the value of cos(B)?
sample_test_questions.explanation: To'g'ri burchakli uchburchakda ikkita o'tkir burchak yig'indisi 90 gradusga teng (A + B = 90°). Bir-birini 90° ga to'ldiruvchi burchaklar (complementary angles) uchun asosiy trigonometrik qoida: sin(A) = cos(90° - A) = cos(B). Shuning uchun sin(A) = 7/25 bo'lsa, cos(B) ham aynan 7/25 ga teng bo'ladi (A to'g'ri). B (24/25) - cos(A) ning qiymati; C - teskari kasr; D esa tangens qiymatidir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ OLTIN TRIGO QOIDASI: sin(A) = cos(B) agar A + B = 90° bo'lsa. Hech qanday hisob-kitobsiz bir zumda 7/25 ni belgilang!

sample_test_questions.question: A circle with radius 15 cm has a central angle of 72 degrees. What is the length, in centimeters, of the arc subtended by this central angle?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Aylanadagi yoy uzunligi formulasi: L = 2 * pi * r * (theta / 360). Bu yerda r = 15, theta = 72°. L = 2 * pi * 15 * (72 / 360) = 30 * pi * (1 / 5) = 6 * pi (A to'g'ri). B (3*pi) - diametr o'rniga radiusni 2 ga ko'paytirishni unutganda; C (12*pi) va D (30*pi) esa burchak ulushini xato olgandagi tuzoqlardir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ YOY UZUNLIGI: Aylananing to'liq perimetri = 2 * pi * 15 = 30*pi. 72 gradus bu to'liq aylananing 72/360 = 1/5 qismi. 30*pi / 5 = 6*pi.

sample_test_questions.question: A right circular cylinder has a height of 14 inches and a volume of 350*pi cubic inches. What is the radius, in inches, of the circular base of this cylinder?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Silindr hajmi formulasi: V = pi * r^2 * h. Qiymatlarni qo'yamiz: 350 * pi = pi * r^2 * 14. Ikkala tomonni pi ga bo'lamiz: 350 = 14 * r^2 => r^2 = 350 / 14 = 25. r = sqrt(25) = 5 dyuym (A to'g'ri). B (25) - r^2 ni radius deb adashish; C (10) - diametr qiymati; D (7) esa balandlikka asoslangan noto'g'ri variantdir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ FORMULA NAZORATI: Hajm = Asos yuzi * Balandlik. r^2 = V / (pi * h) = 350 / 14 = 25. Radius = 5.

sample_test_questions.question: The equation x^2 + y^2 - 10x + 6y + 9 = 0 represents a circle in the xy-plane. What is the radius of this circle?
sample_test_questions.explanation:
To'la kvadratga keltiramiz:
(x^2 - 10x + 25) + (y^2 + 6y + 9) = -9 + 25 + 9
(x - 5)^2 + (y + 3)^2 = 25
Demak, markaz (5, -3) va r^2 = 25 bo'lgani uchun radius r = sqrt(25) = 5 (A to'g'ri). B (25) - r^2 ni radius deb hisoblash tuzog'i; C va D esa to'la kvadratga qo'shilgan sonlarni xato muvozanatlash oqibatidir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ DESMOS USULI: Tenglamani xuddi o'zidek Desmosga yozing: x^2 + y^2 - 10x + 6y + 9 = 0. Aylana paydo bo'ladi. Uning chap va o'ng chegarasiga qarang: x = 0 dan x = 10 gacha (diametr = 10), demak radius = 5!

sample_test_questions.question: A cellular carrier offers two monthly roaming data plans. Plan X charges a $25 monthly fee plus $0.15 per megabyte of data used. Plan Y charges a $40 monthly fee plus $0.10 per megabyte of data used. For what number of megabytes of data used in a month will the total monthly charges for both plans be equal?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Ikkala tarif rejasi tenglashishi uchun chiziqli tenglama tuzamiz: 25 + 0.15m = 40 + 0.10m. O'zgaruvchilarni bir tomonga o'tkazamiz: 0.15m - 0.10m = 40 - 25. Natijada 0.05m = 15 bo'ladi. Ikkala tomonni 0.05 ga bo'lsak: m = 15 / 0.05 = 300 megabayt. To'g'ri javob: A (300). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (150) — ayirmani 0.10 ga bo'lishdagi hisoblash xatosi; C (250) — abonent to'lovlarini xato ayirishdagi chalg'ituvchi tuzoq; D (400) — oshiqcha yaxlitlash natijasidagi xato variant.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ DESMOS USULI: Desmosga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri ikkita chiziqni yozing: y = 25 + 0.15x va y = 40 + 0.10x. Kesishish nuqtasiga bosing: (300, 70). x = 300 darhol chiqadi!

sat_mocks.title: Digital SAT Mock #8: Princeton Review Full Mock 2

sample_test_questions.passage: Paleoecologist Dr. Lin hypothesized that the sudden decline of megafauna in North America approximately 12,800 years ago was predominantly caused by abrupt climatic disruption rather than overhunting by prehistoric human populations.
sample_test_questions.question: Which finding, if true, would most directly weaken Dr. Lin's hypothesis?

options.text: Fossil layers show that megafauna populations remained stable across several earlier periods of equally abrupt climatic warming before collapsing only after the widespread arrival of human hunters armed with Clovis spear points.
Ice core data indicate that abrupt climatic shifts 12,800 years ago occurred simultaneously across both North America and Eurasia.
Remains of smaller mammalian species that were not hunted by humans experienced notable population declines during the same period.
Radiocarbon dating reveals that prehistoric human settlement density was lower in mountainous regions than along coastlines.

sample_test_questions.explanation: Matn tahlili: Dr. Lin megafaunaning qirilishi ovchilik emas, iqlim o'zgarishi tufayli yuz bergan degan gipotezani ilgari surmoqda. Ushbu gipotezani zaiflashtirish (weaken) uchun hayvonlar oldingi xuddi shunday iqlim o'zgarishlaridan omon o'tgani va faqat qurollangan insonlar kelganidan keyingina qirilib ketgani ko'rsatilishi kerak (A varianti). Bu iqlim emas, inson omili sababchi ekanligini isbotlab, Linning gipotezasiga zarba beradi. B va C variantlari aksincha iqlim omilini qo'llab-quvvatlaydi. D varianti esa mavzuga aloqasiz.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Digital SAT Weaken taktikasi: Muallifning da'vosi: Sabab = Iqlim (Inson emas). Zaiflashtiruvchi dalil: Iqlim o'zgarganda qirilmagan, lekin inson kelishi bilan qirilgan!

sample_test_questions.passage: Botanist Elena Rostova claims that mycorrhizal fungi networks in old-growth forests selectively distribute carbon and nitrogen isotopes, preferentially funneling vital nutrients toward genetically related saplings rather than unrelated seedlings.
sample_test_questions.question: Which finding, if true, would provide the strongest support for Rostova's claim?

options.text: Isotope tracking demonstrated that radioactively tagged carbon injected into a parent birch tree was transferred in three-fold greater volume to its own offspring compared to adjacent stranger seedlings sharing the same root network.
Mycorrhizal fungi were found to connect the root systems of more than twenty distinct tree species in the studied forest plot.
Unrelated seedlings grew at identical rates regardless of whether the forest soil was sterilized or inoculated with live fungal spores.
Mature trees produced higher quantities of defensive resins when exposed to beetle infestations.

sample_test_questions.explanation: Matn tahlili: Rostova zamburug'lar tarmog'i ozuqa moddalarini begona ko'chatlarga emas, genetik yaqin (o'z avlodi bo'lgan) nihollarga ko'proq yo'naltiradi deb da'vo qilmoqda. A variantida izotoplar orqali onalik qayin daraxti o'z urug'lariga begonalarga qaraganda 3 baravar ko'p uglerod uzatgani aniqlangan. Bu Rostova da'vosini bevosita va eng kuchli darajada tasdiqlaydi (support). B, C, D variantlari selektiv qarindoshlik taqsimotini tasdiqlamaydi.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Digital SAT Support dalilini topish: Da'voning barcha shartlariga mos keladigan tajribaviy o'lchovni (parent -> offspring vs stranger) toping.

sample_test_questions.passage: Linguist Dr. Aris Thorne contends that bilingualism in early childhood accelerates executive function development, particularly cognitive flexibility and inhibitory control, by forcing the brain to continuously resolve linguistic competition between two active lexical systems.
sample_test_questions.question: Which finding, if true, would best substantiate Dr. Thorne's contention?

options.text: Neuroimaging studies reveal that bilingual children exhibit significantly faster response times and lower prefrontal cortex strain during non-verbal task-switching trials than monolingual peers.
Bilingual children acquire passive listening vocabulary at the exact same chronological pace as monolingual children.
Adults who learn a second language in late adulthood show minimal structural change in auditory cortex density.
Children enrolled in bilingual immersion programs demonstrate high retention of mathematical multiplication tables.

sample_test_questions.explanation: Matn tahlili: Dr. Thorne ikki tillilik kognitiv egiluvchanlik (cognitive flexibility) va nazoratni rivojlantiradi deb hisoblaydi. A variantida ikki tilli bolalar noverbal vazifalarni almashtirishda (task-switching) bir tilli tengdoshlariga qaraganda ancha tezroq ekanligi va miyaning prefrontal qismida yuqori samaradorlik ko'rsatgani keltirilgan. Bu Thorne kontensiyasini to'liq tasdiqlaydi. B, C, D variantlari ijro etuvchi funksiyalar (executive function) rivojlanishiga bevosita dalil bo'lolmaydi.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Digital SAT tushunchalar mosligi: 'Cognitive flexibility' bevosita 'task-switching' (vazifalarni tezkor almashtirish) qobiliyatiga tengdir.

sample_test_questions.passage: Researchers evaluated the operational energy conversion efficiency of four experimental perovskite photovoltaic cells under simulated solar irradiation over 1,000 hours: Cell Alpha began at 24.2% and degraded to 21.0%; Cell Beta began at 22.8% and maintained 22.5%; Cell Gamma began at 25.1% but plummeted to 14.3%; Cell Delta began at 20.5% and degraded to 18.2%. The lead investigator concluded that Cell Beta possessed the highest structural durability despite lacking the highest initial peak efficiency.
sample_test_questions.question: Which data point from the study most directly supports the investigator's conclusion regarding Cell Beta?

options.text: Cell Beta lost only 0.3 percentage points of efficiency over 1,000 hours, whereas all other cells experienced degradation of at least 2.3 percentage points.
Cell Gamma achieved an initial efficiency of 25.1%, outperforming Cell Beta at the start of the experiment.
Cell Delta concluded the 1,000-hour testing window with an efficiency below 20%.
Cell Alpha exhibited higher initial conversion efficiency than Cell Beta.

sample_test_questions.explanation: Matn tahlili: Tadqiqotchi Cell Beta eng yuqori strukturaviy chidamlilikka (durability) ega deb xulosa qilgan. Ma'lumotlarga qarasak, Beta 1000 soat davomida 22.8% dan 22.5% ga tushib, bor-yo'g'i 0.3% yo'qotgan. Boshqa barcha kameralar esa ancha ko'p (Alpha: 3.2%, Gamma: 10.8%, Delta: 2.3%) yo'qotgan. Bu A variantidagi raqamli dalil bilan 100% isbotlanadi. B, C, D variantlari esa chidamlilik xulosasini tasdiqlamaydi.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Digital SAT Quantitative Evidence: 'Highest structural durability' (eng yuqori chidamlilik) degani eng kam degradatsiya (minimal loss = 0.3%) deganidir.

sample_test_questions.passage: An agronomic trial compared drought-tolerant maize yields under three irrigation regimes: Deficit (200 mm water), Moderate (400 mm water), and Optimal (600 mm water). Variety X produced 4.2 tons/hectare under Deficit, 6.8 tons under Moderate, and 7.1 tons under Optimal. Variety Y produced 2.8 tons under Deficit, 6.5 tons under Moderate, and 8.9 tons under Optimal. A policy advisor recommended Variety X for semi-arid zones subject to severe seasonal droughts.
sample_test_questions.question: Which comparison best justifies the advisor's recommendation of Variety X over Variety Y for arid regions?

options.text: Under the Deficit irrigation regime, Variety X yielded 1.4 more tons per hectare (a 50% advantage) than Variety Y.
Under Optimal irrigation, Variety Y yielded 1.8 more tons per hectare than Variety X.
Variety X increased its yield by nearly 3 tons when moving from Deficit to Optimal irrigation.
Both varieties produced their lowest aggregate biomass under the 200 mm irrigation condition.

sample_test_questions.explanation: Matn tahlili: Ekspert qurg'oqchil hududlar (semi-arid zones) uchun Variety X navini tavsiya qilgan. Qurg'oqchilik (Deficit = 200 mm) sharoitida Variety X 4.2 tonna hosil bergan bo'lsa, Variety Y atigi 2.8 tonna bergan (farq 4.2 - 2.8 = 1.4 tonna ko'p). Aynan shu ustunlik tavsiyaning eng to'g'ri ilmiy-raqamli asosi hisoblanadi (A varianti). B varianti Optimal sharoitda Y yaxshiroq ekanini aytadi, bu qurg'oqchilik tavsiyasiga zid. C va D variantlari esa taqqoslash uchun asos bo'lolmaydi.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Digital SAT ma'lumot tahlili: Savol 'arid regions' (qurg'oqchil hududlar) haqida bo'lgani uchun tahlil faqat 'Deficit' ustuni bo'yicha olib borilishi shart.

sample_test_questions.passage: A municipal environmental agency recorded monthly particulate matter (PM2.5) concentrations in four metropolitan districts before and after low-emission transit zones were enforced: District North dropped from 48 to 32 ug/m3; District South dropped from 55 to 50 ug/m3; District East dropped from 62 to 38 ug/m3; and District West remained unchanged at 44 ug/m3.
sample_test_questions.question: Which district achieved the greatest absolute reduction in PM2.5 particulate concentration?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Matn tahlili: Har bir tumandagi mutlaq kamayishni hisoblaymiz: District East: 62 - 38 = 24 ug/m3; District North: 48 - 32 = 16 ug/m3; District South: 55 - 50 = 5 ug/m3; District West: 44 - 44 = 0 ug/m3. Eng katta mutlaq pasayish District East da (24 ug/m3) qayd etilgan. Shuning uchun to'g'ri javob A. B, C, D variantlaridagi pasayish ancha kam yoki nolga teng.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Hisoblash: 62 - 38 = 24. Eng katta farqni tanlang.

sample_test_questions.passage: Hydrogeologists studying an arid plateau discovered that isotopic signatures of deep groundwater matched rainwater from high-altitude mountain ranges located 250 kilometers away. Chemical analysis revealed that this water took approximately 4,000 years to migrate through subterranean permeable sandstone strata before accumulating beneath the plateau basin, where modern agricultural wells currently extract it at rates exceeding natural inflow tenfold.
sample_test_questions.question: Which conclusion is most strongly supported by the passage?

options.text: The plateau's groundwater represents a non-renewable fossil aquifer that cannot be replenished rapidly enough to offset modern extraction.
Subterranean sandstone strata are currently fracturing due to intense seismic activity between the mountains and the plateau.
High-altitude mountain rainfall has increased tenfold over the past four thousand years.
Modern agricultural wells on the plateau are naturally filtering out heavy radioactive isotopes from the groundwater.

sample_test_questions.explanation: Matn tahlili: Suv 250 km uzoqlikdan tog'lardan yetib kelishi uchun 4000 yil vaqt ketadi ('took approximately 4,000 years to migrate'). Ammo hozirgi qishloq xo'jaligi quduqlari uni tabiiy oqimdan 10 barobar tezroq tortib olmoqda ('rates exceeding natural inflow tenfold'). Bundan mantiqiy xulosa shuki, bu suv zahirasi qisqa muddatda qayta tiklanmaydigan qazilma suv havzasi (fossil aquifer) bo'lib, hozirgi iste'mol sur'atida tezda tugab bitadi (A varianti). B, C, D variantlari matnda yo'q va to'qib chiqarilgan (unsupported speculation).
sample_test_questions.strategy: Digital SAT Inferences qoidasi: 'Premises -> Logical necessity'. Agar kirish 4000 yil olsa-yu, chiqish 10 barobar tez bo'lsa, xulosa: resurs tezda qayta tiklana olmaydi (non-renewable in human timescales).

sample_test_questions.passage: Historical linguists reconstructed Proto-Indo-European lexical roots by comparing cognates across dozens of ancient daughter tongues, identifying common terms for wheeled carts, domesticated horses, and wool weaving. However, no shared ancestral root existed for ocean navigation, marine fauna, or seafaring vessels. This lexical absence strongly suggests that Proto-Indo-European speakers [...]
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice most logically completes the text?

options.text: inhabited an inland terrestrial environment far from major maritime coastlines.
depended primarily on maritime trade routes for essential metallurgy materials.
prohibited the consumption of fish and shellfish on strict theological grounds.
navigated open oceans without inventing any technical terminology for their vessels.

sample_test_questions.explanation: Matn tahlili: Qadimgi tilda aravacha, ot va jun to'qish kabi quruqlik atamalari ko'p bo'lgan, ammo dengiz, kemachilik yoki dengiz hayvonlariga oid bitta ham umumiy so'z bo'lmagan ('no shared ancestral root for ocean navigation'). Tilshunoslikda bu mazkur xalqning dengiz qirg'oqlaridan uzoqda, quruqlik ichkarisida (inland terrestrial environment) yashaganini bildiradi. Shuning uchun to'g'ri javob A. B va D variantlari dengiz so'zlari yo'qligiga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri zid. C varianti esa asossiz taxmindir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Digital SAT Matnni mantiqiy yakunlash: Matndagi qarama-qarshilikka e'tibor bering: Quruqlik so'zlari bor, dengiz so'zlari mutlaqo yo'q => Demak, ular dengizdan uzoqda yashagan.

sample_test_questions.passage: Thermal infrared scans of the icy crust of Jupiter's moon Europa revealed localized surface regions with high heat flux and fractured chaotic terrain. Laboratory cryo-experiments demonstrate that pure water ice under Jovian surface temperatures cannot maintain ductile deformation; it fractures brittlely unless significant dissolved salt concentrations lower the melting point and facilitate convective upwelling of liquid plumes. Therefore, scientists deduce that Europa's chaotic terrains [...]
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice most logically completes the text?

options.text: are direct surface manifestations of warm, saline subsurface ocean water interacting with the brittle ice crust.
were generated entirely by violent meteoritic impacts that vaporized the local magnetic field.
prove that Europa's core has cooled completely, ending all internal geothermal convection.
consist exclusively of pure frozen nitrogen devoid of any liquid solvent.

sample_test_questions.explanation: Matn tahlili: Tajribalar shuni ko'rsatadiki, sof muz sinuvchan bo'ladi va faqat erigan tuzlar uning erish nuqtasini pasaytirib, suyuq konvektiv oqimlar hosil bo'lgandagina bunday issiq va deformatsiyalangan relef paydo bo'lishi mumkin. Demak, Yevropadagi bunday tartibsiz relyef muz ostidagi iliq, sho'r okean suvlari bilan muz qobig'i o'zaro ta'sirlashuvining bevosita yuzadagi belgisidir (A varianti). B varianti meteorit zarbasini to'qib chiqaradi. C varianti yadro sovigan deb matnga zid da'vo qiladi (holbuki issiqlik oqimi bor). D varianti esa sof azot degan xato farazni ilgari suradi.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Digital SAT Logically Completes: 'dissolved salt + convective liquid plumes' xulosasi to'g'ridan-to'g'ri 'warm, saline subsurface ocean water' javobiga olib boradi.

sample_test_questions.passage: During the solar eclipse, daytime temperatures dropped precipitously [_______] birds ceased their singing and returned to their nests in confusion.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Grammatik qoida: Ikkita mustaqil gap (independent clauses: 'temperatures dropped...' va 'birds ceased...') o'rtasida 'consequently' kabi kon'yunktiv ravish (conjunctive adverb) kelganda, uning oldiga nuqtali vergul (;) va undan keyin vergul (,) qo'yilishi shart: '; consequently,'. B varianti comma splice hosil qiladi (xato). C varianti tinish belgisiz run-on jumla yaratadi. D variantida esa 'consequently' dan keyingi vergul tushib qolgan.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Digital SAT punktuatsiya formulasi: [Mustaqil gap] + ; however/therefore/consequently, + [Mustaqil gap]. Bu qolip har doim to'g'ri!

sample_test_questions.question: A truck rental company charges an initial reservation fee of $45 plus $0.80 per mile driven. An architect has a maximum budget of $225 for a one-day rental. What is the maximum number of miles the architect can drive without exceeding the budget?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Tengsizlik tuzamiz: Jami xarajat 45 + 0.80m <= 225 bo'lishi kerak, bu yerda m — bosib o'tilgan masofa. 45 ni ayiramiz: 0.80m <= 180. Ikkala tomonni 0.80 ga bo'lamiz: m <= 180 / 0.80 = 225 mil. Demak, eng ko'pi bilan 225 mil yurish mumkin. To'g'ri javob: A (225). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (200) — hisoblashda 0.8 o'rniga 0.9 ga bo'lish xatosi; C (270) — 45 ni ayirish o'rniga qo'shib yuborishdagi chalg'ituvchi tuzoq; D (250) — yaxlitlashdagi noo'rin xato natija.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ TEZ HISOBLASH: 180 / 0.8 = 1800 / 8 = 900 / 4 = 225. 5 soniyada tayyor!

sample_test_questions.question:
Consider the system of equations:
4x + 3y = 38
2x - y = 4
If (x, y) is the solution to the system, what is the value of the product x * y?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Ikkinchi tenglamadan y ni topamiz: y = 2x - 4. Buni birinchi tenglamaga qo'yamiz: 4x + 3(2x - 4) = 38 => 4x + 6x - 12 = 38 => 10x = 50 => x = 5. Endi y ni hisoblaymiz: y = 2(5) - 4 = 6. Savol x * y ko'paytmani so'ragan: 5 * 6 = 30. To'g'ri javob: A (30). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (11) — x + y yig'indini belgilab qo'yish tuzog'i; C (20) — x=4 deb yanglishgandagi xato; D (24) — y ni topishda adashish natijasidagi noto'g'ri variant.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ DESMOS USULI: Ikkala tenglamani Desmosga kiriting. Kesishish nuqtasi (5, 6) chiqadi. 5 * 6 = 30.

sample_test_questions.question:
The system of equations below has infinitely many solutions:
6x - 9y = 21
ax - 6y = b
where a and b are constants. What is the value of a + b?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Cheksiz ko'p yechimga ega bo'lishi uchun koeffitsiyentlar nisbati teng bo'lishi shart: 6 / a = -9 / (-6) = 21 / b. O'rtadagi nisbat: -9 / (-6) = 3 / 2. 1) 6 / a = 3 / 2 => 3a = 12 => a = 4. 2) 21 / b = 3 / 2 => 3b = 42 => b = 14. Yig'indi: a + b = 4 + 14 = 18. To'g'ri javob: A (18). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (14) — faqat b ning qiymatini belgilab qo'yish tuzog'i; C (10) — b - a ayirmani hisoblashdagi adashish; D (22) — ishorani noto'g'ri qo'llashdagi xato variant.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ PROPORSIONALLIK QOIDASI: 2-tenglamadagi y koeffitsiyenti (-6) 1-tenglamadagidan (-9) 2/3 barobar. Demak a = 6 * (2/3) = 4, b = 21 * (2/3) = 14. 4 + 14 = 18!

sample_test_questions.question: A carpenter manufactures wooden bookshelves and desks. Each bookshelf requires 4 hours of assembly and 2 hours of finishing, while each desk requires 6 hours of assembly and 5 hours of finishing. The workshop has at most 60 hours for assembly and at most 40 hours for finishing available each week. If the carpenter builds 6 desks in a week, what is the maximum number of bookshelves that can also be manufactured without exceeding either hourly limit?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Javonga b ta, stolga d ta deb belgilaymiz. Shart bo'yicha d = 6 ta stol yasalgan. Cheklovlar: 1) Yig'ish (assembly): 4b + 6(6) <= 60 => 4b + 36 <= 60 => 4b <= 24 => b <= 6. 2) Pardozlash (finishing): 2b + 5(6) <= 40 => 2b + 30 <= 40 => 2b <= 10 => b <= 5. Ikkala shart ham bajarilishi uchun b <= min(6, 5) = 5 bo'lishi kerak. Demak, eng ko'pi bilan 5 ta javon yasash mumkin. To'g'ri javob: A (5). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (6) — faqat yig'ish vaqtini hisoblab pardozlash vaqtidan oshib ketish (2*6+30 = 42 > 40) xatosi tuzog'i; C (4) — mumkin bo'lsa-da, maksimal emas; D (7) — ikkala vaqtdan ham oshib ketadigan xato variant.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ IKKALA CHEKLOVNI TEKSHIRISH: Ikkinchi shart b <= 5 ni talab qiladi. 6 qo'yilsa vaqt yetmaydi!

sample_test_questions.question: What is the product of all real solutions to the equation |2x - 5| + 3 = 14?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Modulni ajratamiz: |2x - 5| = 14 - 3 = 11. Ikkita holat mavjud: 1) 2x - 5 = 11 => 2x = 16 => x1 = 8. 2) 2x - 5 = -11 => 2x = -6 => x2 = -3. Ildizlar ko'paytmasi: x1 * x2 = 8 * (-3) = -24. To'g'ri javob: A (-24). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (5) — ildizlar yig'indisini hisoblab qo'yish tuzog'i; C (-11) — modul qiymatining o'zini olishdagi xato; D (24) — manfiy ishorani tashlab ketishdagi xato variant.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ DESMOS USULI: y = abs(2x - 5) + 3 va y = 14 chiziqlarini chizing. Kesishish nuqtalari x = -3 va x = 8. Ularning ko'paytmasi -24.

sample_test_questions.question: For what value of constant c does the quadratic equation 2x^2 - 8x + c = 0 have exactly one distinct real solution?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Kvadrat tenglama yagona haqiqiy yechimga ega bo'lishi uchun diskriminant nolga teng bo'lishi shart (D = 0): D = b^2 - 4ac = (-8)^2 - 4(2)(c) = 64 - 8c. 64 - 8c = 0 => 8c = 64 => c = 8. To'g'ri javob: A (8). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (16) — a=1 deb adashganda olinadigan tuzoq; C (4) — 64 ni 16 ga bo'lishdagi xato; D (-8) — ishorani teskari olishdagi xato variant.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ SAT FORMULASI: Yagona yechim uchun c = b^2 / (4a) = 64 / 8 = 8.

sample_test_questions.question:
Consider the nonlinear system of equations:
y = x^2 - 4x + 7
y = 2x - 1
If (x1, y1) and (x2, y2) are the two distinct solutions with x1 < x2, what is the value of y2 - y1?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Ikkala y ni tenglashtiramiz: x^2 - 4x + 7 = 2x - 1 => x^2 - 6x + 8 = 0. Ko'paytuvchilarga ajratamiz: (x - 2)(x - 4) = 0. Bundan x1 = 2 va x2 = 4 (chunki x1 < x2). Tegishli y qiymatlarni topamiz: y1 = 2(2) - 1 = 3; y2 = 2(4) - 1 = 7. Ayirma: y2 - y1 = 7 - 3 = 4. To'g'ri javob: A (4). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (2) — x2 - x1 ayirmani adashib belgilash tuzog'i; C (6) — arifmetik hisoblashdagi xato; D (8) — x1 va x2 ni qo'shib yuborishdagi xato variant.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ DESMOS USULI: Ikkala funksiyani kiriting. Kesishish nuqtalari (2, 3) va (4, 7). y koordinatalar ayirmasi: 7 - 3 = 4.

sample_test_questions.question: Which of the following is equivalent to the expression (3x^2 - 12) / (x^2 + 5x + 6) for all values of x > 0?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Surat va maxrajni ko'paytuvchilarga ajratamiz: Surat: 3(x^2 - 4) = 3(x - 2)(x + 2). Maxraj: (x + 2)(x + 3). Umumiy ko'paytuvchi (x + 2) ni qisqartiramiz: 3(x - 2) / (x + 3) = (3x - 6) / (x + 3). To'g'ri javob: A. Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B — suratdagi ishorani musbat deb adashish tuzog'i; C — x^2 larni noo'rin bekor qilib yuborishdagi qo'pol xato; D — 3 umumiy ko'paytuvchini yo'qotib qo'yishdagi xato variant.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ SON QO'YISH USULI: x = 1 qo'ying: Asl ifoda: (3 - 12)/(1 + 5 + 6) = -9/12 = -0.75. A variantda: (3 - 6)/(1 + 3) = -3/4 = -0.75. Mos keldi!

sample_test_questions.question: A sample of a radioactive isotope has an initial mass of 320 milligrams. The mass decays by half every 18 days. Which function M(d) models the remaining mass, in milligrams, after d days?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Yarim parchalanish eksponensial formulasi: M(d) = M0 * (0.5)^(d / davr). Bu yerda M0 = 320 mg va davr = 18 kun. Demak M(d) = 320 * (0.5)^(d/18). To'g'ri javob: A. Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B — davrni darajaga ko'paytirib qo'yish tuzog'i; C — asos va ko'paytuvchini almashtirish xatosi; D — boshlang'ich massani darhol 2 ga bo'lib 160 deb yozish xatosi.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ TEKSHIRISH: d = 18 da massa roppa-rosa 2 barobar kamayishi (160 mg) kerak. A da: 320 * (0.5)^1 = 160 to'g'ri chiqadi!

sample_test_questions.question: What is the set of all real solutions to the radical equation sqrt(4x + 9) = x - 3?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Ikkala tomonni kvadratga ko'taramiz: 4x + 9 = (x - 3)^2 = x^2 - 6x + 9. Hadlarni bir tomonga o'tkazamiz: x^2 - 10x = 0 => x(x - 10) = 0. Nomzod ildizlar: x = 0 va x = 10. Endi chet ildizlarni tekshiramiz: 1) x = 0: sqrt(9) = 3, lekin o'ng tomon 0 - 3 = -3. 3 != -3, demak x = 0 chet ildiz (noto'g'ri). 2) x = 10: sqrt(49) = 7, o'ng tomon 10 - 3 = 7. 7 = 7 to'g'ri. Shuning uchun yagona haqiqiy yechim {10}. To'g'ri javob: A ({10}). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B ({0, 10}) — chet ildizni tekshirmasdan belgilashdagi eng xavfli tuzoq; C ({0}) — faqat chet ildizni olish xatosi; D — haqiqiy yechim yo'q deb noto'g'ri xulosa chiqarish.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ CHET ILDIZ OGOHLANTIRISHI: Ildizli tenglamani kvadratga ko'targanda har doim o'ng tomon manfiy bo'lmasligini tekshiring: x - 3 >= 0 => x >= 3 bo'lishi shart! x = 0 bu shartni bajarmaydi.

sat_mocks.title: Digital SAT Mock #9: Princeton Review Full Mock 3

sample_test_questions.passage: Historical linguists reconstructed Proto-Indo-European lexical roots by comparing cognates across dozens of ancient daughter tongues, identifying common terms for wheeled carts, domesticated horses, and wool weaving. However, no shared ancestral root existed for ocean navigation, marine fauna, or seafaring vessels. This lexical absence strongly suggests that Proto-Indo-European speakers [...]
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice most logically completes the text?

options.text: inhabited an inland terrestrial environment far from major maritime coastlines.
depended primarily on maritime trade routes for essential metallurgy materials.
prohibited the consumption of fish and shellfish on strict theological grounds.
navigated open oceans without inventing any technical terminology for their vessels.

sample_test_questions.explanation: Matn tahlili: Qadimgi tilda aravacha, ot va jun to'qish kabi quruqlik atamalari ko'p bo'lgan, ammo dengiz, kemachilik yoki dengiz hayvonlariga oid bitta ham umumiy so'z bo'lmagan ('no shared ancestral root for ocean navigation'). Tilshunoslikda bu mazkur xalqning dengiz qirg'oqlaridan uzoqda, quruqlik ichkarisida (inland terrestrial environment) yashaganini bildiradi. Shuning uchun to'g'ri javob A. B va D variantlari dengiz so'zlari yo'qligiga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri zid. C varianti esa asossiz taxmindir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Digital SAT Matnni mantiqiy yakunlash: Matndagi qarama-qarshilikka e'tibor bering: Quruqlik so'zlari bor, dengiz so'zlari mutlaqo yo'q => Demak, ular dengizdan uzoqda yashagan.

sample_test_questions.passage: Thermal infrared scans of the icy crust of Jupiter's moon Europa revealed localized surface regions with high heat flux and fractured chaotic terrain. Laboratory cryo-experiments demonstrate that pure water ice under Jovian surface temperatures cannot maintain ductile deformation; it fractures brittlely unless significant dissolved salt concentrations lower the melting point and facilitate convective upwelling of liquid plumes. Therefore, scientists deduce that Europa's chaotic terrains [...]
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice most logically completes the text?

options.text: are direct surface manifestations of warm, saline subsurface ocean water interacting with the brittle ice crust.
were generated entirely by violent meteoritic impacts that vaporized the local magnetic field.
prove that Europa's core has cooled completely, ending all internal geothermal convection.
consist exclusively of pure frozen nitrogen devoid of any liquid solvent.

sample_test_questions.explanation: Matn tahlili: Tajribalar shuni ko'rsatadiki, sof muz sinuvchan bo'ladi va faqat erigan tuzlar uning erish nuqtasini pasaytirib, suyuq konvektiv oqimlar hosil bo'lgandagina bunday issiq va deformatsiyalangan relef paydo bo'lishi mumkin. Demak, Yevropadagi bunday tartibsiz relyef muz ostidagi iliq, sho'r okean suvlari bilan muz qobig'i o'zaro ta'sirlashuvining bevosita yuzadagi belgisidir (A varianti). B varianti meteorit zarbasini to'qib chiqaradi. C varianti yadro sovigan deb matnga zid da'vo qiladi (holbuki issiqlik oqimi bor). D varianti esa sof azot degan xato farazni ilgari suradi.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Digital SAT Logically Completes: 'dissolved salt + convective liquid plumes' xulosasi to'g'ridan-to'g'ri 'warm, saline subsurface ocean water' javobiga olib boradi.

sample_test_questions.passage: During the solar eclipse, daytime temperatures dropped precipitously [_______] birds ceased their singing and returned to their nests in confusion.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Grammatik qoida: Ikkita mustaqil gap (independent clauses: 'temperatures dropped...' va 'birds ceased...') o'rtasida 'consequently' kabi kon'yunktiv ravish (conjunctive adverb) kelganda, uning oldiga nuqtali vergul (;) va undan keyin vergul (,) qo'yilishi shart: '; consequently,'. B varianti comma splice hosil qiladi (xato). C varianti tinish belgisiz run-on jumla yaratadi. D variantida esa 'consequently' dan keyingi vergul tushib qolgan.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Digital SAT punktuatsiya formulasi: [Mustaqil gap] + ; however/therefore/consequently, + [Mustaqil gap]. Bu qolip har doim to'g'ri!

sample_test_questions.passage: The observatory's primary mirror required three years of continuous optical [_______] researchers finally achieved the nanometer-scale curvature necessary to resolve exoplanet atmospheres.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Grammatik qoida: 'The observatory's primary mirror required three years of continuous optical polishing' mustaqil gap bo'lib, 'before researchers finally achieved...' ergash gap (dependent adverbial clause) hisoblanadi. Agar ergash gap asosiy gapdan KEYIN kelsa, uning oldidan vergul yoki nuqtali vergul qo'yilmaydi: 'polishing before'. Shuning uchun to'g'ri javob A. B variantida keraksiz vergul bor (xato). C variantida ergash gap oldidan nuqtali vergul ishlatilgan (qo'pol xato). D varianti esa ma'noni buzadi.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Digital SAT qoidasi: [Mustaqil gap] + before/because/although + [Ergash gap] bo'lganda o'rtada hech qanday VERGUL qo'yilmaydi!

sample_test_questions.passage: The geobiologist identified the single environmental factor responsible for the mass microbial die-off in the hypersaline [_______] a sudden, catastrophic depletion of dissolved oxygen.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Grammatik qoida: Ikki nuqta (colon) to'liq mustaqil gapdan keyin kelib, o'sha gapda aytilgan tushunchani (bu yerda: 'the single environmental factor') izohlash, ta'riflash yoki ro'yxatini keltirish uchun ishlatiladi: '...in the hypersaline lake: a sudden, catastrophic depletion...'. Shuning uchun to'g'ri javob A. B varianti vergul bilan chalkashlik yaratadi. C varianti (nuqtali vergul) xato, chunki undan keyin mustaqil gap kelmagan. D varianti esa chegarasiz xato tuzilmadir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Digital SAT Ikki nuqta (Colon) oltin qoidasi: Ikki nuqtadan oldin to'liq mustaqil gap (independent clause) turishi SHART. Ikki nuqtadan keyin esa izoh yoki misol keladi.

sample_test_questions.passage: The expedition's senior navigator [_______] an experienced seafarer who had charted three previous polar voyages—immediately recognized that the pack ice was shifting dangerously.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Grammatik qoida: Qo'shimcha izohlovchi kiritma ibora (appositive phrase: 'an experienced seafarer who had charted three previous polar voyages') chiziqcha (em-dash) bilan yopilgan ('—immediately recognized...'). Shuning uchun uning boshlanishi ham aynan bitta chiziqcha (em-dash) bilan ochilishi SHART: 'senior navigator—an experienced...—immediately'. Juft belgilar qoidasi buzilmasligi kerak. To'g'ri javob: A. B varianti vergul bilan ochib chiziqcha bilan yopish xatosi (mismatch). C va D variantlari butunlay noo'rin.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Digital SAT simmetriya qoidasi: Agar kiritma ibora oxirida chiziqcha (—) tursa, uning boshida ham albatta chiziqcha (—) bo'lishi shart!

sample_test_questions.passage: Although the rare alpine orchid blooms for only forty-eight hours each [_______] botanists from around the world travel to the high meadows to document its delicate pollination ecology.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Grammatik qoida: Gap ergash bog'lovchi (dependent clause: 'Although the rare alpine orchid blooms...') bilan boshlanganda, ergash gap tugagan joyda asosiy mustaqil gapdan ajratish uchun bitta VERGUL qo'yilishi shart: 'each spring, botanists from around the world...'. Shuning uchun to'g'ri javob A. B variantida vergul tushib qolgan (xato). C va D variantlarida nuqtali vergul yoki nuqta qo'yilsa, birinchi qism chala jumlaga (sentence fragment) aylanib qoladi.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Digital SAT punktuatsiya qoidasi: Although/Because/While + [gap], + [asosiy gap]. Boshidagi ergash gapdan keyin har doim oddiy VERGUL qo'yiladi.

sample_test_questions.passage: The intricate network of subterranean fungal filaments beneath the ancient pine [_______] crucial nutrients and chemical warnings across vast distances.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Grammatik qoida: Ega (subject) bilan kesim (verb) moslashuvi. Ega bu yerda ko'plikdagi 'filaments' yoki 'pine' emas, balki birlikdagi 'The intricate network' hisoblanadi ('of subterranean fungal filaments beneath the ancient pine' oraliq predlogli ibora bo'lib, egaga ta'sir qilmaydi). Ega birlikda ('network') bo'lgani uchun fe'l ham birlikda bo'lishi kerak: 'transmits'. Shuning uchun to'g'ri javob A. B, C, D variantlaridagi fe'llar ko'plikda bo'lib ('transmit', 'have transmitted', 'are transmitting'), ega bilan moslashmagan xato variantlardir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Digital SAT Ega-kesim qoidasi: 'of...', 'in...', 'beneath...' bilan boshlangan predlogli iboralarni xayolan o'chirib tashlang: 'The network [transmits]'. Javob darhol oydinlashadi!

sample_test_questions.passage: Each of the experimental composite alloys subjected to the stress chamber [_______] its structural integrity under extreme thermodynamic loads.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Grammatik qoida: 'Each' so'zi bilan boshlangan ega har doim BIRLIK (singular) hisoblanadi ('Each of the alloys...'). Garchi 'alloys' ko'plikda bo'lsa ham, haqiqiy grammatik ega 'Each' dir. Birlikdagi ega birlikdagi fe'lni talab qiladi: 'maintains'. To'g'ri javob: A. B, C, D variantlari ko'plik shakllari bo'lib, qoidaga zid xato javoblardir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Digital SAT qoidasi: Each, Neither, Either, Everyone, Somebody kabi olmoshlar bilan boshlangan ega doimo birlikda bo'ladi va -s qo'shimchali fe'lni oladi (maintains).

sample_test_questions.passage: By the time modern archaeologists arrived at the submerged coastal cave in 2012, rising sea levels [_______] the delicate prehistoric cave paintings that had survived for twenty millennia.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Grammatik qoida: 'By the time + o'tgan zamon' (arrived in 2012) iborasi o'tmishdagi ma'lum bir vaqtdan oldinroq sodir bo'lib tugagan harakatni ifodalaydi. Bunday holatda Past Perfect (had + V3) zamoni qo'llanishi shart: 'had already destroyed'. Shuning uchun to'g'ri javob A. B varianti hozirgi oddiy zamon (xato). C varianti Present Perfect bo'lib, o'tmishdagi 'in 2012' bilan birikmaydi. D varianti esa kelasi zamon bo'lib kontekstga zid.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Digital SAT Zamon qoidasi: 'By the time + Past Simple' formulasi ko'rinsa, asosiy gapda har doim 'had + V3' (Past Perfect) bo'ladi!

sample_test_questions.question: What is the minimum value of the quadratic function g(x) = 3x^2 - 24x + 55?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Parabolaning shoxlari yuqoriga qaragan (a = 3 > 0), shuning uchun uning eng kichik qiymati cho'qqisida (vertex) bo'ladi. Cho'qqining x koordinatasi: x = -b / (2a) = -(-24) / (2 * 3) = 24 / 6 = 4. Eng kichik qiymat g(4) ga teng: g(4) = 3(4)^2 - 24(4) + 55 = 3(16) - 96 + 55 = 48 - 96 + 55 = 7. To'g'ri javob: A (7). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (4) — minimum nuqtani (x koordinatani) qiymat deb adashib belgilash klassik tuzog'i; C (55) — y-kesishmasini minimum deb o'ylash xatosi; D (-7) — ishora xatosi natijasidagi noto'g'ri variant.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ DESMOS USULI: Desmosga y = 3x^2 - 24x + 55 ni kiriting va eng pastki nuqtani bosing: (4, 7). Minimum qiymat y = 7!

sample_test_questions.question: A survey of 200 university students recorded their major and mathematics course enrollment. Among the 80 Science majors, 60 enrolled in Statistics and 20 in Calculus. Among the 120 Humanities majors, 30 enrolled in Statistics and 90 in Calculus. If a student who enrolled in Statistics is selected at random, what is the probability that the student is a Science major?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Shartli ehtimollik formulasi: P(Science | Statistics) = N(Science va Statistics) / N(Jami Statistics). Statistics kursiga yozilganlar jami soni: 60 (Science) + 30 (Humanities) = 90 nafar. Ularning ichidan Science yo'nalishidagi talabalar soni: 60 nafar. Ehtimollik: 60 / 90 = 2/3. To'g'ri javob: A (2/3). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (3/4) — 60 / 80 deb Science talabalari ichidan hisoblash tuzog'i; C (3/10) — 60 / 200 deb butun talabalar soniga bo'lish xatosi; D (1/2) — guruhlarni teng deb faraz qilishdagi xato variant.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ SHARTLI EHTIMOLLIK KALITI: 'If a student who enrolled in Statistics...' so'zlari maxraj faqat Statistics olganlar (60+30=90) bo'lishini bildiradi!

sample_test_questions.question: An online retailer increased the price of a wireless keyboard by 25% in November. In January, the retailer discounted the new price by 20%. What was the overall percentage change from the original price?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Multiplikator usulini qo'llaymiz: Dastlabki narx P bo'lsin. 1) 25% oshish: P * 1.25. 2) 20% arzonlashish: yangi narx * (1 - 0.20) = P * 1.25 * 0.80. Ko'paytiramiz: 1.25 * 0.80 = 1.00. Demak yakuniy narx 1.00 * P ga teng, ya'ni narx o'zgarmagan (0% o'zgarish). To'g'ri javob: A. Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (5% increase) — 25% - 20% = +5% deb foizlarni oddiy ayirib yuboradigan eng mashhur SAT tuzog'i; C (5% decrease) — adashgan yo'nalish; D — noo'rin yaxlitlashdagi xato variant.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ QULAY SON TANLASH: Dastlabki narxni $100 deb oling: 25% oshsa $125 bo'ladi. $125 ning 20%i = $25. $125 - $25 = $100. Qaytib o'ziga keldi (0%)!

sample_test_questions.question: A research institute surveyed a random sample of 1,200 registered voters in a metropolitan area regarding a new transit tax. The survey found that 58% supported the tax, with a margin of error of 2.8% at a 95% confidence level. Which of the following is the most appropriate conclusion?

options.text: It is plausible that the true proportion of all registered voters in the metropolitan area who support the tax is between 55.2% and 60.8%.
Exactly 58% of all registered voters in the metropolitan area support the tax.
95% of all registered voters in the metropolitan area support the tax.
The true proportion of voters supporting the tax cannot be greater than 58%.

sample_test_questions.explanation: Ishonch oralig'i (confidence interval) hisoblanadi: 58% +- 2.8%, ya'ni [55.2%, 60.8%]. Bu butun populyatsiyadagi haqiqiy ulush ushbu oraliqda bo'lishi asosli (plausible) ekanligini bildiradi. To'g'ri javob: A. Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B — tanlanma natijasini butun aholi uchun qat'iy 'aynan 58%' deb e'lon qilish statistikaga zid tuzoq; C — 95% ishonchlilik darajasini qo'llab-quvvatlovchilar ulushi deb adashtirish xatosi; D — oraliq yuqori chegarasi 60.8% gacha borishini inkor etuvchi xato variant.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ SAT STATISTIKA QOIDASI: 'Margin of error' har doim interval beradi (58 - 2.8 dan 58 + 2.8 gacha). 'Exactly' yoki 'cannot' so'zlari bo'lgan variantlar deyarli har doim noto'g'ri!

sample_test_questions.question: A solid metal alloy block has a volume of 450 cubic centimeters. The density of the alloy is 7.8 grams per cubic centimeter. What is the mass of the block in kilograms? (1 kilogram = 1,000 grams)
sample_test_questions.explanation: Massa formulasi: m = Zichlik * Hajm = 7.8 g/cm^3 * 450 cm^3 = 3510 gramm. Grammdan kilogrammga o'tkazamiz: 3510 / 1000 = 3.51 kg. To'g'ri javob: A (3.51). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (35.1) — 100 ga bo'lishdagi xato; C (0.351) — 10000 ga bo'lishdagi vergul surilishi xatosi; D (3,510) — massani grammda qoldirib, kilogrammga o'tkazishni unutish klassik tuzog'idir.

sample_test_questions.question: A scatterplot displays the weekly practice hours x and test scores y for 20 students. The line of best fit is given by y_pred = 6.5x + 48. One student practiced for 6 hours and achieved an actual score of 92. What is the residual (actual score minus predicted score) for this student?
sample_test_questions.explanation: 1) Bashorat qilingan ballni hisoblaymiz: y_pred = 6.5(6) + 48 = 39 + 48 = 87. 2) Qoldiq (residual) = Haqiqiy ball - Bashorat qilingan ball = 92 - 87 = +5. To'g'ri javob: A (+5). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (-5) — ayirmani teskari (bashorat - haqiqiy) hisoblashdagi ishora tuzog'i; C (87) — bashorat qilingan ballning o'zini belgilash xatosi; D (92) — haqiqiy ballning o'zini qoldiq deb o'ylash xatosi.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ RESIDUAL QOIDASI: Residual = Actual - Predicted (y - y_hat). Nuqta chiziqdan yuqorida bo'lsa, musbat qoldiq bo'ladi!

sample_test_questions.question: A dataset contains 9 test scores: 72, 74, 76, 78, 80, 82, 84, 86, 88. An outlier with a score of 20 is added to the dataset. Which statement correctly compares the median and mean of the new 10-score dataset with the original 9-score dataset?

options.text: Both the mean and the median decrease, but the mean decreases by a greater amount.
Both the mean and the median decrease, but the median decreases by a greater amount.
The median remains unchanged, while the mean decreases.
The mean remains unchanged, while the median decreases.

sample_test_questions.explanation: Dastlabki 9 ta son simmetrik: mediana = 80, o'rtacha qiymat (mean) = 80. Yangi ro'yxat: 20, 72, 74, 76, 78, 80, 82, 84, 86, 88. 1) Yangi mediana = (78 + 80) / 2 = 79 (1 ga kamaydi). 2) Yangi o'rtacha qiymat = (720 + 20) / 10 = 74 (6 ga kamaydi). Ikkalasi ham kamayadi, lekin o'rtacha qiymat ancha ko'proq kamayadi (-6 ga qarshi -1). To'g'ri javob: A. Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B — medianani kutilmagan ko'rsatkichlarga ta'sirchan deb o'ylash xatosi; C va D — o'zgarishsiz qoladi deb noto'g'ri hisoblash tuzoqlari.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ SAT KONSEPSIYASI: O'rtacha qiymat (mean) anomal qiymatlarga (outliers) nihoyatda sezgir, mediana esa ancha mustahkam (resistant) turadi!

sample_test_questions.question: Account A starts with $1,000 and earns 8% interest compounded annually. Account B starts with $1,500 and earns $100 simple interest each year. After 15 years, which account has the greater total balance, and by approximately how much?
sample_test_questions.explanation: 1) Account A (murakkab foiz): 1000 * (1 + 0.08)^15 = 1000 * (1.08)^15. 1.08^15 taxminan 3.17217 ga teng => Balans = $3,172. 2) Account B (oddiy foiz): 1500 + 15 * 100 = 1500 + 1500 = $3,000. Account A ko'proq: $3,172 - $3,000 = $172. To'g'ri javob: A. Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B — Account B katta deb xato tanlash; C — dastlabki farqni $300 deb o'ylash tuzog'i; D — tenglashadi deb yanglishishdagi xato variant.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ DESMOS USULI: Desmosga 1000 * 1.08^15 va 1500 + 15*100 ni yozing. 3172.17 va 3000 chiqadi. Ayirmasi 172.17!

sample_test_questions.question: In the xy-plane, what is the radius of the circle defined by the equation x^2 + y^2 - 8x + 6y - 11 = 0?
sample_test_questions.explanation: To'la kvadratga ajratamiz: (x^2 - 8x + 16) + (y^2 + 6y + 9) = 11 + 16 + 9. (x - 4)^2 + (y + 3)^2 = 36. Aylananing standart tenglamasi: (x - h)^2 + (y - k)^2 = r^2. r^2 = 36 bo'lgani uchun radius r = sqrt(36) = 6. To'g'ri javob: A (6). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (36) — r^2 ni radius deb adashib belgilash klassik tuzog'i; C (4) — markazning x koordinatasi; D (11) — tenglamadagi ozod hadni olishdagi xato variant.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ RADUS TEZKOR FORMULASI: r = sqrt((d/2)^2 + (e/2)^2 - f) = sqrt(4^2 + (-3)^2 - (-11)) = sqrt(16 + 9 + 11) = sqrt(36) = 6.

sample_test_questions.question: A circular community garden has a diameter of 20 meters. A triangular floral sector formed by central radii OA and OB subtends a central angle of 72 degrees. What is the area of this sector, in square meters?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Diametr 20 metr bo'lsa, radius r = 20 / 2 = 10 metr bo'ladi. To'liq aylananing yuzi: S_doira = pi * r^2 = pi * (10)^2 = 100pi. 72 gradusli sektorning to'liq doiradagi ulushi: 72 / 360 = 1 / 5 qism. Sektor yuzi: S_sektor = (1 / 5) * 100pi = 20pi m^2. To'g'ri javob: A (20pi). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (40pi) — radius o'rniga diametrni (20) qo'yib yuborish tuzog'i; C (10pi) — yuzani noto'g'ri bo'lishdagi xato; D (80pi) — 400pi / 5 deb diametr bilan xato hisoblashdagi variant.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ TEZKOR NISBAT: 72° / 360° = 1/5. Doira yuzi pi*10^2 = 100pi. 100pi / 5 = 20pi!

sat_mocks.title: Digital SAT Mock #10: Princeton Review Full Mock 4

sample_test_questions.passage: The intricate network of subterranean fungal filaments beneath the ancient pine [_______] crucial nutrients and chemical warnings across vast distances.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Grammatik qoida: Ega (subject) bilan kesim (verb) moslashuvi. Ega bu yerda ko'plikdagi 'filaments' yoki 'pine' emas, balki birlikdagi 'The intricate network' hisoblanadi ('of subterranean fungal filaments beneath the ancient pine' oraliq predlogli ibora bo'lib, egaga ta'sir qilmaydi). Ega birlikda ('network') bo'lgani uchun fe'l ham birlikda bo'lishi kerak: 'transmits'. Shuning uchun to'g'ri javob A. B, C, D variantlaridagi fe'llar ko'plikda bo'lib ('transmit', 'have transmitted', 'are transmitting'), ega bilan moslashmagan xato variantlardir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Digital SAT Ega-kesim qoidasi: 'of...', 'in...', 'beneath...' bilan boshlangan predlogli iboralarni xayolan o'chirib tashlang: 'The network [transmits]'. Javob darhol oydinlashadi!

sample_test_questions.passage: Each of the experimental composite alloys subjected to the stress chamber [_______] its structural integrity under extreme thermodynamic loads.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Grammatik qoida: 'Each' so'zi bilan boshlangan ega har doim BIRLIK (singular) hisoblanadi ('Each of the alloys...'). Garchi 'alloys' ko'plikda bo'lsa ham, haqiqiy grammatik ega 'Each' dir. Birlikdagi ega birlikdagi fe'lni talab qiladi: 'maintains'. To'g'ri javob: A. B, C, D variantlari ko'plik shakllari bo'lib, qoidaga zid xato javoblardir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Digital SAT qoidasi: Each, Neither, Either, Everyone, Somebody kabi olmoshlar bilan boshlangan ega doimo birlikda bo'ladi va -s qo'shimchali fe'lni oladi (maintains).

sample_test_questions.passage: By the time modern archaeologists arrived at the submerged coastal cave in 2012, rising sea levels [_______] the delicate prehistoric cave paintings that had survived for twenty millennia.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Grammatik qoida: 'By the time + o'tgan zamon' (arrived in 2012) iborasi o'tmishdagi ma'lum bir vaqtdan oldinroq sodir bo'lib tugagan harakatni ifodalaydi. Bunday holatda Past Perfect (had + V3) zamoni qo'llanishi shart: 'had already destroyed'. Shuning uchun to'g'ri javob A. B varianti hozirgi oddiy zamon (xato). C varianti Present Perfect bo'lib, o'tmishdagi 'in 2012' bilan birikmaydi. D varianti esa kelasi zamon bo'lib kontekstga zid.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Digital SAT Zamon qoidasi: 'By the time + Past Simple' formulasi ko'rinsa, asosiy gapda har doim 'had + V3' (Past Perfect) bo'ladi!

sample_test_questions.passage: Along the southern perimeter of the ancient archaeological trench [_______] several unexcavated ceramic vessels dating to the early Bronze Age.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Grammatik qoida: Bu o'rin almashgan gap (inverted sentence). Gap o'rin holi ('Along the southern perimeter...') bilan boshlanganda ega fe'ldan keyin keladi. Bu yerdagi haqiqiy ega fe'ldan keyin turgan 'several unexcavated ceramic vessels' (ko'plikda!). Ega ko'plikda bo'lgani uchun fe'l ham ko'plikda bo'lishi kerak: 'lie'. B, C, D variantlari birlik shakllari bo'lib ('lies', 'is lying', 'has lain'), 'vessels' bilan mos kelmaydigan xato variantlardir. To'g'ri javob: A.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Digital SAT Inverted Sentence hiylasi: Agar gap predlogli o'rin holi bilan boshlansa, fe'ldan KEYIN kelgan otni toping. Ot ko'plikda (vessels) bo'lsa, fe'l ham ko'plikda (lie) bo'ladi!

sample_test_questions.passage: The scholarship committee granted prestigious international fellowships to both Dr. Ramirez and [_______] in recognition of their pioneering glaciological fieldwork.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Grammatik qoida: Olmosh kelishigi (pronoun case). 'To' predlog (preposition) hisoblanadi. Ingliz tilida predloglardan keyin doimo to'ldiruvchi kelishigi (objective case: me, him, her, us, them) ishlatiladi: 'to both Dr. Ramirez and her'. B, C, D variantlari bosh kelishikdagi olmoshlar (she, they, he) bo'lib, predlogdan keyin qo'llanishi qo'pol grammatik xatodir. To'g'ri javob: A.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Digital SAT Olmosh qoidasi: 'Dr. Ramirez and' qismini olib tashlang: 'granted fellowships to [her]'. Hech qachon 'to she' deyilmaydi!

sample_test_questions.passage: [_______] the conservation team carefully transported the fragile fossil specimen to the temperature-controlled preservation laboratory.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

options.text: Having stabilized the sandstone matrix by the conservation team,
The sandstone matrix having been stabilized,
Stabilizing the sandstone matrix was completed, so

sample_test_questions.explanation: Grammatik qoida: Osilgan aniqlovchi (dangling modifier) qoidasi. 'Having stabilized the sandstone matrix' sifatdosh iborasi bilan boshlangan jumladan so'ng bevosita ushbu harakatni bajargan shaxs/guruh (ega) kelishi shart. Sandtosh matrisasini kim barqarorlashtirgan? Albatta, 'the conservation team'! Shuning uchun A varianti to'liq grammatik uyg'undir. B va C variantlari passiv va chalkash tuzilmalar hosil qiladi. D varianti esa vergul bilan bog'lanish qoidasini buzadi.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Digital SAT Modifier qoidasi: Verguldan keyingi so'zga qarang: 'Having done X, [KIM? -> the conservation team]'. Verguldan keyin har doim harakat egasi kelishi shart!

sample_test_questions.passage: The new environmental protection regulation requires factories to install modern electrostatic precipitators, to monitor sulfur dioxide emissions daily, and [_______] comprehensive environmental impact statements quarterly.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Grammatik qoida: Parallel tuzilish (parallel structure). Ro'yxatdagi barcha elementlar bir xil grammatik shaklda bo'lishi lozim: 'to install...', 'to monitor...', and 'to submit...'. To'g'ri javob: A. B varianti (submitting) gerund bo'lib, parallelizmni buzadi (xato). C varianti (submission of) ot birikmasi. D varianti esa alohida gap bo'lib qoladi.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Digital SAT Parallelism qoidasi: Ro'yxatdagi fe'llarning shaklini sanang: to + fe'l, to + fe'l, and [to + fe'l]!

sample_test_questions.passage: Emitting pulses of coherent ultraviolet light, [_______] capable of etching nanoscale semiconductor pathways with unprecedented accuracy.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

options.text: the newly calibrated excimer laser is
engineers calibrated an excimer laser that is
accurate calibration of the excimer laser makes it
nanoscale semiconductor pathways are etched by the excimer laser,

sample_test_questions.explanation: Grammatik qoida: Aniqlovchi (modifier) moslashuvi. 'Emitting pulses of coherent ultraviolet light' (kogerent ultrabinafsha nurlarini chiqaruvchi) deb nimaga aytilmoqda? Albatta, yangi sozlangan eksimer lazerga ('the newly calibrated excimer laser')! Verguldan keyin bevosita lazer kelishi shart. To'g'ri javob: A. B variantida verguldan keyin 'engineers' kelgan (muhandislar ultrabinafsha nur chiqarmaydi, xato). C variantida 'calibration' kelgan (abstrakt tushuncha nur chiqarmaydi). D variantida esa 'pathways' kelgan.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Digital SAT Modifier savollari: Kirish iborasidagi harakatni kim/nima qilayotganini so'rang: Nurni nima chiqaradi? Lazer! Demak verguldan keyin birinchi so'z 'the laser' bo'lishi shart.

sample_test_questions.passage: Many computer scientists predicted that quantum annealing hardware would instantly render classical encryption protocols obsolete. [_______] classical cryptographic algorithms augmented with lattice-based mathematics have proven exceptionally resilient against quantum decryption attacks.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Mantiqiy bog'lovchi tahlili: Birinchi gapda mutaxassislar kvant texnologiyalari klassik shifrlashni darhol eskirgan qilib qo'yishini bashorat qilgani aytilgan. Ikkinchi gapda esa klassik algoritmlar kvant hujumlariga qarshi juda chidamli ekanligi isbotlangani ta'kidlanadi. Bu ikki fikr o'rtasida yaqqol qarama-qarshilik (contrast) mavjud. Shuning uchun 'However,' (Biroq) eng to'g'ri bog'lovchidir. To'g'ri javob: A. B varianti qo'shimcha fikr (addition), C varianti oqibat (cause-effect), D varianti esa aniqlashtirish bo'lib, mantiqan mos kelmaydi.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Digital SAT Bog'lovchilar strategiyasi: Fikrlar yo'nalishini aniqlang: Bashorat (eskiradi) vs Haqiqat (chidamli chiqdi) => Qarama-qarshilik (-) => 'However'.

sample_test_questions.passage: The agricultural province experienced twelve consecutive weeks of sub-zero frost during the early flowering phase of the stone-fruit orchards. [_______] regional peach and apricot yields dropped by more than 75% compared to the prior ten-year rolling average.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Mantiqiy bog'lovchi tahlili: Birinchi gapda 12 hafta davomida sovuq ayoz bo'lgani (sabab), ikkinchi gapda esa shaftoli va o'rik hosili 75% ga tushib ketgani (oqibat) aytilmoqda. Sabab-oqibat munosabatini ifodalash uchun 'As a result,' (Natijada) bog'lovchisi talab qilinadi. To'g'ri javob: A. B va D variantlari qarama-qarshilik bildiruvchi noto'g'ri bog'lovchilar. C varianti esa o'xshashlik bildiruvchi xato variantdir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Digital SAT Transition qoidasi: Sabab (sovuq urishi) -> Oqibat (hosil kamayishi) => 'As a result', 'Consequently', yoki 'Therefore'.

sample_test_questions.question: Triangle PQR is similar to triangle XYZ, where vertices P, Q, and R correspond to X, Y, and Z, respectively. The length of side PQ is 6, and the length of corresponding side XY is 15. If the area of triangle PQR is 24 square centimeters, what is the area of triangle XYZ, in square centimeters?
sample_test_questions.explanation: O'xshashlik koeffitsiyenti k = XY / PQ = 15 / 6 = 5/2 = 2.5. O'xshash figuralarning maydonlari nisbati o'xshashlik koeffitsiyentining kvadratiga teng (k^2): Area(XYZ) = Area(PQR) * k^2 = 24 * (5/2)^2 = 24 * (25 / 4) = 6 * 25 = 150 sm^2. To'g'ri javob: A (150). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (60) — maydonni k ga (kvadratsiz) ko'paytirib qo'yishdagi klassik tuzoq (24 * 2.5 = 60); C (120) va D (240) — noto'g'ri ko'paytirishdagi chalg'ituvchi xato variantlar.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ MAYDON VA HAJM QOIDASI: Chiziqli o'lcham k marta kattalashsa, maydon k^2 marta, hajm esa k^3 marta ortadi!

sample_test_questions.question: A cylindrical water storage tank has a base diameter of 8 meters and a height of 10 meters. What is the total volume of the tank, in cubic meters?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Asos diametri d = 8 m bo'lsa, radiusi r = d / 2 = 4 m bo'ladi. Silindr hajmi formulasi: V = pi * r^2 * h = pi * (4)^2 * 10 = pi * 16 * 10 = 160pi m^3. To'g'ri javob: A (160pi). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (640pi) — radius o'rniga diametrni (8^2=64) qo'yib yuborish tuzog'i; C (80pi) — formuladagi r^2 o'rniga r*h deb adashish xatosi; D (40pi) — konus formulasini (1/3 yoki 1/4) noo'rin qo'llashdagi xato variant.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ DIQQAT: Diametr berilganda doimo birinchi ish uni 2 ga bo'lib radiusni (r = 4) topishdir!

sample_test_questions.question: In an equilateral triangle DEF, each side has a length of 14. What is the exact length of the altitude of triangle DEF?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Teng tomonli uchburchakning balandligi uni ikkita 30-60-90 to'g'ri burchakli uchburchakka ajratadi. Gipotenuza = 14, 30 gradus qarshisidagi katet (asosning yarmi) = 7. 60 gradus qarshisidagi balandlik: h = asos_kateti * sqrt(3) = 7 * sqrt(3). To'g'ri javob: A. Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B — 45-45-90 uchburchak bilan adashtirib sqrt(2) olish xatosi; C (7) — faqat asosning yarmini belgilash tuzog'i; D — gipotenuzaga sqrt(3) ni ko'paytirib qo'yishdagi xato variant.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ FORMULA: Tomoni s bo'lgan muntazam uchburchak balandligi h = s * sqrt(3) / 2 = 14 * sqrt(3) / 2 = 7*sqrt(3).

sample_test_questions.question: A drone logistics company charges an initial dispatch fee of $15 plus $1.25 per kilometer flown. A client has a maximum spending budget of $65 for a single package delivery. What is the maximum distance, in kilometers, the drone can fly without exceeding the client's budget?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Tengsizlik tuzamiz: Jami to'lov 15 + 1.25d <= 65 bo'lishi lozim, bu yerda d — masofa. Dastlabki to'lov 15 ni ayiramiz: 1.25d <= 50. Ikkala tomonni 1.25 ga bo'lamiz: d <= 50 / 1.25 = 40 km. Demak, eng ko'pi bilan 40 km uchish mumkin. To'g'ri javob: A (40). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (35) — hisoblashda 15 ni ikki marta ayirish xatosi; C (50) — bazaviy to'lovni hisobga olmaslik tuzog'i; D (45) — yaxlitlashdagi xato variant.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ TEZ HISOBLASH: 50 / 1.25 = 50 / (5/4) = 50 * 4 / 5 = 40. 3 soniyada tayyor!

sample_test_questions.question: If 4(2x - 7) + 5(x + 3) = 65, what is the value of the expression 3x - 5?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Qavslarni ochamiz: 8x - 28 + 5x + 15 = 65. O'xshash hadlarni jamlaymiz: 13x - 13 = 65. 13 ni o'ng tomonga qo'shamiz: 13x = 78 => x = 6. Savol x ni emas, 3x - 5 ifodani so'ragan: 3(6) - 5 = 18 - 5 = 13. To'g'ri javob: A (13). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (6) — x ning o'zini shoshib belgilash klassik SAT tuzog'i; C (18) — 3x ning qiymati; D (21) — qo'shishdagi adashish natijasidagi xato variant.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ DIQQAT: Savol x ni emas, 3x - 5 ni so'ramoqda! Desmosda x = 6 ni topib, darhol 3(6)-5 = 13 deb hisoblang.

sample_test_questions.question: An art gallery sells large canvas prints for $120 each and small prints for $45 each. A collector purchases a total of 14 prints and spends exactly $1,080. How many large canvas prints did the collector purchase?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Katta rasmlar L ta, kichiklari S ta bo'lsin. 1) L + S = 14 => S = 14 - L. 2) 120L + 45S = 1080. O'rniga qo'yamiz: 120L + 45(14 - L) = 1080 => 120L + 630 - 45L = 1080 => 75L = 450 => L = 6 ta katta rasm. To'g'ri javob: A (6). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (8) — kichik rasmlar sonini (S = 8) belgilab qo'yish tuzog'i; C (5) va D (9) — hisob-kitobdagi xato variantlar.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ DESMOS USULI: Desmosga x + y = 14 va 120x + 45y = 1080 ni kiriting. Kesishish nuqtasi (6, 8). Katta rasm x = 6!

sample_test_questions.question: The linear equation 8x - 12 = 2(kx + 5) has no real solution, where k is a constant. What is the value of k?
sample_test_questions.explanation: O'ng tomonni ochamiz: 8x - 12 = 2kx + 10. Chiziqli tenglama yechimga ega bo'lmasligi (no solution) uchun x oldidagi koeffitsiyentlar teng, ozod hadlar esa turli bo'lishi shart: 8 = 2k => k = 4. Ozod hadlar -12 != 10 bo'lgani uchun tenglama hech qachon bajarilmaydi. To'g'ri javob: A (4). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (-4) — ishorani adashtirish tuzog'i; C (8) — 2 ga bo'lishni unutish xatosi; D (2) — arifmetik yanglishishdagi xato variant.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ NO SOLUTION QOIDASI: x ning koeffitsiyentlari teng bo'lishi shart: 8 = 2k => k = 4!

sample_test_questions.question: A theater sells adult admission tickets for $14 each and student tickets for $9 each. A community group has a maximum budget of $150 and must purchase at least 12 tickets in total. If x represents the number of adult tickets and y represents the number of student tickets, which system of inequalities represents this scenario?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Masala tahlili va bosqichma-bosqich yechim: 1) Jami sarf 150 dollardan oshmasligi kerak (maximum budget): 14x + 9y <= 150. 2) Jami biletlar soni kamida 12 ta bo'lishi shart (at least 12): x + y >= 12. Bu shartlar A variantda aynan to'g'ri ifodalangan. Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B variantida tengsizlik ishoralari teskari qo'yilgan; C variantida x va y narxlari almashtirilgan; D variantida kamida 12 ta degan shart 'x + y <= 12' deb xato yozilgan.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ KALIT SO'ZLAR: 'at most / maximum' = <= ; 'at least / minimum' = >=.

sample_test_questions.question: What is the sum of all real solutions to the absolute value equation |4x - 6| = 18?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Ikkita holat: 1) 4x - 6 = 18 => 4x = 24 => x1 = 6. 2) 4x - 6 = -18 => 4x = -12 => x2 = -3. Ildizlar yig'indisi: x1 + x2 = 6 + (-3) = 3. To'g'ri javob: A (3). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (-18) — modul qiymati bilan adashish; C (6) — faqat bitta musbat ildizni belgilab qo'yish tuzog'i; D (9) — ildizlarni noto'g'ri ayirishdagi xato variant.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ MODUL SIMMETRIYASI: |ax - b| = c ning ildizlari b/a markaziga nisbatan simmetrik. Yig'indi doimo 2*(b/a) = 2*(6/4) = 3 bo'ladi!

sample_test_questions.question: The graph of a linear function f passes through points (2, 11) and (5, 23) in the xy-plane. What is the value of f(9)?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Chiziqli funksiya qiyaligi (slope): m = (23 - 11) / (5 - 2) = 12 / 3 = 4. Funksiya tenglamasi: f(x) - 11 = 4(x - 2) => f(x) = 4x + 3. Endi x = 9 ni qo'yamiz: f(9) = 4(9) + 3 = 36 + 3 = 39. To'g'ri javob: A (39). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (36) — ozod had 3 ni qo'shishni unutish xatosi; C (41) va D (43) — hisoblashdagi xato variantlar.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ BOSQICHMA-BOSQICH QADAM: x har 3 ga oshganda y 12 ga oshyapti (har 1 birlik x uchun +4 y). x = 5 dan x = 9 gacha +4 qadam: 23 + 4*4 = 39!
