sample_test_questions.explanation: Mantiqiy bog'lovchi tahlili: Birinchi gapda mutaxassislar kvant texnologiyalari klassik shifrlashni darhol eskirgan qilib qo'yishini bashorat qilgani aytilgan. Ikkinchi gapda esa klassik algoritmlar kvant hujumlariga qarshi juda chidamli ekanligi isbotlangani ta'kidlanadi. Bu ikki fikr o'rtasida yaqqol qarama-qarshilik (contrast) mavjud. Shuning uchun 'However,' (Biroq) eng to'g'ri bog'lovchidir. To'g'ri javob: A. B varianti qo'shimcha fikr (addition), C varianti oqibat (cause-effect), D varianti esa aniqlashtirish bo'lib, mantiqan mos kelmaydi.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Digital SAT Bog'lovchilar strategiyasi: Fikrlar yo'nalishini aniqlang: Bashorat (eskiradi) vs Haqiqat (chidamli chiqdi) => Qarama-qarshilik (-) => 'However'.

sample_test_questions.passage: The agricultural province experienced twelve consecutive weeks of sub-zero frost during the early flowering phase of the stone-fruit orchards. [_______] regional peach and apricot yields dropped by more than 75% compared to the prior ten-year rolling average.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Mantiqiy bog'lovchi tahlili: Birinchi gapda 12 hafta davomida sovuq ayoz bo'lgani (sabab), ikkinchi gapda esa shaftoli va o'rik hosili 75% ga tushib ketgani (oqibat) aytilmoqda. Sabab-oqibat munosabatini ifodalash uchun 'As a result,' (Natijada) bog'lovchisi talab qilinadi. To'g'ri javob: A. B va D variantlari qarama-qarshilik bildiruvchi noto'g'ri bog'lovchilar. C varianti esa o'xshashlik bildiruvchi xato variantdir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Digital SAT Transition qoidasi: Sabab (sovuq urishi) -> Oqibat (hosil kamayishi) => 'As a result', 'Consequently', yoki 'Therefore'.

sample_test_questions.passage: Installing smart LED lighting systems in public academic libraries reduces annual electricity consumption by approximately 35%. [_______] the automated dimming sensors extend the operational lifespan of the illumination fixtures by several years.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Mantiqiy bog'lovchi tahlili: Birinchi gapda aqlli chiroqlarning 1-afzalligi (elektr sarfini 35% ga kamaytirishi) keltirilgan. Ikkinchi gapda esa yana bitta yangi ijobiy afzallik (chiroqlarning xizmat muddatini bir necha yilga uzaytirishi) qo'shilmoqda. Fikrga ijobiy qo'shimcha kiritish uchun 'Moreover,' (Bundan tashqari) bog'lovchisi to'g'ri keladi. To'g'ri javob: A. B, C, D variantlari qarama-qarshilik bildiruvchi xato bog'lovchilardir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Digital SAT Transition qoidasi: Ijobiy fakt (+) ketidan yana bir ijobiy fakt (+) kelsa, 'Moreover', 'Furthermore', yoki 'In addition' ishlatiladi.

sample_test_questions.passage: Early twentieth-century critics condemned the raw, unpolished compositions of avant-garde visual artist Sonia Delaunay as decorative and frivolous. [_______] her pioneering exploration of simultaneous color contrast laid the conceptual foundation for non-representational modernism.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Mantiqiy bog'lovchi tahlili: Birinchi gapda tanqidchilar rassomning ishlarini sayoz va nojo'ya deb qoralagani aytiladi. Ikkinchi gapda esa, barcha bu tanqidlarga qaramay, uning ishlari zamonaviy san'at poydevorini yaratgani ta'kidlanadi. Bu yon berish / qarama-qarshilik (concession / contrast) munosabatidir. Bunga eng to'g'ri bog'lovchi 'Nonetheless,' (Shunga qaramasdan) dir. To'g'ri javob: A. B varianti (oqibat), C varianti (o'xshashlik), D varianti (misol) mantiqiy jihatdan noto'g'ri.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Digital SAT Taktikasi: Tanqid (-) ketidan erishilgan buyuk natija (+) kelsa, 'Nonetheless', 'Nevertheless' yoki 'Still' to'g'ri keladi.

sample_test_questions.passage: Marine biologists have identified several shark species that possess remarkable adaptations for coping with low-oxygen aquatic environments. [_______] the epaulette shark can slow its metabolic rate and survive in hypoxic tidal pools for over two hours without enduring irreversible brain damage.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Mantiqiy bog'lovchi tahlili: Birinchi gapda akulalarning kislorod kam sharoitga moslashuvi haqida umumiy fikr bildirilgan. Ikkinchi gapda esa aniq bitta tur (epaulette shark) va uning o'ziga xos qobiliyati misol tariqasida batafsil aniqlashtirilmoqda. Umumiy fikrdan aniq bir misolga o'tishda 'Specifically,' (Xususan / Aniqrog'i) bog'lovchisi ishlatiladi. To'g'ri javob: A. B varianti (aks holda), C varianti (xulosa qilib), D varianti (boshqa tomondan) bu yerda mantiqan noto'g'ri.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Digital SAT qoidasi: Umumiy guruh ('several shark species') -> Aniq bir a'zo ('the epaulette shark') bo'lsa, 'Specifically' yoki 'For example' tanlanadi.

sample_test_questions.passage: Lobbyists claimed that deregulating chemical manufacturing emissions would unleash immediate private capital expenditure and stimulate industrial hiring. [_______] comprehensive economic analyses conducted over the subsequent decade revealed a measurable decline in regional capital investment alongside severe healthcare expenditures.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Mantiqiy bog'lovchi tahlili: Birinchi gapda lobbistlarning xomxayol da'vosi (ish o'rinlari ko'payadi, investitsiya oqib keladi) aytilgan. Ikkinchi gapda esa o'n yillik haqiqiy iqtisodiy tahlillar investitsiyalar pasaygani va sog'liqni saqlash xarajatlari oshganini ko'rsatadi. Da'vo qilingan xayol va haqiqiy voqelik o'rtasidagi tafovutni ko'rsatish uchun 'In reality,' (Aslida esa / Voqelikda) eng mos tushadi. To'g'ri javob: A. B varianti oqibat, C varianti qo'shimcha, D varianti o'xshashlik bo'lib, yolg'on da'vo bilan haqiqatni bog'lay olmaydi.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Digital SAT Taktikasi: 'Claimed / Alleged X' -> [In reality / In fact] -> 'Actual data showed Y'.

sample_test_questions.passage:
While researching architectural history, a student took the following notes:
• The Parthenon in Athens was constructed primarily from local Pentelic marble between 447 and 432 BCE.
• The Pantheon in Rome was built between 118 and 125 CE utilizing revolutionary Roman pozzolanic concrete.
• The Parthenon features a post-and-lintel colonnade with an open interior cella.
• The Pantheon features a massive unreinforced concrete dome spanning 43.3 meters.
sample_test_questions.question: The student wants to emphasize a difference in structural materials between the two monuments. Which choice most effectively uses the relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.text: While Athens's Parthenon was built from Pentelic marble, Rome's Pantheon was engineered using innovative unreinforced pozzolanic concrete.
Both the Parthenon in Athens and the Pantheon in Rome are celebrated monuments constructed during the classical antiquity era.
Featuring an unreinforced dome spanning 43.3 meters, the Pantheon was completed in Rome between 118 and 125 CE.
The Parthenon in Athens utilized Pentelic marble to support a post-and-lintel colonnade.

sample_test_questions.explanation: Rhetorical Synthesis tahlili: Talabaning aniq maqsadi: ikkala yodgorlik o'rtasidagi QURILISH MATERIALLARIDAGI FARQNI (difference in structural materials) ta'kidlash. A variantida to'g'ridan-to'g'ri Parfenon marmardan (Pentelic marble), Panteon esa betondan (pozzolanic concrete) qurilgani taqqoslab ko'rsatilgan. To'g'ri javob: A. B varianti o'xshashlikni aytadi (difference emas). C varianti faqat Panteon haqida. D varianti faqat Parfenon haqida bo'lib, taqqoslash maqsadini bajarmaydi.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Digital SAT Rhetorical Synthesis qoidasi: Talabaning maqsadiga qarang ('emphasize a difference in materials'). Javobda har ikkala bino va ularning materiallari (marble vs concrete) qarama-qarshi qo'yilgan bo'lishi shart!

sample_test_questions.passage:
While researching green energy innovations, a student took the following notes:
• Aerogel is a synthetic ultralight material derived from a gel in which the liquid component has been replaced with a gas.
• It is composed of 99.8% air by volume, making it one of the lowest-density solids known.

sample_test_questions.question: The student wants to introduce aerogel and its primary distinguishing property to an audience unfamiliar with the material. Which choice most effectively uses the relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.text: Aerogel is an ultralight synthetic material consisting of 99.8% air, a unique structure that makes it an exceptionally powerful thermal insulator.
Commercial skyscrapers require advanced insulation to reduce annual municipal heating expenditure.
Architectural engineers prefer aerogel to conventional fiberglass because of high skyscraper utility bills.
Silica aerogel has been tested extensively by architectural engineers in urban centers.

sample_test_questions.explanation: Rhetorical Synthesis tahlili: Talabaning maqsadi: material bilan tanish bo'lmagan auditoriyaga aerogelni TANISHTIRISH (introduce) va uning ASOSIY AJRALIB TURUVCHI XUSUSIYATINI (primary distinguishing property) bayon qilish. A variantida aerogelning nima ekanligi (ultralight synthetic material) va uning 99.8% havodan iborat noyob izolatsiyalovchi xususiyati mukammal umumlashtirilgan. To'g'ri javob: A. B, C, D variantlari yangi auditoriyaga materialni tanishtirmaydi, balki tor qo'llanish sohasini aytib ketadi.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Digital SAT Taktikasi: 'Introduce X to an unfamiliar audience' talabi qo'yilganda, to'g'ri javob har doim 'X is a [ta'rif]...' ko'rinishidagi tushunarli kirish jumlasi bo'ladi.

sample_test_questions.passage:
While researching marine ecology, a student took the following notes:
• Kelp forests along the California coastline provide nursery habitat for over 800 marine species.
• Beginning in 2014, a marine heatwave combined with sea star wasting disease caused sunflower sea star populations to collapse by over 90%.
• Sunflower sea stars are the primary apex predators of purple sea urchins.
• Unchecked by predation, purple sea urchin populations surged tenfold, decimating 95% of Northern California's bull kelp canopies.
sample_test_questions.question: The student wants to explain the ecological cause-and-effect sequence that led to the destruction of the kelp canopies. Which choice most effectively uses the relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.text: When disease and warming waters caused predatory sea star populations to collapse, unchecked purple sea urchin numbers surged and subsequently decimated 95% of the kelp canopies.
Kelp forests along the California coastline once supported over 800 species before marine heatwaves began in 2014.
Purple sea urchins reproduce rapidly along the California coastline because water temperatures have warmed substantially.
Sunflower sea stars are apex predators that inhabit marine kelp ecosystems alongside more than 800 species.

sample_test_questions.explanation: Rhetorical Synthesis tahlili: Talabaning maqsadi: laminariya (kelp) o'rmonlarining nobud bo'lishiga olib kelgan SABAB-VA-OQIBAT ZANJIRINI (cause-and-effect sequence) tushuntirish. A varianti butun zanjirni aniq ko'rsatadi: kasallik/issiq suv -> yirtqich yulduzlar qirilishi -> dengiz tipratikanlari ko'payishi -> laminariyaning 95% yo'q qilinishi. To'g'ri javob: A. B, C, D variantlari zanjirni to'liq ko'rsatmaydi va faqat ayrim bo'laklarni tilga oladi.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Digital SAT Cause-and-Effect zanjiri: Savol 'sequence' (ketma-ketlik) so'raganda, dastlabki sababdan boshlab pirovard oqibatgacha bo'lgan barcha bo'g'inlarni o'z ichiga olgan variantni tanlang.

sample_test_questions.question: In the xy-plane, line j is defined by the equation 2x + 5y = 15. If line k is perpendicular to line j, what is the slope of line k?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Line j ni y = mx + b ko'rinishiga keltiramiz: 5y = -2x + 15 => y = (-2/5)x + 3. Line j ning qiyaligi m1 = -2/5. Perpendikulyar to'g'ri chiziqning qiyaligi teskari va qarama-qarshi ishorali bo'ladi (negative reciprocal): m2 = -1 / m1 = -1 / (-2/5) = 5/2. To'g'ri javob: A (5/2). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (-2/5) — parallel chiziq qiyaligini belgilash tuzog'i; C (-5/2) — ishorani almashtirishni unutish xatosi; D (2/5) — to'ntarishni unutishdagi xato variant.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ PERPENDIKULYAR QOIDASI: Kasrni to'ntaring va ishorasini teskari qiling: -2/5 -> +5/2!

sample_test_questions.question: Two cyclists start from the exact same trailhead at the same time and travel in opposite directions along a straight path. Cyclist A travels at a constant speed of 14 miles per hour, while Cyclist B travels at a constant speed of 18 miles per hour. After how many hours will the two cyclists be exactly 80 miles apart?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Qarama-qarshi yo'nalishda harakatlanayotgani sababli ularning bir-biridan uzoqlashish tezligi qo'shiladi: v_nisbiy = 14 + 18 = 32 mil/soat. Masofa 80 mil bo'lishi uchun vaqt: t = Masofa / v_nisbiy = 80 / 32 = 5 / 2 = 2.5 soat. To'g'ri javob: A (2.5). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (2.0) — tezliklarni ayirib hisoblash xatosi; C (3.0) va D (3.5) — noto'g'ri bo'lishdagi chalg'ituvchi variantlar.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ HARAKAT TENGLAMASI: 14t + 18t = 80 => 32t = 80 => t = 80/32 = 2.5 soat.

sample_test_questions.question: What is the maximum value of the quadratic function f(x) = -3(x - 4)^2 + 27?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Funksiya cho'qqi ko'rinishida (vertex form) berilgan: f(x) = a(x - h)^2 + k. Bu yerda a = -3 < 0 bo'lgani uchun parabola pastga qaragan va o'zining eng katta (maksimal) qiymatiga cho'qqisida erishadi: k = 27 (x = 4 bo'lganda). To'g'ri javob: A (27). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (4) — maksimum nuqtani (x koordinatani) qiymat deb adashib belgilash tuzog'i; C (-3) — a koeffitsiyenti; D (-27) — ishorani teskari olishdagi xato variant.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ VERTEX FORM: y = a(x - h)^2 + k da maksimum/minimum qiymat doimo k ning o'zidir (k = 27)!

sample_test_questions.question: The quadratic equation x^2 - 10x + 21 = 0 has two distinct real solutions, p and q, where p > q. What is the value of p - q?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Kvadrat tenglamani ko'paytuvchilarga ajratamiz: (x - 7)(x - 3) = 0. Ildizlar: x = 7 va x = 3. Shart bo'yicha p > q, demak p = 7 va q = 3. Ayirma: p - q = 7 - 3 = 4. To'g'ri javob: A (4). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (10) — ildizlar yig'indisini belgilash tuzog'i; C (7) — faqat bitta ildizni olish xatosi; D (21) — ozod hadni belgilashdagi xato variant.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ DESMOS USULI: Desmosda y = x^2 - 10x + 21 ni kiritib x-kesishmalarini ko'ring: (3, 0) va (7, 0). Masofa: 7 - 3 = 4.

sample_test_questions.question: For what integer value of constant c does the quadratic equation x^2 - 6x + c = 0 have two distinct real solutions?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Ikkita turli haqiqiy ildizga ega bo'lishi uchun diskriminant noldan qat'iy katta bo'lishi shart (D > 0): D = b^2 - 4ac = (-6)^2 - 4(1)(c) = 36 - 4c > 0. 4c < 36 => c < 9. Variantlar orasida 9 dan kichik bo'lgan yagona butun son 7 dir. To'g'ri javob: A (7). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (9) — D = 0 bo'lib bitta ildiz beradi; C (12) va D (15) — D < 0 bo'lib haqiqiy ildiz bermaydi (noto'g'ri variantlar).
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ DISKRIMINANT QOIDASI: Ikkita haqiqiy yechim -> D > 0. c < 9 bo'lishi kerak, faqat A (7) to'g'ri!

sample_test_questions.question: In the xy-plane, the circle C is defined by the equation (x - 5)^2 + (y + 2)^2 = 49. The horizontal line y = 5 intersects circle C at how many distinct points?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Aylana markazi (h, k) = (5, -2), radiusi esa r = sqrt(49) = 7 ga teng. Gorizontal to'g'ri chiziq y = 5 aylananing markazidan vertikal ravishda d = |5 - (-2)| = 7 birlik masofada joylashgan. Masofa aylananing radiusiga teng bo'lgani sababli (d = r = 7), chiziq aylanaga urinadi (tangent) va uni aynan 1 ta nuqtada (5, 5) kesib o'tadi. To'g'ri javob: A (Exactly 1). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (Exactly 2) — chiziq aylanani ikkita joydan kesadi deb o'ylash; C (0) — kesishmaydi deb adashish; D — to'g'ri chiziq aylanani cheksiz nuqtada kesa olmaydi.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ DESMOS USULI: Desmosda (x-5)^2 + (y+2)^2 = 49 va y = 5 ni kiriting. To'g'ri chiziq aylananing eng yuqori uchiga urinib o'tishini ko'rasiz — aynan 1 ta nuqta!

sample_test_questions.question: A medical researcher models the concentration of an antibiotic in a patient's bloodstream using the function C(t) = 180 * (0.72)^(t / 6), where C(t) is the concentration in micrograms per milliliter t hours after administration. By what percentage does the antibiotic concentration decrease every 6 hours?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Eksponensial kamayish modelida har 6 soat o'tganda (t/6 ko'rsatkichi 1 ga oshganda) konsentratsiya 0.72 koeffitsiyentiga ko'paytiriladi. Bu dastlabki miqdorning 72% qismi qolishini bildiradi. Demak, kamayish foizi: 100% - 72% = 28%. To'g'ri javob: A (28%). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (72%) — qolgan miqdorni kamayish ulushi deb chalkashtirish klassik SAT tuzog'i; C (18%) — boshlang'ich konsentratsiyadagi 180 soni bilan adashish; D (12%) — noto'g'ri hisob-kitob.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ FOIZ KAMAYISHI QOIDASI: Kamayish foizi = 1 - asos = 1 - 0.72 = 0.28, ya'ni 28%!

sample_test_questions.question: When the polynomial f(x) = x^3 - 4x^2 + 7x - 5 is divided by (x - 2), what is the remainder?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Polinom qoldiq teoremasi (Remainder Theorem): f(x) ni (x - c) ga bo'lgandagi qoldiq f(c) ga teng. Bu yerda c = 2. x = 2 ni qo'yamiz: f(2) = (2)^3 - 4(2)^2 + 7(2) - 5 = 8 - 16 + 14 - 5 = 1. To'g'ri javob: A (1). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (5) — ozod hadni adashtirish; C (-1) — hisoblashdagi ishora xatosi; D (9) — darajalarni xato hisoblashdagi noto'g'ri variant.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ POLINOM QOIDASI: f(x) ni (x - 2) ga bo'lish uchun x = 2 ni funksiyaga qo'yish kifoya!

sample_test_questions.question: A business computer system depreciates in monetary value according to the model V(t) = 2,400 * (0.85)^t, where V(t) is the estimated value in dollars t years after purchase. By what percentage does the computer system's value decrease each year?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Eksponensial kamayish modeli: V(t) = V0 * (1 - r)^t, bu yerda r — yillik kamayish foizi. Asos 0.85 ga teng: 1 - r = 0.85 => r = 0.15, ya'ni har yili 15% ga kamayadi. To'g'ri javob: A (15%). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (85%) — qolgan qiymat ulushini kamayish foizi deb adashish klassik SAT tuzog'i; C (24%) — boshlang'ich narxdagi son bilan adashish; D (1.5%) — vergul siljishi xatosi.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ SAT KONSEPSIYASI: Kamayish foizi = 1 - asos = 1 - 0.85 = 0.15 (15%)!

sample_test_questions.question: If x and y are positive real numbers such that the expression (x^(5/2) * y^(-1/3)) / (x^3 * y^(-4/3))^(1/2) is equivalent to x^a * y^b, what is the value of the product a * b?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Kasr maxrajini soddalashtiramiz: (x^3 * y^(-4/3))^(1/2) = x^(3/2) * y^(-2/3). Endi suratni maxrajga bo'lamiz: x ning darajasi a = 5/2 - 3/2 = 2/2 = 1. y ning darajasi b = -1/3 - (-2/3) = -1/3 + 2/3 = 1/3. Ko'paytma qiymati: a * b = 1 * (1/3) = 1/3. To'g'ri javob: A (1/3). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (2/3) — darajalarni qo'shib yuborishdagi xato; C (1) — faqat a qiymatini belgilash tuzog'i; D (-1/6) — ishoralarni noto'g'ri ko'paytirish xatosi.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ DARAJA QOIDALARI: (x^m)^n = x^(m*n) va x^m / x^n = x^(m-n). Bosqichma-bosqich hisoblang: a=1, b=1/3 => ab = 1/3!

sample_test_questions.strategy: Digital SAT Taktikasi: 'Introduce X to an unfamiliar audience' talabi qo'yilganda, to'g'ri javob har doim 'X is a [ta'rif]...' ko'rinishidagi tushunarli kirish jumlasi bo'ladi.

sample_test_questions.passage:
While researching marine ecology, a student took the following notes:
• Kelp forests along the California coastline provide nursery habitat for over 800 marine species.
• Beginning in 2014, a marine heatwave combined with sea star wasting disease caused sunflower sea star populations to collapse by over 90%.
• Sunflower sea stars are the primary apex predators of purple sea urchins.
• Unchecked by predation, purple sea urchin populations surged tenfold, decimating 95% of Northern California's bull kelp canopies.
sample_test_questions.question: The student wants to explain the ecological cause-and-effect sequence that led to the destruction of the kelp canopies. Which choice most effectively uses the relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.text: When disease and warming waters caused predatory sea star populations to collapse, unchecked purple sea urchin numbers surged and subsequently decimated 95% of the kelp canopies.
Kelp forests along the California coastline once supported over 800 species before marine heatwaves began in 2014.
Purple sea urchins reproduce rapidly along the California coastline because water temperatures have warmed substantially.
Sunflower sea stars are apex predators that inhabit marine kelp ecosystems alongside more than 800 species.

sample_test_questions.explanation: Rhetorical Synthesis tahlili: Talabaning maqsadi: laminariya (kelp) o'rmonlarining nobud bo'lishiga olib kelgan SABAB-VA-OQIBAT ZANJIRINI (cause-and-effect sequence) tushuntirish. A varianti butun zanjirni aniq ko'rsatadi: kasallik/issiq suv -> yirtqich yulduzlar qirilishi -> dengiz tipratikanlari ko'payishi -> laminariyaning 95% yo'q qilinishi. To'g'ri javob: A. B, C, D variantlari zanjirni to'liq ko'rsatmaydi va faqat ayrim bo'laklarni tilga oladi.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Digital SAT Cause-and-Effect zanjiri: Savol 'sequence' (ketma-ketlik) so'raganda, dastlabki sababdan boshlab pirovard oqibatgacha bo'lgan barcha bo'g'inlarni o'z ichiga olgan variantni tanlang.

sample_test_questions.passage:
While researching Mayan archaeology, a student took the following notes:
• Traditional excavation in dense tropical rainforests is impeded by heavy jungle canopy cover.
• Archaeologist Marcello Canuto deployed airborne LiDAR (Light Detection and Ranging) mapping over Guatemala's Petén region.
• LiDAR uses laser pulses from aircraft to penetrate vegetation and generate digital 3D elevation models of the ground surface.
• The survey detected over 61,000 previously unrecorded ancient Mayan structures, including defensive walls, elevated highways, and agricultural terraces.
sample_test_questions.question: The student wants to highlight the technological breakthrough that enabled Canuto's archaeological discoveries. Which choice most effectively uses the relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.text: By using airborne LiDAR laser pulses to penetrate the dense jungle canopy, Canuto mapped the ground surface and uncovered over 61,000 ancient Mayan structures.
Dense tropical rainforest canopies historically prevented archaeologists from finding ancient defensive walls in Guatemala.
Over 61,000 structures in the Petén region of Guatemala included elevated highways and extensive agricultural terraces.
Archaeologists exploring Guatemala must navigate thick vegetation to conduct traditional topographic surveys.

sample_test_questions.explanation: Rhetorical Synthesis tahlili: Talabaning maqsadi: Canutoning kashfiyotlariga imkon bergan TEXNOLOGIK YUTUQNI (technological breakthrough) ko'rsatish. A variantida samolyotdagi LiDAR lazer nurlari zich o'rmondan o'tib yer relyefini xaritalagani va 61,000 dan ortiq inshootlarni topgani to'g'ridan-to'g'ri texnologiyani e'tirof etgan holda bayon qilingan. To'g'ri javob: A. B, C, D variantlari texnologik yutuqni ifodalamaydi.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Digital SAT Taktikasi: 'Highlight the technological breakthrough' -> Javobda yangi texnologiya (airborne LiDAR laser pulses) asosiy urg'u sifatida turishi kerak.

sample_test_questions.passage:
While researching computer vision, a student took the following notes:
• Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) process image data via hierarchical local receptive fields.
• Vision Transformers (ViTs) utilize self-attention mechanisms across non-overlapping image patches.
• On standardized ImageNet benchmarks, CNNs achieve high accuracy with significantly lower training data requirements.
• Conversely, ViTs demonstrate superior top-1 accuracy on massive datasets but suffer from high computational latency on edge devices.
sample_test_questions.question: The student wants to compare the operational trade-offs between CNNs and ViTs. Which choice most effectively uses the relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.text: While CNNs require less training data and operate efficiently on edge devices, ViTs achieve superior benchmark accuracy on massive datasets at the cost of higher computational latency.
Vision Transformers split images into non-overlapping patches and process them through multi-head self-attention mechanisms.
Both CNNs and Vision Transformers are computer vision architectures tested on standardized ImageNet benchmarks.
CNNs process local receptive fields, which makes them preferable for all commercial machine learning applications.

sample_test_questions.explanation: Rhetorical Synthesis tahlili: Talabaning maqsadi: CNN va ViT o'rtasidagi AMALIY IJOBIY VA SALBIY JIHATLARNI (operational trade-offs) taqqoslash. A variantida ikkala modelning afzalliklari va cheklovlari (CNN: kamroq ma'lumot talab qilishi va samaradorligi; ViT: katta ma'lumotlarda yuqori aniqligi, lekin yuqori kechikishga egaligi) mukammal taqqoslangan. To'g'ri javob: A. B varianti faqat ViT mexanizmini aytadi. C varianti umumiy gap. D varianti esa haddan tashqari mutlaq xato da'vodir ('preferable for all').
sample_test_questions.strategy: Digital SAT Taktikasi: 'Compare operational trade-offs' -> Ikkala tarafning ham ijobiy va noqulay tomonlari bitta jumladagi 'While X offers A but lacks B, Y excels at B at the cost of A' tuzilishi orqali beriladi.

sample_test_questions.passage:
While researching the history of science, a student took the following notes:
• The medieval Persian polymath al-Biruni completed his astronomical treatise 'The Mas'udi Canon' in 1030 CE.
• The treatise compiled comprehensive mathematical tables for solar, lunar, and planetary coordinates.
• Using trigonometric calculations and a dip-angle quadrant, al-Biruni calculated the radius of Earth to be 6,339.6 kilometers.
• His radius measurement was within 1% of the modern verified equatorial radius of 6,378 kilometers.
sample_test_questions.question: The student wants to emphasize the extraordinary mathematical accuracy of al-Biruni's Earth radius calculation. Which choice most effectively uses the relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.text: In his 1030 CE treatise, al-Biruni calculated the radius of Earth to within 1% of modern satellite measurements using only a dip-angle quadrant and trigonometric equations.
Al-Biruni was a medieval Persian polymath who authored 'The Mas'udi Canon' containing extensive planetary coordinate tables.
Modern satellite measurements confirm that Earth's equatorial radius is approximately 6,378 kilometers.
Dip-angle quadrants were standard astronomical instruments utilized by medieval Persian scholars to construct planetary tables.

sample_test_questions.explanation: Rhetorical Synthesis tahlili: Talabaning maqsadi: Al-Beruniyning Yer radiusini hisoblashdagi HAYRATLANARLI MATEMATIK ANIQLIGINI (extraordinary mathematical accuracy) ta'kidlash. A variantida Beruniy 1030-yilda zamonaviy o'lchovlardan bor-yo'g'i 1% farq qiluvchi o'ta aniq natijaga oddiy trigonometrik asbob bilan erishgani ko'rsatilgan. To'g'ri javob: A. B, C, D variantlari Beruniy hisob-kitobining zamonaviy aniqlik bilan taqqosini ko'rsatmaydi.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Digital SAT Rhetorical Synthesis qoidasi: Maqsad 'extraordinary accuracy' (hayratlanarli aniqlik) bo'lgani uchun, javobda 'within 1% of modern measurements' dalili markaziy o'rinda turishi shart!

sample_test_questions.passage: During the late nineteenth century, urban reformers sought to ameliorate the overcrowded and unsanitary conditions of tenement districts by mandating better ventilation and public sanitation infrastructure.
sample_test_questions.question: As used in the text, what does the word 'ameliorate' most nearly mean?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Matn kontekstiga qarang: islohotchilar (urban reformers) antisanitariya va zich sharoitlarni ventilyatsiya hamda tozalik infratuzilmasi o'rnatish orqali yaxshilashga (ameliorate) intilgan. 'Ameliorate' - biror yomon sharoitni yaxshilash, o'nglash ma'nosini bildiradi, ya'ni 'improve' (A to'g'ri). B (publicize - ommalashtirish), C (document - qayd etish) va D (complicate - murakkablashtirish) islohotlarning ijobiy maqsadiga mutlaqo to'g'ri kelmaydigan chalg'ituvchi variantlardir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ CONTEXT CLUE: Islohotchilar yaxshiroq ventilyatsiya kiritmoqda => demak sharoitni yaxshilamoqda ('ameliorate' = 'improve').

sample_test_questions.passage: Although earlier paleontologists hypothesized that pterosaurs were merely passive gliders, recent aerodynamic modeling indicates that their muscular anatomy was sufficiently robust to sustain vigorous, powered flight.
sample_test_questions.question: As used in the text, what does the word 'robust' most nearly mean?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Kontekst tahlili: Gapda passiv suzuvchi (passive gliders) bo'lish g'oyasiga zid ravishda, pterozavrlarning mushak tuzilishi baquvvat, kuchli (robust) bo'lib, mustaqil faol parvozni (vigorous, powered flight) ta'minlay olgani aytilmoqda. 'Robust' mushaklar haqida ketganda 'strong' (baquvvat/kuchli) ma'nosida keladi (A to'g'ri). B (rigid - qotib qolgan/egilmas), C (complex - murakkab) va D (visible - ko'rinadigan) parvoz kuchini ta'minlash kontekstiga mos kelmaydigan tuzoqlardir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ QARAMA-QARSHILIKNI TOPING: 'passive gliders' vs 'vigorous, powered flight'. Faol parvoz uchun mushaklar baquvvat (strong) bo'lishi shart.

sample_test_questions.passage: The philosopher's prose was notoriously opaque, compelling commentators to spend decades parsing ambiguous aphorisms to extract a coherent theoretical framework.
sample_test_questions.question: As used in the text, what does the word 'opaque' most nearly mean?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Matndagi dalilga e'tibor bering: sharhlovchilar o'n yillab noaniq iboralarni tahlil qilib, tushunishga majbur bo'lishgan ('compelling commentators to spend decades parsing ambiguous aphorisms'). Matn yoki uslub haqida 'opaque' so'zi ishlatilganda, u shaffof emas, ya'ni tushunish o'ta qiyin, tushunarsiz ('difficult to understand') degan majoziy ma'noni anglatadi (A to'g'ri). B (physically dense - jismonan zich) bu so'zning jismoniy narsalarga nisbatan birlamchi ma'nosi bo'lib, kontekstga zid; C va D esa asossiz taxminlardir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ SECONDARY MEANING TRAP: 'Opaque' fizika bo'yicha 'yorug'lik o'tkazmaydigan', adabiyot/matn kontekstida esa 'tushunish qiyin bo'lgan' (obscure/unclear) demakdir.

sample_test_questions.passage: In many ecosystems, apex predators regulate herbivore populations and indirectly maintain plant diversity. When grey wolves were reintroduced to Yellowstone National Park, elk ceased overbrowsing young willow and aspen saplings near riverbanks. Consequently, stabilizing root systems flourished, riverbank erosion slowed, and beaver colonies returned to construct vital wetland habitats.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice best describes the primary function of the underlined sentence ('Consequently, stabilizing root systems flourished...') in the overall text?

options.text: It illustrates a downstream ecological cascade triggered by the predator's return.
It challenges the initial assertion regarding apex predators.
It introduces an unforeseen flaw in the reintroduction project.
It compares Yellowstone's geography to other North American river systems.

sample_test_questions.explanation: Matn strukturasi: Dastlab yirtqichlarning ekotizimga ta'siri aytiladi, keyin bo'rilar qaytarilgach bug'ular daraxtlarni yeb bitirmagani va buning natijasida (Consequently) o'simliklar ildiz otib, daryo qirg'og'i mustahkamlanib, qunduzlar qaytgani keltiriladi. Bu yirtqich qaytishi zanjirsimon ijobiy ekologik oqibatlarni keltirib chiqarganini ko'rsatuvchi misoldir (A to'g'ri). B - boshlang'ich da'voga zid emas, uni tasdiqlaydi; C - hech qanday kamchilik (flaw) tilga olinmagan; D - boshqa daryolar bilan taqqoslash yo'q.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ FUNKSIYANI ANIQLASH: 'Consequently' so'zi sabab-oqibat zanjirini bog'laydi. Bo'rilar qaytdi => o'simliklar ko'paydi => qunduzlar qaytdi (ecological cascade).

sample_test_questions.question: In the xy-plane, what is the minimum point of the parabola defined by the function h(x) = x^2 + 8x + 23?
sample_test_questions.explanation: To'la kvadratga ajratamiz: h(x) = (x^2 + 8x + 16) + 23 - 16 = (x + 4)^2 + 7. Parabolaning cho'qqisi: (-4, 7). Parabola yuqoriga qaragan (a = 1 > 0), shuning uchun cho'qqi minimum nuqtadir. To'g'ri javob: A ((-4, 7)). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B ((4, 7)) — ishorani adashtirish klassik tuzog'i; C ((-4, 23)) — y-koordinatani to'g'rilamaslik xatosi; D — koeffitsiyentlarni to'g'ridan-to'g'ri olishdagi xato variant.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ DESMOS: y = x^2 + 8x + 23 ni kiriting va eng pastki nuqtani bosing: (-4, 7).

sample_test_questions.question: For all positive values of x, which of the following expressions is equivalent to (x^(3/4) * x^(1/2)) / x^(1/4)?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Daraja qoidalarini qo'llaymiz: Bir xil asosli sonlar ko'paytirilganda darajalar qo'shiladi, bo'linganda ayiriladi: Daraja = 3/4 + 1/2 - 1/4 = 3/4 + 2/4 - 1/4 = 4/4 = 1. Demak x^1 = x. To'g'ri javob: A (x). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (x^2) — qo'shishda xato qilish; C (x^(3/8)) — darajalarni ko'paytirib yuborishdagi qo'pol xato; D (x^(5/4)) — maxrajdagi darajani ayirishni unutish tuzog'i.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ DARAJA QOIDASI: x^(a) * x^(b) / x^(c) = x^(a + b - c). 3/4 + 2/4 - 1/4 = 1.

sample_test_questions.question: The polynomial function p is defined by p(x) = x^3 - 5x^2 - 4x + 20. Which of the following is NOT an x-intercept of the graph of p in the xy-plane?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Guruhlash usuli bilan ko'paytuvchilarga ajratamiz: p(x) = x^2(x - 5) - 4(x - 5) = (x^2 - 4)(x - 5) = (x - 2)(x + 2)(x - 5). Funksiyaning nollari (x-kesishmalari): x = 2, x = -2 va x = 5. Demak (2, 0), (-2, 0) va (5, 0) kesishmalar hisoblanadi. (4, 0) esa kesishma emas (p(4) = 64 - 80 - 16 + 20 = -12 != 0). To'g'ri javob: A ((4, 0)). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B, C va D haqiqiy kesishmalar bo'lgani sababli savol shartiga ('NOT an x-intercept') mos kelmaydi.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ VARIANTLARNI QO'YIB KO'RISH: p(4) = 4^3 - 5(16) - 4(4) + 20 = 64 - 80 - 16 + 20 = -12 != 0. Demak (4, 0) x-kesishma emas!

sample_test_questions.question: A clinical trial evaluated a therapeutic drug on 100 participants. Among the 50 participants receiving the drug (Group A), 35 improved and 15 did not. Among the 50 participants receiving a placebo (Group B), 20 improved and 30 did not. If a participant who improved is chosen at random, what is the probability that this participant received the drug (Group A)?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Shartli ehtimollik: 'If a participant who improved is chosen at random...' sharti maxraj faqat yaxshilanganlar soni bo'lishini bildiradi: Jami yaxshilanganlar = 35 (Group A) + 20 (Group B) = 55. Ularning ichidan preparat qabul qilganlar soni = 35. Ehtimollik = 35 / 55 = 7 / 11. To'g'ri javob: A (7/11). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (35/50) — Group A ning jami soniga bo'lish xatosi; C (35/100) — barcha 100 qatnashchiga bo'lish tuzog'i; D (1/2) — guruhlarni teng deb yanglishish.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ SHARTLI EHTIMOLLIK: 'Given that...' yoki 'If a participant who improved...' so'zlari maxrajni faqat yaxshilanganlar (35+20=55) ga cheklaydi!

sample_test_questions.question: An investment fund gained 30% in its first fiscal year and subsequently declined by 10% in its second fiscal year. What was the overall percentage change of the fund across the two-year period?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Multiplikator usuli: 1) 30% o'sish: 1.30. 2) 10% pasayish: 1 - 0.10 = 0.90. Yakuniy multiplikator: 1.30 * 0.90 = 1.17. 1.17 bu dastlabki qiymatga nisbatan 17% o'sish demakdir (1.17 - 1 = 0.17). To'g'ri javob: A (17% increase). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (20% increase) — 30% - 10% = 20% deb foizlarni shunchaki ayirib yuborishdagi eng mashhur SAT tuzog'i; C (23%) va D (15%) — hisoblashdagi xato variantlar.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ $100 QOIDASI: Dastlab $100 bo'lsa: 30% oshgach $130 bo'ladi. $130 ning 10%i = $13. $130 - $13 = $117. Jami o'sish: 17%!

sample_test_questions.question: A small software startup employs 8 engineers with salaries ranging from $40,000 to $60,000. When a new chief executive officer is hired with an annual salary of $350,000, which summary statistic of the employee compensation dataset increases by the greatest percentage?
sample_test_questions.explanation: O'rtacha arifmetik qiymat (mean) anomal katta qiymatga (outlier $350,000) favqulodda sezgir va keskin ko'tariladi. Mediana esa o'rtadagi 1-2 ta qiymatning o'rniga qaraydi va juda kam miqdorda siljiydi. Shuning uchun eng katta foizli o'sish o'rtacha qiymatda (mean) ro'y beradi. To'g'ri javob: A. Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B — medianani sezgir deb yanglishish tuzog'i; C va D — statistik parametrlarning xususiyatlariga zid xato variantlar.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ SAT STATISTIKA QOIDASI: Ekstremal anomal qiymatlar (outliers) har doim o'rtacha qiymatni (mean) medianaga nisbatan ancha kuchli siljitadi!

sample_test_questions.question: A researcher conducts a public opinion survey and determines a margin of error of 4% at a 95% confidence level. If the researcher wants to conduct a follow-up survey of the same population with a margin of error of 2% at the same confidence level, by what factor must the sample size be multiplied?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Xatolik chegarasi (margin of error) tanlanma hajmining kvadrat ildiziga teskari proportsional: ME = z * sqrt(p(1-p) / n). Xatolikni 2 barobar kamaytirish uchun (4% dan 2% ga) tanlanma hajmi n roppa-rosa 2^2 = 4 barobarga oshirilishi shart. To'g'ri javob: A (4). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (2) — ildizni hisobga olmasdan tanlanmani 2 marta oshirish yetadi deb o'ylash klassik tuzog'i; C (8) va D (16) — darajani noto'g'ri qo'llashdagi xato variantlar.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ SAMPLE SIZE FORMULASI: Xatolikni k marta kamaytirish uchun tanlanma sonini k^2 marta oshirish kerak: 2^2 = 4 marta!

sample_test_questions.question: A municipal water pump operates at a steady flow rate of 180 liters per minute. What is the flow rate of the pump in milliliters per second? (1 liter = 1,000 milliliters, 1 minute = 60 seconds)
sample_test_questions.explanation: Birliklarni bosqichma-bosqich o'zgartiramiz: 180 litr / minut = (180 * 1,000 ml) / (60 soniya) = 180,000 ml / 60 soniya = 3,000 ml/soniya. To'g'ri javob: A (3,000). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (18,000) — 60 o'rniga 10 ga bo'lish xatosi; C (300) — 1,000 o'rniga 100 ga ko'paytirish tuzog'i; D (10,800) — bo'lish o'rniga 60 ga ko'paytirib yuborishdagi xato variant.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ BIRLIKLAR ZANJIRI: (180 L / 1 min) * (1000 mL / 1 L) * (1 min / 60 s) = 180000 / 60 = 3000 mL/s.

sample_test_questions.question: A pediatric study calculates a linear correlation coefficient of r = -0.89 between daily recreational screen hours and nighttime sleep duration in adolescents. Which of the following is the most valid interpretation of this statistic?

options.text: There is a strong negative linear association between daily screen time and sleep duration.
Daily screen time causes adolescents to experience lower sleep duration.
There is a weak positive linear association between the two variables.
Exactly 89% of adolescents experience inadequate sleep duration.

sample_test_questions.explanation: r = -0.89 qiymati noldan ancha uzoq va -1 ga yaqin bo'lgani uchun bu kuchli manfiy chiziqli bog'liqlikni (strong negative linear association) anglatadi. To'g'ri javob: A. Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B — korrelyatsiya sabab-oqibatni (causation) isbotlamaydi, shuning uchun 'causes' so'zi statistik jihatdan xato; C — musbat emas, manfiy; D — 89% o'smirlar degan raqamli foiz matnga aloqador emas.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ SAT KONSEPSIYASI: 'Correlation does NOT imply causation' (Korrelyatsiya sababiyatni anglatmaydi). 'Causes' so'zi bo'lgan variantlar deyarli har doim noto'g'ri!

sample_test_questions.question: In a school science laboratory, the ratio of test tubes to glass beakers is 7 to 4. If the laboratory contains 84 test tubes, how many glass beakers are in the laboratory?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Proporsiya tuzamiz: Prozkalar / Menzurkalar = 7 / 4. 84 / B = 7 / 4. Birlikka to'g'ri keluvchi miqdor: 84 / 7 = 12. Demak menzurkalar soni: 12 * 4 = 48 ta. To'g'ri javob: A (48). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (56) — noto'g'ri proporsiya; C (36) — 84 ni 7 ga emas, 9 ga bo'lish xatosi; D (64) — hisob-kitobdagi adashish natijasidagi xato variant.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ PROPORSIONALLIK: 7 qism = 84 bo'lsa, 1 qism = 12. 4 qism = 4 * 12 = 48!

It introduces an unforeseen flaw in the reintroduction project.

sample_test_questions.explanation: Matn strukturasi: Dastlab yirtqichlarning ekotizimga ta'siri aytiladi, keyin bo'rilar qaytarilgach bug'ular daraxtlarni yeb bitirmagani va buning natijasida (Consequently) o'simliklar ildiz otib, daryo qirg'og'i mustahkamlanib, qunduzlar qaytgani keltiriladi. Bu yirtqich qaytishi zanjirsimon ijobiy ekologik oqibatlarni keltirib chiqarganini ko'rsatuvchi misoldir (A to'g'ri). B - boshlang'ich da'voga zid emas, uni tasdiqlaydi; C - hech qanday kamchilik (flaw) tilga olinmagan; D - boshqa daryolar bilan taqqoslash yo'q.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ FUNKSIYANI ANIQLASH: 'Consequently' so'zi sabab-oqibat zanjirini bog'laydi. Bo'rilar qaytdi => o'simliklar ko'paydi => qunduzlar qaytdi (ecological cascade).

sample_test_questions.passage:
Text 1: Proponents of open-plan office layouts argue that removing physical partitions fosters spontaneous interdisciplinary collaboration and flattens organizational hierarchies, ultimately boosting workplace creative output.

Text 2: Empirical studies tracking employee communication show that face-to-face interactions often decline precipitously by up to 70% following transitions to open-plan designs. Deprived of acoustic privacy, workers retreat behind noise-canceling headphones and substitute verbal communication with email and instant messaging.
sample_test_questions.question: Based on the texts, how would the author of Text 2 most likely respond to the claim in Text 1 regarding 'spontaneous collaboration'?

options.text: By demonstrating that open layouts often inadvertently diminish in-person communication as workers seek privacy.
By agreeing that creative output increases despite minor acoustic inconveniences.
By advocating for the complete elimination of electronic messaging in corporate environments.
By arguing that interdisciplinary projects should be abandoned entirely.

sample_test_questions.explanation: Text 1 ochiq ofislar hamkorlikni (collaboration) oshiradi deb da'vo qiladi. Text 2 esa empirik tadqiqotlarga tayanib, ochiq ofisga o'tilgach yuzma-yuz muloqot 70% ga kamayib ketgani, odamlar shovqindan qochib naushnik taqib, yozishmaga o'tib olganini bildiradi. Demak, Text 2 muallifi ochiq ofis xususiy hudud yo'qligi sababli o'z-o'zidan jonli muloqotni kamaytirib yuboradi deb javob beradi (A to'g'ri). B - Text 2 ijodiy mahsuldorlik oshishiga qo'shilmaydi; C va D esa haddan tashqari radikal va matnda yo'q da'volardir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ JUFT MATNLAR QOIDASI: Text 1 nazariy da'vo beradi, Text 2 empirik dalil (70% pasayish) bilan uni rad etadi. Javob aynan shu to'qnashuvni aks ettirishi shart.

sample_test_questions.passage: The archival records from the expedition were fragmentary, yet the historian managed to reconstruct a remarkably coherent narrative of the polar voyage.
sample_test_questions.question: As used in the text, what does the word 'coherent' most nearly mean?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Matn ziddiyatiga qarang: arxiv yozuvlari parcha-parcha, to'liq emas ('fragmentary') bo'lsa-da, tarixchi mantiqan izchil va ravshan ('coherent') hikoyani tiklashga muvaffaq bo'ldi. 'Coherent' mantiqiy jihatdan bir-biriga bog'langan va tushunarli demakdir (A to'g'ri). B (lengthy - cho'zilgan), C (financially successful - moliyaviy muvaffaqiyatli) va D (controversial - bahsli) kontekstga umuman aloqador bo'lmagan xato distractorlardir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ KONTRAST LOGIKASI: 'Yet' so'zi fragmentary (parcha-parcha) ga teskari sifat talab qiladi: bir butun, mantiqiy (coherent = logically consistent).

sample_test_questions.passage: Biologists long considered subterranean bioluminescence in fungi to be an incidental metabolic byproduct of lignin breakdown. However, recent behavioral assays reveal that the eerie nocturnal glow specifically attracts spore-dispersing beetles, ensuring reproductive dissemination even in windless underground hollows.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice best describes the relationship between the two sentences in the passage?

options.text: The first presents an established hypothesis, and the second introduces evidence that overturns it with an adaptive function.
The first outlines an experimental methodology, and the second critiques its sampling errors.
The first describes an evolutionary mystery, and the second dismisses its ecological significance.
The first introduces an insect species, and the second tracks its predatory habits.

sample_test_questions.explanation: Birinchi gapda olimlar uzoq vaqt qo'ziqorinlarning porlashini shunchaki tasodifiy moddalar almashinuvi mahsuli ('incidental byproduct') deb hisoblagan gipotezasi keltirilgan. Ikkinchi gap 'However' bilan burilib, yangi tajribalar bu porlash hasharotlarni jalb qilib sporalarni tarqatishga xizmat qiladigan moslashuv vazifasi (adaptive function) ekanini isbotlaganini ko'rsatadi (A to'g'ri). B - metodologiya haqida emas; C - ahamiyatini yo'qqa chiqarmaydi, aksincha ochib beradi; D - hasharot birinchi gapda umuman yo'q.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ MATN STRUKTURASI: 'long considered X... However, recent Y reveals Z' - bu ilmiy matnlardagi klassik 'eski qarash va uni inkor etuvchi yangi kashfiyot' andozasidir.

sample_test_questions.passage: Because the experimental antibiotic displayed broad-spectrum efficacy in laboratory petri dishes, physicians were optimistic that clinical human trials would yield comparable therapeutic results.
sample_test_questions.question: As used in the text, what does the word 'efficacy' most nearly mean?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Matn mantiqi: Antibiotik laboratoriyada yuqori samara (broad-spectrum efficacy) ko'rsatgani uchun shifokorlar klinik sinovlar yaxshi natija berishiga umid qilishgan. 'Efficacy' so'zi samaradorlik, natija bera olish qobiliyati ('effectiveness') deganidir (A to'g'ri). B (toxicity - zaharlilik) ijobiy umidga zid; C (expense - qimmatlik) va D (rarity - noyoblik) kontekstga to'g'ri kelmaydi.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ SO'Z ILDIZI: Efficacy = Effective (samarali). 'Yield comparable results' iborasi samaradorlikni ko'rsatadi.

sample_test_questions.passage:
Text 1: Urban rooftop gardens provide vital micro-climate cooling and insulation, reducing residential energy consumption by up to 15% in densely built city cores.

Text 2: While rooftop vegetation undoubtedly moderates surface temperatures, structural retrofitting costs often exceed municipal budgets, rendering widespread installation impractical without substantial private capital investment.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice best describes how Text 2 regards the perspective presented in Text 1?

options.text: It acknowledges the environmental benefits mentioned in Text 1 but highlights practical financial impediments.
It outright denies that green roofs provide any thermodynamic cooling benefits.
It contends that public funds should completely replace private investment.

sample_test_questions.explanation: Text 2 boshidayoq Text 1 dagi haroratni pasaytirish foydasini tan oladi ('While rooftop vegetation undoubtedly moderates surface temperatures...'), biroq binolarni qayta jihozlash xarajatlari shahar byudjetidan oshib ketishini, ya'ni moliyaviy to'siqlarni o'rtaga tashlaydi (A to'g'ri). B - foydani inkor etmaydi; C - xususiy kapital zarur deydi; D - arxitektura jihatidan oson deb maqtamaydi.

sample_test_questions.passage: In arid desert environments, the saguaro cactus functions as a keystone species. Its spring blossoms provide vital nectar for migrating long-nosed bats, while its summer fruit nourishes desert tortoises and coyotes. Furthermore, Gila woodpeckers excavate nest cavities in the cactus's thick trunk, which are subsequently inhabited by screech owls and purple martins once vacated.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice best states the main idea of the text?

options.text: The saguaro cactus provides essential food and shelter that support a wide variety of desert wildlife.
Gila woodpeckers are the primary threat to the structural integrity of mature saguaro cacti.
Long-nosed bats depend exclusively on saguaro fruit during the summer months.
Desert tortoises compete aggressively with coyotes for nesting cavities in desert plants.

sample_test_questions.explanation: Matnning birinchi jumlasidayoq saguaro kaktusi ekotizim uchun tayanch tur ('keystone species') ekani e'lon qilinadi. Keyingi jumlalarda u ko'rshapalaklar, toshbaqalar, koyotlarga ozuqa berishi hamda qushlarga in vazifasini o'tashi sanab o'tiladi. Demak, asosiy g'oya kaktus ko'plab cho'l jonivorlarini oziq va boshpana bilan ta'minlashidir (A to'g'ri). B - kaktusga xavf haqida emas; C - ko'rshapalaklar faqat kaktusga tayanadi deyilmagan (exclusively xato); D - toshbaqa va koyotlar in uchun urushmaydi.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ ASOSIY G'OYA: Birinchi jumlani va butun matn qamrovini oling: kaktus oziq (gul, meva) va boshpana (kovaklar) beradi.

sample_test_questions.passage: In an experiment on memory consolidation, participants learned word pairs before either eight hours of nocturnal sleep or eight hours of continuous daytime wakefulness. Brain imaging revealed that sleep-deprived participants exhibited significantly reduced functional connectivity between the hippocampus and prefrontal cortex during subsequent recall tests. Conversely, the sleep group displayed robust neural synchrony between these regions, accompanied by a 35% higher retention accuracy.
sample_test_questions.question: Which conclusion is most logically supported by the experimental findings?

options.text: Sleep facilitates the neural communication pathways necessary for durable memory retrieval.
Prefrontal cortex activity is entirely inactive during daytime wakefulness.
The hippocampus permanently stores all semantic memories without cortical involvement.
Word-pair recall is unaffected by the duration of sleep as long as participants rest.

sample_test_questions.explanation: Eksperiment shuni ko'rsatadiki, uxlagan guruhda gipokamp va prefrontal korteks o'rtasidagi neyron aloqalar mustahkamlanib, xotirada saqlash 35% ga yuqori bo'lgan, uyqusizlarda esa bu aloqalar uzilgan. Bundan mantiqiy xulosa: uyqu xotirani mustahkam qayta tiklash uchun zarur bo'lgan neyron aloqalarni osonlashtiradi (A to'g'ri). B - kunduzi miya butunlay o'chadi ('entirely inactive') degan radikal da'vo matnda yo'q; C - gipokamp xotirani doimiy saqlaydi deyilmagan; D - ta'sir qilmaydi degan da'vo eksperiment natijasiga (35% farq) to'g'ridan-to'g'ri ziddir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ XULOSA QOIDASI: Xulosa aynan matndagi dalillarga (35% yuqori saqlash + neyron sinxronlik) tayanishi shart. 'Entirely' yoki 'permanently' kabi ekstremal so'zlar odatda noto'g'ri distractorlardir.

sample_test_questions.question: In a college cohort, 60% of students live in university dormitory halls. Of those students residing in dormitories, 45% participate in campus club sports. What percentage of the entire college cohort lives in dormitories AND participates in club sports?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Foizning foizini hisoblaymiz: Jami talabalarning 60% yotoqxonada yashaydi (0.60). Ularning 45%i sport bilan shug'ullanadi (0.45). Jami ulush: 0.60 * 0.45 = 0.27, ya'ni 27%. To'g'ri javob: A (27%). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (52.5%) — foizlarni qo'shib 2 ga bo'lish xatosi; C (15%) — 60% dan 45% ni ayirib qo'yishdagi qo'pol tuzoq; D (30%) — noo'rin yaxlitlashdagi xato variant.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ FOIZNING FOIZI: 0.60 * 0.45 = 0.27 (27%). Ko'paytirish orqali darhol topiladi!

sample_test_questions.question: The relationship between daily maximum temperature x, in degrees Celsius, and bottled iced tea sales y, in bottles, at an amusement park is modeled by the line of best fit y_pred = 1.8x + 14.5. Based on this model, what is the predicted number of iced tea bottles sold on a day when the maximum temperature reaches 30 degrees Celsius?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Model formulasiga x = 30 ni qo'yamiz: y_pred = 1.8(30) + 14.5 = 54 + 14.5 = 68.5 shisha. To'g'ri javob: A (68.5). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (54.0) — ozod had 14.5 ni qo'shishni unutish xatosi; C (65.0) va D (72.5) — 1.8 ga noto'g'ri ko'paytirishdagi chalg'ituvchi xato variantlar.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ HISOBLASH: 1.8 * 30 = 54. 54 + 14.5 = 68.5. 5 soniyada tayyor!

sample_test_questions.question: In the xy-plane, what are the center coordinates and radius of the circle defined by the equation (x - 5)^2 + (y + 2)^2 = 49?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Aylananing standart tenglamasi: (x - h)^2 + (y - k)^2 = r^2. Bu yerda h = 5, k = -2 bo'lgani uchun markaz (5, -2) da joylashgan. r^2 = 49 bo'lgani sababli radius r = sqrt(49) = 7 bo'ladi. To'g'ri javob: A. Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B — markaz koordinatalarining ishoralarini teskari olish klassik tuzog'i; C va D — r^2 ni radius deb adashish xatosi.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ ISHORA VA RADIUS: (x - h) da markaz +h, (y + k) da markaz -k bo'ladi. Radius esa sqrt(49) = 7!

sample_test_questions.question: A circle has a radius of 8 centimeters. A sector on the circle subtends a central angle of (3pi)/4 radians. What is the area of this sector, in square centimeters?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Sektor yuzi formulasi (radianlarda): Area = (1/2) * r^2 * theta. Bu yerda r = 8 va theta = 3pi / 4. Area = (1/2) * (8)^2 * (3pi / 4) = (1/2) * 64 * (3pi / 4) = 32 * (3pi / 4) = 8 * 3pi = 24pi sm^2. To'g'ri javob: A (24pi). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (48pi) — 1/2 koeffitsiyentini unutish xatosi; C (12pi) — radiusni kvadratga ko'tarmaslik tuzog'i; D (64pi) — butun doira yuzasini belgilashdagi xato variant.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ SEKTOR YUZI FORMULASI: Area = 0.5 * r^2 * theta = 0.5 * 64 * (3pi/4) = 24pi.

sample_test_questions.question: In an isosceles right triangle, the length of the hypotenuse is 16 * sqrt(2). What is the length of each leg?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Teng yonli to'g'ri burchakli uchburchak (45-45-90) qoidasiga ko'ra, gipotenuza katetdan sqrt(2) barobar katta: Gipotenuza = Katet * sqrt(2). Demak, Katet = Gipotenuza / sqrt(2) = (16 * sqrt(2)) / sqrt(2) = 16. To'g'ri javob: A (16). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (32) — gipotenuzani 2 ga ko'paytirish xatosi; C (8*sqrt(2)) — 16 ni 2 ga bo'lib sqrt(2) ni qoldirish tuzog'i; D (8) — 16 ni 2 ga bo'lish xatosi.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ 45-45-90 UCHBURCHAK QOIDASI: Tomonlar nisbati 1 : 1 : sqrt(2). Gipotenuza 16*sqrt(2) bo'lsa, katetlar 16 ga teng!

sample_test_questions.question: In right triangle XYZ, angle Z measures 90 degrees. The length of the side opposite angle X is 15, and the length of the side adjacent to angle X is 8. What is the value of tan(X)?
sample_test_questions.explanation: To'g'ri burchakli uchburchakda tangens ta'rifi: tan(X) = Qarama-qarshi katet / Yopishgan katet (Opposite / Adjacent). Bu yerda Opposite = 15 va Adjacent = 8. Shuning uchun tan(X) = 15/8. To'g'ri javob: A (15/8). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (8/15) — kasrni to'ntarib kotangensni belgilash tuzog'i; C (15/17) — sin(X) ning qiymati (Opposite / Hypotenuse); D (8/17) — cos(X) ning qiymati.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ SOH CAH TOA: TOA -> Tan = Opposite / Adjacent = 15 / 8!

sample_test_questions.question: A solid rectangular storage container has a base length of 12 centimeters, a base width of 5 centimeters, and a vertical height of 8 centimeters. What is the total volume of the container in cubic centimeters?
sample_test_questions.explanation: To'g'ri burchakli parallelepiped hajmi formulasi: V = Uzunlik * Kenglik * Balandlik = 12 * 5 * 8 = 60 * 8 = 480 sm^3. To'g'ri javob: A (480). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (240) — piramida formulasi deb adashib 2 ga bo'lish xatosi; C (392) — to'liq sirt maydoni (surface area) bilan adashtirish klassik tuzog'i; D (520) — ko'paytirishdagi arifmetik xato.

sample_test_questions.question: Triangle ABC is similar to triangle DEF, where vertices A, B, and C correspond to D, E, and F, respectively. Side AB has a length of 9, and corresponding side DE has a length of 21. If the area of triangle ABC is 36 square units, what is the area of triangle DEF in square units?
sample_test_questions.explanation: O'xshashlik koeffitsiyenti: k = DE / AB = 21 / 9 = 7 / 3. O'xshash figuralarning maydonlari nisbati o'xshashlik koeffitsiyentining kvadratiga teng (k^2): Area(DEF) = Area(ABC) * k^2 = 36 * (7 / 3)^2 = 36 * (49 / 9) = 4 * 49 = 196 kvadrat birlik. To'g'ri javob: A (196). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (84) — maydonni k ga (kvadratsiz) ko'paytirib qo'yish tuzog'i (36 * 7/3 = 84); C (144) va D (252) — noto'g'ri hisoblashdagi xato variantlar.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ MAYDON NISBATI: Tomonlar nisbati 7/3 bo'lsa, maydonlar nisbati (7/3)^2 = 49/9. 36 * 49/9 = 4 * 49 = 196!

sample_test_questions.question: In a circle, an inscribed angle intercepts an arc measuring 130 degrees. What is the measure, in degrees, of the inscribed angle?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Aylanaga ichki chizilgan burchak (inscribed angle) o'zi tiralgan yoy o'lchovining yarmiga teng: Burchak = Yoy / 2 = 130 / 2 = 65 gradus. To'g'ri javob: A (65). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (130) — markaziy burchak bilan adashtirish klassik tuzog'i; C (260) — 2 ga ko'paytirib yuborish xatosi; D (50) — 180 dan ayirishdagi noto'g'ri variant.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ ICHKI CHIZILGAN BURCHAK: Ichki chizilgan burchak = Yoy / 2 = 130 / 2 = 65°. Markaziy burchak esa yoyga teng bo'ladi!

sample_test_questions.question: A right circular cone has a base radius of 6 centimeters and a vertical height of 10 centimeters. What is the total volume of the cone, in cubic centimeters?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Konus hajmi formulasi: V = (1/3) * pi * r^2 * h. Bu yerda r = 6 va h = 10. V = (1/3) * pi * (6)^2 * 10 = (1/3) * pi * 36 * 10 = 12 * 10 * pi = 120pi sm^3. To'g'ri javob: A (120pi). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (360pi) — silindr deb adashib 1/3 koeffitsiyentini unutish tuzog'i; C (60pi) — radiusni kvadratga ko'tarmaslik xatosi; D (40pi) — arifmetik xato variant.

sample_test_questions.passage: Ecologist Dr. Elena Vance investigated whether marine protected areas (MPAs) with strict no-fishing mandates enhance fish biomass in adjacent unprotected waters through the 'spillover effect.' Critics hypothesized that fish rarely migrate outside the protected boundaries, meaning adjacent non-reserve waters gain no measurable productivity.
sample_test_questions.question: Which finding, if true, would most directly weaken the critics' hypothesis?

options.text: Commercial fish catches within 3 kilometers of the MPA boundary increased steadily over five years as tagged adult fish migrated outward.
Fish species inside the MPA displayed higher genetic diversity than fish documented in distant oceanic trenches.
Tourism revenue within the marine reserve increased significantly due to recreational diving.
Local fishing fleets purchased motorized vessels with larger refrigeration holds.

sample_test_questions.explanation: Tanqidchilarning gipotezasi: Baliqlar qo'riqxona chegarasidan tashqariga deyarli chiqmaydi, shuning uchun chegaraga yaqin himoyalanmagan suvlar hech qanday hosildorlikka erishmaydi. Ushbu gipotezani kuchsizlantirish (weaken) uchun qo'riqxonaga yaqin hududlarda belgilangan baliqlar tashqariga chiqib, ovi ko'payganini isbotlash kerak. A varianti aynan belgilangan balig'i tashqariga chiqib, 3 km masofadagi tijorat ovi 5 yil davomida oshganini ko'rsatadi va tanqidchilarni inkor etadi (A to'g'ri). B - uzoq okean xandaqlari haqida gap bormagan; C - turizm pulining baliq migratsiyasiga aloqasi yo'q; D - kemalarning kattalashishi baliq chiqqanini isbotlamaydi.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ WEAKEN SAVOLLARIDA: Avval tanqidchining da'vosini aniqlang ('baliq tashqariga chiqmaydi'). Uni sindiruvchi variant: 'baliqlar belgilangan holda tashqariga chiqib ovlandi'.

sample_test_questions.passage:
A study compared the thermal insulation efficacy of four bio-composite construction materials:
- Material W (Hemp-lime): Thermal conductivity 0.07 W/(m*K), Cost $18/sqm
- Material X (Mycelium foam): Thermal conductivity 0.04 W/(m*K), Cost $26/sqm
- Material Y (Straw bale): Thermal conductivity 0.09 W/(m*K), Cost $12/sqm
- Material Z (Cellulose fiber): Thermal conductivity 0.05 W/(m*K), Cost $21/sqm
Note: Lower thermal conductivity indicates superior insulating capability.
sample_test_questions.question: Based on the data, which material offers the superior insulating capability, and which is the most economical per square meter?

options.text: Material X provides superior insulation; Material Y is the most economical.
Material Y provides superior insulation; Material X is the most economical.
Material W provides superior insulation; Material Z is the most economical.
Material Z provides superior insulation; Material W is the most economical.

sample_test_questions.explanation: Ma'lumotlar tahlili: Eslatmaga qarang: 'Lower thermal conductivity indicates superior insulating capability' (Past o'tkazuvchanlik yuqori izolyatsiyani bildiradi). Eng past ko'rsatkich Material X da: 0.04 W/(m*K). Demak, eng yaxshi izolyatsiya - Material X. Eng tejamkor (eng arzon) narx esa Material Y da: $12/sqm. Shunday qilib, A to'g'ri javob. B teskari tushunish; C va D esa jadvallar sonlarini noto'g'ri taqqoslashdir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ JADVAL ESLETMASINI O'QING: 'Lower indicates superior' shartiga e'tibor bering: eng kichik son (0.04) = eng kuchli izolyatsiya!

sample_test_questions.passage: While Renaissance fresco painters primarily employed mineral pigments bound in wet lime plaster, Northern European masters pioneered oil glazing techniques. By layering translucent linseed oil glazes over opaque underpaintings, Northern artists achieved unprecedented luminous depth and rich textural realism that fresco could not replicate.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice best captures the central idea of the passage?

options.text: Northern European oil glazing enabled greater optical depth and surface realism than traditional plaster fresco techniques.
Renaissance fresco painters completely abandoned mineral pigments after the invention of oil glaze.
Linseed oil was too costly to be used by any painters working outside Northern Europe.
Fresco painting was technically superior to oil painting in achieving luminous light effects.

sample_test_questions.explanation: Matn freska va moybo'yoq texnikasini taqqoslaydi. Shimoliy Yevropa ustalari shaffof moybo'yoq qatlamlarini qo'llash orqali freska bera olmaydigan jozibador chuqurlik va to'qimalar realizmiga erishgani ta'kidlanadi (A to'g'ri). B - freskachilar mineral pigmentlarni butunlay tashlab yuborgani yo'q; C - xarajat haqida matnda so'z bormagan; D - freska moybo'yoqdan ustun emas, aksincha moybo'yoq freska bera olmagan chuqurlikni bergan.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ ASOSIY G'OYA: Matndagi taqqoslash xulosasini toping: 'oil glazing achieved unprecedented luminous depth that fresco could not replicate'.

sample_test_questions.passage: Archaeobotanists analyzed sediment cores from an ancient Mayan lake basin, tracking maize pollen alongside charcoal deposits from agricultural burning. Between 800 CE and 950 CE, maize pollen dropped to near-zero levels, coinciding with a prolonged multi-decade decrease in regional precipitation indicators and the subsequent abandonment of major urban administrative plazas.
sample_test_questions.question: Which conclusion about the ancient society is most reliably inferred from the sediment evidence?

options.text: Severe drought severely disrupted staple crop cultivation, likely contributing to urban collapse.
The population voluntarily transitioned from agriculture to nomadic pastoralism.
Urban plazas were abandoned solely due to foreign military invasion.
Maize crops were successfully replaced with drought-resistant wheat varieties.

sample_test_questions.explanation: Dalillarni birlashtiramiz: 800-950 yillar oralig'ida makkajo'xori changchalari deyarli yo'qolgan, bu davr yog'ingarchilikning keskin kamayishi (qurg'oqchilik) va yirik shahar maydonlarining tashlab ketilishi bilan bir vaqtga to'g'ri kelgan. Mantiqiy xulosa: qattiq qurg'oqchilik asosiy hosil yetishtirishni izdan chiqargan va shahar markazlarining bo'shab qolishiga olib kelgan (A to'g'ri). B - ko'chmanchilikka ixtiyoriy o'tish aytilmagan; C - harbiy bosqin haqida dalil yo'q ('solely' so'zi tuzoq); D - bug'doy haqida hech narsa deyilmagan.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ BOG'LIQLIKNI BIRLASHTIRISH: Qurg'oqchilik ko'rsatkichi + Makkajo'xori yo'qolishi + Shaharlar tashlab ketilishi => Ekologik qurg'oqchilik va dehqonchilik inqirozi.

sample_test_questions.passage: Linguist Dr. Tara Chen asserts that learning a tonal language in infancy enhances non-linguistic pitch discrimination later in childhood. To test this, she compared musical pitch memory scores between 8-year-olds raised in Mandarin-speaking households and 8-year-olds raised in English-speaking households.
sample_test_questions.question: Which finding from Dr. Chen's study would most directly support her assertion?

options.text: The Mandarin-speaking children consistently outperformed the English-speaking children on microtonal pitch differentiation tasks.
Both groups achieved identical scores on instrumental rhythm and percussion reproduction tests.
English-speaking children demonstrated a preference for stringed instruments over wind instruments.
Mandarin-speaking children had larger vocabularies in second languages than their peers.

sample_test_questions.explanation: Dr. Chenning da'vosi: Tonal tilni (masalan, mandarin) go'daklikdan o'rganish keyinchalik tildan tashqari musiqiy ohangni (pitch discrimination) ajratishni kuchaytiradi. Buni tasdiqlash (support) uchun mandarin tilida ulg'aygan bolalar musiqiy ohang farqini aniqlash testlarida ingliz tilidagi bolalardan sezilarli darajada ustun kelganini ko'rsatuvchi dalil kerak (A to'g'ri). B - ritm haqida; C - cholg'u tanlovi; D - leksika haqida bo'lib, ohangni ajratish da'vosini tasdiqlamaydi.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ DA'VOGA MOS DALIL: Da'vo: 'tonal language enhances pitch discrimination'. Dalil: 'Mandarin group outperformed on pitch tasks'.

sample_test_questions.passage: Early twentieth-century economists viewed technological automation as a pure engine of employment expansion, assuming machines merely relieved humans of repetitive manual labor while creating higher-tier administrative roles. Modern labor data, however, reveals a 'job polarization' phenomenon: automation disproportionately displaces middle-skill clerical and routine assembly jobs, while simultaneously expanding both high-wage specialized cognitive jobs and low-wage service occupations.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice best summarizes the passage's description of how modern economists view automation compared to early economists?

options.text: Modern analysts recognize that automation polarizes the labor market across skill tiers rather than uniformly generating middle-tier jobs.
Modern analysts believe automation has ceased to create any high-wage cognitive occupations.
Early economists correctly predicted that service industry wages would decline to zero.
Early economists argued that automation would permanently eliminate all forms of human employment.

sample_test_questions.explanation: Matn tahlili: Dastlabki iqtisodchilar avtomatlashtirish o'rta qatlam ma'muriy ishlarini ko'paytiradi deb o'ylashgan. Zamonaviy ma'lumotlar esa 'job polarization' (mehnat bozorining qutblanishi) ni ko'rsatmoqda: o'rta toifadagi ishlar yo'qolib, faqat eng yuqori malakali va eng quyi xizmat ko'rsatish sohalari o'smoqda (A to'g'ri). B - yuqori toifali ishlar to'xtagan deyilmagan (expanding high-wage); C va D - erta iqtisodchilar bunday da'vo qilmagan.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ POLARIZATION MAZMUNI: O'rta qatlam ishlari siqib chiqarilib, yuqori va quyi qutblar o'sishi (job polarization across skill tiers).

sample_test_questions.passage:
A botanist recorded seed germination rates across four soil temperature settings:
- 15°C: 22% germination rate
- 20°C: 48% germination rate
- 25°C: 86% germination rate
- 30°C: 54% germination rate
sample_test_questions.question: Which claim is most directly supported by the recorded data?

options.text: Germination rate reached its maximum at 25°C and declined at higher temperatures.
Germination rate increased continuously as temperature rose from 15°C to 30°C.
The seeds will fail to germinate entirely at 25°C.

sample_test_questions.explanation: Raqamlar zanjiriga qarang: 15°C da 22%, 20°C da 48%, 25°C da 86% (eng yuqori cho'qqi), keyin esa 30°C da 54% ga tushib ketgan. Demak, unib chiqish 25°C da o'z maksimumiga erishgan va undan yuqori haroratda pasaygan (A to'g'ri). B - uzluksiz oshmagan (30°C da pasaygan); C va D - raqamlarga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri zid xatolardir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ GRAFIK TRENDI: 22% -> 48% -> 86% -> 54%. Cho'qqi (peak) = 25°C.

sample_test_questions.question: A community theater charges $14 per adult ticket and $9 per child ticket. For a Saturday matinee, a total of 320 tickets were sold, generating $3,630 in revenue. How many adult tickets were sold?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Kattalar chiptasi soni a, bolalar chiptasi soni c bo'lsin. Sistema: a + c = 320 va 14a + 9c = 3630. Birinchi tenglamadan c = 320 - a ni ikkinchisiga qo'yamiz: 14a + 9(320 - a) = 3630 => 14a + 2880 - 9a = 3630 => 5a = 3630 - 2880 = 750 => a = 150 ta kattalar chiptasi sotilgan. Bolalar chiptasi: 320 - 150 = 170 ta (B variant chalg'ituvchi tuzoq).
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ DESMOS HACK: Desmosga x + y = 320 va 14x + 9y = 3630 kiritiladi. Kesishish nuqtasi (150, 170). x = 150 darhol chiqadi.

sample_test_questions.question: A venture capital fund allocated a total of $4,500,000 across early-stage biotech and clean-energy startups. The expected annual return on biotech investments is 12%, and the expected return on clean-energy investments is 7%. If the total anticipated return from both sectors combined is $410,000, how much capital was invested in clean-energy startups?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Biotech investitsiyasi b, toza energiya investitsiyasi c bo'lsin. Sistema: b + c = 4500000 va 0.12b + 0.07c = 410000. Birinchi tenglamadan b = 4500000 - c ni ikkinchisiga qo'yamiz: 0.12(4500000 - c) + 0.07c = 410000 => 540000 - 0.05c = 410000 => 0.05c = 130000 => c = $2,600,000. Biotech ulushi b = $1,900,000 (A variant tuzoq). C to'g'ri.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ DESMOS HACK: x + y = 4500000 va 0.12x + 0.07y = 410000 ni Desmosga kiritib, y koordinatasini qarang: y = 2600000.

sample_test_questions.question: Line L in the xy-plane passes through the points (-3, 7) and (5, -9). Line M is perpendicular to line L and passes through the point (4, 1). What is the y-intercept of line M?
sample_test_questions.explanation: L chiziqning burchak koeffitsiyenti (slope): m_L = (-9 - 7) / (5 - (-3)) = -16 / 8 = -2. L chiziqqa perpendikulyar bo'lgan M chiziqning burchak koeffitsiyenti manfiy teskari (negative reciprocal) bo'ladi: m_M = -1 / (-2) = 1/2 = 0.5. M chiziq tenglamasi: y - 1 = 0.5(x - 4) => y = 0.5x - 2 + 1 => y = 0.5x - 1. y-intercept qiymati b = -1. D variant (2) x-intercept bilan adashtirish oqibatidir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ DESMOS HACK: Desmosga m = (-9 - 7)/(5 - (-3)) deb kiritib, so'ng y - 1 = (-1/m)(x - 4) chiziladi. (0, -1) nuqta ko'rinadi.

sample_test_questions.question: A catering service prepares boxed lunches. Each deluxe lunch requires 12 minutes to assemble, and each standard lunch requires 8 minutes. The catering staff can spend at most 6 hours assembling lunches today, and they must produce at least 35 total lunches. If d represents deluxe lunches and s represents standard lunches, which system models this situation?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Vaqt birliklarini tenglashtiramiz: 6 soat = 6 * 60 = 360 daqiqa. 'At most 6 hours' demak <= 360 daqiqa: 12d + 8s <= 360. 'At least 35 lunches' demak d + s >= 35. C va D variantlarida soat va daqiqa birlashtirilmagan (6 deb olingan), B variantida esa tengsizlik ishoralari teskari.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ SAT STRATEGY: Birlik konversiyasiga doimo e'tibor bering: 6 soat = 360 minut. 'At most' = <=, 'at least' = >=.

sample_test_questions.question: The total cost C, in dollars, of renting a utility trailer for d days is given by the function C(d) = 42d + 35, where 35 represents a mandatory reservation and insurance fee. What is the rental cost for a customer who uses the trailer for 5 days?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Funksiyaga d = 5 ni qo'yamiz: C(5) = 42(5) + 35 = 210 + 35 = $245. A variant ($210) faqat kunlik ijara haqini hisoblab, boshlang'ich $35 sug'urta to'lovini unutish natijasidir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ DESMOS HACK: Desmosga C(d) = 42d + 35 kiritib, C(5) deb yozilsa, darhol 245 qiymatini qaytaradi.

sample_test_questions.question: A logistics warehouse uses heavy-duty forklifts that can carry at most 3,200 kilograms per load. Each crate of industrial machinery weighs 140 kilograms, and each pallet of steel fasteners weighs 85 kilograms. If a forklift operator loads 12 crates of machinery, what is the maximum number of full pallets of fasteners that can be loaded without exceeding the forklift weight limit?
sample_test_questions.explanation: 12 ta uskuna qutisining umumiy og'irligi: 12 * 140 = 1680 kg. Qolgan ko'tarish quvvati: 3200 - 1680 = 1520 kg. Fastener palletlari soni p: 85 * p <= 1520 => p <= 1520 / 85 = 17.88... To'liq palletlar so'ralgani uchun maksimal butun son p = 17 bo'ladi. B variant to'g'ri. C variant (18) 1530 kg og'irlik hosil qilib limitdan oshadi.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ DESMOS HACK: (3200 - 12 * 140) / 85 hisoblansa 17.88 chiqadi. Pastga yaxlitlanadi: 17 ta.

sample_test_questions.question: The graph of the linear function f has an x-intercept at (8, 0) and a y-intercept at (0, -6). What is the slope of the graph of f?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Burchak koeffitsiyenti formulasi: m = (y2 - y1) / (x2 - x1). Berilgan nuqtalar (x1, y1) = (8, 0) va (x2, y2) = (0, -6). m = (-6 - 0) / (0 - 8) = -6 / -8 = 3/4. B variant (-3/4) ishorada adashish, D variant (4/3) esa teskari nisbat (run over rise) xatosidir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ DESMOS HACK: Desmos jadvaliga (8, 0) va (0, -6) kiritib, y1 ~ m*x1 + b regressiya chaqirilsa, m = 0.75 = 3/4 chiqadi.

sample_test_questions.question: In the xy-plane, the vertices of a triangle are located at A(2, 3), B(8, 3), and C(5, 7). What is the area of triangle ABC?
sample_test_questions.explanation: A(2, 3) va B(8, 3) nuqtalar y = 3 gorizontal to'g'ri chizig'ida yotadi. Demak, uchburchak asosi uzunligi: asos = 8 - 2 = 6 birlik. Balandlik esa C(5, 7) nuqtadan y = 3 to'g'ri chiziqqacha bo'lgan vertikal masofadir: balandlik = 7 - 3 = 4 birlik. Uchburchak yuzi formulasi: S = 0.5 * asos * balandlik = 0.5 * 6 * 4 = 12. B variant to'g'ri.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ DESMOS HACK: Desmosga polygon((2,3), (8,3), (5,7)) deb yozing, Desmos uning yuzini darhol 12 deb ko'rsatadi.

sample_test_questions.question: An agricultural agronomist models the yield Y, in bushels of wheat per acre, as a function of fertilizer application x, in kilograms per hectare, using the quadratic function Y(x) = -0.05x^2 + 6x + 80. According to this model, what amount of fertilizer x maximizes the per-acre wheat yield?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Kvadratik funksiya a = -0.05 < 0 bo'lgani uchun o'zining cho'qqi (vertex) nuqtasida maksimal qiymatga erishadi. Cho'qqining x koordinatasi: x = -b / (2a) = -6 / (2 * (-0.05)) = -6 / (-0.10) = 60 kg/ga. Demak, x = 60 bo'lganda hosildorlik eng yuqori bo'ladi. C to'g'ri.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ DESMOS HACK: y = -0.05x^2 + 6x + 80 ni chizib, parabolaning cho'qqisini bosing: (60, 260). x = 60 darhol ko'rinadi.

sample_test_questions.question: A model rocket is launched vertically from a platform. Its height h, in meters above the ground, t seconds after launch is modeled by the equation h(t) = -4.9t^2 + 39.2t + 4. At what time t, in seconds, does the rocket reach its maximum height?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Maksimal balandlikka erishish vaqti parabolaning cho'qqisiga to'g'ri keladi: t = -b / (2a) = -39.2 / (2 * (-4.9)) = -39.2 / -9.8 = 4.0 soniya. B variant to'g'ri. D variant (8.0) raketaning yerga qaytib tushish vaqtiga yaqin bo'lib chalg'ituvchi tuzoqdir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ DESMOS HACK: y = -4.9x^2 + 39.2x + 4 parabola cho'qqisi (4, 82.4) da joylashgan. Maksimal vaqt t = 4 soniya.
