sample_test_questions.passage: In studying ancient maritime commerce in the Baltic Sea, historian Henrik Lund hypothesized that the fourteenth-century expansion of the Hanseatic League was driven more by monopolistic legal privileges granted by regional monarchs than by superior merchant naval technology. To substantiate this hypothesis, Lund must identify historical evidence demonstrating that rival non-Hanseatic merchants possessed vessels of equivalent maritime capability but were excluded through statutory barriers.
sample_test_questions.question: Which finding, if true, would most directly support Lund's hypothesis?

options.text: Dutch merchant cogs matched Hanseatic ships in cargo capacity and navigational range but were barred from Baltic ports under royal charter agreements that granted exclusive trading monopolies to Hanseatic guilds.
Hanseatic shipwrights engineered innovative double-hulled vessels that withstood northern storms far better than any contemporary European craft.
Regional monarchs continuously raised customs duties equally on all foreign merchant vessels regardless of their guild affiliations.
Non-Hanseatic merchants willingly abandoned Baltic shipping routes due to widespread domestic textile shortages in Flanders.

sample_test_questions.explanation: Lundning farazi: Ganza ligasining ustunligi kema texnologiyasidan emas, balki qirollar bergan monopol huquqiy imtiyozlardan kelib chiqqan. Buning uchun raqib kemalar texnik jihatdan teng bo'lsa-da, qonuniy to'siqlar tufayli portlarga kiritilmaganini isbotlash kerak. A variant aynan shuni ko'rsatadi: golland kemalari sig'imi va masofasi bo'yicha teng bo'lgan, biroq qirollik shartnomalari tufayli portlardan chiqarib qo'yilgan. To'g'ri javob: A. Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B — texnologik ustunlikni aytib, gipotezaga qarshi ishlaydi; C — barcha savdogarlardan teng boj olingan bo'lsa, monopol imtiyoz gipotezasi puchga chiqadi; D — texnologiya yoki qonuniy to'siqqa aloqasi yo'q xato variant.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ GIPOTEZANI TASDIQLASH: Gipoteza 'Texnologiya emas, qonuniy to'siq' degan. Demak, javobda 'Texnologiya bir xil, lekin qonun bilan taqiqlangan' dalili bo'lishi shart!

sample_test_questions.passage: Energy engineers conducted a 500-cycle degradation trial evaluating four utility-scale battery chemistries. They recorded initial capacity retention and internal resistance increases. Lithium iron phosphate (LFP) retained 94% capacity with a 6% resistance gain; nickel manganese cobalt (NMC) retained 88% capacity with a 14% resistance gain; sodium-ion retained 82% capacity with a 18% resistance gain; and lead-carbon retained 71% capacity with a 29% resistance gain. The researchers concluded that LFP demonstrates the greatest electrochemical stability under repeated cycling.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice best uses data from the passage to support the researchers' conclusion?

options.text: LFP achieved the highest capacity retention (94%) and the lowest internal resistance increase (6%) among all four tested chemistries.
Lead-carbon batteries exhibited lower internal resistance increases than sodium-ion batteries.
NMC batteries retained more capacity than LFP batteries throughout the 500-cycle trial.
All four battery chemistries maintained capacity retention above 85% after 500 cycles.

sample_test_questions.explanation: Tadqiqotchilar LFP kimyosi eng barqaror deb xulosa qilishgan. Buni matndagi raqamlar bilan tasdiqlash uchun LFP ning ko'rsatkichlari eng yaxshi ekanini ko'rsatish kerak: u eng yuqori sig'im saqlashga (94%) va eng kam ichki qarshilik o'sishiga (6%) ega bo'ldi. To'g'ri javob: A. Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B — matnga zid (qo'rg'oshin 29%, natriy 18%); C — matnga zid (NMC 88% < LFP 94%); D — matnga zid (faqat LFP va NMC 85% dan yuqori, qolganlari 82% va 71%).
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ RAQAMLARNI SOLISHTIRISH: Matndagi jadval ma'lumotlarini qat'iy tekshiring va 'superlativ' (eng yuqori/eng past) ko'rsatkichga e'tibor bering.

sample_test_questions.passage: Many deep-sea organisms utilize bioluminescent counterillumination to evade predators hunting from below. By emitting downward-directed light from ventral photophores that matches the intensity and wavelength of downwelling sunlight, these creatures disguise their silhouettes. Marine ecologist Sarah Hirst observed that when mesopelagic squids encounter artificial water turbidity that scatters sunlight irregularly, their photophore adjustments become mismatched with ambient light, suggesting that ______
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice most logically completes the text?

options.text: their counterillumination camouflage relies on uniform ambient light fields to effectively obscure their silhouettes.
turbid waters provide superior camouflage protection compared to clear oceanic zones.
mesopelagic squids migrate into shallower waters when oceanic turbidity increases.
ventral photophores generate light through external bacterial digestion rather than biochemical reactions.

sample_test_questions.explanation: Matnda kalmarlarning pastga yo'naltirilgan nuri tushayotgan quyosh nuriga moslashib siluetni yashirishi aytilgan. Biroq loyqa suv yorug'likni notekis tarqatganda kalmarlarning nuri atrof-muhitga mos kelmay qolgan. Bundan mantiqiy xulosa: ularning bu kamuflyaji samarali ishlashi uchun bir tekis (uniform) yorug'lik maydoniga tayanadi. To'g'ri javob: A. Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B — loyqa suv yaxshiroq himoya beradi degan matnga teskari da'vo; C — sayoz suvga ko'chib o'tadi degan asossiz taxmin; D — bakterial hazm haqida matnda hech qanday ma'lumot yo'q.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ MANTIQIY DAVOM: Sabab-oqibat zanjiri: loyqalik nur muvozanatini buzdi -> demak tizim bir tekis yorug'likka bog'liq!

sample_test_questions.passage: Obsidian, a naturally occurring volcanic glass, was among the most prized materials in Neolithic tool manufacturing. Because each volcanic deposit possesses a unique chemical fingerprint of trace elements, modern archaeologists can use X-ray fluorescence spectrometry to trace obsidian blades discovered at distant settlement sites back to their precise quarry of origin, thereby reconstructing trade networks that spanned thousands of kilometers across prehistoric Anatolia.
sample_test_questions.question: According to the text, why are modern archaeologists able to identify the geographic origins of ancient obsidian blades?

options.text: Each volcanic source has a distinct chemical composition of trace elements that can be detected through spectrometry.
Neolithic toolmakers inscribed distinctive geographical symbols onto every blade.
Ancient trade treaties detailing raw material shipments were preserved in Anatolian archives.
Obsidian blades change physical color based on the geographical distance they travel.

sample_test_questions.explanation: Matnda ochiq-oydin aytilgan: 'Because each volcanic deposit possesses a unique chemical fingerprint of trace elements, modern archaeologists can use X-ray fluorescence spectrometry to trace obsidian blades... back to their precise quarry of origin'. Bu A variantga to'liq mos keladi. Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B — pichoqlarga geografik belgilar yozilgani haqida gap yo'q; C — arxivalar saqlangani aytilmagan; D — masofaga qarab rang o'zgarishi kabi ilmiy bo'lmagan chalg'ituvchi variant.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ TO'G'RIDAN-TO'G'RI MATN ASOSI: 'Because each volcanic deposit possesses a unique chemical fingerprint...' so'zlarini javob bilan solishtiring.

sample_test_questions.passage: Linguists investigating phonological acquisition have debated whether infants identify word boundaries primarily by tracking statistical transitional probabilities between syllables or by responding to acoustic stress patterns. To demonstrate that statistical learning operates independently of acoustic stress, researcher Marcus Gable presented eight-month-old infants with a stream of synthesized speech in which all syllables were uttered with identical pitch, duration, and volume, but with specific syllable pairs occurring in predictable sequences.
sample_test_questions.question: Which finding from Gable's experiment, if true, would most strongly support the statistical learning hypothesis?

options.text: The infants displayed significantly greater listening interest in novel syllable combinations than in the predictable syllable pairs from the stream.
The infants showed no measurable reaction to any syllable sequence unless pitch and volume varied noticeably.
The infants recognized words only when the synthesized voices resembled their primary caregivers' voices.
The infants struggled to perceive individual syllables when background white noise was eliminated.

sample_test_questions.explanation: Kognitiv psixologiyada chaqaloqlar o'rgangan narsasidan ko'ra yangi narsaga ko'proq e'tibor qaratadi (novelty preference). Agar chaqaloqlar bir xil ohang va balandlikdagi oqimdan so'ng yangi kombinatsiyalarga ko'proq quloq solsa, bu ularning statistik ketma-ketlikni eslab qolganini va yangisini farqlay olganini isbotlaydi. To'g'ri javob: A. Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B — ohangsiz hech narsani sezmadi desa gipotezani rad etgan bo'ladi; C — ona ovozi sharti matnda sinovdan chiqarilgan; D — oq shovqin haqida matnda ma'lumot yo'q.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ CHAQALOQLAR PSIXOLOGIYASI TESTI: O'rganilgan so'zlarni tanish chaqaloqning 'novel' (yangi) so'zlarga uzoqroq quloq solishi (preferential listening) orqali o'lchanadi.

sample_test_questions.passage: In cognitive psychology, retrieval-induced forgetting occurs when the act of practicing the recall of certain items from memory causes the temporary suppression of related, unpracticed items. For instance, repeatedly reviewing the word pair 'Fruit-Apple' impairs subsequent recall of 'Fruit-Banana.' Neuroimaging indicates that this suppression is driven by prefrontal inhibitory control mechanisms that resolve competition during memory access. Thus, retrieval-induced forgetting demonstrates that ______
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice most logically completes the text?

options.text: forgetting is not merely a passive decay of information, but can result from active cognitive mechanisms that suppress competing memories.
human memory has a rigid, finite capacity that permanently deletes older memories to store new data.
practicing recall is generally harmful to academic test preparation.
all memory retrieval is unmediated by prefrontal neurological circuits.

sample_test_questions.explanation: Matnda miyadagi tormozlash mexanizmi (inhibitory control) raqobatdosh xotiralarni faol ravishda bosib turishi (suppress) ko'rsatilgan. Bundan mantiqiy xulosa shuki, unutish shunchaki xotiraning o'z-o'zidan passiv o'chib ketishi (passive decay) emas, balki miyaning faol boshqaruv mexanizmi natijasidir. To'g'ri javob: A. Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B — xotira ma'lumotni butunlay o'chirib tashlaydi degan noto'g'ri da'vo (matnda 'temporary suppression' deyilgan); C — takrorlash o'qishga zarar degan mantiqsiz umumlashtirish; D — neyron zanjirlarga aloqador emas degan matnga teskari xato variant.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ MATN XULOSASI: 'active suppression by inhibitory control' = xotira passiv yo'qolmaydi, faol tormozlanadi.

sample_test_questions.question: If r and s are the distinct solutions to the quadratic equation 3x^2 - 15x + 7 = 0, what is the value of 1/r + 1/s?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Using Vieta's formulas: r + s = -(-15)/3 = 5, and r * s = 7/3. Note that 1/r + 1/s = (r + s) / (r * s) = 5 / (7/3) = 5 * 3/7 = 15/7.
sample_test_questions.strategy: 1/r + 1/s = (r + s)/(r * s). Ildizlar yig'indisi 5, ko'paytmasi 7/3. 5 / (7/3) = 15/7.

sample_test_questions.question: A radioactive sample decays according to the model M(t) = 800(0.88)^t, where t is measured in years. By what annual percentage does the mass of the sample decrease?
sample_test_questions.explanation: In an exponential decay model y = a(1 - r)^t, the base is 1 - r. Here, 1 - r = 0.88 => r = 1 - 0.88 = 0.12, which represents an annual decrease of 12%.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Asos 0.88 bo'lsa, 100% - 88% = 12% ga kamayish demakdir.

sample_test_questions.question: The height h(t), in feet, of a baseball t seconds after being struck is given by h(t) = -16t^2 + 64t + 80. How many seconds after impact does the ball strike the ground?
sample_test_questions.explanation: The ball strikes the ground when h(t) = 0: -16t^2 + 64t + 80 = 0. Divide both sides by -16: t^2 - 4t - 5 = 0. Factor: (t - 5)(t + 1) = 0. Since time t >= 0, t = 5 seconds.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Tenglamani -16 ga bo'ling: t^2 - 4t - 5 = 0 => (t - 5)(t + 1) = 0 => t = 5.

sample_test_questions.question: If (x - 2)^(3/2) = 27, what is the value of x?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Raise both sides to the power of 2/3: x - 2 = (27)^(2/3). Since 27 = 3^3, (3^3)^(2/3) = 3^2 = 9. Thus, x - 2 = 9 => x = 11.
sample_test_questions.strategy: 27 ning kub ildizi 3, kvadrati 9. x - 2 = 9 => x = 11.

sample_test_questions.question: In the xy-plane, the equation x^2 + y^2 - 10x + 6y = 47 represents a circle. What is the radius of the circle?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Complete the square for x and y: (x^2 - 10x + 25) + (y^2 + 6y + 9) = 47 + 25 + 9 => (x - 5)^2 + (y + 3)^2 = 81. The standard form of a circle is (x - h)^2 + (y - k)^2 = r^2. Therefore, r^2 = 81 => r = 9.

sample_test_questions.question: The population of an endangered bird species increased by 25% from 2020 to 2022, but then decreased by 20% from 2022 to 2024. If the population in 2024 was 1,200 birds, what was the population in 2020?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Let P be the 2020 population. In 2022, it was 1.25P. In 2024, after a 20% decrease, it was (1 - 0.20)(1.25P) = 0.80 * 1.25P = 1.00P. Since P_2024 = 1,200, the 2020 population was exactly 1,200.
sample_test_questions.strategy: 1.25 * 0.80 = 1.00! Ya'ni +25% va -20% bir-birini to'liq neytrallaydi. Boshlang'ich son 1,200 bo'lgan.

sample_test_questions.question: A student scored 82, 88, 91, and 79 on the first four physics exams. What score must the student earn on the fifth exam to achieve an overall mean score of 86?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Total sum required for 5 exams with a mean of 86 is 5 * 86 = 430. The sum of the first 4 exams is 82 + 88 + 91 + 79 = 340. The fifth exam score must be 430 - 340 = 90.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Jami kerakli ball: 5 * 86 = 430. Mavjud: 340. Kerak: 430 - 340 = 90.

sample_test_questions.domain: Problem Solving - Margin of Error & Probability
sample_test_questions.question: A random sample of 600 voters in a municipality found that 54% support a proposed environmental ordinance, with an associated margin of error of 4% at a 95% confidence level. Which of the following conclusions is best supported by the survey results?

options.text: Exactly 54% of all municipal voters support the ordinance.
It is plausible that the true proportion of all municipal voters who support the ordinance is between 50% and 58%.
Every random sample of 600 voters will yield exactly between 50% and 58% support.
The ordinance is guaranteed to pass with more than 50% of the vote.

sample_test_questions.explanation: The margin of error gives a plausible interval for the population parameter: 54% +/- 4% = [50%, 58%]. It does not guarantee certainty ('exactly' or 'guaranteed'). Hence, B is the only statistically sound interpretation.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Statistika qoidasi: 'Guaranteed' yoki 'Exactly' so'zlari noto'g'ri. Har doim 'plausible' (ehtimoliy oraliq) to'g'ri bo'ladi.

sample_test_questions.question: A rectangular ceramic tile has an area of 54 square inches. Given that 1 foot = 12 inches, what is the area of the tile in square feet?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Since 1 foot = 12 inches, 1 square foot = 12^2 = 144 square inches. Convert the area: 54 sq in * (1 sq ft / 144 sq in) = 54 / 144 = 3 / 8 = 0.375 square feet.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Kvadrat birliklar tuzog'i! 12 ga emas, 12^2 = 144 ga bo'linadi: 54 / 144 = 0.375.

sample_test_questions.domain: Problem Solving - Margin of Error & Probability
sample_test_questions.question: In a clinical study of 250 patients, 160 received Treatment A and 90 received a Placebo. Of those who received Treatment A, 128 reported symptom relief. Of those who received the Placebo, 36 reported symptom relief. If a patient is selected at random from those who reported symptom relief, what is the probability that the patient received Treatment A?
sample_test_questions.explanation: The condition specifies selecting 'from those who reported symptom relief'. Total patients reporting relief = 128 (Treatment A) + 36 (Placebo) = 164. The favorable count from Treatment A is 128. Therefore, P = 128 / 164.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Shartli ehtimollik: Maxrajda faqat shart qanoatlantirganlar (yengillik sezganlar): 128 + 36 = 164. Ehtimollik: 128/164.

sample_test_questions.passage: Botanist Linda Perez investigated whether urban plants adapt to elevated ground-level ozone by altering stomatal conductance. In a controlled greenhouse study, she exposed common plantain (Plantago major) seedlings from both rural roadside populations and dense inner-city populations to identical ozone concentrations (80 ppb) for four weeks. Perez observed that inner-city plants exhibited significantly lower stomatal conductance and accumulated 40% less cellular oxidative damage than rural specimens.
sample_test_questions.question: Which statement is best supported by Perez's findings?

options.text: Inner-city populations of Plantago major possess adaptive traits that limit ozone uptake and subsequent oxidative damage.
Rural plants are better suited to withstand high ozone concentrations than urban varieties.
Elevated ozone exposure consistently increases stomatal conductance across all plant species.
Plantago major is incapable of surviving in environments with ground-level ozone levels above 40 ppb.

sample_test_questions.explanation: Shaharda o'sgan o'simliklar qishloqdagilarga nisbatan kamroq og'izcha o'tkazuvchanligiga ega bo'lib, 40% kamroq oksidlanish zarari ko'rgan. Bu ularning shahar muhitida ozon gazining kirishini cheklaydigan moslashuvchan (adaptive) xususiyatlarga ega ekanini to'liq tasdiqlaydi. To'g'ri javob: A. Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B — qishloq o'simliklari bardoshliroq degan matnga teskari da'vo; C — barcha turlarda o'tkazuvchanlik oshadi degan xato; D — 40 ppb dan yuqorida yashay olmaydi degan asossiz cheklov.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ DALILNI MOSLASHTIRISH: Kamroq zarar ko'rgan (40% less damage) = yaxshiroq moslashgan (possess adaptive traits).

sample_test_questions.passage: Astronomers surveying debris disks around mature G-type stars noted that secondary gas emissions—principally carbon monoxide—are replenished through volatile-rich comet collisions rather than surviving from the primordial protoplanetary nebula. Because carbon monoxide is rapidly photodissociated by stellar ultraviolet radiation within a few thousand years, its persistent presence in multi-billion-year-old stellar systems implies that ______
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice most logically completes the text?

options.text: cometary collision rates remain sufficiently frequent in these systems to continuously regenerate the dissipated gas.
primordial gas nebulae are completely immune to stellar ultraviolet photodissociation.
mature G-type stars gradually stop emitting ultraviolet radiation as they age.
planetary formation is physically impossible in systems containing carbon monoxide debris disks.

sample_test_questions.explanation: Agar CO gazi yulduz nurlari ta'sirida bir necha ming yilda yo'qolib ketsa-yu, lekin milliard yillik qadimgi yulduz tizimlarida hamon mavjud bo'lsa, bu yangi gaz doimiy ravishda kometa to'qnashuvlari orqali qayta ishlab chiqarilayotganini bildiradi. To'g'ri javob: A. Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B — gaz nurlanishga chidamli degan matnga teskari gap (matnda 'rapidly photodissociated' deyilgan); C — yulduzlar ultrabinafsha nurlanishni to'xtatadi degan asossiz faraz; D — sayyora paydo bo'lishi mumkin emas degan xato radikal xulosa.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ MANTIQIY TENGSIZLIK: Gaz tez yo'qoladi + lekin hali ham bor = yangi gaz muntazam paydo bo'lyapti (continuously regenerated)!

sample_test_questions.passage: Before the advent of reliable refrigeration in the nineteenth century, harvesting natural ice from northern ponds and rivers was a vital global industry. Entrepreneurs like Frederic Tudor harvested frozen blocks in New England, insulated them in double-walled holds packed with sawdust, and successfully shipped thousands of tons of ice to tropical destinations such as Havana, Kingston, and Calcutta with remarkably little melt loss.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice best describes how Frederic Tudor minimized melt loss during maritime ice transportation?

options.text: By stowing the ice blocks in double-walled holds insulated with sawdust
By chemically treating the pond water prior to freezing
By transporting ice exclusively during the mid-winter months on steamships
By compressing the ice blocks into airtight vacuum chambers

sample_test_questions.explanation: Matnda to'g'ridan-to'g'ri ko'rsatilgan: 'insulated them in double-walled holds packed with sawdust' (qipiq bilan to'ldirilgan ikki qavatli devorli xonalarda saqlagan). To'g'ri javob: A. Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B — muzlashdan oldin kimyoviy ishlov berish aytilmagan; C — faqat qishda bug'li kemalarda tashigan deyilmagan; D — vakuum kamerasiga qisish degan noto'g'ri fantastik variant.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ MATN DETALI: Matndagi 'insulated them in double-walled holds packed with sawdust' iborasini qidiring.

sample_test_questions.passage: The archival research team uncovered three previously unpublished letters by author Mary ______ were meticulous reflections on the social turbulence of early Victorian England.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Bu yerda ikkita mustaqil gap (independent clauses) mavjud: 1) 'The archival research team uncovered three previously unpublished letters by author Mary Shelley' va 2) 'all of them were meticulous reflections...'. Ikkita mustaqil gapni bog'lovchisiz faqat vergul bilan ajratish 'comma splice' xatosidir (B xato). Nuqta-vergul (;) ikkita mustaqil gapni grammatik to'g'ri bog'laydi. To'g'ri javob: A. Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B — vergul xatosi (comma splice); C — tinish belgisiz qo'shib yuborish (run-on); D — nuqta-verguldan keyin 'which' qo'yib gapni chala qoldirish (fragment).
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ SAT GRAMMATIKA: Mustaqil gap + mustaqil gap = Nuqta-vergul (;) yoki Vergul + FANBOYS. Faqat vergul bo'lsa xato!

sample_test_questions.passage: A team of structural engineers inspected the suspension bridge's primary cable ______ discovering extensive corrosion along the western anchoring vault, they recommended immediate tension reduction.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Tuzilishga qaraymiz: Birinchi mustaqil gap: 'A team... inspected the suspension bridge's primary cable bands'. sample_test_questions.passage: The collection of rare Mesoamerican jade artifacts that was recovered from underwater cenotes in the Yucatán Peninsula ______ currently undergoing non-destructive laser spectroscopy in Mexico City.

'of rare Mesoamerican jade artifacts that was recovered...' oraliqdagi aniqlovchi birikma (prepositional phrase) bo'lib, egaga ta'sir qilmaydi. Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (are), C (were) va D (have been) ko'plikdagi fe'llar bo'lib, 'artifacts' so'ziga adashib moslashtirilgan klassik SAT tuzoqlaridir.

sample_test_questions.question: Dataset X consists of the numbers {12, 14, 15, 18, 21}. Dataset Y is formed by adding 6 to each number in Dataset X. Which statement correctly compares the standard deviation and median of the two datasets?

options.text: The median increases by 6, and the standard deviation increases by 6.
The median increases by 6, and the standard deviation remains unchanged.
The median remains unchanged, and the standard deviation increases by 6.
Both the median and the standard deviation remain unchanged.

sample_test_questions.explanation: Adding a constant c to every value in a dataset shifts the entire distribution rightward by c (so the median increases by c = 6), but the distances between points remain completely identical, meaning the spread (standard deviation) is unchanged.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Har bir elementga son qo'shilganda: Median o'zgaradi (+6), lekin dispersiya/standart og'ish o'zgarmaydi.

sample_test_questions.question: A line of best fit for a scatterplot relating weekly study hours x to exam score y is modeled by y = 4.2x + 48. If a student studies 9.5 hours in a week, what is the student's predicted exam score, to the nearest whole point?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Substitute x = 9.5 into the equation: y = 4.2(9.5) + 48 = 39.9 + 48 = 87.9. Rounding to the nearest whole point gives 88.

sample_test_questions.question: Two commuter trains leave the same station at 08:00 AM traveling in opposite directions along a straight track. Train A travels at an average speed of 65 miles per hour, and Train B travels at 85 miles per hour. At what time will the two trains be 450 miles apart?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Because they travel in opposite directions, their separation speed is the sum: 65 + 85 = 150 miles per hour. Time needed to separate 450 miles = 450 / 150 = 3 hours. Adding 3 hours to 08:00 AM gives 11:00 AM.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Qarama-qarshi yo'nalishda tezliklar qo'shiladi: 65 + 85 = 150 mph. Vaqt = 450 / 150 = 3 soat. 08:00 + 3:00 = 11:00 AM.

sample_test_questions.question: An online retailer sold 480 smartphones in November and 600 smartphones in December. What was the percentage increase in smartphone sales from November to December?
sample_test_questions.strategy: Oshish foizi: (Oshgan miqdor / Boshlang'ich) * 100 = 120 / 480 = 0.25 (25%).

sample_test_questions.domain: Problem Solving - Margin of Error & Probability
sample_test_questions.question: A quality inspector tests components from an automated assembly line. The probability that any individual component has a manufacturing defect is 0.04, independently of other components. What is the probability that in a random sample of 2 components, at least one component has a defect?
sample_test_questions.explanation: P(at least one defect) = 1 - P(no defects). The probability that a component has no defect is 1 - 0.04 = 0.96. For 2 independent components: P(no defects) = 0.96 * 0.96 = 0.9216. Thus, P(at least one defect) = 1 - 0.9216 = 0.0784.

sample_test_questions.question: A solid rectangular prism made of titanium has dimensions 8 cm by 5 cm by 4 cm. If the density of titanium is 4.5 grams per cubic centimeter, what is the mass of the prism in grams?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Volume of prism = length * width * height = 8 * 5 * 4 = 160 cm^3. Mass = density * volume = 4.5 g/cm^3 * 160 cm^3 = 720 grams.

sample_test_questions.domain: Geometry and Trigonometry - Right Triangles & Trigonometric Ratios
sample_test_questions.question: In right triangle ABC, angle C is the right angle. If sin(A) = 5/13, what is the value of cos(B)?
sample_test_questions.explanation: In any right triangle where angles A and B are complementary acute angles (A + B = 90 degrees), the co-function identity holds: sin(A) = cos(90 - A) = cos(B). Therefore, cos(B) = 5/13.
sample_test_questions.strategy: O'zaro to'ldiruvchi burchaklar qoidasi: sin(A) = cos(B). Sinus berilgan bo'lsa, ikkinchi burchak kosinusi unga teng: 5/13.

sample_test_questions.domain: Geometry and Trigonometry - Arc Length & Angles
sample_test_questions.question: A circle has a radius of 18 centimeters. What is the length, in centimeters, of an arc intercepted by a central angle measuring 5*pi / 6 radians?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Arc length s is given by s = r * theta when theta is in radians. Here, s = 18 * (5*pi / 6) = 3 * 5*pi = 15*pi centimeters.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Yoy uzunligi formulasi (radianda): s = r * theta. 18 * (5*pi/6) = 15*pi.

sample_test_questions.domain: Geometry and Trigonometry - Circle Equations & Radius
sample_test_questions.question: In the xy-plane, the circle with equation (x + 7)^2 + (y - 4)^2 = 144 has its center at point (h, k) and radius r. What is the value of h + k + r?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Standard form is (x - h)^2 + (y - k)^2 = r^2. Comparing gives h = -7, k = 4, and r = sqrt(144) = 12. Therefore, h + k + r = -7 + 4 + 12 = 9.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Markaz: (-7, 4), radius r = 12. Yig'indi: -7 + 4 + 12 = 9.

sample_test_questions.domain: Geometry and Trigonometry - Area, Volume & Similarity
sample_test_questions.question: Cylinder P has radius r and height h. Cylinder Q has twice the radius and half the height of Cylinder P. If the volume of Cylinder P is 45*pi cubic inches, what is the volume of Cylinder Q, in cubic inches?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Volume of a cylinder is V = pi * r^2 * h. For Cylinder Q, V_Q = pi * (2r)^2 * (h/2) = pi * (4r^2) * (h/2) = 2 * (pi * r^2 * h) = 2 * V_P. Thus, V_Q = 2 * 45*pi = 90*pi cubic inches.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Radius kvadratik ta'sir qiladi (2^2 = 4), balandlik esa chiziqli (1/2). Umumiy hajm 4 * 1/2 = 2 barobar oshadi: 45*pi * 2 = 90*pi.

sample_test_questions.passage: The Kepler space observatory, which discovered more than 2,600 verified exoplanets during its nine-year ______ finally exhausted its onboard thruster propellant in October 2018.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
sample_test_questions.explanation: 'which discovered more than 2,600 verified exoplanets during its nine-year mission' — bu qo'shimcha kiritma gap (non-essential relative clause). U 'which' dan oldin vergul bilan boshlangan, shuning uchun 'mission' so'zidan keyin ham vergul bilan yopilishi shart (paired commas). To'g'ri javob: A. Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (mission;) — kiritmani nuqta-vergul bilan yopish grammatik qo'pol xato; C (mission) — kiritmani ochiq qoldirib tinish belgisini qo'ymaslik xatosi; D (mission—) — bir tomoni vergul, ikkinchi tomoni tire bo'lishi mumkin emas.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ JUFT VERGULLAR: Agar kiritma vergul bilan ochilgan bo'lsa (..., which...), u vergul bilan yopilishi shart (...mission,).

sample_test_questions.passage: Neither the senior aerospace engineers nor the lead project manager ______ able to determine the root cause of the telemetry transmission anomaly during the preliminary debrief.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
sample_test_questions.explanation: 'Neither... nor...' bog'lovchisida fe'l o'ziga eng yaqin turgan egaga moslashadi (Rule of Proximity). Bu yerda 'nor' dan keyin 'the lead project manager' (birlik) turibdi. Shuning uchun fe'l birlikda bo'lishi shart: 'was'. To'g'ri javob: A (was). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (were), C (are) va D (have been) ko'plikdagi fe'llar bo'lib, ular 'engineers' so'ziga adashib qaraganda tushiladigan tuzoqlardir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ NEITHER/NOR QOIDASI: 'nor' dan keyingi otga qarang: 'manager' (birlik) bo'lsa -> 'was'.

sample_test_questions.passage: During the archaeological survey of the Roman villa, researchers catalogued hundreds of well-preserved everyday ______ bronze oil lamps, terracotta cookware, and carved ivory hairpins.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Ikki nuqta (colon) to'liq mustaqil gapdan keyin ro'yxat, izoh yoki misollarni keltirish uchun ishlatiladi: '...catalogued hundreds of well-preserved everyday items' — bu to'liq mustaqil gap. Undan keyin sanab o'tilgan buyumlar ro'yxati kelgan. Shuning uchun ikki nuqta (:) to'g'ri tanlov. To'g'ri javob: A. Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (vergul) — ro'yxatni ochishda bo'linish noaniqligini keltirib chiqaradi; C (nuqta-vergul) — faqat mustaqil gaplarni bog'laydi, ro'yxat kiritmaydi; D — tinish belgisiz qo'shib yuborish xatosi.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ IKKI NUQTA (:) QOIDASI: [To'liq mustaqil gap] : [Ro'yxat yoki izoh].

sample_test_questions.passage: Unlike the ornate frescoes produced by his Italian contemporaries, the seventeenth-century Dutch painter Johannes Vermeer ______ scenes of quiet domesticity, depicting solitary figures engaged in routine household tasks.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Gapning grammatik asosini tahlil qilamiz: 'Johannes Vermeer' bu yerda ega (subject). Gapda boshqa hech qanday asosiy kesim (finite verb) yo'q. Shuning uchun Vermeer dan keyin o'tgan zamondagi to'liq kesim 'favored' kelishi shart. B ('favoring'), C ('having favored') va D ('to favor') sifatdosh va infinitiv bo'lib, mustaqil kesim bo'la olmaydi va gapni grammatik nuqsonga (fragment) aylantiradi. To'g'ri javob: A.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ FINITE VERB TALABI: Har bir gapda albatta to'liq tuslangan zamon fe'li (kesim) bo'lishi shart! '-ing' yoki 'to...' yolg'iz o'zi kesim bo'lolmaydi.

sample_test_questions.passage: Neurobiologist Elena Rostova spent decades investigating synaptic ______ her pioneering work on hippocampal long-term potentiation fundamentally transformed contemporary models of memory formation.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Bu yerda ikkita to'liq mustaqil gap bor: 1) 'Neurobiologist Elena Rostova spent decades investigating synaptic plasticity' va 2) 'her pioneering work... fundamentally transformed contemporary models...'. Ikkita mustaqil gapni ajratish uchun nuqta-vergul (;) talab qilinadi. To'g'ri javob: A. Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (vergul) — comma splice xatosi; C — run-on xatosi; D ('and,') — vergul noo'rin qo'yilgan xato variant.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ COMMA SPLICE TESTI: Ikkita gap o'rtasiga nuqta qo'yib ko'ring: ikkisi ham mustaqil tura olsa, ularning orasiga faqat vergul qo'yish taqiqlanadi!

sample_test_questions.passage: Every autumn, millions of monarch butterflies embark on a 3,000-mile migration from eastern North America to central Mexico, where ______ congregate in the high-altitude fir forests of Michoacán.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Olmosh o'zi almashtirayotgan otga mos kelishi kerak (pronoun-antecedent agreement). Gapda gap 'millions of monarch butterflies' (ko'plik) haqida ketmoqda. Shuning uchun ko'plik olmoshi 'they' ishlatilishi shart. To'g'ri javob: A. Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B ('it'), C ('one'), D ('this') birlikdagi olmoshlar bo'lib, ko'plikdagi 'butterflies' ga mos kelmaydi.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ OLMOSH MOSLIGI: 'butterflies' (ko'plik) -> 'they'.

sample_test_questions.passage: For decades, materials scientists sought to replicate the remarkable tensile strength of natural spider silk using synthetic petrochemical polymers. ______, by utilizing genetically engineered silkworms expressing transgenic arachnid proteins, contemporary bioengineers finally produced fibers matching the elasticity of natural dragline silk.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Matnda olimlarning o'nlab yillar davomida harakat qilgani ('For decades... sought') va oxir-oqibat genetik muhandislik orqali yakuniy muvaffaqiyatga erishgani ('contemporary bioengineers finally produced...') bayon qilingan. Bu uzoq jarayonning yakuniy yechimini ko'rsatuvchi 'Ultimately' (oxir-oqibat, pirovardida) o'tish so'zini talab qiladi. To'g'ri javob: A. Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B ('For instance') — o'tgan harakatlarga misol emas, natija; C ('Similarly') — o'xshashlik emas; D ('In other words') — boshqacha qilib aytganda emas, yangi yakuniy natija.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ VAQT VA NATIJA: 'For decades... finally...' juftligi 'Ultimately' (oxir-oqibat) o'tishini bildiradi.

sample_test_questions.domain: Geometry and Trigonometry - Area, Volume & Similarity
sample_test_questions.question: Triangle ABC is similar to triangle DEF, where vertices A, B, and C correspond to D, E, and F respectively. The length of side AB is 15 cm and the length of corresponding side DE is 25 cm. If the area of triangle ABC is 72 square centimeters, what is the area of triangle DEF, in square centimeters?
sample_test_questions.explanation: The ratio of corresponding side lengths is k = 25/15 = 5/3. The ratio of their areas is k^2 = (5/3)^2 = 25/9. Thus, Area(DEF) = 72 * (25/9) = 8 * 25 = 200 square centimeters.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Yuzalar nisbati chiziqli nisbatning kvadrati: (25/15)^2 = (5/3)^2 = 25/9. 72 * 25/9 = 200 sm^2.

sample_test_questions.domain: Geometry and Trigonometry - Arc Length & Angles
sample_test_questions.question: In a circle with center O, the measure of central angle AOB is 72 degrees. If the area of sector AOB is 20*pi square centimeters, what is the circumference of circle O, in centimeters?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Sector area formula: Area = (theta / 360) * pi * r^2. Here, (72/360) * pi * r^2 = 20*pi => 1/5 * r^2 = 20 => r^2 = 100 => r = 10. The circumference is C = 2*pi*r = 2*pi*(10) = 20*pi centimeters.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Sektor yuzi: (72/360) * pi * r^2 = 20*pi => r^2 = 100 => r = 10. Aylana uzunligi C = 2*pi*r = 20*pi.

sample_test_questions.domain: Geometry and Trigonometry - Circle Equations & Radius
sample_test_questions.question: In the xy-plane, the line y = 8 is tangent to a circle at point (5, 8). If the circle also passes through the point (5, 0), what is the equation of the circle?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Since y = 8 is a horizontal tangent line at (5, 8), the radius at this point is vertical, so the x-coordinate of the center is 5. The circle passes through (5, 8) and (5, 0), so the diameter endpoints along x = 5 are (5, 8) and (5, 0). The diameter is 8 - 0 = 8, meaning radius r = 4 and center is at (5, 4). The equation is (x - 5)^2 + (y - 4)^2 = 16.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Diametr x=5 bo'ylab (5,8) dan (5,0) gacha => uzunligi 8 => radius r = 4, r^2 = 16, markaz (5, 4).

sample_test_questions.domain: Geometry and Trigonometry - Right Triangles & Trigonometric Ratios
sample_test_questions.question: In triangle PQR, side QR is extended past R to point S. If angle P = 58 degrees and angle Q = 64 degrees, what is the measure of the exterior angle PRS?
sample_test_questions.explanation: By the Exterior Angle Theorem, the measure of an exterior angle of a triangle equals the sum of the measures of the two non-adjacent interior angles: angle PRS = angle P + angle Q = 58 + 64 = 122 degrees.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Tashqi burchak xossasi: Tashqi burchak o'ziga qo'shni bo'lmagan ikki ichki burchak yig'indisiga teng: 58 + 64 = 122°.

sample_test_questions.domain: Geometry and Trigonometry - Area, Volume & Similarity
sample_test_questions.question: In the xy-plane, what is the distance between the points (-3, 2) and (5, -4)?
sample_test_questions.strategy: Pifagor uchligi: Delta_x = 8, Delta_y = 6 => 6-8-10 uchburchagi! Masofa 10.

sample_test_questions.domain: Geometry and Trigonometry - Right Triangles & Trigonometric Ratios
sample_test_questions.question: For acute angle theta, cos(theta) = 24/25. What is the value of tan(theta)?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Using the Pythagorean triple 7-24-25, if the adjacent side is 24 and the hypotenuse is 25, the opposite side is sqrt(25^2 - 24^2) = sqrt(625 - 576) = sqrt(49) = 7. Therefore, tan(theta) = opposite / adjacent = 7/24.
sample_test_questions.strategy: 7-24-25 Pifagor uchligi. cos = 24/25 bo'lsa, sin = 7/25. tan = sin/cos = (7/25)/(24/25) = 7/24.

sample_test_questions.question:
The system of equations below has infinitely many solutions:
4x - 6y = 18
6x - 9y = c
where c is a constant. What is the value of c?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Cheksiz ko'p yechimga ega bo'lishi uchun proporsiya teng bo'lishi shart: 4 / 6 = -6 / (-9) = 18 / c. 2 / 3 = 18 / c => 2c = 54 => c = 27. To'g'ri javob: B (27). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: A (18) — birinchi tenglamadagi ozod hadni o'zgarmas deb adashish tuzog'i; C (12) va D (36) — noto'g'ri ko'paytirishdagi xato variantlardir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ PROPORSIONALLIK: Ikkinchi tenglama birinchisidan 1.5 barobar katta (6/4 = 1.5). Demak, c = 18 * 1.5 = 27.

sample_test_questions.question:
In the xy-plane, point (x, y) is a solution to the system of inequalities below:
y <= -2x + 8
y >= 3x - 7
What is the maximum possible integer value of x?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Tengsizliklarni birlashtiramiz: 3x - 7 <= y <= -2x + 8. Bundan 3x - 7 <= -2x + 8 kelib chiqadi. O'xshash hadlarni jamlaymiz: 5x <= 15 => x <= 3. Demak, x ning qabul qilishi mumkin bo'lgan eng katta butun qiymati 3 ga teng. To'g'ri javob: B (3). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: A (2) — mumkin, lekin maksimal emas; C (4) va D (5) — tengsizlikni buzadigan noto'g'ri variantlar.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ DESMOS USULI: Desmosda ikkala tengsizlikni chizing. Ularning kesishish nuqtasi (3, 2). Eng katta x qiymati 3 ga teng!

sample_test_questions.question: The quadratic equation 3x^2 - kx + 12 = 0 has exactly one distinct real solution, where k is a positive constant. What is the value of k?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Kvadrat tenglama yagona haqiqiy yechimga ega bo'lishi uchun diskriminant nolga teng bo'lishi kerak: D = b^2 - 4ac = (-k)^2 - 4(3)(12) = k^2 - 144 = 0. k^2 = 144 => k = 12 (chunki k > 0). To'g'ri javob: B (12). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: A (6) — 144 ni adashib 24 ga bo'lish xatosi; C (144) — k^2 ning qiymatini k deb belgilash tuzog'i; D (24) — noto'g'ri ko'paytirishdagi xato variant.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ TEZKOR DISKRIMINANT: k = 2 * sqrt(a * c) = 2 * sqrt(3 * 12) = 2 * sqrt(36) = 2 * 6 = 12.

sample_test_questions.question:
How many distinct real solutions (x, y) does the system of equations below have?
x^2 + y^2 = 25
y = x^2 - 5
sample_test_questions.explanation: Ikkinchi tenglamadan x^2 = y + 5 ni olib, birinchi tenglamaga qo'yamiz: (y + 5) + y^2 = 25 => y^2 + y - 20 = 0. Ko'paytuvchilarga ajratamiz: (y + 5)(y - 4) = 0 => y = -5 yoki y = 4. 1) Agar y = -5 bo'lsa: x^2 = -5 + 5 = 0 => x = 0 (bitta yechim: (0, -5)). 2) Agar y = 4 bo'lsa: x^2 = 4 + 5 = 9 => x = 3 yoki x = -3 (ikkita yechim: (3, 4) va (-3, 4)). Jami haqiqiy yechimlar soni: 1 + 2 = 3 ta. To'g'ri javob: C (3). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: A (1) va B (2) — yechimlarning bir qismini hisobga olmaslik xatosi; D (4) — y = -5 da ikkita ildiz bor deb yanglishishdagi klassik tuzoq.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ DESMOS USULI: Desmosda x^2 + y^2 = 25 aylanasi va y = x^2 - 5 parabolasini chizing. Ular roppa-rosa 3 ta nuqtada kesishadi: (-3, 4), (0, -5), (3, 4).

sat_mocks.title: Digital SAT Mock #22: College Board Bank Adaptive Mock 2

sample_test_questions.passage: Neurobiologist Elena Rostova spent decades investigating synaptic ______ her pioneering work on hippocampal long-term potentiation fundamentally transformed contemporary models of memory formation.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Bu yerda ikkita to'liq mustaqil gap bor: 1) 'Neurobiologist Elena Rostova spent decades investigating synaptic plasticity' va 2) 'her pioneering work... fundamentally transformed contemporary models...'. Ikkita mustaqil gapni ajratish uchun nuqta-vergul (;) talab qilinadi. To'g'ri javob: A. Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (vergul) — comma splice xatosi; C — run-on xatosi; D ('and,') — vergul noo'rin qo'yilgan xato variant.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ COMMA SPLICE TESTI: Ikkita gap o'rtasiga nuqta qo'yib ko'ring: ikkisi ham mustaqil tura olsa, ularning orasiga faqat vergul qo'yish taqiqlanadi!

sample_test_questions.passage: Every autumn, millions of monarch butterflies embark on a 3,000-mile migration from eastern North America to central Mexico, where ______ congregate in the high-altitude fir forests of Michoacán.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Olmosh o'zi almashtirayotgan otga mos kelishi kerak (pronoun-antecedent agreement). Gapda gap 'millions of monarch butterflies' (ko'plik) haqida ketmoqda. Shuning uchun ko'plik olmoshi 'they' ishlatilishi shart. To'g'ri javob: A. Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B ('it'), C ('one'), D ('this') birlikdagi olmoshlar bo'lib, ko'plikdagi 'butterflies' ga mos kelmaydi.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ OLMOSH MOSLIGI: 'butterflies' (ko'plik) -> 'they'.

sample_test_questions.passage: For decades, materials scientists sought to replicate the remarkable tensile strength of natural spider silk using synthetic petrochemical polymers. ______, by utilizing genetically engineered silkworms expressing transgenic arachnid proteins, contemporary bioengineers finally produced fibers matching the elasticity of natural dragline silk.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Matnda olimlarning o'nlab yillar davomida harakat qilgani ('For decades... sought') va oxir-oqibat genetik muhandislik orqali yakuniy muvaffaqiyatga erishgani ('contemporary bioengineers finally produced...') bayon qilingan. Bu uzoq jarayonning yakuniy yechimini ko'rsatuvchi 'Ultimately' (oxir-oqibat, pirovardida) o'tish so'zini talab qiladi. To'g'ri javob: A. Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B ('For instance') — o'tgan harakatlarga misol emas, natija; C ('Similarly') — o'xshashlik emas; D ('In other words') — boshqacha qilib aytganda emas, yangi yakuniy natija.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ VAQT VA NATIJA: 'For decades... finally...' juftligi 'Ultimately' (oxir-oqibat) o'tishini bildiradi.

sample_test_questions.passage: Traditional silicon photovoltaic panels experience significant efficiency losses as ambient operating temperatures rise above 25°C. ______, newly formulated perovskite-silicon tandem cells demonstrate superior thermal stability, maintaining peak electrical conversion efficiency even in desert climates.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Birinchi gapda an'anaviy silikon panellarning issiqda samaradorlikni yo'qotishi ('efficiency losses'), ikkinchi gapda esa yangi tandem elementlarning issiqda ham yuqori barqarorlikni saqlab qolishi ('superior thermal stability') aytilgan. Bu ikki holat o'rtasida yaqqol qarama-qarshilik (contrast) mavjud. Shuning uchun 'In contrast' (A) eng mantiqiy bog'lovchidir. Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B ('Consequently' - natijada) — ikkinchisi birinchisining oqibati emas; C ('Furthermore' - bundan tashqari) — bir xil yo'nalishdagi fikrlar uchun; D ('Specifically') — umumiy fikrni aniqlashtirmayapti.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ KONTRAST QIDIRISH: Salbiy xususiyat (losses) vs Ijobiy xususiyat (superior stability) = 'In contrast'.

sample_test_questions.passage: Urban rooftop gardens insulate buildings against extreme winter cold and summer heat, dramatically reducing HVAC power consumption. ______, their vegetation absorbs stormwater runoff, preventing municipal sewer overflows during intense cloudbursts.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Birinchi gap tom bog'larining energiya tejashdagi birinchi foydasini ko'rsatadi. Ikkinchi gap esa yomg'ir suvlarini yutishdagi yana bir qo'shimcha foydasini keltiradi. Bu fikrni qo'shimcha boyitish (additive) munosabatidir. Shuning uchun 'Additionally' (Bundan tashqari) to'g'ri bog'lovchi. To'g'ri javob: A. Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B ('Nevertheless' - shunga qaramay), C ('Conversely' - aksincha) va D ('Instead' - o'rniga) barchasi qarama-qarshilik bog'lovchilari bo'lib, ikkita ijobiy foydani bog'lashda xatodir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ FOYDA + FOYDA = ADDITIVE: Foyda 1 + 'Additionally' + Foyda 2.

sample_test_questions.passage: Agricultural runoff introduces excess nitrogen and phosphorus into freshwater estuaries, fueling massive blooms of microscopic algae. As these algal mats die and decompose, microbial respiration depletes dissolved oxygen levels. ______, hypoxic 'dead zones' form where fish and shellfish cannot survive.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Matnda sabab-oqibat zanjiri keltirilgan: O'g'itlar suvga tushadi -> suvo'tlar ko'payadi -> parchalanishda kislorod tugaydi -> BARCHA SHU SABABLARNING OQIBATI O'LAROQ ('As a result') baliqlar yashay olmaydigan o'lik zonalar paydo bo'ladi. Sabab-oqibatni bog'lash uchun 'As a result' to'g'ri tanlov. To'g'ri javob: A. Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B ('In comparison') — taqqoslash yo'q; C ('Meanwhile') — parallel vaqt munosabati emas, to'g'ridan-to'g'ri oqibat; D ('Regardless') — qaramasdan emas.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ SABAB-OQIBAT ZANJIRI: Kislorod tugashi -> Baliqlar o'lishi = 'As a result' (Natijada).

sample_test_questions.passage: Medieval scribes produced parchment manuscripts through labor-intensive manual curing and stretching of animal hides, rendering books luxury commodities accessible solely to religious institutions and aristocrats. Johannes Gutenberg's fifteenth-century invention of movable type printing press completely revolutionized text production. ______, the technological transition did not occur instantaneously; scribe guilds fiercely opposed printing shops across central Europe for decades.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Gutenberg matbaa mashinasi kitob chop etishni inqilobiy o'zgartirgani aytildi. Lekin keyingi gap bu o'tish birdaniga silliq bo'lmaganini, xattotlar gildiyalari o'nlab yillar qarshilik ko'rsatganini aytib, kutilgan tezkor g'alabaga zid cheklov (concession / contrast) kiritmoqda. Shuning uchun 'However' (Biroq) eng to'g'ri bog'lovchi. To'g'ri javob: A. Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B ('Accordingly' - mos ravishda) — sabab-oqibat emas; C ('Furthermore') — davomiy qo'shimcha emas; D ('Likewise') — o'xshashlik emas.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ BURILISH NUQTASI: 'revolutionized... [However], the transition did not occur instantaneously'.

sample_test_questions.passage:
While researching aviation history, a student took the following notes:
- In 1932, Amelia Earhart became the first woman to complete a solo nonstop transatlantic flight.
- She flew a modified Lockheed Vega 5B from Harbour Grace, Newfoundland, to Londonderry, Northern Ireland.
- The flight took approximately 14 hours and 56 minutes under harsh icing and fatigue conditions.
- Her achievement challenged prevailing societal skepticism regarding women's endurance in long-distance aviation.
sample_test_questions.question: The student wants to emphasize the historical significance of Earhart's transatlantic flight. Which choice best accomplishes this goal?

options.text: By completing her grueling 1932 solo flight across the Atlantic, Amelia Earhart shattered contemporary skepticism about women's capability in long-distance aviation.
Amelia Earhart's 1932 flight in a modified Lockheed Vega 5B departed from Harbour Grace and ended in Northern Ireland.
The flight across the Atlantic took Earhart exactly 14 hours and 56 minutes despite difficult weather conditions.
In 1932, a modified Lockheed Vega 5B was used by Amelia Earhart for long-distance flight testing.

sample_test_questions.explanation: Talabaning aniq maqsadi: 'emphasize the historical significance' (tarixiy ahamiyatini ta'kidlash). A variantda Earhartning parvozi o'sha davrdagi jamiyatning ayollarning uzoq masofaga ucha olishiga bo'lgan shubhalarini sindirgani ('shattered contemporary skepticism') aniq ta'kidlangan, bu uning asosiy tarixiy ahamiyatidir. Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B — faqat marshrutni aytadi; C — faqat vaqtni aytadi; D — kema modelini aytadi; ularning hech biri tarixiy ahamiyatni ochib bermaydi.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ MAQSADNI O'QISH: 'emphasize the historical significance' -> Javobda jamiyatga ta'siri (shattered skepticism) bo'lishi shart!

sample_test_questions.passage:
While researching architecture, a student took the following notes:
- The High Line in New York City is a 1.45-mile elevated public park built on a disused historic freight rail line.
- It opened in stages between 2009 and 2014, designed by landscape architecture firm James Corner Field Operations.
- The park features native perennial plantings, open lawns, and pedestrian walkways elevated 30 feet above street traffic.
- Since its opening, the High Line has spurred over $2 billion in surrounding real estate development and attracts millions of visitors annually.
sample_test_questions.question: The student wants to highlight the economic and urban revival impact of the High Line project. Which choice best accomplishes this goal?

options.text: Beyond transforming an abandoned industrial rail line into an elevated public park, the High Line has catalyzed over $2 billion in surrounding development and drawn millions of visitors.
Designed by James Corner Field Operations, the High Line park opened in stages between 2009 and 2014.
The High Line is an elevated public park in New York City featuring native perennial plantings and open lawns 30 feet above the street.
Historic freight rail lines in New York City were originally constructed 30 feet above street traffic.

sample_test_questions.explanation: Talabaning maqsadi: 'highlight the economic and urban revival impact' (iqtisodiy va shahar jonlanishi ta'sirini ko'rsatish). A variant 2 milliard dollarlik rivojlanish va millionlab sayyohlar jalb qilinganini hamda tashlandiq hudud shahar parkiga aylanganini aniq ko'rsatadi. Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B — faqat arxitektura firmasi va sanani aytadi; C — faqat o'simlik turlarini aytadi; D — tarixiy temir yo'l balandligini aytadi; ularda iqtisodiy ta'sir yo'q.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ KALIT SO'ZLAR: 'economic impact' -> $2 billion in surrounding development!

sample_test_questions.passage:
While researching marine biology, a student took the following notes:
- The Greenland shark (Somniosus microcephalus) inhabits cold, deep waters of the Arctic and North Atlantic.
- In 2016, marine biologists used radiocarbon dating of eye lens crystalline proteins to estimate their lifespans.
- The study determined that Greenland sharks can live for at least 272 years, with some specimens possibly exceeding 400 years.
- They are currently recognized as the longest-lived vertebrate species on Earth.
sample_test_questions.question: The student wants to introduce the Greenland shark's exceptional longevity to a new audience. Which choice best accomplishes this goal?

options.text: Inhabiting Arctic waters, the Greenland shark holds the distinction of being the longest-lived vertebrate on Earth, with lifespans documented to reach at least 272 years.
Marine biologists in 2016 utilized radiocarbon dating on eye lens crystalline proteins during an Arctic expedition.
The Greenland shark, or Somniosus microcephalus, is a marine animal that resides in deep, cold northern oceans.
Radiocarbon dating is an effective technique commonly employed to measure organic specimens in marine research.

sample_test_questions.explanation: Maqsad: 'introduce the Greenland shark's exceptional longevity to a new audience' (Grenlandiya akulasining favqulodda uzoq umr ko'rishini yangi auditoriyaga tanishtirish). A variant akulaning kimligini tanishtiradi va uning 272 yildan ortiq yashaydigan yer yuzidagi eng uzoq umr ko'ruvchi umurtqali hayvon ekanini aniq bayon qiladi. Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B — faqat 2016 yilgi usulni aytadi; C — uzoq umr ko'rishini aytmaydi; D — faqat radiouglerod usulini umumiy ta'riflaydi.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ AUDITORIYAGA TANISHTIRISH: Jonivorning nomi + uning favqulodda rekordi (exceptional longevity: 272+ years) = Variant A.

sample_test_questions.question: Do'kondagi noutbukning narxi dastlab $800 edi. Do'kon egasi narxni 25% ga oshirdi. Bir oydan so'ng ushbu yangi narxga 20% chegirma e'lon qilindi. Noutbukning yakuniy narxi necha dollar bo'ldi?
sample_test_questions.explanation:
1) 25% ga oshirish: 800 * 1.25 = $1000.
2) 20% chegirma: 1000 * (1 - 0.20) = 1000 * 0.80 = $800.
Yakuniy narx dastlabki narx bilan teng chiqdi ($800). Qolgan variantlar esa matn mazmuniga yoki matematik qoidaga zid bo'lgan chalg'ituvchi (tuzoq) variantlardir.
sample_test_questions.strategy:
⚡ MATEMATIK FORMULA:
800 * 1.25 * 0.80 = 800 * 1.00 = 800.
Desmos kalkulyatoriga bitta qatorda '800 * 1.25 * 0.80' deb yozsangiz 1 soniyada 800 chiqadi!

sample_test_questions.question: Avtomobil o'zgarmas 90 km/soat tezlikda harakatlanmoqda. Ushbu avtomobil 1 soniyada necha metr masofani bosib o'tadi?
sample_test_questions.explanation:
Km/soat dan m/s ga o'tish uchun tezlikni 3.6 ga bo'lish kerak:
90 / 3.6 = 25 m/s.
Yoki: 90 km = 90,000 metr. 1 soat = 3600 soniya. 90,000 / 3600 = 25 metr. Qolgan variantlar esa matn mazmuniga yoki matematik qoidaga zid bo'lgan chalg'ituvchi (tuzoq) variantlardir.
sample_test_questions.strategy:
⚡ SAT METRIC QOIDASI:
Har doim km/h dan m/s ga o'tishda qiymatni 3.6 ga bo'ling. 90 / 3.6 = 25!

sample_test_questions.question: In a right triangle, for an acute angle x degrees, sin(x) = 0.6. What is the value of cos(90 - x)?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Qo'shimcha burchaklar trigonometrik ayniyati (cofunction identity): sin(x) = cos(90 - x) doimo tengdir. Shartda sin(x) = 0.6 berilgan, demak cos(90 - x) ham aynan 0.6 bo'ladi. To'g'ri javob: A (0.6). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (0.8) — cos(x) ni topib belgilash tuzog'i; C (0.75) — tangensni hisoblash xatosi; D (1.0) — birlik aylanadagi adashish natijasidagi xato variant.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ SAT TRİGONOMETRİYA: sin(x) = cos(90 - x) va cos(x) = sin(90 - x). Qiymat o'zgarmaydi!

sample_test_questions.question: Aylananing radiusi 12 ga teng. Aylanadagi markaziy burchak 60° ga teng bo'lgan yoyning uzunligi nechaga teng?
sample_test_questions.explanation:
Aylananing to'liq uzunligi C = 2πR = 2π(12) = 24π.
60° li burchak to'liq aylananing 60/360 = 1/6 qismini tashkil qiladi.
Demak yoy uzunligi: 24π * (1/6) = 4π. Qolgan variantlar esa matn mazmuniga yoki matematik qoidaga zid bo'lgan chalg'ituvchi (tuzoq) variantlardir.
sample_test_questions.strategy:
⚡ DESMOS HACK:
Desmosga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri yozing: 2 * pi * 12 * (60 / 360). Desmos darhol 12.566 chiqazadi. 4 * pi ham 12.566 ga teng! Javob: B.

sample_test_questions.question:
For what value of k does the system of equations below have no solution?

3x + 5y = 15
kx + 10y = 20
sample_test_questions.explanation: To'g'ri javob C (k = 6). Sistema yechimga ega bo'lmasligi uchun ikki tenglama parallel bo'lishi kerak - ya'ni koeffitsientlarning nisbati bir xil, lekin ozod hadlarning nisbati boshqacha bo'lishi kerak. Birinchi tenglamani 2 ga ko'paytirsak: 6x + 10y = 30. Endi ikkinchi tenglama bilan taqqoslasak: kx + 10y = 20. Y koeffitsientlari allaqachon bir xil (10 = 10). X koeffitsientlari ham bir xil bo'lishi uchun k = 6 bo'lishi kerak. Lekin ozod hadlar har xil (30 ≠ 20). Bu parallel chiziqlarni beradi, demak yechim yo'q. Tekshirish: agar k = 6 bo'lsa, 6x + 10y = 20 va 6x + 10y = 30 (birinchisini 2 ga ko'paytirgandan keyin) - bu parallel chiziqlar. Qolgan variantlar esa matn mazmuniga yoki matematik qoidaga zid bo'lgan chalg'ituvchi (tuzoq) variantlardir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: DESMOS 5-sekund hack: 1) Desmos grafigiga ikkala tenglamani kiriting: y = (-3/5)x + 3 va y = (-k/10)x + 2. 2) k qiymatini slider qilib qo'ying. 3) k ning qiymatini o'zgartirib, chiziqlar parallel bo'lgan (kesishmagan) joyni toping. Yoki algebrik usul: parallel bo'lish uchun slope (qiyalik) bir xil bo'lishi kerak: -3/5 = -k/10, bundan k = 6. Ozod hadlar har xil ekanligini tekshiring (3 ≠ 2) - bu sistemaning yechimsiz ekanligini tasdiqlaydi.

sample_test_questions.question: A local bakery sells croissants for $3 each and muffins for $2 each. The bakery needs to make at least $120 in sales today. If x represents the number of croissants sold and y represents the number of muffins sold, which inequality represents this situation?
sample_test_questions.explanation: To'g'ri javob A. Har bir kruvasan $3, shuning uchun x ta kruvasan 3x dollar. Har bir muffin $2, shuning uchun y ta muffin 2y dollar. Umumiy daromad 3x + 2y. Savoldagi "at least $120" (kamida $120) iborasi "≥ 120" (katta yoki teng) degan ma'noni anglatadi. B variant noto'g'ri, chunki ≤ "ko'pi bilan" degan ma'noni anglatadi, "kamida" emas. C variant noto'g'ri, chunki > "qat'iy katta" degan ma'noni anglatadi, lekin "at least" teng bo'lishi ham mumkinligini nazarda tutadi. D variant noto'g'ri, chunki koeffitsientlar almashtirilgan (kruvasan narxi 3, muffin narxi 2).
sample_test_questions.strategy: DESMOS hack: 1) Desmos grafigiga tengsizlikni kiriting: 3x + 2y ≥ 120. 2) Shaded region (bo'yalgan hudud) ko'rinadi - bu yechimlar to'plami. 3) Bir nechta nuqtalarni sinab ko'ring (masalan, (40, 0) kruvasan va 0 muffin = $120, bu ishlaydimi?) 4) Nuqta shaded regionda bo'lsa, tengsizlik to'g'ri. Yoki "at least", "minimum", "no less than" = ≥ (katta yoki teng). "At most", "maximum", "no more than" = ≤ (kichik yoki teng).

sample_test_questions.question: The function f(x) = -2x² + 8x + c has a maximum value of 15. What is the value of c?
sample_test_questions.explanation: To'g'ri javob B (c = 7). Parabola maksimum qiymatiga vertex (cho'qqi nuqta) da erishadi. Vertex x koordinatasi: x = -b/(2a) = -8/(2(-2)) = -8/(-4) = 2. Vertex y koordinatasi (maksimum qiymat): f(2) = -2(2)² + 8(2) + c = -2(4) + 16 + c = -8 + 16 + c = 8 + c. Savol shartiga ko'ra maksimum qiymat 15 ga teng: 8 + c = 15, demak c = 7. Tekshirish: f(x) = -2x² + 8x + 7, f(2) = -8 + 16 + 7 = 15 ✓ Qolgan variantlar esa matn mazmuniga yoki matematik qoidaga zid bo'lgan chalg'ituvchi (tuzoq) variantlardir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: DESMOS 3-sekund hack: 1) Desmos grafigiga funktsiyani kiriting: f(x) = -2x² + 8x + c. 2) c ni slider qilib qo'ying. 3) c ni o'zgartirib, vertex ning y koordinatasi 15 bo'lgan joyni toping. Vertex koordinatalari avtomatik ko'rinadi. Yoki formula: Quadratic f(x) = ax² + bx + c uchun vertex x = -b/(2a), keyin shu x ni tenglamaga qo'yib, maksimum qiymatni toping va c ni yeching.

sample_test_questions.question: If x² + y² = 25 and y = x + 1, what is the sum of all possible values of x?
sample_test_questions.explanation: To'g'ri javob A (-1). Ikkinchi tenglamadan y ni topamiz: y = x + 1. Buni birinchi tenglamaga qo'yamiz: x² + (x + 1)² = 25. Ochib yozamiz: x² + x² + 2x + 1 = 25. Soddalashtiramiz: 2x² + 2x + 1 = 25. Barcha hadlarni chap tomonga o'tkazamiz: 2x² + 2x - 24 = 0. 2 ga bo'lamiz: x² + x - 12 = 0. Faktorizatsiya qilamiz: (x + 4)(x - 3) = 0. Yechimlar: x = -4 yoki x = 3. Barcha mumkin bo'lgan x qiymatlari yig'indisi: -4 + 3 = -1. Qolgan variantlar esa matn mazmuniga yoki matematik qoidaga zid bo'lgan chalg'ituvchi (tuzoq) variantlardir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: DESMOS 5-sekund hack: 1) Desmos grafigiga ikkala tenglamani kiriting: x² + y² = 25 (doira) va y = x + 1 (to'g'ri chiziq). 2) Kesishish nuqtalarini ko'ring. 3) Har bir kesishish nuqtasining x koordinatasini yozing va ularni qo'shing. Desmos kesishish nuqtalari koordinatalarini avtomatik ko'rsatadi. Algebraik usul: almashtirish (substitution) usuli - bir tenglamadan y ni topib, ikkinchisiga qo'ying.

sample_test_questions.question: A bacteria culture doubles in size every 3 hours. If the culture initially contains 500 bacteria, which function models the number of bacteria, B(t), after t hours?
sample_test_questions.explanation: To'g'ri javob A. Eksponensial o'sish formulasi: B(t) = B₀ · r^(t/d), bu yerda B₀ = boshlang'ich qiymat (500), r = o'sish koeffitsienti (2, chunki ikki barobar ko'payadi), d = davr (3 soat). Demak, B(t) = 500 · 2^(t/3). Tekshirish: t = 0 da B(0) = 500 · 2^0 = 500 ✓ (boshlang'ich holat). t = 3 da B(3) = 500 · 2^(3/3) = 500 · 2^1 = 1000 ✓ (3 soatdan keyin ikki barobar). t = 6 da B(6) = 500 · 2^(6/3) = 500 · 2^2 = 2000 ✓ (6 soatdan keyin to'rt barobar). B variant noto'g'ri, chunki daraja t/3 emas, 3t - bu juda tez o'sishni beradi. C va D variantlar noto'g'ri asos (base) ishlatadi.
sample_test_questions.strategy: DESMOS hack: 1) Har bir variantni Desmos grafigiga kiriting. 2) Bir nechta nuqtalarni tekshiring: (0, 500), (3, 1000), (6, 2000). 3) Qaysi grafik bu nuqtalardan o'tsa, o'sha javob to'g'ri. Yoki formula eslab qoling: Eksponensial o'sish/kamayish = Boshlang'ich qiymat · (o'sish/kamayish koeffitsienti)^(vaqt/davr). "Doubles every 3 hours" = koeffitsient 2, davr 3.

sample_test_questions.question: A laptop originally priced at $800 is on sale for 25% off. An additional 10% discount is applied to the sale price. What is the final price of the laptop?
sample_test_questions.explanation: To'g'ri javob B ($540). Birinchi chegirma: 25% off = 75% qoladi. $800 × 0.75 = $600 (sotuvdagi narx). Ikkinchi chegirma sotuvdagi narxdan: 10% off = 90% qoladi. $600 × 0.90 = $540 (yakuniy narx). Ko'p talabalar xato qilib, ikkala chegirmani qo'shib yuboradilar (25% + 10% = 35% off, $800 × 0.65 = $520), lekin ikkinchi chegirma yangi narxdan olinadi, asl narxdan emas. To'g'ri usul: har bir chegirmani ketma-ket qo'llash.
sample_test_questions.strategy: DESMOS hack: Desmos kalkulyatorida: 800 × 0.75 × 0.90 ni hisoblang = 540. Yoki percent qisqartma: "25% off" = "× 0.75" (100% - 25% = 75% qoladi). "10% off" = "× 0.90" (100% - 10% = 90% qoladi). Ketma-ket chegirmalar: har bir chegirmani alohida qo'llang, qo'shmang.

sat_mocks.title: Digital SAT Mock #23: College Board Bank Adaptive Mock 3

sample_test_questions.passage:
While researching aviation history, a student took the following notes:
- In 1932, Amelia Earhart became the first woman to complete a solo nonstop transatlantic flight.
- She flew a modified Lockheed Vega 5B from Harbour Grace, Newfoundland, to Londonderry, Northern Ireland.
- The flight took approximately 14 hours and 56 minutes under harsh icing and fatigue conditions.
- Her achievement challenged prevailing societal skepticism regarding women's endurance in long-distance aviation.
sample_test_questions.question: The student wants to emphasize the historical significance of Earhart's transatlantic flight. Which choice best accomplishes this goal?

options.text: By completing her grueling 1932 solo flight across the Atlantic, Amelia Earhart shattered contemporary skepticism about women's capability in long-distance aviation.
Amelia Earhart's 1932 flight in a modified Lockheed Vega 5B departed from Harbour Grace and ended in Northern Ireland.
The flight across the Atlantic took Earhart exactly 14 hours and 56 minutes despite difficult weather conditions.
In 1932, a modified Lockheed Vega 5B was used by Amelia Earhart for long-distance flight testing.

sample_test_questions.explanation: Talabaning aniq maqsadi: 'emphasize the historical significance' (tarixiy ahamiyatini ta'kidlash). A variantda Earhartning parvozi o'sha davrdagi jamiyatning ayollarning uzoq masofaga ucha olishiga bo'lgan shubhalarini sindirgani ('shattered contemporary skepticism') aniq ta'kidlangan, bu uning asosiy tarixiy ahamiyatidir. Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B — faqat marshrutni aytadi; C — faqat vaqtni aytadi; D — kema modelini aytadi; ularning hech biri tarixiy ahamiyatni ochib bermaydi.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ MAQSADNI O'QISH: 'emphasize the historical significance' -> Javobda jamiyatga ta'siri (shattered skepticism) bo'lishi shart!

sample_test_questions.passage:
While researching architecture, a student took the following notes:
- The High Line in New York City is a 1.45-mile elevated public park built on a disused historic freight rail line.
- It opened in stages between 2009 and 2014, designed by landscape architecture firm James Corner Field Operations.
- The park features native perennial plantings, open lawns, and pedestrian walkways elevated 30 feet above street traffic.
- Since its opening, the High Line has spurred over $2 billion in surrounding real estate development and attracts millions of visitors annually.
sample_test_questions.question: The student wants to highlight the economic and urban revival impact of the High Line project. Which choice best accomplishes this goal?

options.text: Beyond transforming an abandoned industrial rail line into an elevated public park, the High Line has catalyzed over $2 billion in surrounding development and drawn millions of visitors.
Designed by James Corner Field Operations, the High Line park opened in stages between 2009 and 2014.
The High Line is an elevated public park in New York City featuring native perennial plantings and open lawns 30 feet above the street.
Historic freight rail lines in New York City were originally constructed 30 feet above street traffic.

sample_test_questions.explanation: Talabaning maqsadi: 'highlight the economic and urban revival impact' (iqtisodiy va shahar jonlanishi ta'sirini ko'rsatish). A variant 2 milliard dollarlik rivojlanish va millionlab sayyohlar jalb qilinganini hamda tashlandiq hudud shahar parkiga aylanganini aniq ko'rsatadi. Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B — faqat arxitektura firmasi va sanani aytadi; C — faqat o'simlik turlarini aytadi; D — tarixiy temir yo'l balandligini aytadi; ularda iqtisodiy ta'sir yo'q.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ KALIT SO'ZLAR: 'economic impact' -> $2 billion in surrounding development!

sample_test_questions.passage:
While researching marine biology, a student took the following notes:
- The Greenland shark (Somniosus microcephalus) inhabits cold, deep waters of the Arctic and North Atlantic.
- In 2016, marine biologists used radiocarbon dating of eye lens crystalline proteins to estimate their lifespans.
- The study determined that Greenland sharks can live for at least 272 years, with some specimens possibly exceeding 400 years.
- They are currently recognized as the longest-lived vertebrate species on Earth.
sample_test_questions.question: The student wants to introduce the Greenland shark's exceptional longevity to a new audience. Which choice best accomplishes this goal?

options.text: Inhabiting Arctic waters, the Greenland shark holds the distinction of being the longest-lived vertebrate on Earth, with lifespans documented to reach at least 272 years.
Marine biologists in 2016 utilized radiocarbon dating on eye lens crystalline proteins during an Arctic expedition.
The Greenland shark, or Somniosus microcephalus, is a marine animal that resides in deep, cold northern oceans.
Radiocarbon dating is an effective technique commonly employed to measure organic specimens in marine research.

sample_test_questions.explanation: Maqsad: 'introduce the Greenland shark's exceptional longevity to a new audience' (Grenlandiya akulasining favqulodda uzoq umr ko'rishini yangi auditoriyaga tanishtirish). A variant akulaning kimligini tanishtiradi va uning 272 yildan ortiq yashaydigan yer yuzidagi eng uzoq umr ko'ruvchi umurtqali hayvon ekanini aniq bayon qiladi. Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B — faqat 2016 yilgi usulni aytadi; C — uzoq umr ko'rishini aytmaydi; D — faqat radiouglerod usulini umumiy ta'riflaydi.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ AUDITORIYAGA TANISHTIRISH: Jonivorning nomi + uning favqulodda rekordi (exceptional longevity: 272+ years) = Variant A.

sample_test_questions.passage:
While researching renewable energy materials, a student took the following notes:
- Solar cell efficiency depends significantly on bandgap energy, measured in electron-volts (eV).
- Silicon has a bandgap of 1.1 eV, capturing infrared and visible light but losing high-energy photons to heat.
- Perovskite semiconductors can be engineered with adjustable bandgaps ranging from 1.2 to 2.3 eV.
- By stacking a wide-bandgap perovskite layer on top of silicon, tandem cells harvest both high-energy and low-energy photons efficiently.
sample_test_questions.question: The student wants to explain the mechanical advantage of tandem solar cells over single-layer silicon cells. Which choice best accomplishes this goal?

options.text: By pairing an adjustable wide-bandgap perovskite top layer with an underlying silicon base, tandem cells absorb both high-energy and low-energy photons, overcoming the thermal energy losses of conventional silicon.
Bandgap energy is measured in electron-volts and determines which wavelengths of light a semiconductor material can absorb.
Silicon semiconductors have a fixed bandgap of 1.1 eV, making them the standard material in photovoltaic manufacturing for decades.
Perovskite semiconductors feature bandgaps that can be adjusted anywhere between 1.2 and 2.3 eV in laboratory conditions.

sample_test_questions.explanation: Talabaning maqsadi: 'explain the mechanical advantage of tandem solar cells over single-layer silicon cells' (tandem hujayralarning bir qatlamli kremniyga nisbatan ustunligini tushuntirish). A variant tandem tizimi keng va tor oraliqlarni birlashtirib, yuqori va past energiyali fotonlarni birday yutishini va an'anaviy silikonning issiqlik yo'qotishini yengib o'tishini mukammal tushuntiradi. Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B — faqat bandgap ta'rifini beradi; C — faqat silikon haqida; D — faqat perovskit haqida; solishtirma ustunlik faqat A da bor.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ SOLISHTIRMA USTUNLIK: Tandem + Silikon bilan qiyos + yechilgan muammo = Variant A.

sample_test_questions.passage: Early twentieth-century astronomers assumed that spiral nebulae were isolated clouds of interstellar gas and dust located within the perimeter of the Milky Way galaxy. In 1923, Edwin Hubble identified Cepheid variable stars within the Andromeda nebula and calculated its distance as nearly one million light-years away. ______, Hubble proved conclusively that spiral nebulae were entirely separate galaxies existing far beyond our own.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Hubble Andromeda tumanligidagi Sefeida yulduzlarini topdi va uning masofasi million yorug'lik yili ekanini hisobladi. Natijada / Buning oqibatida ('Consequently') Hubble bu tumanliklar Somon Yo'lidan ancha olisdagi butunlay mustaqil galaktikalar ekanini uzil-kesil isbotladi. Masofaning uzoqligi mustaqil galaktika degan xulosaga olib keladi (sabab-oqibat). To'g'ri javob: A. Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B ('Previously' - avval) — o'tmishga qaytish yo'q, xulosa chiqarilyapti; C ('Nevertheless' - shunga qaramay) — qarama-qarshilik yo'q; D ('For example') — misol keltirilmayapti, buyuk kashfiyot xulosalanyapti.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ SABAB VA XULOSA: Hisoblangan masofa 1 million yorug'lik yili -> 'Consequently' (Natijada) mustaqil galaktikalar ekani isbotlandi.

sample_test_questions.passage: For decades, the standard narrative in paleoclimatology held that the Younger Dryas cooling event was triggered exclusively by a catastrophic glacial meltwater outburst. Recent sediment cores, however, reveal a far more ______ picture, suggesting that atmospheric circulation shifts and volcanic aerosols played equally decisive roles.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
sample_test_questions.explanation:
To'g'ri javob: A (nuanced).

Matn tahlili:
Matnda avval Younger Dryas sovuqlashuv davri faqat bitta sabab ('exclusively by a catastrophic meltwater outburst') bilan izohlangani, biroq yangi cho'kindi jinslar qatlamlari ('Recent sediment cores, however...') ko'plab omillar (atmosfera oqimlari, vulqon aerozollari) teng rol o'ynaganini ko'rsatayotgani aytilmoqda. Demak, yangi manzara bir yoqlama emas, balki murakkabroq, ko'p qirrali ('nuanced') hisoblanadi.

Variantlar tahlili:
A) nuanced - nozik qirralari ko'p, murakkab va batafsil (to'g'ri).
B) redundant - ortiqcha, keraksiz takrorlanuvchi (kontekstga mos emas).
C) precarious - xavfli, beqaror (manzaraning beqarorligi haqida gap ketmayapti).
D) prosaic - oddiy, jo'n, zerikarli (ko'p omilli murakkab rasm jo'n bo'la olmaydi).
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ READING STRATEGIYASI: Bo'sh joy atrofidagi qarama-qarshilik (contrast) yoki qo'shimcha belgilarni toping va matndan kelib chiqing.

sample_test_questions.passage: While the novelist's earlier works were celebrated for their sprawling plots and effusive prose, her latest novella is remarkably ______; every sentence is stripped of ornamentation, delivering emotional impact through stark austerity.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
sample_test_questions.explanation:
To'g'ri javob: A (laconic).

Matn tahlili:
Muallifning oldingi asarlari so'zamol, keng qamrovli ('sprawling plots and effusive prose') bo'lgan bo'lsa, 'while' qarshilantiruvchi bog'lovchisi orqali yangi qissasi buning aksi ekani aytilmoqda: har bir jumla bezaklardan xoli ('stripped of ornamentation') va qat'iy vazminlik ('stark austerity') orqali ta'sir ko'rsatadi. Bu ixcham, kamso'z va lo'nda ma'nosidagi 'laconic' so'ziga to'liq mos keladi.

Variantlar tahlili:
A) laconic - lo'nda, qisqa va mazmunli (to'g'ri).
B) derivative - birovdan ko'chirilgan, o'ziga xos bo'lmagan.
C) ostentatious - ko'z-ko'z qiluvchi, dabdabali (effusive bilan sinonim bo'lib, ziddiyat hosil qilmaydi).
D) erratic - tartibsiz, oldindan aytib bo'lmaydigan.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ READING STRATEGIYASI: Bo'sh joy atrofidagi qarama-qarshilik (contrast) yoki qo'shimcha belgilarni toping va matndan kelib chiqing.

sample_test_questions.passage: Biomimetic engineers frequently look to marine organisms for inspiration; the hydrodynamic efficiency of the boxfish, for instance, has ______ automotive designers seeking to reduce aerodynamic drag in fuel-efficient vehicles.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
sample_test_questions.explanation:
To'g'ri javob: A (guided).

Matn tahlili:
Muhandislar dengiz jonzotlaridan ilhom oladi ('look to marine organisms for inspiration'). Masalan, qutichali baliqning gidrodinamik samaradorligi avtomobil konstruktorlariga aerodinamik qarshilikni kamaytirishda yo'l ko'rsatgan / turtki bergan ('guided').

Variantlar tahlili:
A) guided - yo'naltirgan, ilhom bergan (to'g'ri).
B) deterred - to'sqinlik qilgan, qaytargan (qarama-qarshi ma'no).
C) obscured - qorong'ilashtirgan, yashirgan.
D) reproached - ayblagan, tanbeh bergan.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ READING STRATEGIYASI: Bo'sh joy atrofidagi qarama-qarshilik (contrast) yoki qo'shimcha belgilarni toping va matndan kelib chiqing.
