sample_test_questions.passage: The anthropologist cautioned that attempting to reconstruct ancient kinship networks exclusively from mortuary arrangements is fundamentally ______; funerary rituals often express idealized aspirations rather than mirror mundane social realities.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
sample_test_questions.explanation:
To'g'ri javob: A (tenuous).

Matn tahlili:
Antropolog qabrlarni dafn etish odatlaridan qadimiy qarindoshlik tizimini tiklash xatarli/mo'rt ekanidan ogohlantirmoqda, chunki dafn marosimlari kundalik ijtimoiy haqiqatni emas, balki ideallashtirilgan niyatlarni ifodalaydi. Shuning uchun bunday xulosalar zaif, asossiz yoki omonat ('tenuous') bo'ladi.

Variantlar tahlili:
A) tenuous - zaif, mo'rt, yetarlicha asoslanmagan (to'g'ri).
B) imperious - buyruqboz, takabbur.
C) unimpeachable - shubhasiz, mukammal (kontekstga teskari).
D) salutary - foydali, shifobaxsh.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ READING STRATEGIYASI: Bo'sh joy atrofidagi qarama-qarshilik (contrast) yoki qo'shimcha belgilarni toping va matndan kelib chiqing.

sample_test_questions.passage: Rather than clinging rigidly to outdated behavioral models, contemporary evolutionary psychologists acknowledge that cognitive adaptations are highly ______: their developmental expression can shift dynamically depending on socioecological cues.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
sample_test_questions.explanation:
To'g'ri javob: A (plastic).

Matn tahlili:
Qattiq qolipga yopishmasdan ('Rather than clinging rigidly...'), zamonaviy tadqiqotchilar kognitiv moslashuvlarning o'zgaruvchan, moslashuvchan ekanini ('shift dynamically depending on socioecological cues') tan olishadi. Biologiya va psixologiyada muhitga qarab moslashuvchanlik xususiyati 'plastic' (plastiklik, egiluvchanlik) atamasi bilan ifodalanadi.

Variantlar tahlili:
A) plastic - moslashuvchan, o'zgaruvchan (to'g'ri).
B) intractable - bo'ysunmas, qaysar, o'zgarmas.
C) obsolete - eskirgan, o'z kuchini yo'qotgan.
D) dogmatic - qotib qolgan aqidaparast.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ READING STRATEGIYASI: Bo'sh joy atrofidagi qarama-qarshilik (contrast) yoki qo'shimcha belgilarni toping va matndan kelib chiqing.

sample_test_questions.question: A circle in the xy-plane has center (3, -2) and radius 5. Which equation represents this circle?
sample_test_questions.explanation: To'g'ri javob C. Aylana tenglamasi: (x - h)² + (y - k)² = r², bu yerda (h, k) markaz koordinatalari va r radius. Markaz (3, -2), demak h = 3, k = -2. Radius 5, demak r² = 25. Tenglama: (x - 3)² + (y - (-2))² = 25, ya'ni (x - 3)² + (y + 2)² = 25. Eslatma: (y + 2) ni ko'ring - bu (y - (-2)) dan keladi. A variant noto'g'ri, chunki o'ng tomon 5, lekin r² = 25 bo'lishi kerak. B variant noto'g'ri, chunki belgilar noto'g'ri: (x + 3) o'rniga (x - 3) va (y - 2) o'rniga (y + 2) bo'lishi kerak. D variant noto'g'ri, chunki belgilar ham, r² ham noto'g'ri.
sample_test_questions.strategy: DESMOS 3-sekund hack: 1) Har bir variantni Desmos grafigiga kiriting. 2) Markaz (3, -2) ga diqqat qiling va radius 5 ni tekshiring. Yoki formula: (x - h)² + (y - k)² = r². Belgilar muhim: agar markaz x = 3 bo'lsa, (x - 3) bo'ladi. Agar markaz y = -2 bo'lsa, (y - (-2)) = (y + 2) bo'ladi. O'ng tomon har doim radius kvadrati (r²), radius o'zi emas.

sample_test_questions.question: In a right triangle, the length of the side opposite to angle θ is 7, and the length of the hypotenuse is 25. What is the value of sin(θ)?
sample_test_questions.explanation: To'g'ri javob B (7/25). Sinus formulasi: sin(θ) = qarama-qarshi tomon / gipotenuza. Bu yerda qarama-qarshi tomon = 7, gipotenuza = 25. Demak, sin(θ) = 7/25. A variant noto'g'ri, chunki 24 qo'shni tomon (adjacent side) bo'lishi mumkin (Pifagor teoremasi: 7² + 24² = 49 + 576 = 625 = 25²), lekin sinus uchun gipotenuza kerak, qo'shni tomon emas. C variant cos(θ) ni beradi (qo'shni tomon / gipotenuza = 24/25), sin(θ) ni emas. D variant nisbat teskari yo'nalishda.
sample_test_questions.strategy: DESMOS hack: Agar burchak qiymati berilgan bo'lsa, sin(θ) ni Desmos kalkulyatorida hisoblash mumkin. Lekin bu yerda burchak o'rniga tomonlar berilgan, shuning uchun formula kerak. SOH-CAH-TOA ni eslab qoling: SOH = Sin = Opposite/Hypotenuse (qarama-qarshi/gipotenuza), CAH = Cos = Adjacent/Hypotenuse (qo'shni/gipotenuza), TOA = Tan = Opposite/Adjacent (qarama-qarshi/qo'shni). Sin uchun har doim gipotenuza maxrajda.

sample_test_questions.question: Which of the following is equivalent to (2x + 3)² - (2x - 3)²?
sample_test_questions.explanation: To'g'ri javob B (24x). Bu yerda "difference of squares" (kvadratlar ayirmasi) formulasidan foydalanish mumkin: a² - b² = (a + b)(a - b). a = 2x + 3, b = 2x - 3 bo'lsa: (2x + 3)² - (2x - 3)² = [(2x + 3) + (2x - 3)][(2x + 3) - (2x - 3)] = [2x + 3 + 2x - 3][2x + 3 - 2x + 3] = [4x][6] = 24x. Yoki to'liq ochib yozish mumkin: (2x + 3)² = 4x² + 12x + 9, (2x - 3)² = 4x² - 12x + 9. Ayirma: (4x² + 12x + 9) - (4x² - 12x + 9) = 4x² + 12x + 9 - 4x² + 12x - 9 = 24x. Qolgan variantlar esa matn mazmuniga yoki matematik qoidaga zid bo'lgan chalg'ituvchi (tuzoq) variantlardir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: DESMOS 3-sekund hack: 1) Desmos grafigiga kiriting: y₁ = (2x + 3)² - (2x - 3)². 2) Har bir javob variantini alohida kiriting: y₂ = 12x, y₃ = 24x, va h.k. 3) Qaysi grafik y₁ bilan bir xil bo'lsa, o'sha javob to'g'ri. Yoki formula: a² - b² = (a + b)(a - b). Bu formula SAT da juda tez-tez uchraydi va ko'p vaqt tejaydi.

sample_test_questions.question: A circle has a radius of 12 centimeters. What is the length, in centimeters, of an arc that subtends a central angle of 60°?
sample_test_questions.explanation: To'g'ri javob B (4π). Yoy uzunligi formulasi: Arc length = (θ/360°) × 2πr, bu yerda θ markaziy burchak daraja hisobida, r radius. θ = 60°, r = 12. Arc length = (60°/360°) × 2π(12) = (1/6) × 24π = 4π santimetr. Yoki boshqacha usul: 60° aylana markazidan 360° ning 1/6 qismini tashkil qiladi. Aylana uzunligi 2πr = 2π(12) = 24π. Yoy uzunligi 24π ning 1/6 qismi = 4π. Qolgan variantlar esa matn mazmuniga yoki matematik qoidaga zid bo'lgan chalg'ituvchi (tuzoq) variantlardir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: DESMOS hack: Desmos kalkulyatorida hisoblang: (60/360) × 2 × π × 12 = 4π ≈ 12.57. Keyin javoblarni tekshiring: 2π ≈ 6.28, 4π ≈ 12.57 ✓, 6π ≈ 18.85, 12π ≈ 37.70. Yoki formula eslab qoling: Yoy uzunligi = (burchak/360°) × aylana uzunligi. Agar burchak radianlarda berilgan bo'lsa: Arc length = rθ (bu yerda θ radian).

sample_test_questions.question: A recipe for 4 servings requires 3 cups of flour. How many cups of flour are needed to make 10 servings of the same recipe?
sample_test_questions.explanation: To'g'ri javob C (7.5 cups). Proporsiya o'rnatamiz: 4 porsiya uchun 3 cups, 10 porsiya uchun x cups. 4/3 = 10/x yoki 3/4 = x/10. Ikkinchi usulni ishlatamiz: x = (3 × 10) / 4 = 30/4 = 7.5 cups. Yoki boshqacha: bitta porsiya uchun 3/4 = 0.75 cup kerak. 10 porsiya uchun 0.75 × 10 = 7.5 cups. Qolgan variantlar esa matn mazmuniga yoki matematik qoidaga zid bo'lgan chalg'ituvchi (tuzoq) variantlardir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: DESMOS hack: Desmos kalkulyatorida hisoblang: (3/4) × 10 = 7.5. Yoki proporsiya o'rnating va cross-multiply (perpendikulyar ko'paytirish) qiling. SAT da proporsiya savollari uchun: 1) Nisbatni aniqlang (3 cups / 4 servings). 2) Kerakli miqdorga ko'paytiring (× 10 servings). 3) Soddalashtiring.

sample_test_questions.question: In right triangle ABC, angle C measures 90 degrees. If sin(A) = 5/13, what is the value of cos(B)?
sample_test_questions.explanation: To'g'ri burchakli uchburchakda A + B = 90 gradus. Cofunction formulasi bo'yicha: cos(B) = cos(90 - A) = sin(A). Shuning uchun cos(B) = 5/13. To'g'ri javob: A (5/13). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (12/13) — cos(A) yoki sin(B) ni hisoblab qo'yish tuzog'i; C (13/5) — kasrni to'ntarish xatosi; D (5/12) — tangens qiymati bilan adashtirishdagi xato variant.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ COFUNCTION QOIDASI: sin(A) = cos(B). 1 soniyada hal bo'ladi!

sample_test_questions.question: In the xy-plane, the equation x^2 + y^2 + 6x - 14y - 42 = 0 defines a circle. What is the radius of the circle?
sample_test_questions.explanation: To'la kvadratga ajratamiz: (x^2 + 6x + 9) + (y^2 - 14y + 49) = 42 + 9 + 49. (x + 3)^2 + (y - 7)^2 = 100. Standart tenglama (x - h)^2 + (y - k)^2 = r^2 bo'lgani uchun r^2 = 100 => r = 10. To'g'ri javob: A (10). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (100) — r^2 ni radius deb adashish klassik tuzog'i; C (7) — markazning y koordinatasi; D (14) — y koeffitsiyenti bilan adashtirishdagi xato variant.

sample_test_questions.question: How many integers satisfy the absolute value inequality |2x - 5| <= 9?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Tengsizlikni ochamiz: -9 <= 2x - 5 <= 9. Har bir tomonga 5 qo'shamiz: -4 <= 2x <= 14. 2 ga bo'lamiz: -2 <= x <= 7. Butun sonlar: -2, -1, 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7. Jami butun sonlar miqdori: 7 - (-2) + 1 = 10 ta. To'g'ri javob: A (10). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (9) — oxirgi 1 ni qo'shishni unutib 7 - (-2) = 9 deb qoldirish tuzog'i; C (8) va D (11) — sanashdagi adashish natijasidagi xato variantlar.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ BUTUN SONLARNI SANASH: [a, b] oralig'idagi butun sonlar soni = b - a + 1. 7 - (-2) + 1 = 10 ta!

sample_test_questions.question: If 4x + 12 = 36, what is the value of 2x + 6?
sample_test_questions.explanation: 2x + 6 ifodani 4x + 12 bilan solishtiramiz: 4x + 12 = 2(2x + 6). Demak 2(2x + 6) = 36 bo'lsa, 2x + 6 = 36 / 2 = 18. To'g'ri javob: A (18). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (6) — x ning qiymatini topib (x = 6) adashib belgilash klassik SAT tuzog'i; C (12) — 2x ning qiymati; D (24) — 36 dan 12 ni ayirib qo'yishdagi xato variant.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ SAT TUZOG'I: Savol x ni emas, 2x + 6 ni so'ragan. 4x+12 ni 2 ga bo'lsangiz 18 chiqadi!

sample_test_questions.question: A bakery sells custom gift boxes containing chocolate cookies and almond biscotti. Chocolate cookies cost \.50 each and almond biscotti cost \.00 each. A customer purchases a total of 18 items and spends exactly \.00. How many chocolate cookies did the customer purchase?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Chiziqli tenglamalar sistemasi tuzamiz: c — shokoladli pechenyelar soni, b — biskotti soni. 1) Jami mahsulotlar: c + b = 18 => b = 18 - c. 2) Jami summa: 2.50c + 3.00b = 49.00. Ikkinchi tenglamaga b ning ifodasini qo'yamiz: 2.50c + 3.00(18 - c) = 49 => 2.50c + 54 - 3.00c = 49 => -0.50c = -5 => c = 10 ta shokoladli pechenye. To'g'ri javob: A (10). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (8) — biskotti sonini (b = 8) belgilab qo'yish klassik tuzog'i; C (12) va D (6) — hisoblashdagi xato variantlardir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ DESMOS USULI: Desmosga x + y = 18 va 2.5x + 3y = 49 tenglamalarini yozing. Kesishish nuqtasi (10, 8). x = 10 darhol chiqadi!

sat_mocks.title: Digital SAT Mock #24: College Board Bank Adaptive Mock 4

sample_test_questions.passage: Biomimetic engineers frequently look to marine organisms for inspiration; the hydrodynamic efficiency of the boxfish, for instance, has ______ automotive designers seeking to reduce aerodynamic drag in fuel-efficient vehicles.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
sample_test_questions.explanation:
To'g'ri javob: A (guided).

Matn tahlili:
Muhandislar dengiz jonzotlaridan ilhom oladi ('look to marine organisms for inspiration'). Masalan, qutichali baliqning gidrodinamik samaradorligi avtomobil konstruktorlariga aerodinamik qarshilikni kamaytirishda yo'l ko'rsatgan / turtki bergan ('guided').

Variantlar tahlili:
A) guided - yo'naltirgan, ilhom bergan (to'g'ri).
B) deterred - to'sqinlik qilgan, qaytargan (qarama-qarshi ma'no).
C) obscured - qorong'ilashtirgan, yashirgan.
D) reproached - ayblagan, tanbeh bergan.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ READING STRATEGIYASI: Bo'sh joy atrofidagi qarama-qarshilik (contrast) yoki qo'shimcha belgilarni toping va matndan kelib chiqing.

sample_test_questions.passage: The anthropologist cautioned that attempting to reconstruct ancient kinship networks exclusively from mortuary arrangements is fundamentally ______; funerary rituals often express idealized aspirations rather than mirror mundane social realities.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
sample_test_questions.explanation:
To'g'ri javob: A (tenuous).

Matn tahlili:
Antropolog qabrlarni dafn etish odatlaridan qadimiy qarindoshlik tizimini tiklash xatarli/mo'rt ekanidan ogohlantirmoqda, chunki dafn marosimlari kundalik ijtimoiy haqiqatni emas, balki ideallashtirilgan niyatlarni ifodalaydi. Shuning uchun bunday xulosalar zaif, asossiz yoki omonat ('tenuous') bo'ladi.

Variantlar tahlili:
A) tenuous - zaif, mo'rt, yetarlicha asoslanmagan (to'g'ri).
B) imperious - buyruqboz, takabbur.
C) unimpeachable - shubhasiz, mukammal (kontekstga teskari).
D) salutary - foydali, shifobaxsh.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ READING STRATEGIYASI: Bo'sh joy atrofidagi qarama-qarshilik (contrast) yoki qo'shimcha belgilarni toping va matndan kelib chiqing.

sample_test_questions.passage: Rather than clinging rigidly to outdated behavioral models, contemporary evolutionary psychologists acknowledge that cognitive adaptations are highly ______: their developmental expression can shift dynamically depending on socioecological cues.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
sample_test_questions.explanation:
To'g'ri javob: A (plastic).

Matn tahlili:
Qattiq qolipga yopishmasdan ('Rather than clinging rigidly...'), zamonaviy tadqiqotchilar kognitiv moslashuvlarning o'zgaruvchan, moslashuvchan ekanini ('shift dynamically depending on socioecological cues') tan olishadi. Biologiya va psixologiyada muhitga qarab moslashuvchanlik xususiyati 'plastic' (plastiklik, egiluvchanlik) atamasi bilan ifodalanadi.

Variantlar tahlili:
A) plastic - moslashuvchan, o'zgaruvchan (to'g'ri).
B) intractable - bo'ysunmas, qaysar, o'zgarmas.
C) obsolete - eskirgan, o'z kuchini yo'qotgan.
D) dogmatic - qotib qolgan aqidaparast.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ READING STRATEGIYASI: Bo'sh joy atrofidagi qarama-qarshilik (contrast) yoki qo'shimcha belgilarni toping va matndan kelib chiqing.

sample_test_questions.passage: Although the treaty was ______ celebrated as a watershed moment for international conservation, independent observers noted that it lacked enforceable mechanisms to penalize noncompliant signatories.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
sample_test_questions.explanation:
To'g'ri javob: A (ostensibly).

Matn tahlili:
Shartnoma tashqi ko'rinishidan / rasmiy ravishda yuksak burilish nuqtasi deb nishonlangan ('celebrated as a watershed moment') bo'lsa-da, 'Although' va 'lacked enforceable mechanisms' iboralari aslida unda majburlovchi vositalar yo'qligini fosh qiladi. Demak, bu nishonlash faqat yuzaki yoki ko'rinishdagina ('ostensibly') bo'lgan.

Variantlar tahlili:
A) ostensibly - ko'rinishidan, zohiran (to'g'ri).
B) inadvertently - bilmasdan, tasodifan.
C) reluctantly - istamaygina, majburlikdan.
D) scrupulously - o'ta sinchkovlik va vijdonan.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ READING STRATEGIYASI: Bo'sh joy atrofidagi qarama-qarshilik (contrast) yoki qo'shimcha belgilarni toping va matndan kelib chiqing.

sample_test_questions.passage: The computational chemist argued that the new quantum simulation algorithm does not entirely replace empirical spectroscopy; instead, it serves a ______ purpose, validating theoretical bond geometries that physical instruments cannot directly resolve.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
sample_test_questions.explanation:
To'g'ri javob: A (complementary).

Matn tahlili:
Algoritm empirik spektroskopiyaning o'rnini to'liq bosmaydi ('does not entirely replace'), balki jismoniy asboblar to'g'ridan-to'g'ri o'lchay olmaydigan sohalarni to'ldiradi va tekshiradi ('validating theoretical bond geometries that physical instruments cannot directly resolve'). Ya'ni u spektroskopiyani to'ldiruvchi ('complementary') vazifani bajaradi.

Variantlar tahlili:
A) complementary - bir-birini to'ldiruvchi (to'g'ri).
B) superfluous - ortiqcha, keraksiz.
C) contentious - bahsli, janjalli.
D) rudimentary - boshlang'ich, ibtidoiy.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ READING STRATEGIYASI: Bo'sh joy atrofidagi qarama-qarshilik (contrast) yoki qo'shimcha belgilarni toping va matndan kelib chiqing.

sample_test_questions.passage: Urban planners observed that introducing pedestrianized corridors not only eased automotive congestion but also ______ commercial activity, as foot traffic along storefronts surged by over 40 percent.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
sample_test_questions.explanation:
To'g'ri javob: A (bolstered).

Matn tahlili:
Piyodalar yo'lagi avtomobil tirbandligini kamaytirdi hamda do'konlar oldidagi odamlar oqimini 40 foizga oshirib, savdo faolligini kuchaytirdi / jonlantirdi ('bolstered').

Variantlar tahlili:
A) bolstered - kuchaytirgan, qo'llab-quvvatlagan (to'g'ri).
B) suppressed - bostirgan, pasaytirgan.
C) preempted - oldini olgan, bartaraf etgan.
D) regulated - tartibga solgan (surged - ko'tarildi bilan mos kelmaydi).
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ READING STRATEGIYASI: Bo'sh joy atrofidagi qarama-qarshilik (contrast) yoki qo'shimcha belgilarni toping va matndan kelib chiqing.

sample_test_questions.passage: Because early deep-sea submersibles possessed only limited battery life and crude imaging sensors, deep benthic ecosystems remained largely ______ to marine biologists until autonomous robotic gliders were deployed in the late 1990s.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
sample_test_questions.explanation:
To'g'ri javob: A (inaccessible).

Matn tahlili:
Dastlabki suvosti apparatlari cheklangan quvvatga va oddiy datchiklarga ega bo'lgani sababli, chuqur suv tubi ekotizimlari 1990-yillarning oxirigacha biologlar uchun yetib borib o'rganib bo'lmaydigan ('inaccessible') bo'lib qolgan edi.

Variantlar tahlili:
A) inaccessible - kirish qiyin, yetib bo'lmas (to'g'ri).
B) ubiquitous - hamma joyda uchraydigan.
C) transparent - shaffof, ochiq-oydin.
D) perilous - xavf-xatarga to'la.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ READING STRATEGIYASI: Bo'sh joy atrofidagi qarama-qarshilik (contrast) yoki qo'shimcha belgilarni toping va matndan kelib chiqing.

sample_test_questions.passage: Critics of the proposed economic deregulation argued that the agency's relaxed reporting requirements would ______ corporate transparency, allowing shadow accounting practices to flourish unchecked.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
sample_test_questions.explanation:
To'g'ri javob: A (undermine).

Matn tahlili:
Iqtisodiy qoidalarni yengillashtirish tanqidchilari hisobot talablarining yumshatilishi korporativ shaffoflikka putur yetkazadi ('undermine') va yashirin buxgalteriya amaliyotlarining nazoratsiz rivojlanishiga yo'l ochadi deb da'vo qilishmoqda.

Variantlar tahlili:
A) undermine - putur yetkazmoq, zaiflashtirmoq (to'g'ri).
B) explicate - batafsil tushuntirib bermoq.
C) reconcile - yarashtirmoq, muvofiqlashtirmoq.
D) reinforce - mustahkamlamoq (kontekstga butunlay teskari).
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ READING STRATEGIYASI: Bo'sh joy atrofidagi qarama-qarshilik (contrast) yoki qo'shimcha belgilarni toping va matndan kelib chiqing.

sample_test_questions.passage: Historically, historians divided the painter's career into two discordant phases: his austere monochromatic portraits of the 1950s and his vibrant, chaotic collages of the 1970s. Curator Elena Vance's current exhibition, however, recontextualizes this supposed rupture. By showcasing previously unexhibited studio sketches from the intervening decade, the gallery reveals a systematic, deliberate transition—demonstrating that the later expressive masterworks evolved directly from the rigorous spatial geometry of the early portraits.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice best describes the overall function of the text?

options.text: It explains how a current exhibition challenges a longstanding biographical consensus.
It argues that the artist's sketches are aesthetically superior to his finished paintings.
It outlines the chronological development of mid-century abstract portraiture techniques.
It details how an artist responded to commercial criticism throughout his career.

sample_test_questions.explanation:
To'g'ri javob: A.

Matn tahlili:
Matn an'anaviy qarash ('Historically, historians divided...') bilan boshlanadi: rassomning ijodi ikki qarama-qarshi bosqichga ajratilgan deb hisoblangan. So'ngra 'however' orqali kurator Elena Vance'ning ko'rgazmasi bu eski konsensusni o'zgartirayotgani ('recontextualizes this supposed rupture') va 1960-yillardagi eskizlar orqali uzluksiz rivojlanishni isbotlayotgani bayon qilinadi. Bu aynan A variantdagi 'ko'rgazma uzoq vaqt mavjud bo'lgan biografik konsensusga e'tiroz bildirishini tushuntiradi' fikrini aks ettiradi.

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
B) Eskizlar tugallangan rasmlardan ko'ra go'zalroq deb taqqoslanmagan.
C) Umuman mavhum portret san'ati xronologiyasi haqida emas, bitta rassom ko'rgazmasi haqida.
D) Rassom tanqidlarga qanday javob bergani haqida ma'lumot yo'q.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ STRUKTURA TAKTIKASI: Matn qismlari o'rtasidagi mantiqiy bog'lanishni (dalil, inkor, izoh) aniqlab, umumiy maqsadni belgilang.

sample_test_questions.passage: In avian ecology, the 'dear enemy' effect predicts that territorial songbirds will display lower levels of aggression toward familiar territorial neighbors than toward unfamiliar intruders, conserving energy for genuine competitive threats. In a 2023 study of savannah sparrows, however, ecologist Noah Diaz discovered an unexpected inversion: birds nesting in high-density scrublands exhibited significantly heightened territorial singing and threat displays toward long-standing neighbors. Diaz hypothesizes that when territory sizes fall below a critical threshold, neighboring birds become continuous resource competitors rather than stable partners in boundary maintenance.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice best states the primary purpose of the text?

options.text: To present experimental findings that delineate a boundary condition of an established ecological hypothesis.
To demonstrate that savannah sparrows lack the cognitive capacity to distinguish familiar birds from strangers.
To propose that territorial behaviors in songbirds are determined entirely by auditory vocalization pitch.
To resolve a historical debate regarding the evolutionary origin of avian song repertoires.

sample_test_questions.explanation:
To'g'ri javob: A.

Matn tahlili:
Matnda avval qushlar ekologiyasidagi mashhur 'dear enemy' gipotezasi keltiriladi (qushlar qo'shnilarga nisbatan begonalarga ko'ra kamroq tajovuzkor bo'lishi). Keyin Noah Diaz'ning tadqiqoti zich hududlarda bu qoidaning teskarisi sodir bo'lishini ko'rsatadi (inversion). Diaz hudud o'lchami kritik nuqtadan pastga tushganda gipoteza ishlamay qolishini tushuntiradi. Demak, maqsad mavjud gipotezaning qaysi chegara sharoitida (boundary condition) ishlamay qolishini ko'rsatishdir (A variant).

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
B) Qushlar tanish qushlarni taniy olmasligi aytilmagan, aksincha ularni taniydi.
C) Qo'shiq balandligi (pitch) haqida hech narsa deyilmagan.
D) Qushlar sayrash repertuarining evolyutsion kelib chiqishi bahsi hal qilinmayapti.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ STRUKTURA TAKTIKASI: Matn qismlari o'rtasidagi mantiqiy bog'lanishni (dalil, inkor, izoh) aniqlab, umumiy maqsadni belgilang.

sample_test_questions.question: To'pning t soniyadagi yerdan balandligi h(t) = -5t² + 20t + 2 (metr) funksiya bilan modellashtiriladi. To'p erishadigan maksimal balandlik necha metr?
sample_test_questions.explanation:
Parabolaning cho'qqisi (vertex) vaqti: t = -b / (2a) = -20 / (2 * (-5)) = 2 soniya.
Maksimal balandlik: h(2) = -5(2)² + 20(2) + 2 = -20 + 40 + 2 = 22 metr.
B variant (20) — tezlik yoki vaqt bilan adashtiruvchi chalg'ituvchidir.
sample_test_questions.strategy:
⚡ DESMOS HACK (5 soniya):
Desmosga y = -5x^2 + 20x + 2 ni yozing. Parabolaning cho'qqi nuqtasini bosing: (2, 22). y qiymati = 22 — bu maksimal balandlik!

sample_test_questions.question: Which of the following is equivalent to the expression (4x^2 - 9) / (2x^2 + 5x - 12) for all values of x where the expression is defined?
sample_test_questions.explanation:
Surat va maxrajni ko'paytuvchilarga ajratamiz:
Surat: 4x^2 - 9 = (2x - 3)(2x + 3) (kvadratlar ayirmasi).
Maxraj: 2x^2 + 5x - 12 = 2x^2 + 8x - 3x - 12 = 2x(x + 4) - 3(x + 4) = (2x - 3)(x + 4).
Kasrni qisqartiramiz: (2x - 3)(2x + 3) / [(2x - 3)(x + 4)] = (2x + 3) / (x + 4)... To'xtang! Suratda (2x+3) qoladi, lekin variantlarga qarasak A da (2x - 3)/(x + 4) yoki B da (2x + 3)/(x + 4). Keling aniq ko'paytiramiz: agar surat (2x-3)(2x+3) bo'lsa va maxrajda (2x-3)(x+4) bo'lsa, qisqargach (2x+3)/(x+4) qoladi. Demak to'g'ri javob B!
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ DESMOS TEST-NUMBER: x ga ixtiyoriy son bering (masalan x = 5). Asl ifoda: (100-9)/(50+25-12) = 91/63 = 13/9 ≈ 1.444. B varianti: (2*5+3)/(5+4) = 13/9 ≈ 1.444. Aniq va xatosiz tekshiruv!

sample_test_questions.question: A vehicle travels at a constant speed of 60 miles per hour. What is the vehicle's speed in feet per second? (1 mile = 5,280 feet, 1 hour = 3,600 seconds)
sample_test_questions.explanation: Birliklarni bosqichma-bosqich o'zgartiramiz: Tezlik = 60 mil / soat = (60 * 5,280 fut) / (3,600 soniya) = 316,800 / 3,600 = 88 fut/soniya. To'g'ri javob: A (88). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (60) — o'zgarishsiz qoldirish xatosi; C (120) va D (44) — ko'paytirish va bo'lishdagi xato hisob-kitoblarga asoslangan chalg'ituvchi variantlar.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ BIRLIK KO'PAYTUVCHISI: 60 mil/soat * (5280 / 3600) = 60 * (22 / 15) = 4 * 22 = 88 fut/soniya.

sample_test_questions.question: A laboratory culture of bacteria doubles in population every 6 hours. If the initial population is 500 bacteria, which function P(t) models the population after t hours?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Eksponensial o'sish formulasi: P(t) = P0 * (asos)^(t / davr). Bu yerda P0 = 500, ikki barobar ortish asosi = 2, davri = 6 soat. Funksiya: P(t) = 500 * (2)^(t/6). To'g'ri javob: A. Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B — davrni darajaga ko'paytirib qo'yish tuzog'i; C — kamayish (0.5) formulasini qo'llash xatosi; D — boshlang'ich sonni adashtirishdagi xato variant.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ QIYMAT TEKSHIRISH: t = 6 soatda populyatsiya ikki barobar (1000) bo'lishi kerak. A da: 500 * 2^(6/6) = 1000 to'g'ri chiqadi!

sample_test_questions.question: Maktabdagi 200 nafar o'quvchi o'rtasida o'tkazilgan so'rovnomada 120 nafari sport to'garagiga, 80 nafari musiqa to'garagiga a'zo ekanligi ma'lum bo'ldi. Har ikkala to'garakka qatnashadigan o'quvchilar soni 30 nafar. Tasodifiy tanlangan sport to'garagi a'zosining ayni paytda musiqa to'garagiga ham qatnashishi ehtimolligi (conditional probability) nechaga teng?
sample_test_questions.explanation:
Shartli ehtimollik: P(Musiqa | Sport) = n(Sport va Musiqa) / n(Sport).
Diqqat: jami 200 nafar emas, tanlangan o'quvchi 'sport to'garagi a'zosi' ekanligi oldindan ma'lum!
Demak maxraj: 120.
Surat: 30.
Ehtimollik = 30 / 120 = 1/4 = 0.25 (25%).
B variant (3/20 = 30/200) — savol shartini o'qimay barcha o'quvchilarga nisbatan hisoblaganlar uchun tuzoq!
sample_test_questions.strategy:
🎯 SAT TAKTIKASI:
'Given that' yoki 'Tasodifiy tanlangan [Guruh] a'zosining...' deyilganda, umumiy o'quvchilar soni (200) bekor bo'ladi. Yangi maxraj faqat o'sha guruh (120) bo'ladi: 30 / 120 = 1/4!

sample_test_questions.question: What is the value of x when x + 2 = 10?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Tenglamani yechish: x + 2 = 10 bo'lsa, ikkala tomondan 2 ni ayiramiz: x = 8 (A to'g'ri). B (10), C (12) va D (14) noto'g'ri amallar natijasidagi chalg'ituvchi variantlardir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ DESMOS USULI: 1-qator: y = x + 2; 2-qator: y = 10. Kesishish nuqtasi x = 8.

sample_test_questions.question: If 3x + 9 = 24, what is x?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Chiziqli tenglamani yechish: 3x + 9 = 24 => 3x = 15 => x = 5 (A to'g'ri). B (6), C (7) va D (8) hisoblash xatolariga asoslangan tuzoqlardir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ DESMOS USULI: 1-qator: y = 3x + 9; 2-qator: y = 24. Graflar kesishgan absissasi x = 5.

sample_test_questions.question: If 4(3x - 5) + 6 = 2(x + 8), what is the value of x?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Qadam-baqadam yechim: Qavslarni ochamiz: 12x - 20 + 6 = 2x + 16, ya'ni 12x - 14 = 2x + 16. O'xshash hadlarni birlashtirsak: 12x - 2x = 16 + 14 => 10x = 30 => x = 3. To'g'ri javob: A. B varianti (5) ishoralarni noto'g'ri ko'chirganda kelib chiqadi (xato). C va D variantlari arifmetik xatoliklar natijasida paydo bo'ladigan chalg'ituvchi variantlardir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Desmos hack: Chap tomonni y1 = 4(3x - 5) + 6 va o'ng tomonni y2 = 2(x + 8) deb kiriting. Ikki to'g'ri chiziqning kesishish nuqtasi x koordinatasini ko'ring: x = 3.

sample_test_questions.question: A line in the xy-plane has an x-intercept of (-6, 0) and a y-intercept of (0, 9). Which of the following is an equation of the line?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Qadam-baqadam tahlil: Nishab (slope) m = (9 - 0) / (0 - (-6)) = 9/6 = 3/2. Tenglama y = (3/2)x + 9 ko'rinishida bo'ladi. Ikkala tomonni 2 ga ko'paytirsak: 2y = 3x + 18. Hadlarni qayta joylashtirsak: 3x - 2y = -18 hosil bo'ladi. Shuning uchun to'g'ri javob A. B varianti noto'g'ri chunki unda nishab teskari (2/3) olingan. C va D variantlarida esa interceptlarning ishoralari xato qo'llangan.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Desmos hack: Berilgan 4 ta variantni birma-bir Desmosga kiriting va (-6, 0) hamda (0, 9) nuqtalardan qaysi to'g'ri chiziq o'tishini vizual tekshiring. Faqat A to'g'ri keladi.

sample_test_questions.question: The linear function f is defined by f(x) = cx + d, where c and d are constants. If f(2) = 11 and f(5) = 26, what is the value of f(-1)?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Qadam-baqadam yechim: Funksiya chiziqli bo'lgani uchun burchak koeffitsienti c = (26 - 11) / (5 - 2) = 15 / 3 = 5. Demak, f(x) = 5x + d. f(2) = 11 bo'lgani uchun 5(2) + d = 11 => d = 1. Funksiya formulasi: f(x) = 5x + 1. Endi f(-1) ni hisoblaymiz: f(-1) = 5(-1) + 1 = -5 + 1 = -4. To'g'ri javob: A. B varianti d ning qiymati bo'lib, x=-1 qo'yilmagan xato variant. C va D variantlari esa nishabni xato topganda kelib chiqadigan chalg'ituvchi javoblardir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Desmos hack: Desmosda jadval (table) yarating va (2, 11), (5, 26) nuqtalarni kiriting. Keyin y1 ~ m*x1 + b regressiyasini yozing. m=5, b=1 chiqadi. f(-1) = 5(-1)+1 = -4.

sat_mocks.title: Digital SAT Mock #25: College Board Bank Adaptive Mock 5

sample_test_questions.passage: Critics of the proposed economic deregulation argued that the agency's relaxed reporting requirements would ______ corporate transparency, allowing shadow accounting practices to flourish unchecked.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
sample_test_questions.explanation:
To'g'ri javob: A (undermine).

Matn tahlili:
Iqtisodiy qoidalarni yengillashtirish tanqidchilari hisobot talablarining yumshatilishi korporativ shaffoflikka putur yetkazadi ('undermine') va yashirin buxgalteriya amaliyotlarining nazoratsiz rivojlanishiga yo'l ochadi deb da'vo qilishmoqda.

Variantlar tahlili:
A) undermine - putur yetkazmoq, zaiflashtirmoq (to'g'ri).
B) explicate - batafsil tushuntirib bermoq.
C) reconcile - yarashtirmoq, muvofiqlashtirmoq.
D) reinforce - mustahkamlamoq (kontekstga butunlay teskari).
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ READING STRATEGIYASI: Bo'sh joy atrofidagi qarama-qarshilik (contrast) yoki qo'shimcha belgilarni toping va matndan kelib chiqing.

sample_test_questions.passage: Historically, historians divided the painter's career into two discordant phases: his austere monochromatic portraits of the 1950s and his vibrant, chaotic collages of the 1970s. Curator Elena Vance's current exhibition, however, recontextualizes this supposed rupture. By showcasing previously unexhibited studio sketches from the intervening decade, the gallery reveals a systematic, deliberate transition—demonstrating that the later expressive masterworks evolved directly from the rigorous spatial geometry of the early portraits.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice best describes the overall function of the text?

options.text: It explains how a current exhibition challenges a longstanding biographical consensus.
It argues that the artist's sketches are aesthetically superior to his finished paintings.
It outlines the chronological development of mid-century abstract portraiture techniques.
It details how an artist responded to commercial criticism throughout his career.

sample_test_questions.explanation:
To'g'ri javob: A.

Matn tahlili:
Matn an'anaviy qarash ('Historically, historians divided...') bilan boshlanadi: rassomning ijodi ikki qarama-qarshi bosqichga ajratilgan deb hisoblangan. So'ngra 'however' orqali kurator Elena Vance'ning ko'rgazmasi bu eski konsensusni o'zgartirayotgani ('recontextualizes this supposed rupture') va 1960-yillardagi eskizlar orqali uzluksiz rivojlanishni isbotlayotgani bayon qilinadi. Bu aynan A variantdagi 'ko'rgazma uzoq vaqt mavjud bo'lgan biografik konsensusga e'tiroz bildirishini tushuntiradi' fikrini aks ettiradi.

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
B) Eskizlar tugallangan rasmlardan ko'ra go'zalroq deb taqqoslanmagan.
C) Umuman mavhum portret san'ati xronologiyasi haqida emas, bitta rassom ko'rgazmasi haqida.
D) Rassom tanqidlarga qanday javob bergani haqida ma'lumot yo'q.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ STRUKTURA TAKTIKASI: Matn qismlari o'rtasidagi mantiqiy bog'lanishni (dalil, inkor, izoh) aniqlab, umumiy maqsadni belgilang.

sample_test_questions.passage: In avian ecology, the 'dear enemy' effect predicts that territorial songbirds will display lower levels of aggression toward familiar territorial neighbors than toward unfamiliar intruders, conserving energy for genuine competitive threats. In a 2023 study of savannah sparrows, however, ecologist Noah Diaz discovered an unexpected inversion: birds nesting in high-density scrublands exhibited significantly heightened territorial singing and threat displays toward long-standing neighbors. Diaz hypothesizes that when territory sizes fall below a critical threshold, neighboring birds become continuous resource competitors rather than stable partners in boundary maintenance.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice best states the primary purpose of the text?

options.text: To present experimental findings that delineate a boundary condition of an established ecological hypothesis.
To demonstrate that savannah sparrows lack the cognitive capacity to distinguish familiar birds from strangers.
To propose that territorial behaviors in songbirds are determined entirely by auditory vocalization pitch.
To resolve a historical debate regarding the evolutionary origin of avian song repertoires.

sample_test_questions.explanation:
To'g'ri javob: A.

Matn tahlili:
Matnda avval qushlar ekologiyasidagi mashhur 'dear enemy' gipotezasi keltiriladi (qushlar qo'shnilarga nisbatan begonalarga ko'ra kamroq tajovuzkor bo'lishi). Keyin Noah Diaz'ning tadqiqoti zich hududlarda bu qoidaning teskarisi sodir bo'lishini ko'rsatadi (inversion). Diaz hudud o'lchami kritik nuqtadan pastga tushganda gipoteza ishlamay qolishini tushuntiradi. Demak, maqsad mavjud gipotezaning qaysi chegara sharoitida (boundary condition) ishlamay qolishini ko'rsatishdir (A variant).

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
B) Qushlar tanish qushlarni taniy olmasligi aytilmagan, aksincha ularni taniydi.
C) Qo'shiq balandligi (pitch) haqida hech narsa deyilmagan.
D) Qushlar sayrash repertuarining evolyutsion kelib chiqishi bahsi hal qilinmayapti.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ STRUKTURA TAKTIKASI: Matn qismlari o'rtasidagi mantiqiy bog'lanishni (dalil, inkor, izoh) aniqlab, umumiy maqsadni belgilang.

sample_test_questions.passage: Volcanic lightning has fascinated observers since Pliny the Younger documented the eruption of Mount Vesuvius in 79 CE. For centuries, this spectacular phenomenon was thought to result solely from triboelectric friction—magma fragments rubbing against one another during violent ascent. Yet recent high-speed cinematography reveals a second mechanism: radioactive decay of radon gas within the ash plume ionizes surrounding air molecules, producing the high electric potential required for electrical discharge.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice best describes the relationship between the two parts of the text?

options.text: The first part describes an ancient belief, and the second part confirms its scientific accuracy.
The first part introduces a traditional explanation, and the second part presents an additional mechanism.
The first part describes a natural disaster, and the second part evaluates emergency evacuation protocols.
The first part introduces an engineering invention, and the second part critiques its efficiency.

sample_test_questions.explanation:
To'g'ri javob: B.

Matn tahlili:
Birinchi qismda asrlar davomida vulqon chaqmoqlari faqat ishqalanish (triboelectric friction) oqibatida sodir bo'ladi deb hisoblangani ('traditional explanation') aytiladi. Ikkinchi qismda esa ('Yet recent high-speed cinematography reveals a second mechanism...') unga qo'shimcha mexanizm (radon gazining parchalanishi) topilgani ko'rsatiladi. Bu aynan B variantga to'liq mos keladi.

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
A) Ikkinchi qism birinchi qismdagi qarashning yagona to'g'riligini tasdiqlamaydi, balki yangi omil qo'shadi.
C) Evakuatsiya choralari haqida gap yo'q.
D) Muhandislik ixtirosi emas, tabiiy hodisa o'rganilmoqda.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ STRUKTURA TAKTIKASI: Matn qismlari o'rtasidagi mantiqiy bog'lanishni (dalil, inkor, izoh) aniqlab, umumiy maqsadni belgilang.

sample_test_questions.passage: In standard macroeconomic models, central bank interest rate hikes are assumed to transmit predictably to mortgage lending rates within weeks. Economists analyzing the 2022–2023 tightening cycle, however, documented an unusual divergence: while short-term commercial paper tracked policy rates seamlessly, 30-year fixed mortgages exhibited unprecedented volatility and lagged transmission. The researchers attributed this decoupling to quantitative tightening, which removed a major price-insensitive buyer from the sovereign debt market and amplified secondary market liquidity premiums.
sample_test_questions.question: In the text, the statement about quantitative tightening primarily serves to:

options.text: provide an explanatory hypothesis for an observed anomaly.
dismiss the empirical validity of the economists' dataset.
argue that central banks should eliminate all mortgage interest rate targets.
summarize the historical origins of fixed-rate mortgage contracts.

sample_test_questions.explanation:
To'g'ri javob: A.

Matn tahlili:
Matnda avval kutilgan qonuniyat, so'ngra 2022-2023 yillarda kuzatilgan kutilmagan tafovut/anomaliya ('unusual divergence', 'decoupling') bayon etilgan. Belgilangan jumla aynan nima sababdan bu anomaliya yuz berganini tushuntiruvchi sababni ('attributed this decoupling to...') keltiradi. Demak, uning vazifasi kuzatilgan anomaliya uchun izohlovchi gipotezani taqdim etishdir (A variant).

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
B) Iqtisodchilarning ma'lumotlar to'plamini rad etmaydi, balki tasdiqlaydi.
C) Markaziy bank barcha foiz maqsadlarini yo'qotishi kerak degan da'vo yo'q.
D) Ipoteka shartnomalarining tarixiy kelib chiqishi bayon qilinmagan.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ STRUKTURA TAKTIKASI: Matn qismlari o'rtasidagi mantiqiy bog'lanishni (dalil, inkor, izoh) aniqlab, umumiy maqsadni belgilang.

sample_test_questions.passage: Philosopher of science Karl Popper famously held that scientific theories can never be verified, only falsified. If a theory survives strenuous attempts to refute it, Popper asserted, it acquires 'corroboration' but remains perpetually tentative. Yet practicing laboratory scientists rarely abandon foundational paradigms at the first sign of conflicting empirical data; instead, they routinely suspect faulty calibration, impurities in samples, or auxiliary assumptions before discarding their primary framework.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice best reflects the author's overarching organizational strategy?

options.text: Contrasting a prescriptive philosophical principle with the practical realities of scientific investigation.
Tracing the historical progression of laboratory methodologies from the Renaissance to the modern era.
Defending Popperian epistemology against accusations of internal logical inconsistency.
Advocating for the total replacement of theoretical models with pure observational empiricism.

sample_test_questions.explanation:
To'g'ri javob: A.

Matn tahlili:
Muallif avval Popperning nazariy falsafiy tamoyilini (nazariyani faqat inkor etish mumkin, tasdiqlab bo'lmaydi) keltiradi. So'ng 'Yet practicing laboratory scientists rarely abandon...' jumlasi orqali haqiqiy amaliyotdagi laboratoriya olimlarining kundalik realligi Popper aytganidek bo'lmasligini, ular darhol nazariyani tashlamasdan, asbob xatosini tekshirishini ko'rsatadi. Bu esa 'me'yoriy falsafiy tamoyilni amaliy ilmiy tadqiqot voqeligi bilan taqqoslash/qarshilantirish' (A variant) strategiyasidir.

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
B) Uyg'onish davridan to hozirgacha bo'lgan tarixiy bosqichlar keltirilmagan.
C) Popper falsafasini mantiqiy nomutanosiblikdan himoya qilmayapti.
D) Nazariy modellarni to'liq tashlab, faqat kuzatuvga o'tishni targ'ib qilmayapti.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ STRUKTURA TAKTIKASI: Matn qismlari o'rtasidagi mantiqiy bog'lanishni (dalil, inkor, izoh) aniqlab, umumiy maqsadni belgilang.

sample_test_questions.passage:
Text 1
Many cognitive ethologists maintain that tool manufacture among nonhuman primates demonstrates foresight and mental representation. When wild chimpanzees select branches, strip foliage, and trim the tips hours before visiting termite mounds, their sequential preparation suggests a pre-planned goal rather than trial-and-error associative conditioning.

Text 2
Skeptics argue that complex behavioral sequences in animals can emerge entirely through cumulative reinforcement without requiring abstract forethought. If individual actions within a sequence—such as snapping off side-twigs—have been reinforced independently through accidental tactile satisfaction or social imitation, the entire chain can appear goal-directed while relying strictly on low-level motor habits.
sample_test_questions.question: Based on the texts, how would the author of Text 2 most likely respond to the chimpanzee example in Text 1?

options.text: By contending that the twig-stripping behaviors may be explained by chained conditioning rather than mental foresight.
By conceding that chimpanzees possess cognitive faculties identical to human strategic planning.
By arguing that the observed tool preparation was fabricated by biased field researchers.
By maintaining that chimpanzees only fabricate tools when human observers directly prompt them.

sample_test_questions.explanation:
To'g'ri javob: A.

Matnlar tahlili:
1-matnda shimpanzelarning shoxlarni oldindan tozalab, tayyorlab qo'yishi ularda oldindan rejalashtirish ('foresight and mental representation') borligini ko'rsatadi deyiladi.
2-matndagi skeptiklar esa bunday murakkab zanjirlar mavhum rejasiz, oddiy mustahkamlangan odatlar va ketma-ket shartlanish ('cumulative reinforcement', 'low-level motor habits') orqali vujudga kelishi mumkinligini ta'kidlaydi.
Shu sababli, 2-matn muallifi 1-matndagi misolga 'shoxlarni tozalash harakati oldindan o'ylangan reja emas, balki zanjirli shartlanish (chained conditioning) bilan tushuntirilishi mumkin' deb javob beradi (A variant).

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
B) Shimpanzelar inson bilan bir xil qobiliyatga ega deb tan olmaydi.
C) Kuzatuvlar tadqiqotchilar tomonidan soxtalashtirilgan degan da'vo yo'q.
D) Odamlar bevosita undaganida asbob yasaydi degan gap yo'q.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ MATNLAR ARO TAKTIKA: Har ikkala muallifning markaziy da'vosini aniqlang va 2-matn 1-matnga qanday munosabat bildirishini qidiring.

sample_test_questions.passage:
Text 1
Astronomer Alan Stern asserts that the definition of a planet adopted by the International Astronomical Union (IAU) in 2006 is fundamentally flawed. By requiring a celestial body to have 'cleared the neighborhood around its orbit,' the IAU criterion ties planetary status to dynamic orbital distance rather than intrinsic physical properties. Under this definition, an Earth-mass object placed in the Kuiper Belt would fail to qualify as a planet simply because its orbital zone is too vast to clear.

Text 2
Astronomer Michael Brown defends the IAU dynamical classification, emphasizing that orbital clearing marks a profound qualitative evolutionary threshold in solar system formation. Objects that clear their orbits contain more than 99 percent of the remaining mass in their orbital zones, allowing them to govern the trajectories of all surrounding debris. Focusing solely on intrinsic geophysics ignores the defining gravitational role that true planets play in sculpting planetary architecture.
sample_test_questions.question: On which point would Stern (Text 1) and Brown (Text 2) most likely agree?

options.text: The IAU's 'clearing the neighborhood' criterion is dependent on an object's orbital environment rather than its internal physical attributes alone.
Pluto possesses sufficient gravitational dominance to dictate the orbital stability of Neptune.
Planetary definitions should prioritize historical cultural nomenclature over astrophysical metrics.
An object with the mass of Earth in the Kuiper Belt would successfully clear all nearby asteroids.

sample_test_questions.explanation:
To'g'ri javob: A.

Matnlar tahlili:
Text 1 muallifi Stern IAU mezonini aynan orbital muhitga bog'liq bo'lib qolgani ('ties planetary status to dynamic orbital distance rather than intrinsic physical properties') uchun tanqid qiladi.
Text 2 muallifi Brown esa bu mezon orbital muhit va tortishish kuchi bilan atrofni boshqarishiga asoslanganini tasdiqlaydi ('orbital clearing marks a profound... gravitational role in sculpting planetary architecture') va buni to'g'ri deb himoya qiladi.
Demak, har ikki olim ham IAU ning 'orbitani tozalash' mezoni ichki jismoniy xususiyatlarga emas, orbital muhit va dinamikaga bog'liq ekanligiga birdek rozi bo'lishadi (A variant).

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
B) Pluton Neptun barqarorligini belgilaydi degan fikr yo'q.
C) Madaniy/tarixiy nomlanishni astrofizikadan ustun qo'yish kerak deyilmagan.
D) Stern aynan Kuiper belbog'idagi Yer massasidagi jism orbitani tozalay olmasligini aytadi, Brown bunga qarshi chiqmaydi.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ MATNLAR ARO TAKTIKA: Har ikkala muallifning markaziy da'vosini aniqlang va 2-matn 1-matnga qanday munosabat bildirishini qidiring.

sample_test_questions.passage:
Text 1
Advocates of degrowth argue that perpetual GDP expansion on a finite planet is an ecological impossibility. They maintain that reducing aggregate throughput—the physical extraction and consumption of raw materials—is the only viable strategy to avert climate destabilization and resource exhaustion.

Text 2
Ecomodernists counter that decoupling economic value from material consumption is not only theoretically possible but already underway in industrialized nations. Through digitization, energy-efficiency gains, and advanced nuclear power, economies can continue expanding their financial and human development indicators while drastically contracting their net carbon footprints.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice best describes the central point of disagreement between the authors?

options.text: Whether sustained economic growth can be reconciled with ecological sustainability.
Whether nuclear energy produces zero greenhouse gas emissions during operation.
Whether industrialized nations currently consume more resources than developing nations.
Whether GDP accurately reflects the subjective well-being of national populations.

sample_test_questions.explanation:
To'g'ri javob: A.

Matnlar tahlili:
1-matn muallifi cheklangan sayyorada iqtisodiy o'sishni davom ettirish ekologik jihatdan imkonsiz ekanini ('ecological impossibility') aytadi.
2-matn muallifi esa yangi texnologiyalar orqali iqtisodiyot o'sishda davom etishi va shu bilan birga ekologiyaga ta'sirni kamaytirishi mumkinligini ('decoupling... is not only theoretically possible but already underway') ta'kidlaydi.
Demak, ularning asosiy bahs nuqtasi: barqaror iqtisodiy o'sishni ekologik barqarorlik bilan uyg'unlashtirish mumkinmi yoki yo'qmi (A variant).

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
B) Yadro energiyasi emissiyasi bo'yicha alohida bahs yo'q.
C) Rivojlangan va rivojlanayotgan davlatlar iste'moli taqqoslanmagan.
D) YaIM subyektiv baxtni o'lchay oladimi degan savol ko'tarilmagan.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ MATNLAR ARO TAKTIKA: Har ikkala muallifning markaziy da'vosini aniqlang va 2-matn 1-matnga qanday munosabat bildirishini qidiring.

sample_test_questions.passage:
Text 1
In historical linguistics, the comparative method reconstructs proto-languages by identifying systematic phonetic correspondences across descendant tongues. Proponents assert that regular sound laws operate mechanically without exceptions, allowing researchers to establish genealogical language family trees with mathematical rigor.

Text 2
Dialectologists emphasizing areal linguistics note that languages frequently borrow grammatical structures, lexical items, and phonological features across genetic boundaries via sustained trade and geographical proximity. This phenomenon of convergence, or 'wave propagation,' frequently blurs phylogenetic boundaries, rendering tree models misleading representations of linguistic history.
sample_test_questions.question: Based on the texts, the author of Text 2 would most likely characterize the 'mathematical rigor' claimed in Text 1 as:

options.text: an oversimplified metric that obscures the messy reality of cross-linguistic borrowing.
a proven framework that successfully accounts for all dialect contact phenomena.
an outdated relic that has been completely discarded by all modern linguists.
a valuable approach that is solely applicable to written alphabetic languages.

sample_test_questions.explanation:
To'g'ri javob: A.

Matnlar tahlili:
1-matn fonetik qonunlar qat'iy mexanik va istisnosiz ishlaydi deb da'vo qiladi, bu esa 'matematik aniqlik' (mathematical rigor) bilan til oilasi daraxtini qurishga imkon beradi.
2-matn esa tillar o'zaro qo'shnichilik va savdo orqali qardosh bo'lmagan holda ham grammatika va so'zlarni o'zlashtirishini ('cross genetic boundaries'), bu esa shajarali daraxt modellarini chalg'ituvchi (misleading) qilib qo'yishini ta'kidlaydi.
Demak, 2-matn muallifi 1-matndagi 'matematik aniqlik'ni tillar o'rtasidagi chalkash o'zlashtirish jarayonlarini e'tibordan chetda qoldiruvchi haddan tashqari soddalashtirilgan o'lchov (A variant) deb hisoblaydi.

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
B) Kontakt fenomenlarini hisobga oluvchi isbotlangan model deb maqtamaydi.
C) Butunlay barcha zamonaviy tilshunoslar tomonidan tashlab yuborilgan deb rad etilmagan.
D) Faqat yozma alifboli tillarga tegishli degan cheklov aytilmagan.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ MATNLAR ARO TAKTIKA: Har ikkala muallifning markaziy da'vosini aniqlang va 2-matn 1-matnga qanday munosabat bildirishini qidiring.

sample_test_questions.question: Which of the following points (x, y) is NOT a solution to the system of inequalities y > 2x - 3 and 3x + 2y <= 12?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Qadam-baqadam tekshirish: Har bir nuqtani tengsizliklar sistemasiga qo'yamiz. A varianti (3, 2): 1-tengsizlik: 2 > 2(3) - 3 => 2 > 3 (BU NOTO'G'RI, chunki 2 soni 3 dan katta emas!). Ikkinchi tengsizlik: 3(3) + 2(2) = 9 + 4 = 13 <= 12 ham yolg'on. Demak (3, 2) yechim emas va savol shartiga ko'ra to'g'ri javob A dir. B, C, D variantlaridagi nuqtalar har ikkala tengsizlikni qanoatlantiradi, shuning uchun ular xato javob hisoblanadi.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Desmos hack: Ikkala tengsizlikni Desmosga kiriting: y > 2x - 3 va 3x + 2y <= 12. So'ngra variantlardagi 4 ta nuqtani belgilang. Qaysi nuqta bo'yalgan umumiy maydondan tashqarida qolishini darhol ko'rasiz (3, 2).

sample_test_questions.question: In the system of equations 5x + py = 20 and 15x + 12y = q, the system has infinitely many solutions. What is the value of p + q?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Qadam-baqadam yechim: Sistemaning cheksiz ko'p yechimga ega bo'lishi (infinitely many solutions) uchun ikkala tenglama aynan bir xil to'g'ri chiziqni ifodalashi lozim: 15/5 = 12/p = q/20. 15/5 = 3 bo'lgani uchun: 12/p = 3 => p = 4. q/20 = 3 => q = 60. Bizdan p + q so'ralgan: p + q = 4 + 60 = 64. Shuning uchun to'g'ri javob A. B (56) va C (44) variantlari qo'shish yoki ko'paytirishdagi arifmetik xatolardan kelib chiqadi. D varianti (60) faqat q ning qiymati bo'lib, p qo'shilmagan tuzoqdir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Desmos hack: 15x + 12y = 60 ni chizing. Birinchi tenglamani 5x + py = 20 deb kiritib p=4 qilganda chiziqlar ustma-ust tushishini ko'rasiz. p=4, q=60 => 64.

sample_test_questions.question: A catering service charges a fixed delivery fee of $45 plus $18 per guest. If the total bill for an event was $765, how many guests were catered for?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Qadam-baqadam tahlil: Mehmonlar sonini g deb belgilaymiz. Umumiy xarajat tenglamasi: 18g + 45 = 765. Ikkala tomondan 45 ni ayiramiz: 18g = 720. g = 720 / 18 = 40. Demak 40 nafar mehmon bo'lgan. To'g'ri javob: A. B, C, D variantlari hisoblashda 45 ni ayirish o'rniga qo'shish yoki bo'lishdagi xatolar tufayli yuzaga keladigan noto'g'ri chalg'ituvchilardir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Desmos hack: Desmos qidiruv satriga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri (765 - 45) / 18 deb yozsangiz, javob 40 chiqadi.

sample_test_questions.question: A water tank originally contains 320 gallons of water. Water begins draining at a constant rate such that after 8 minutes, 248 gallons remain. In how many total minutes from the start will the tank be completely empty?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Qadam-baqadam tahlil: 8 daqiqada oqib ketgan suv miqdori: 320 - 248 = 72 gallon. Bir daqiqadagi oqish tezligi (rate of change): 72 / 8 = 9 gallon/daqiqa. Idish butunlay bo'shashi uchun barcha 320 gallon oqib ketishi kerak: t = 320 / 9 = 35.55... daqiqa (yoki 35 5/9 daqiqa). Shuning uchun to'g'ri javob A. B varianti (40) agar tezlik 8 gal/min deb yanglish hisoblansa chiqadigan noto'g'ri variant. C va D variantlari esa 248 ni 9 ga bo'lganda (qolgan vaqt) kelib chiqadigan chalg'ituvchi tuzoqlardir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Desmos hack: W(t) = 320 - 9t funksiyasini kiriting. X o'qi bilan kesishish nuqtasini bosing: (35.556, 0).

sample_test_questions.question: Which of the following is equivalent to the expression 16x^4 - 81y^2?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Qadam-baqadam yechim: Kvadratlar ayirmasi formulasi a^2 - b^2 = (a - b)(a + b). Bu yerda a = 4x^2, chunki (4x^2)^2 = 16x^4; b = 9y, chunki (9y)^2 = 81y^2. Shuning uchun ifoda (4x^2 - 9y)(4x^2 + 9y) ga teng. To'g'ri javob: A. B va C variantlarida ikkilangan ko'paytma (-72x^2*y) qolib ketadi (xato). D varianti esa to'g'ri ko'paytuvchilarga ajratilmagan.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Desmos hack: Asl ifodaga x=2, y=3 qo'yib hisoblang: 16(16) - 81(9) = 256 - 729 = -473. Variantlarga ham x=2, y=3 qo'ying. Faqat A varianti (16-27)(16+27) = (-11)(43) = -473 beradi.

sample_test_questions.question: What is the sum of the solutions to the quadratic equation 2x^2 - 14x + 19 = 0?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Qadam-baqadam tahlil: Viyet teoremasiga ko'ra, ax^2 + bx + c = 0 kvadrat tenglama ildizlari yig'indisi x1 + x2 = -b / a ga teng. Bu yerda a = 2, b = -14. Demak, yig'indi: -(-14) / 2 = 14 / 2 = 7. Shuning uchun to'g'ri javob A. B varianti (-7) ishora xatosidan iborat. C varianti (9.5) ildizlar ko'paytmasi c/a = 19/2 dir (tuzoq). D varianti (14) esa a ga bo'linmagan xato natijadir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Desmos hack: y = 2x^2 - 14x + 19 grafigini chizing. Ikkala x-kesishmasini (roots) bosing: 1.838 va 5.162. Ularni qo'shsangiz 1.838 + 5.162 = 7 chiqadi.

sample_test_questions.question: The graphs of y = x^2 - 6x + 11 and y = 2x - 4 intersect at points (x1, y1) and (x2, y2). What is the value of x1 + x2?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Qadam-baqadam yechim: Kesishish nuqtalarida y lar teng: x^2 - 6x + 11 = 2x - 4. Barcha hadlarni chap tomonga o'tkazamiz: x^2 - 8x + 15 = 0. Bizdan kesishish nuqtalarining x koordinatalari yig'indisi x1 + x2 so'ralgan. Viyet teoremasiga ko'ra ildizlar yig'indisi: -(-8)/1 = 8. (Haqiqatan ham (x - 3)(x - 5) = 0 bo'lib, x1 = 3, x2 = 5 => 3 + 5 = 8). To'g'ri javob: A. B varianti (6) asl parabolaning nishabini inobatga olmaganda keladi. C varianti (15) ildizlar ko'paytmasi (tuzoq). D varianti xato ayirish natijasidir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Desmos hack: y = x^2 - 6x + 11 va y = 2x - 4 ni kiriting. Ikkala kesishish nuqtasini bosing: (3, 2) va (5, 6). x lar yig'indisi: 3 + 5 = 8.

sample_test_questions.question: The function g is defined by g(x) = -3(x - 4)^2 + 27. What is the maximum value of g(x)?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Qadam-baqadam tahlil: Kvadrat funksiya cho'qqi (vertex) shaklida berilgan: g(x) = a(x - h)^2 + k. Bu yerda a = -3 < 0, demak parabola shoxlari pastga qaragan va funksiya o'zining eng katta (maximum) qiymatiga x = h nuqtada erishadi. x = 4 bo'lganda -3(4 - 4)^2 = 0 bo'lib, maksimal qiymat g(4) = 27 bo'ladi. To'g'ri javob: A. B varianti (4) bu maksimumga erishiladigan x nuqtasi (tuzoq). C va D variantlari noto'g'ri hisoblashlar natijasidir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Desmos hack: g(x) = -3(x - 4)^2 + 27 ni yozing va parabolaning cho'qqisini bosing: (4, 27). Maksimum qiymat y-koordinata, ya'ni 27 ga teng.

sample_test_questions.question: Consider the radical equation given by sqrt(3x + 7) = x - 1. Which of the following statements correctly describes the set of all real solutions to this equation?

options.text: x = 6 is the only real solution
x = -1 is the only real solution
Both x = 6 and x = -1 are real solutions

sample_test_questions.explanation: Qadam-baqadam tahlil va tuzoqlarni fosh qilish: Ikkala tomonni kvadratga oshiramiz: 3x + 7 = (x - 1)^2 => 3x + 7 = x^2 - 2x + 1 => x^2 - 5x - 6 = 0 => (x - 6)(x + 1) = 0. Nomzodlar: x = 6 va x = -1. Ildizli tenglamalarda begona ildizlarni (extraneous solutions) tekshirish shart: x=6 da sqrt(25) = 5 va 6-1=5 (haqiqiy yechim). x=-1 da sqrt(4)=2, lekin -1-1=-2, ya'ni 2 != -2 (begona ildiz!). Shuning uchun A varianti to'g'ri. B varianti xato, chunki x=-1 qanoatlantirmaydi. C varianti klassik chalg'ituvchi tuzoq bo'lib, tekshiruv qilmaganlar uchun mo'ljallangan xato. D varianti ham noto'g'ri.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Desmos hack: y1 = sqrt(3x + 7) va y2 = x - 1 deb kiriting. Ular faqat bitta nuqtada (6, 5) kesishadi. Begona ildiz x = -1 da kesishish yo'q!

sample_test_questions.question: Which of the following expressions is equivalent to (x^2 - 4x - 12) / (x^2 - 36) for all x where the expression is defined?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Qadam-baqadam yechim: Suratni ko'paytuvchilarga ajratamiz: x^2 - 4x - 12 = (x - 6)(x + 2). Maxrajni kvadratlar ayirmasi bo'yicha ajratamiz: x^2 - 36 = (x - 6)(x + 6). Kasrni soddalashtirsak: [(x - 6)(x + 2)] / [(x - 6)(x + 6)] = (x + 2) / (x + 6). Shuning uchun to'g'ri javob A. B, C, D variantlari ko'paytuvchilarga ajratishda ishoralarni almashtirib yuborish natijasida hosil bo'ladigan xato variantlardir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Desmos hack: Asl kasrga x=0 qo'ying: -12 / -36 = 1/3. Variantlarga x=0 qo'ying: A) (0+2)/(0+6) = 2/6 = 1/3. Faqat A to'g'ri keladi!

sat_mocks.title: Digital SAT Mock #26: College Board Bank Adaptive Mock 6

sample_test_questions.passage:
Text 1
Astronomer Alan Stern asserts that the definition of a planet adopted by the International Astronomical Union (IAU) in 2006 is fundamentally flawed. By requiring a celestial body to have 'cleared the neighborhood around its orbit,' the IAU criterion ties planetary status to dynamic orbital distance rather than intrinsic physical properties. Under this definition, an Earth-mass object placed in the Kuiper Belt would fail to qualify as a planet simply because its orbital zone is too vast to clear.

Text 2
Astronomer Michael Brown defends the IAU dynamical classification, emphasizing that orbital clearing marks a profound qualitative evolutionary threshold in solar system formation. Objects that clear their orbits contain more than 99 percent of the remaining mass in their orbital zones, allowing them to govern the trajectories of all surrounding debris. Focusing solely on intrinsic geophysics ignores the defining gravitational role that true planets play in sculpting planetary architecture.
sample_test_questions.question: On which point would Stern (Text 1) and Brown (Text 2) most likely agree?

options.text: The IAU's 'clearing the neighborhood' criterion is dependent on an object's orbital environment rather than its internal physical attributes alone.
Pluto possesses sufficient gravitational dominance to dictate the orbital stability of Neptune.
Planetary definitions should prioritize historical cultural nomenclature over astrophysical metrics.
An object with the mass of Earth in the Kuiper Belt would successfully clear all nearby asteroids.

sample_test_questions.explanation:
To'g'ri javob: A.

Matnlar tahlili:
Text 1 muallifi Stern IAU mezonini aynan orbital muhitga bog'liq bo'lib qolgani ('ties planetary status to dynamic orbital distance rather than intrinsic physical properties') uchun tanqid qiladi.
Text 2 muallifi Brown esa bu mezon orbital muhit va tortishish kuchi bilan atrofni boshqarishiga asoslanganini tasdiqlaydi ('orbital clearing marks a profound... gravitational role in sculpting planetary architecture') va buni to'g'ri deb himoya qiladi.
Demak, har ikki olim ham IAU ning 'orbitani tozalash' mezoni ichki jismoniy xususiyatlarga emas, orbital muhit va dinamikaga bog'liq ekanligiga birdek rozi bo'lishadi (A variant).

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
B) Pluton Neptun barqarorligini belgilaydi degan fikr yo'q.
C) Madaniy/tarixiy nomlanishni astrofizikadan ustun qo'yish kerak deyilmagan.
D) Stern aynan Kuiper belbog'idagi Yer massasidagi jism orbitani tozalay olmasligini aytadi, Brown bunga qarshi chiqmaydi.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ MATNLAR ARO TAKTIKA: Har ikkala muallifning markaziy da'vosini aniqlang va 2-matn 1-matnga qanday munosabat bildirishini qidiring.

sample_test_questions.passage:
Text 1
Advocates of degrowth argue that perpetual GDP expansion on a finite planet is an ecological impossibility. They maintain that reducing aggregate throughput—the physical extraction and consumption of raw materials—is the only viable strategy to avert climate destabilization and resource exhaustion.

Text 2
Ecomodernists counter that decoupling economic value from material consumption is not only theoretically possible but already underway in industrialized nations. Through digitization, energy-efficiency gains, and advanced nuclear power, economies can continue expanding their financial and human development indicators while drastically contracting their net carbon footprints.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice best describes the central point of disagreement between the authors?

options.text: Whether sustained economic growth can be reconciled with ecological sustainability.
Whether nuclear energy produces zero greenhouse gas emissions during operation.
Whether industrialized nations currently consume more resources than developing nations.
Whether GDP accurately reflects the subjective well-being of national populations.

sample_test_questions.explanation:
To'g'ri javob: A.

Matnlar tahlili:
1-matn muallifi cheklangan sayyorada iqtisodiy o'sishni davom ettirish ekologik jihatdan imkonsiz ekanini ('ecological impossibility') aytadi.
2-matn muallifi esa yangi texnologiyalar orqali iqtisodiyot o'sishda davom etishi va shu bilan birga ekologiyaga ta'sirni kamaytirishi mumkinligini ('decoupling... is not only theoretically possible but already underway') ta'kidlaydi.
Demak, ularning asosiy bahs nuqtasi: barqaror iqtisodiy o'sishni ekologik barqarorlik bilan uyg'unlashtirish mumkinmi yoki yo'qmi (A variant).

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
B) Yadro energiyasi emissiyasi bo'yicha alohida bahs yo'q.
C) Rivojlangan va rivojlanayotgan davlatlar iste'moli taqqoslanmagan.
D) YaIM subyektiv baxtni o'lchay oladimi degan savol ko'tarilmagan.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ MATNLAR ARO TAKTIKA: Har ikkala muallifning markaziy da'vosini aniqlang va 2-matn 1-matnga qanday munosabat bildirishini qidiring.

sample_test_questions.passage:
Text 1
In historical linguistics, the comparative method reconstructs proto-languages by identifying systematic phonetic correspondences across descendant tongues. Proponents assert that regular sound laws operate mechanically without exceptions, allowing researchers to establish genealogical language family trees with mathematical rigor.

Text 2
Dialectologists emphasizing areal linguistics note that languages frequently borrow grammatical structures, lexical items, and phonological features across genetic boundaries via sustained trade and geographical proximity. This phenomenon of convergence, or 'wave propagation,' frequently blurs phylogenetic boundaries, rendering tree models misleading representations of linguistic history.
sample_test_questions.question: Based on the texts, the author of Text 2 would most likely characterize the 'mathematical rigor' claimed in Text 1 as:

options.text: an oversimplified metric that obscures the messy reality of cross-linguistic borrowing.
a proven framework that successfully accounts for all dialect contact phenomena.
an outdated relic that has been completely discarded by all modern linguists.
a valuable approach that is solely applicable to written alphabetic languages.

sample_test_questions.explanation:
To'g'ri javob: A.

Matnlar tahlili:
1-matn fonetik qonunlar qat'iy mexanik va istisnosiz ishlaydi deb da'vo qiladi, bu esa 'matematik aniqlik' (mathematical rigor) bilan til oilasi daraxtini qurishga imkon beradi.
2-matn esa tillar o'zaro qo'shnichilik va savdo orqali qardosh bo'lmagan holda ham grammatika va so'zlarni o'zlashtirishini ('cross genetic boundaries'), bu esa shajarali daraxt modellarini chalg'ituvchi (misleading) qilib qo'yishini ta'kidlaydi.
Demak, 2-matn muallifi 1-matndagi 'matematik aniqlik'ni tillar o'rtasidagi chalkash o'zlashtirish jarayonlarini e'tibordan chetda qoldiruvchi haddan tashqari soddalashtirilgan o'lchov (A variant) deb hisoblaydi.

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
B) Kontakt fenomenlarini hisobga oluvchi isbotlangan model deb maqtamaydi.
C) Butunlay barcha zamonaviy tilshunoslar tomonidan tashlab yuborilgan deb rad etilmagan.
D) Faqat yozma alifboli tillarga tegishli degan cheklov aytilmagan.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ MATNLAR ARO TAKTIKA: Har ikkala muallifning markaziy da'vosini aniqlang va 2-matn 1-matnga qanday munosabat bildirishini qidiring.

sample_test_questions.passage:
Text 1
Laboratory experiments demonstrate that cultivating plants under blue-enriched light-emitting diodes (LEDs) stimulates stomatal opening and enhances photosynthetic gas exchange, resulting in faster leaf expansion during initial vegetative development.

Text 2
While horticulturalists acknowledge the positive vegetative effects of blue LEDs, commercial greenhouse trials demonstrate that prolonged exclusive exposure to blue wavelengths causes photomorphogenic dwarfism, producing stout stems but severely stunting overall biomass accumulation.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice best summarizes the shared topic of both texts?

options.text: The developmental consequences of blue LED illumination on plant physiology.
The cost efficiency of LED fixtures compared to traditional sodium lamps.
The genetic modification of agricultural crops to survive low-light environments.
The impact of ambient humidity on stomatal conductance in flowering plants.

sample_test_questions.explanation:
To'g'ri javob: A.

Matnlar tahlili:
Har ikkala matnda ham ko'k spektrdagi LED yoritgichlarning o'simliklarning rivojlanishiga (fotosintez, barg kengayishi, poya bo'yi va biomassa) ta'siri haqida so'z boradi. Demak, ularning umumiy mavzusi ko'k LED yorug'ligining o'simlik fiziologiyasiga ko'rsatadigan ta'siridir (A variant).

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
B) Natriy lampalari bilan xarajat samaradorligi taqqoslanmagan.
C) Genetik modifikatsiya haqida gap yo'q.
D) Havoning namligi ta'siri haqida emas.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ MATNLAR ARO TAKTIKA: Har ikkala muallifning markaziy da'vosini aniqlang va 2-matn 1-matnga qanday munosabat bildirishini qidiring.

sample_test_questions.passage: In the arid Atacama Desert of Chile, certain hypolithic cyanobacteria survive not by drawing water from the parched soil, but by colonizing the undersides of translucent quartz pebbles. During early morning fog events, water vapor condenses preferentially along the cooler mineral surfaces. Concurrently, the quartz acts as a natural optical filter: it scatters intense ultraviolet radiation while transmitting sufficient photosynthetically active radiation for metabolic survival.
sample_test_questions.question: According to the text, which dual function does the translucent quartz serve for the hypolithic cyanobacteria?

options.text: It collects condensed moisture and provides radiation shielding while permitting photosynthesis.
It absorbs ambient carbon monoxide and releases essential subterranean nutrients.
It warms the surrounding soil during freezing nights and stores solar heat.
It reflects all incoming solar light to prevent cellular dehydration.

sample_test_questions.explanation:
To'g'ri javob: A.

Matn tahlili:
Matnda kvars toshlari ikki xil vazifani bajarishi ochiq bayon qilingan:
1) 'water vapor condenses preferentially along the cooler mineral surfaces' (namlikni kondensatsiyalash / yig'ish);
2) 'scatters intense ultraviolet radiation while transmitting sufficient photosynthetically active radiation' (zararli ultrabinafsha nurlanishdan himoya qilish va fotosintez uchun yetarli yorug'lik o'tkazish).
Bu ikki vazifa A variantda aniq umumlashtirilgan.

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
B) Is gazi (carbon monoxide) yoki yer osti moddalari haqida gap yo'q.
C) Tuproqni isitish va issiqlik saqlash aytilmagan.
D) Barcha quyosh nurini qaytarmaydi, aksincha fotosintez nurlarini o'tkazadi.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ ASOSIY FIKR STRATEGIYASI: Xulosaviy jumla va asosiy dalilni toping; matndan tashqari qo'shimcha fikrlardan qoching.

sample_test_questions.passage: The development of steam-powered rotary printing presses in the mid-nineteenth century revolutionized publishing economics. By replacing manual lever presses that produced fewer than 250 sheets per hour with mechanized rollers capable of printing upwards of 10,000 sheets hourly, printers dramatically lowered unit production costs. Consequently, newspapers transformed from expensive subscriptions reserved for mercantile elites into affordable daily broadsheets accessible to the urban working class.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice best states the main idea of the text?

options.text: Mechanized rotary presses slashed newspaper printing costs, democratizing access to daily news.
Manual lever presses remained popular among rural printers due to their superior typographic quality.
Steam power primarily benefited nineteenth-century book publishers rather than newspaper syndicates.
Working-class literacy rates were the sole driving factor behind mechanical printing innovations.

sample_test_questions.explanation:
To'g'ri javob: A.

Matn tahlili:
Matn bug'li aylanma bosmaxona stanoklari soatiga 250 varaqdan 10,000 varaqqa oshirgani, bu esa tannarxni keskin tushirgani va natijada gazetalarni elita mulkidan oddiy ishchilar o'qiy oladigan arzon nashrga aylantirgani haqida. Bu aynan A variantdagi 'mexanizatsiyalashgan stanoklar bosma xarajatlarni qisqartirdi va kundalik yangiliklardan foydalanishni ommalashtirdi/demokratlashtirdi' degan bosh g'oyadir.

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
B) Qo'l stanoklari qishloqda ommabop bo'lib qolgani aytilmagan.
C) Asosan kitob nashriyotlariga foyda keltirdi deyilmagan (gazetalar misol keltirilgan).
D) Ishchilarning savodxonligi yagona harakatlantiruvchi kuch bo'lgan degan da'vo yo'q.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ ASOSIY FIKR STRATEGIYASI: Xulosaviy jumla va asosiy dalilni toping; matndan tashqari qo'shimcha fikrlardan qoching.

sample_test_questions.passage: Sociologist Pierre Bourdieu proposed the concept of 'cultural capital' to explain how social stratification reproduces across generations without explicit legal coercion. Bourdieu argued that elite families endow their offspring with tacit linguistic fluency, aesthetic sensibilities, and credentialed educational credentials that are subtly recognized and rewarded by academic institutions. Because schools mistakenly treat these socially transmitted dispositions as innate intellectual merit, children from disadvantaged backgrounds are systematically marginalized under the guise of an objective meritocracy.
sample_test_questions.question: According to Bourdieu's theory as outlined in the text, why do educational institutions reinforce existing class divisions?

options.text: They misattribute cultivated cultural dispositions to innate scholarly capability.
They enforce explicit legal quotas that restrict university enrollment by social caste.
They reject conventional testing methodologies in favor of subjective vocational assessments.
They prioritize financial donations from wealthy alumni over standardized exam performance.

sample_test_questions.explanation:
To'g'ri javob: A.

Matn tahlili:
Matndagi asosiy jumlaga e'tibor qaratamiz: 'Because schools mistakenly treat these socially transmitted dispositions as innate intellectual merit, children from disadvantaged backgrounds are systematically marginalized...'.
Ya'ni maktablar oiladan o'tgan madaniy ko'nikmalarni tug'ma aqliy iqtidor deb xato baholaydi va shu tariqa mavjud tabaqalanishni mustahkamlaydi. Bu to'g'ridan-to'g'ri A variantga to'g'ri keladi.

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
B) Matnda 'without explicit legal coercion' deyilgan, ochiq qonuniy kvotalar yo'q.
C) Kasbiy baholash usullari haqida aytilmagan.
D) Homiy xayriyalari haqida gap bormayapti.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ ASOSIY FIKR STRATEGIYASI: Xulosaviy jumla va asosiy dalilni toping; matndan tashqari qo'shimcha fikrlardan qoching.

sample_test_questions.passage: Unlike mammalian red blood cells, which eject their nuclei and mitochondria during maturation to maximize hemoglobin packing efficiency, avian erythrocytes retain functional nuclei and mitochondria throughout their circulatory lifespans. Biologists hypothesize that the persistence of mitochondria in bird erythrocytes supports the immense aerobic metabolic demands of prolonged powered flight, supplying localized ATP during intense endurance exercise.
sample_test_questions.question: Which finding regarding avian erythrocytes is explicitly stated in the text?

options.text: They maintain operational mitochondria and cell nuclei as mature circulating cells.
They carry significantly less total oxygen per volume than any mammalian red blood cells.
They lack the ability to synthesize ATP under low-oxygen atmospheric conditions.
They are generated exclusively in the lung tissues rather than in the bone marrow.

sample_test_questions.explanation:
To'g'ri javob: A.

Matn tahlili:
Matnda aniq aytilgan: 'avian erythrocytes retain functional nuclei and mitochondria throughout their circulatory lifespans' (qushlarning qizil qon tanachalari o'zlarining butun qon aylanish davrida ishchi yadro va mitoxondriyalarni saqlab qoladi). Bu aynan A variantda takrorlangan.

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
B) Sut emizuvchilardan kamroq kislorod tashiydi degan fakt yo'q.
C) Past kislorodda ATF sintez qila olmaydi deyilmagan.
D) O'pkada hosil bo'lishi haqida gap yo'q.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ ASOSIY FIKR STRATEGIYASI: Xulosaviy jumla va asosiy dalilni toping; matndan tashqari qo'shimcha fikrlardan qoching.

sample_test_questions.passage: A team of neurobiologists investigated whether enriched olfactory environments could retard age-related neurodegeneration in laboratory mice. The researchers placed 18-month-old mice in cages infused with four novel natural fragrances daily for 12 weeks, while a control group remained in standard odorless air. At the conclusion of the trial, fragrance-exposed mice exhibited a 35 percent increase in hippocampal neurogenesis and significantly higher scores on spatial memory maze tests compared to controls.
sample_test_questions.question: Which finding, if true, would most directly bolster the researchers' conclusion that the olfactory stimulation itself caused the cognitive improvements?

options.text: Control mice and fragrance-exposed mice engaged in identical amounts of physical wheel running and food consumption.
Fragrance-exposed mice showed increased levels of aggressive social interaction compared to baseline measurements.
Fragrance compounds were detected in trace quantities inside the digestive tracts of the test subjects.
Mice naturally lose their sense of smell completely within the first six months of adulthood.

sample_test_questions.explanation:
To'g'ri javob: A.

Matn tahlili:
Tadqiqotchilar hidlar (olfactory stimulation) sichqonlarda xotira va neyrogenezni yaxshilagan deb xulosa qilishmoqda. Bu xulosani mustahkamlash uchun alternativ tushuntirishlarni (masalan, tajriba guruhidagi sichqonlar hidlar sababli ko'proq yugurgan yoki ko'proq ovqatlangan bo'lishi mumkinligi) istisno qilish kerak. Agar ikki guruhdagi sichqonlarning jismoniy mashg'uloti va ovqatlanishi mutlaqo bir xil bo'lgan bo'lsa (A variant), yaxshilanish aynan hidlar ta'sirida bo'lgani qat'iy isbotlanadi.

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
B) Agressivlikning oshishi kognitiv sabab-oqibatni isbotlamaydi.
C) Oshqozonda hid birikmalarining bo'lishi miyadagi ta'sirni isbotlamaydi.
D) Sichqonlar 6 oyligida hid bilishni yo'qotsa, 18 oylik sichqonlar hidni umuman sezmagan bo'lib chiqadi va tadqiqot asossiz bo'lib qoladi.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ DALIL TANLASH QOIDASI: Gipotezani bevosita qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan yoki inkor etadigan eng aniq empirik faktni qidiring.

sample_test_questions.passage: Archaeologists studying the collapse of the Classic Maya center of Copán hypothesized that widespread deforestation on upland slopes caused severe soil erosion, which filled agricultural valley floors with infertile sediments and triggered systemic famine. To evaluate this hypothesis, a geoarchaeologist analyzed sequential sedimentary layers from oxbow lakes in the Copán Valley.
sample_test_questions.question: Which finding from the sediment analysis, if true, would most strongly challenge the researchers' hypothesis?
