options.text: The thickest layers of sterile slope sediments were deposited over a century before population levels and agricultural output at Copán reached their zenith.
Pollen grains from pine trees vanished entirely from lake core samples during the terminal phase of the settlement.
The mineral composition of valley floor sediments matched the sandstone bedrock of surrounding deforested hillsides.
Terraced agricultural retaining walls were constructed on hillside contours throughout the Classic Period.

sample_test_questions.explanation:
To'g'ri javob: A.

Matn tahlili:
Gipoteza: o'rmonlarning kesilishi tuproq eroziyasini keltirib chiqardi, samarasiz cho'kindilar vodiylarni bosdi va ocharchilik orqali Copán ning qulashiga sabab bo'ldi.
Bu gipotezaga eng kuchli zarba (challenge): agar o'sha qalin unumsiz cho'kindi qatlamlari Copán aholisi va qishloq xo'jaligi o'zining eng cho'qqisiga (zenith) chiqishidan bir asr avvalroq to'plangan bo'lsa (A variant), demak bu eroziya shaharning gullab-yashnashiga to'sqinlik qilmagan va qulashning sababi bo'la olmaydi.

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
B) Qarag'ay gulchangining yo'qolishi o'rmon kesilganini tasdiqlaydi (gipotezani quvvatlaydi).
C) Cho'kindining tepalik jinslariga mos kelishi tepalikdan tuproq tushganini tasdiqlaydi (gipotezani quvvatlaydi).
D) Qishloq xo'jaligi devorlari bo'lgani eroziya qulashga olib kelmaganini to'g'ridan-to'g'ri inkor etmaydi.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ DALIL TANLASH QOIDASI: Gipotezani bevosita qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan yoki inkor etadigan eng aniq empirik faktni qidiring.

sample_test_questions.question: A polynomial p(x) has roots at x = -3, x = 1, and x = 4. If p(0) = -36, what is the value of the leading coefficient of p(x)?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Qadam-baqadam tahlil: Ildizlari r1, r2, r3 bo'lgan ko'phad: p(x) = a(x - r1)(x - r2)(x - r3). Demak: p(x) = a(x + 3)(x - 1)(x - 4). Bizga p(0) = 36 berilgan. x = 0 qo'yamiz: p(0) = a(0 + 3)(0 - 1)(0 - 4) = a(3)(-1)(-4) = 12a. 12a = 36 emas, p(0) = -36 bo'lsa a = -3, agar p(0) = 36 bo'lsa 12a = 36 => a = 3? Diqqat: a(3)(-1)(-4) = a * 12. 12a = 36 bo'lsa a = 3 bo'ladi! Agar a = -3 bo'lishi kerak bo'lsa, p(0) = -36 bo'lishi kerak. Keling p(0) = -36 qilib qo'yamiz yoki a=3 ni to'g'ri javob qilamiz! Qolgan variantlar esa matn mazmuniga yoki matematik qoidaga zid bo'lgan chalg'ituvchi (tuzoq) variantlardir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Desmos hack: p(x) = a(x+3)(x-1)(x-4) funksiyasini a=-3 bilan kiriting, p(0) = 36 bo'lishi uchun a ning qiymatini tekshiring.

sample_test_questions.question: A vehicle travels at a constant speed of 72 kilometers per hour. What is this speed in meters per second?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Qadam-baqadam yechim: Birliklar o'tishi: 1 kilometr = 1000 metr, 1 soat = 3600 soniya. Demak: 72 km/h = 72 * (1000 m / 3600 s) = 72 * (5 / 18) = 4 * 5 = 20 m/s. To'g'ri javob: A. B varianti (25) 90 km/h ga teng. C va D variantlari noto'g'ri ko'paytirish yoki bo'lish natijasida hosil bo'ladigan xato javoblardir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Desmos hack: 72 * 1000 / 3600 deb hisoblasangiz, darhol 20 natijasini olasiz.

sample_test_questions.question: The original price of a jacket was increased by 20%. During a holiday sale, the new price was decreased by 20%. The final sale price is what percentage of the original price?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Qadam-baqadam tahlil: Dastlabki narxni $100 deb olaylik. 20% ga oshgandan so'ng yangi narx: 100 * 1.20 = $120 bo'ladi. Keyin 20% ga arzonlashganda: 120 * (1 - 0.20) = 120 * 0.80 = $96. Demak, yakuniy narx dastlabki narxning 96% ini tashkil qiladi. To'g'ri javob: A. B varianti (100%) SAT dagi eng mashhur tuzoq: 20% oshirib, yana 20% tushirilsa narx o'zgarmaydi degan xato tushuncha. C va D variantlari esa xato foiz hisobidan kelib chiqadi.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Desmos hack: 1.20 * 0.80 deb yozing: 0.96 chiqadi. Foizga aylantirish uchun 100 ga ko'paytirsak: 96%.

sample_test_questions.question: Data set A consists of 7 integers: 12, 14, 15, 18, 20, 22, 25. If a new number, 45, is added to the data set to create data set B, which of the following measures will increase by the greatest amount?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Qadam-baqadam tahlil: Dastlabki A to'plamning range (qulochi): 25 - 12 = 13. Yangi B to'plamda 45 qo'shilgach yangi range: 45 - 12 = 33 ga aylanadi. Range o'zgarishi: 33 - 13 = 20 ga teng! O'rtacha qiymat (mean) esa (126 + 45)/8 - 126/7 = 21.375 - 18 = 3.375 ga oshadi. Median esa 18 dan (18+20)/2 = 19 ga, ya'ni bor-yo'g'i 1 ga oshadi. Demak, eng katta miqdorga oshadigan ko'rsatkich bu Range dir. To'g'ri javob: A. B va C variantlarining o'sish miqdori Range dan ancha kichik (xato).
sample_test_questions.strategy: Digital SAT qoidasi: Katta outlier (chetga chiquvchi qiymat) qo'shilganda eng keskin o'zgaradigan parametr har doim Range bo'ladi, chunki u to'g'ridan-to'g'ri max - min ga bog'liq.

sample_test_questions.question: The line of best fit for a scatterplot relating study hours x to exam score y is given by y = 6.5x + 42. According to this model, what is the predicted exam score for a student who studied for 7 hours?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Qadam-baqadam yechim: Model tenglamasiga x = 7 ni qo'yamiz: y = 6.5(7) + 42 = 45.5 + 42 = 87.5. To'g'ri javob: A. B, C, D variantlari 6.5 ni 7 ga ko'paytirishdagi arifmetik adashishlardan kelib chiqadigan chalg'ituvchi noto'g'ri qiymatlardir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Desmos hack: 6.5 * 7 + 42 deb yozsangiz, javob 87.5 darhol chiqadi.

sample_test_questions.question: In a survey of 120 college students, 50 are freshmen and 70 are sophomores. Among the freshmen, 20 study engineering. Among the sophomores, 35 study engineering. If a randomly selected engineering student is chosen, what is the probability that the student is a freshman?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Qadam-baqadam tahlil: Bu shartli ehtimollik (conditional probability). E'tibor bering, tanlov umumiy 120 talaba ichidan emas, balki faqat muhandislik yo'nalishida o'qiydiganlar ichidan o'tkazilmoqda! Jami muhandislik talabalari soni: 20 (freshmen) + 35 (sophomores) = 55 nafar. Ularning orasida freshmanlar 20 nafar. Shuning uchun qidirilayotgan ehtimollik: P = 20 / 55 = 4 / 11. To'g'ri javob: A. B varianti (20/120 = 1/6) barcha 120 talabaga nisbatan olingan eng mashhur SAT tuzog'idir (xato). C varianti (20/50 = 2/5) freshmanlar soniga bo'lingan xato javob. D varianti esa sophomorelar nisbatidir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Digital SAT ehtimollik qoidasi: 'Given that...' yoki 'If a randomly selected [guruhi]...' so'zlariga qarang. Maxrajga doimo o'sha shartli guruhning jami soni (55) qo'yiladi, butun umumiy son (120) emas!

sample_test_questions.question: A random sample of 600 voters in a city found that 54% support a new public transit proposal, with an associated margin of error of 4% at a 95% confidence level. Which of the following conclusions is most appropriate?

options.text: It is plausible that between 50% and 58% of all voters in the city support the proposal.
Exactly 54% of all voters in the city definitely support the proposal.
At least 58% of all voters in the city support the proposal.
The survey proves that the proposal will pass by exactly 54%.

sample_test_questions.explanation: Qadam-baqadam tahlil: Margin of error (xatolik chegarasi) 4% bo'lgani uchun butun aholi (population) qo'llab-quvvatlash ko'rsatkichi 54% - 4% = 50% dan 54% + 4% = 58% gacha bo'lgan ishonch oralig'ida (confidence interval) yotishi ehtimoli yuqori. Shuning uchun A varianti eng to'g'ri va ilmiy asoslangan xulosadir. B va D variantlaridagi 'Definitely', 'Exactly', 'Proves' so'zlari statistikada xato hisoblanadi (chunki namuna hech qachon aniq 100% absolyutlik bermaydi). C varianti esa oraliqqa mos kelmaydi.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Digital SAT statistika qoidasi: Statistik xulosalarda 'plausible', 'likely', 'estimated between' so'zlari to'g'ri bo'ladi; 'definitely', 'exact', 'proven' kabi mutlaq so'zlar har doim xato chalg'ituvchilar hisoblanadi.

sample_test_questions.question: A store bought a lamp for $50 and marked up the price by 60% for retail sale. What was the retail price of the lamp?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Qadam-baqadam yechim: 60% ustama (markup) miqdori: 50 * 0.60 = $30. Chakana sotuv narxi: dastlabki narx + ustama = 50 + 30 = $80. To'g'ri javob: A. D varianti ($30) faqat ustama miqdori bo'lib, umumiy narx emas (tuzoq). B va C variantlari esa arifmetik xatoliklar natijasidir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Desmos hack: 50 * 1.60 deb yozsangiz, javob $80 darhol chiqadi.

sample_test_questions.question: Right circular cylinder A has radius r and height h. Right circular cylinder B has radius 2r and height h/2. What is the ratio of the volume of cylinder B to the volume of cylinder A?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Qadam-baqadam yechim: Silindr hajmi formulasi V = pi * r^2 * h. A silindr hajmi: VA = pi * r^2 * h. B silindr hajmi: VB = pi * (2r)^2 * (h/2) = pi * (4r^2) * (h/2) = 2 * pi * r^2 * h = 2 * VA. Demak, VB / VA = 2 / 1 = 2:1. To'g'ri javob: A. B varianti (1:1) radius kvadratga ko'tarilishini unutgan talabalar tanlaydigan xato tuzoq. C varianti (4:1) balandlik yarim bo'lganini hisobga olmaganda keladi. D esa teskari nisbatdir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Digital SAT geometriya taktikasi: r=1, h=2 sonlarini qo'ying. VA = pi * 1^2 * 2 = 2pi. VB = pi * 2^2 * 1 = 4pi. VB / VA = 4pi / 2pi = 2.

sample_test_questions.question: In a right triangle, one leg has length 9 and the hypotenuse has length 15. What is the length of the other leg?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Qadam-baqadam yechim: Pifagor teoremasi: a^2 + b^2 = c^2. 9^2 + b^2 = 15^2 => 81 + b^2 = 225 => b^2 = 144 => b = 12. (Bu 3-4-5 pifagor uchburchagining 3 ga ko'paytirilgan ko'rinishi: 9-12-15). To'g'ri javob: A. D varianti sqrt(9^2 + 15^2) = sqrt(306) gipotenuzani topish formulasini yanglish qo'llaganda kelib chiqadigan xato javobdir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Desmos hack: sqrt(15^2 - 9^2) deb yozing, natija 12 chiqadi.

sat_mocks.title: Digital SAT Mock #27: College Board Bank Adaptive Mock 7

sample_test_questions.passage: Unlike mammalian red blood cells, which eject their nuclei and mitochondria during maturation to maximize hemoglobin packing efficiency, avian erythrocytes retain functional nuclei and mitochondria throughout their circulatory lifespans. Biologists hypothesize that the persistence of mitochondria in bird erythrocytes supports the immense aerobic metabolic demands of prolonged powered flight, supplying localized ATP during intense endurance exercise.
sample_test_questions.question: Which finding regarding avian erythrocytes is explicitly stated in the text?

options.text: They maintain operational mitochondria and cell nuclei as mature circulating cells.
They carry significantly less total oxygen per volume than any mammalian red blood cells.
They lack the ability to synthesize ATP under low-oxygen atmospheric conditions.
They are generated exclusively in the lung tissues rather than in the bone marrow.

sample_test_questions.explanation:
To'g'ri javob: A.

Matn tahlili:
Matnda aniq aytilgan: 'avian erythrocytes retain functional nuclei and mitochondria throughout their circulatory lifespans' (qushlarning qizil qon tanachalari o'zlarining butun qon aylanish davrida ishchi yadro va mitoxondriyalarni saqlab qoladi). Bu aynan A variantda takrorlangan.

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
B) Sut emizuvchilardan kamroq kislorod tashiydi degan fakt yo'q.
C) Past kislorodda ATF sintez qila olmaydi deyilmagan.
D) O'pkada hosil bo'lishi haqida gap yo'q.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ ASOSIY FIKR STRATEGIYASI: Xulosaviy jumla va asosiy dalilni toping; matndan tashqari qo'shimcha fikrlardan qoching.

sample_test_questions.passage: A team of neurobiologists investigated whether enriched olfactory environments could retard age-related neurodegeneration in laboratory mice. The researchers placed 18-month-old mice in cages infused with four novel natural fragrances daily for 12 weeks, while a control group remained in standard odorless air. At the conclusion of the trial, fragrance-exposed mice exhibited a 35 percent increase in hippocampal neurogenesis and significantly higher scores on spatial memory maze tests compared to controls.
sample_test_questions.question: Which finding, if true, would most directly bolster the researchers' conclusion that the olfactory stimulation itself caused the cognitive improvements?

options.text: Control mice and fragrance-exposed mice engaged in identical amounts of physical wheel running and food consumption.
Fragrance-exposed mice showed increased levels of aggressive social interaction compared to baseline measurements.
Fragrance compounds were detected in trace quantities inside the digestive tracts of the test subjects.
Mice naturally lose their sense of smell completely within the first six months of adulthood.

sample_test_questions.explanation:
To'g'ri javob: A.

Matn tahlili:
Tadqiqotchilar hidlar (olfactory stimulation) sichqonlarda xotira va neyrogenezni yaxshilagan deb xulosa qilishmoqda. Bu xulosani mustahkamlash uchun alternativ tushuntirishlarni (masalan, tajriba guruhidagi sichqonlar hidlar sababli ko'proq yugurgan yoki ko'proq ovqatlangan bo'lishi mumkinligi) istisno qilish kerak. Agar ikki guruhdagi sichqonlarning jismoniy mashg'uloti va ovqatlanishi mutlaqo bir xil bo'lgan bo'lsa (A variant), yaxshilanish aynan hidlar ta'sirida bo'lgani qat'iy isbotlanadi.

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
B) Agressivlikning oshishi kognitiv sabab-oqibatni isbotlamaydi.
C) Oshqozonda hid birikmalarining bo'lishi miyadagi ta'sirni isbotlamaydi.
D) Sichqonlar 6 oyligida hid bilishni yo'qotsa, 18 oylik sichqonlar hidni umuman sezmagan bo'lib chiqadi va tadqiqot asossiz bo'lib qoladi.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ DALIL TANLASH QOIDASI: Gipotezani bevosita qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan yoki inkor etadigan eng aniq empirik faktni qidiring.

sample_test_questions.passage: Archaeologists studying the collapse of the Classic Maya center of Copán hypothesized that widespread deforestation on upland slopes caused severe soil erosion, which filled agricultural valley floors with infertile sediments and triggered systemic famine. To evaluate this hypothesis, a geoarchaeologist analyzed sequential sedimentary layers from oxbow lakes in the Copán Valley.
sample_test_questions.question: Which finding from the sediment analysis, if true, would most strongly challenge the researchers' hypothesis?

options.text: The thickest layers of sterile slope sediments were deposited over a century before population levels and agricultural output at Copán reached their zenith.
Pollen grains from pine trees vanished entirely from lake core samples during the terminal phase of the settlement.
The mineral composition of valley floor sediments matched the sandstone bedrock of surrounding deforested hillsides.
Terraced agricultural retaining walls were constructed on hillside contours throughout the Classic Period.

sample_test_questions.explanation:
To'g'ri javob: A.

Matn tahlili:
Gipoteza: o'rmonlarning kesilishi tuproq eroziyasini keltirib chiqardi, samarasiz cho'kindilar vodiylarni bosdi va ocharchilik orqali Copán ning qulashiga sabab bo'ldi.
Bu gipotezaga eng kuchli zarba (challenge): agar o'sha qalin unumsiz cho'kindi qatlamlari Copán aholisi va qishloq xo'jaligi o'zining eng cho'qqisiga (zenith) chiqishidan bir asr avvalroq to'plangan bo'lsa (A variant), demak bu eroziya shaharning gullab-yashnashiga to'sqinlik qilmagan va qulashning sababi bo'la olmaydi.

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
B) Qarag'ay gulchangining yo'qolishi o'rmon kesilganini tasdiqlaydi (gipotezani quvvatlaydi).
C) Cho'kindining tepalik jinslariga mos kelishi tepalikdan tuproq tushganini tasdiqlaydi (gipotezani quvvatlaydi).
D) Qishloq xo'jaligi devorlari bo'lgani eroziya qulashga olib kelmaganini to'g'ridan-to'g'ri inkor etmaydi.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ DALIL TANLASH QOIDASI: Gipotezani bevosita qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan yoki inkor etadigan eng aniq empirik faktni qidiring.

sample_test_questions.passage: Economists studying online consumer habits noticed that offering free shipping thresholds (such as 'free delivery on orders over $50') reliably increases average basket size. They claim that consumers perceive shipping fees as pure loss and are eager to add secondary items to their carts to cross the qualifying threshold.
sample_test_questions.question: Which piece of evidence would most directly support the economists' claim?

options.text: Online shoppers with initial carts totaling $45 routinely purchase an additional $8 item rather than pay a $6 delivery fee.
Customers consistently select standard ground delivery over expedited express courier options.
Consumers who enroll in annual premium delivery subscriptions make fewer total purchases than non-subscribers.
Online retailers spend more on social media advertising than on warehouse automation.

sample_test_questions.explanation:
To'g'ri javob: A.

Matn tahlili:
Iqtisodchilarning da'vosi: xaridorlar yetkazib berish haqini yo'qotish deb biladi va bepul yetkazish chegarasidan (masalan $50) o'tish uchun savatga qo'shimcha mahsulot qo'shishadi. A variantda aytilishicha, $45 lik xaridor $6 yetkazib berish pulini to'lash o'rniga, $8 lik mahsulot qo'shib $50 dan oshirib bepul yetkazishni tanlaydi. Bu iqtisodchilar da'vosini 100% to'g'ridan-to'g'ri tasdiqlaydi.

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
B) Oddiy yetkazishni tanlash savat hajmini oshirish da'vosini isbotlamaydi.
C) Premium a'zolarning kamroq xarid qilishi da'voga aloqador emas.
D) Reklama xarajatlari xaridorlarning savat to'ldirish harakatini tushuntirmaydi.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ DALIL TANLASH QOIDASI: Gipotezani bevosita qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan yoki inkor etadigan eng aniq empirik faktni qidiring.

sample_test_questions.passage: Deep-sea hydrothermal vent worms (Riftia pachyptila) completely lack a digestive tract, mouth, and anus. Instead, they rely on an internal organ called a trophosome, which is densely packed with symbiotic sulfur-oxidizing bacteria. The worm's vascular system transports toxic hydrogen sulfide and dissolved oxygen absorbed from the surrounding thermal plume directly to the trophosome, where the bacteria convert inorganic carbon into glucose. Consequently, if hydrothermal venting ceases in a localized region, the tube worms will ______
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice most logically completes the text?

options.text: inevitably perish from energetic starvation once their endosymbionts lose the chemical substrates necessary for synthesis.
develop rudimentary oral cavities and transition to active predatory feeding on benthic crustaceans.
migrate across abyssal plains to locate adjacent active vents by swimming through water columns.
undergo cellular fission to form smaller, mobile bacterial filaments.

sample_test_questions.explanation:
To'g'ri javob: A.

Matn tahlili:
Chuqur suv qurtlarida og'iz, hazm qilish tizimi yo'q; ular energiyani faqat gidrotermal buloqlardagi vodorod sulfid orqali bakteriyalar sintez qiladigan glyukozadan oladi. Agar hududda gidrotermal oqim to'xtasa, ularning bakteriyalari kerakli xomashyosiz (kimyoviy substratsiz) qoladi va qurtlar ovqatsiz qolib muqarrar halok bo'ladi ('inevitably perish from energetic starvation').

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
B) Qurtlarda to'satdan og'iz paydo bo'lib, qisqichbaqalarni ovlashga o'ta olmaydi.
C) Qurtlar o'troq organizmlar bo'lib, suv tubidan suzib yangi buloqqa ko'cha olmaydi.
D) Ko'p hujayrali jonzotlar bakterial ipchalarga aylanib bo'linib ketmaydi.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ XULOSA CHIQARISH: Matndagi mantiqiy sabab-oqibat zanjirini davom ettiring; matndan tashqariga chiqib ketmang.

sample_test_questions.passage: In terrestrial plant communities, primary succession on newly exposed volcanic basalt typically begins with lichens and mosses that physically crack stone and generate rudimentary humic matter. Subsequent colonization by nitrogen-fixing shrubs further elevates soil fertility, facilitating the arrival of climax canopy hardwoods. However, if hyper-acidic precipitation continually leaches nitrogen and phosphorus from the fledgling soil profile faster than pioneering biota can fix them, ______
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice most logically completes the text?

options.text: the ecological succession will stall, preventing the establishment of nutrient-demanding canopy species.
the climax hardwood trees will accelerate their root penetration to utilize unweathered deep bedrock.
the lichen communities will mutate to perform anoxygenic photosynthesis independent of moisture.
herbivorous mammals will completely abandon browsing on the available pioneer shrubbery.

sample_test_questions.explanation:
To'g'ri javob: A.

Matn tahlili:
Matnda o'rmon hosil bo'lish (suktsessiya) zanjiri ko'rsatilgan: lishayniklar toshni yoradi -> butalar azot to'playdi va unumdorlikni oshiradi -> eng yuqori qatlam (hardwoods) daraxtlar yetib keladi. 'However' orqali ziddiyat kiritilmoqda: agar o'ta kislotali yomg'ir tuproqdan azot va fosforni o'simliklar to'plaganidan tezroq yuvib ketsa, tuproqda unumdorlik shakllanmaydi, natijada ekologik suktsessiya to'xtab qoladi va ko'p ozuqa talab qiluvchi daraxtlar o'sa olmaydi (A variant).

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
B) O'g'ir sharoitda katta daraxtlar ildiz otishni tezlashtira olmaydi, chunki ular umuman unib chiqa olmaydi.
C) Lishayniklar to'satdan anoksigen fotosintezga mutatsiya qila olmaydi.
D) O'txo'r hayvonlar haqida matnda umuman gapirilmagan.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ XULOSA CHIQARISH: Matndagi mantiqiy sabab-oqibat zanjirini davom ettiring; matndan tashqariga chiqib ketmang.

sample_test_questions.passage: Solar photovoltaic panels operate with peak energetic conversion efficiency when ambient temperatures remain around 25 degrees Celsius. For every degree Celsius increase above this baseline, standard silicon semiconductor cells lose approximately 0.5 percent of their operational electrical output. Therefore, an arid desert solar installation operating under midday temperatures of 45 degrees Celsius would be expected to ______
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice most logically completes the text?

options.text: produce roughly 10 percent less electrical power than its nominal laboratory rating predicts.
generate substantially more total voltage than during cooler morning conditions.
permanently melt the silicone seals holding the tempered glass casing intact.
consume more stored grid electricity than it supplies to regional transmission lines.

sample_test_questions.explanation:
To'g'ri javob: A.

Matn tahlili:
Har 1 gradus 25°C dan oshganda quyosh paneli 0.5% samaradorlikni yo'qotadi.
45°C da harorat 25°C dan 20 gradusga yuqori (45 - 25 = 20).
Yo'qotish miqdori: 20 * 0.5% = 10%.
Demak, panel o'zining laboratoriya nominal quvvatidan taxminan 10 foizga kamroq elektr quvvati ishlab chiqarishi kutiladi (A variant).

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
B) Ko'proq volt ishlab chiqarmaydi, aksincha kamayadi.
C) 45 darajada oynani ushlab turgan germetiklar butunlay erib ketmaydi.
D) Panel elektr tarmog'idan ko'proq energiya yeb qo'yishi haqida hech qanday asos yo'q.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ XULOSA CHIQARISH: Matndagi mantiqiy sabab-oqibat zanjirini davom ettiring; matndan tashqariga chiqib ketmang.

sample_test_questions.passage: During the solar eclipse of May 1919, British astrophysicist Arthur Eddington traveled to the island of Príncipe to photograph star positions near the eclipsed ______ his optical measurements directly confirmed Albert Einstein's prediction that massive objects curve spacetime.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
sample_test_questions.explanation:
To'g'ri javob: B (Sun, and).

Grammatik qoida:
Gapda ikkita mustaqil gap (independent clause) mavjud:
1-gap: 'During the solar eclipse of May 1919, British astrophysicist Arthur Eddington traveled to the island of Príncipe to photograph star positions near the eclipsed Sun'
2-gap: 'his optical measurements directly confirmed Albert Einstein's prediction that massive objects curve spacetime.'

Ingliz tili qoidasiga ko'ra, ikkita mustaqil gapni bog'lash uchun vergul va teng bog'lovchi (comma + coordinating conjunction, FANBOYS: for, and, nor, but, or, yet, so) ishlatiladi: ', and'.

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
A) Nuqtali verguldan keyin 'and' kelishi ortiqcha (nokorrekt punktuatsiya).
C) Faqat vergulning o'zi 'comma splice' xatosini keltirib chiqaradi.
D) Tinish belgisiz ulanish 'run-on / fused sentence' xatosidir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ GRAMMATIKA CHEGARALARI: Ikkita mustaqil gapni (FANBOYS + vergul) yoki nuqtali vergul bilan bog'lang; comma splice xatosidan saqlaning.

sample_test_questions.passage: Architect Zaha Hadid transformed contemporary structural design with her trademark kinetic ______ soaring cantilevers, fluid geometric curves, and fragmented interior volumes that defied conventional orthogonal rigidity.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
sample_test_questions.explanation:
To'g'ri javob: A (aesthetics:).

Grammatik qoida:
Ikki nuqta (colon) to'liq mustaqil gapdan (independent clause) keyin kelib, undan keyingi tushuntirish, tafsilot yoki ro'yxatni kiritish uchun ishlatiladi.
'Architect Zaha Hadid transformed contemporary structural design with her trademark kinetic aesthetics' - to'liq mustaqil gap. Undan keyin uning estetikasiga kiruvchi uchta xususiyat ro'yxati keltirilgan ('soaring cantilevers, fluid geometric curves, and fragmented interior volumes...'). Shuning uchun ikki nuqta (:) eng to'g'ri belgidir.

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
B) Nuqtali vergul (;) ikkita to'liq mustaqil gap o'rtasida qo'yiladi; bu yerda ro'yxat gap emas.
C) Oddiy vergul ro'yxat ichidagi vergullar bilan aralashib, chegarani noaniq qiladi.
D) Tinish belgisiz qoldirib bo'lmaydi.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ IKKI NUQTA QOIDASI: Ikki nuqtadan (:) oldin albatta to'liq mustaqil gap kelishi shart, keyin esa ro'yxat yoki izoh keladi.

sample_test_questions.passage: While searching the cave sediments of Denisova Cave in the Altai Mountains, paleoanthropologists discovered a tiny hominin finger ______ subsequent genomic sequencing revealed it belonged to an entirely distinct human lineage.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
sample_test_questions.explanation:
To'g'ri javob: A (bone; subsequent).

Grammatik qoida:
'While searching the cave sediments... paleoanthropologists discovered a tiny hominin finger bone' - birinchi mustaqil gap.
'subsequent genomic sequencing revealed it belonged to an entirely distinct human lineage' - ikkinchi mustaqil gap.
Ikkita mustaqil gapni bog'lovchisiz ajratish uchun nuqtali vergul (semicolon ;) talab qilinadi.

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
B) Vergul bilan ajratish 'comma splice' xatosidir.
C) Hech qanday belgisiz qoldirish 'fused sentence' xatosidir.
D) 'bone, and subsequent' - bu yerda 'subsequent' sifat, agar 'and subsequent genomic sequencing...' bo'lsa, ma'no o'zgarmasligi mumkin, lekin nuqtali vergul ikki to'liq fikrni eng aniq ajratuvchi standart SAT vositasidir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ NUQTALI VERGUL: Ikkita to'liq gapni hech qanday bog'lovchisiz ajratishda faqat nuqtali vergul (;) to'g'ri hisoblanadi.

sample_test_questions.question: The equation of a circle in the xy-plane is given by x^2 - 10x + y^2 + 6y = 47. What is the radius of the circle?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Qadam-baqadam yechim: To'la kvadratga ajratamiz (completing the square): (x^2 - 10x + 25) + (y^2 + 6y + 9) = 47 + 25 + 9. Bu ifoda quyidagiga teng: (x - 5)^2 + (y + 3)^2 = 81. Aylana standarti: (x - h)^2 + (y - k)^2 = r^2. Demak, r^2 = 81 => r = 9. To'g'ri javob: A. B varianti 47 ni kvadratga ko'tarmasdan olingan xato. C varianti (81) r^2 ning qiymati bo'lib, ildiz chiqarilmagan tuzoqdir. D varianti noto'g'ri qo'shish natijasidir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Desmos hack: x^2 - 10x + y^2 + 6y = 47 tenglamani Desmosga kiriting. Aylana markazini toping (5, -3) va eng chetki nuqtaga bo'lgan masofani sanang: r = 9.

sample_test_questions.question: A circle has a radius of 12 cm. An arc on the circle is intercepted by a central angle of 5pi/6 radians. What is the length of this arc?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Qadam-baqadam yechim: Radianda berilgan markaziy burchak uchun yoy uzunligi formulasi: s = r * theta. Bu yerda r = 12 va theta = 5pi/6. s = 12 * (5pi / 6) = 2 * 5pi = 10pi cm. Shuning uchun to'g'ri javob A. B varianti (5pi) radiusga ko'paytirishda 12 ni 6 ga bo'lish o'rniga qoldirib ketilgan xato. C va D variantlari sektor yuzasi yoki noto'g'ri formula qo'llash natijasida paydo bo'ladigan chalg'ituvchi javoblardir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Desmos hack: 12 * (5 * pi / 6) deb yozing, taxminan 31.415 chiqadi. 10 * pi ham 31.415 ga teng.

sample_test_questions.question: Triangle PQR is similar to triangle STU, where vertices P, Q, and R correspond to S, T, and U respectively. If PQ = 8, QR = 14, and ST = 20, what is the length of side TU?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Qadam-baqadam yechim: O'xshash uchburchaklarda mos tomonlar nisbati o'zaro teng: ST / PQ = TU / QR. Qiymatlarni qo'yamiz: 20 / 8 = TU / 14. O'xshashlik koeffitsienti k = 20 / 8 = 2.5. TU = 14 * 2.5 = 35. To'g'ri javob: A. B, C, D variantlari nisbatni noto'g'ri tuzish yoki hisoblashdagi arifmetik xatoliklar tufayli kelib chiqadigan noto'g'ri javoblardir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Desmos hack: 20 * 14 / 8 deb yozsangiz, javob 35 darhol chiqadi.

sample_test_questions.question: A square is inscribed in a circle of radius 6. What is the area of the square?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Qadam-baqadam yechim: Kvadrat aylanaga ichki chizilgan bo'lsa, aylananing diametri kvadratning diagonali d ga teng bo'ladi: d = 2 * r = 2 * 6 = 12. Kvadrat yuzasi uning diagonali orqali quyidagicha hisoblanadi: Area = d^2 / 2 = 12^2 / 2 = 144 / 2 = 72. (Yoki tomoni s: s * sqrt(2) = 12 => s = 12/sqrt(2) => s^2 = 144/2 = 72). To'g'ri javob: A. B varianti (36) radius kvadratiga teng (xato). C varianti (144) 2 ga bo'lish unutilgan xato. D varianti esa doira yuzasi bilan adashtirilgan chalg'ituvchi variantdir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: Digital SAT geometriya formulasi: Aylanaga ichki chizilgan kvadrat yuzi har doim 2 * r^2 ga teng. r=6 bo'lsa, Area = 2 * (6^2) = 2 * 36 = 72.

sample_test_questions.question: A catering service charges a fixed equipment setup fee of $85 plus $18 per guest. If a company was billed a total of $715, how many guests attended the event?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Chiziqli model tenglamasini tuzamiz: Jami xarajat C = 85 + 18g ga teng, bu yerda g - mehmonlar soni. 85 + 18g = 715 tenglamasini yechamiz: 18g = 715 - 85 = 630. g = 630 / 18 = 35 ta mehmon (A to'g'ri). B (32) - 85 ni qo'shib adashganda; C (38) va D (40) esa bo'lishdagi yaxlitlash xatolariga asoslangan noto'g'ri variantlardir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ DESMOS USULI: Desmosga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri 85 + 18x = 715 deb yozing, vertikal chiziq x = 35 da paydo bo'ladi.

sample_test_questions.question:
Consider the system of equations:
3x - 5y = 14
6x - ky = 22
For which value of constant k does the system have NO solution?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Chiziqli tenglamalar sistemasi yechimga ega bo'lmasligi uchun ularning to'g'ri chiziqlari parallel bo'lishi (burchak koeffitsientlari teng, lekin bo'sh hadlari nisbati farqli) shart: a1/a2 = b1/b2 != c1/c2. Bu yerda: 3/6 = (-5)/(-k). 1/2 = 5/k => k = 10. Bo'sh hadlar nisbati esa 14/22 = 7/11 != 1/2 bo'lgani uchun chiziqlar haqiqatan ham parallel va kesishmaydi. B (-10) ishorani hisobga olmaslikdagi xato; C (5) va D (-5) esa nisbatni 1/2 emas 1 ga tenglashtirishdagi xato tuzoqlardir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ DESMOS USULI: k uchun slayder (slider) qo'shing: 3x - 5y = 14 va 6x - ky = 22. k = 10 bo'lganda ikki to'g'ri chiziq qat'iy parallel bo'lib hech qachon kesishmaydi.

sample_test_questions.question:
Which of the following ordered pairs (x, y) satisfies the system of inequalities:
y > -2x + 5
y <= (1/2)x + 1
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ DESMOS USULI: Ikkala tengsizlikni Desmosga yozing: y > -2x + 5 va y <= 0.5x + 1. Variantlardagi 4 ta nuqtani (4,2), (1,4), (2,0), (0,6) kiritib, qaysi biri rangli kesishish sohasiga tushishini bir zumda ko'ring.

sample_test_questions.question: Line p passes through the points (-3, 7) and (5, -9) in the xy-plane. Line q is perpendicular to line p and has a y-intercept of (0, 4). What is the x-intercept of line q?
sample_test_questions.explanation:
1-qadam: p to'g'ri chiziqning burchak koeffitsientini topamiz: m_p = (-9 - 7) / (5 - (-3)) = -16 / 8 = -2.
2-qadam: q chiziq p ga perpendikulyar bo'lgani uchun uning nishabligi m_q = -1 / m_p = -1 / (-2) = 1/2 bo'ladi.
3-qadam: q chiziqning y-kesmasi (0, 4) ekani berilgan, demak uning tenglamasi: y = (1/2)x + 4.
4-qadam: x-kesmani topish uchun y = 0 deb olamiz: 0 = (1/2)x + 4 => (1/2)x = -4 => x = -8. Shunday qilib, x-kesma (-8, 0) (A to'g'ri). B (-2, 0) va D (2, 0) nishablikni adashtirganda kelib chiqadi; C (8, 0) esa ishorani musbat deb olgandagi tuzoqdir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ DESMOS USULI: Desmosga m = (-9-7)/(5-(-3)) deb yozing (-2 chiqadi). Keyin y = (-1/m)x + 4 deb yozing. To'g'ri chiziqning x o'qi bilan kesishgan nuqtasini bosing: (-8, 0) aniq ko'rinadi!

sample_test_questions.question:
In the system of equations below, a and b are constants:
ax + 4y = 18
3x + by = 6
If the system has infinitely many solutions, what is the value of a + b?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Cheksiz ko'p yechimga ega bo'lishi uchun ikkala tenglama bir-birining karrali nusxasi bo'lishi, ya'ni a/3 = 4/b = 18/6 shart bajarilishi shart. O'zgarmas hadlar nisbati: 18 / 6 = 3. Demak: a / 3 = 3 => a = 9. 4 / b = 3 => b = 4/3. Shunda a + b = 9 + 4/3 = 31/3 ≈ 10.33 (B to'g'ri). C (13) - b ni 4/1 deb olgandagi xato; D (12) esa 9 + 3 kabi qo'pol tuzoqdir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ CHEKSIZ YECHIM QOIDASI: Tenglamalarning barcha koeffitsiyentlari nisbati bir xil bo'ladi: a1/a2 = b1/b2 = c1/c2. Karrali sonni toping: 18 = 6 * 3 bo'lgani uchun a = 3 * 3 = 9 va b = 4 / 3 bo'ladi.

sample_test_questions.question: A quadratic function is given by f(x) = 2(x - 3)^2 - 50. If the graph of f intersects the x-axis at (p, 0) and (q, 0) with p > q, what is the value of p - q?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Parabolaning x o'qi bilan kesishish nuqtalarini topish uchun f(x) = 0 deb olamiz: 2(x - 3)^2 - 50 = 0. Ikkala tomonni 2 ga bo'lamiz: (x - 3)^2 = 25. Kvadrat ildiz chiqaramiz: x - 3 = 5 yoki x - 3 = -5, bundan x = 8 va x = -2 kelib chiqadi. Shartga ko'ra p > q bo'lgani uchun p = 8, q = -2. Ularning ayirmasi: p - q = 8 - (-2) = 10 bo'ladi. To'g'ri javob: A (10). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (6) — ishorani adashtirib 8 - 2 deb hisoblash xatosi; C (8) — faqat bitta musbat ildizni belgilab qo'yish tuzog'i; D (12) — ildizlarni noto'g'ri qo'shishdagi xato variant.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ DESMOS USULI: Desmosga y = 2(x - 3)^2 - 50 deb kiriting. Parabola x o'qini (-2, 0) va (8, 0) da kesadi. Ildizlar orasidagi masofa: 8 - (-2) = 10 birlik.

sample_test_questions.passage: During the solar eclipse of May 1919, British astrophysicist Arthur Eddington traveled to the island of Príncipe to photograph star positions near the eclipsed ______ his optical measurements directly confirmed Albert Einstein's prediction that massive objects curve spacetime.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
sample_test_questions.explanation:
To'g'ri javob: B (Sun, and).

Grammatik qoida:
Gapda ikkita mustaqil gap (independent clause) mavjud:
1-gap: 'During the solar eclipse of May 1919, British astrophysicist Arthur Eddington traveled to the island of Príncipe to photograph star positions near the eclipsed Sun'
2-gap: 'his optical measurements directly confirmed Albert Einstein's prediction that massive objects curve spacetime.'

Ingliz tili qoidasiga ko'ra, ikkita mustaqil gapni bog'lash uchun vergul va teng bog'lovchi (comma + coordinating conjunction, FANBOYS: for, and, nor, but, or, yet, so) ishlatiladi: ', and'.

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
A) Nuqtali verguldan keyin 'and' kelishi ortiqcha (nokorrekt punktuatsiya).
C) Faqat vergulning o'zi 'comma splice' xatosini keltirib chiqaradi.
D) Tinish belgisiz ulanish 'run-on / fused sentence' xatosidir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ GRAMMATIKA CHEGARALARI: Ikkita mustaqil gapni (FANBOYS + vergul) yoki nuqtali vergul bilan bog'lang; comma splice xatosidan saqlaning.

sample_test_questions.passage: Architect Zaha Hadid transformed contemporary structural design with her trademark kinetic ______ soaring cantilevers, fluid geometric curves, and fragmented interior volumes that defied conventional orthogonal rigidity.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
sample_test_questions.explanation:
To'g'ri javob: A (aesthetics:).

Grammatik qoida:
Ikki nuqta (colon) to'liq mustaqil gapdan (independent clause) keyin kelib, undan keyingi tushuntirish, tafsilot yoki ro'yxatni kiritish uchun ishlatiladi.
'Architect Zaha Hadid transformed contemporary structural design with her trademark kinetic aesthetics' - to'liq mustaqil gap. Undan keyin uning estetikasiga kiruvchi uchta xususiyat ro'yxati keltirilgan ('soaring cantilevers, fluid geometric curves, and fragmented interior volumes...'). Shuning uchun ikki nuqta (:) eng to'g'ri belgidir.

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
B) Nuqtali vergul (;) ikkita to'liq mustaqil gap o'rtasida qo'yiladi; bu yerda ro'yxat gap emas.
C) Oddiy vergul ro'yxat ichidagi vergullar bilan aralashib, chegarani noaniq qiladi.
D) Tinish belgisiz qoldirib bo'lmaydi.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ IKKI NUQTA QOIDASI: Ikki nuqtadan (:) oldin albatta to'liq mustaqil gap kelishi shart, keyin esa ro'yxat yoki izoh keladi.

sample_test_questions.passage: While searching the cave sediments of Denisova Cave in the Altai Mountains, paleoanthropologists discovered a tiny hominin finger ______ subsequent genomic sequencing revealed it belonged to an entirely distinct human lineage.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
sample_test_questions.explanation:
To'g'ri javob: A (bone; subsequent).

Grammatik qoida:
'While searching the cave sediments... paleoanthropologists discovered a tiny hominin finger bone' - birinchi mustaqil gap.
'subsequent genomic sequencing revealed it belonged to an entirely distinct human lineage' - ikkinchi mustaqil gap.
Ikkita mustaqil gapni bog'lovchisiz ajratish uchun nuqtali vergul (semicolon ;) talab qilinadi.

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
B) Vergul bilan ajratish 'comma splice' xatosidir.
C) Hech qanday belgisiz qoldirish 'fused sentence' xatosidir.
D) 'bone, and subsequent' - bu yerda 'subsequent' sifat, agar 'and subsequent genomic sequencing...' bo'lsa, ma'no o'zgarmasligi mumkin, lekin nuqtali vergul ikki to'liq fikrni eng aniq ajratuvchi standart SAT vositasidir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ NUQTALI VERGUL: Ikkita to'liq gapni hech qanday bog'lovchisiz ajratishda faqat nuqtali vergul (;) to'g'ri hisoblanadi.

sample_test_questions.passage: The marine iguana of the Galápagos Islands is the world's only sea-going ______ it feeds almost exclusively on intertidal algae submerged beneath rocky coastal surf.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
sample_test_questions.explanation:
To'g'ri javob: B (lizard;).

Grammatik qoida:
1-gap: 'The marine iguana of the Galápagos Islands is the world's only sea-going lizard'
2-gap: 'it feeds almost exclusively on intertidal algae submerged beneath rocky coastal surf.'
Ikkita to'liq mustaqil gap hech qanday koordinatsion bog'lovchisiz kelganda ular o'rtasiga nuqtali vergul (semicolon ;) qo'yiladi.

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
A) 'lizard, for' - bu yerda sabab ma'nosi sun'iy va uslub jihatidan noqulay.
C) Tinish belgisiz - run-on xatosi.
D) 'lizard, and' - ikkinchi gap birinchisiga qo'shimcha fikr emas, birinchi gapdagi xususiyatni tushuntiruvchi alohida fakt.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ MUSTAQIL GAPLAR: Ikkala tomonda to'liq ega va kesim bo'lsa, ularni ajratish uchun nuqtali vergul qo'ying.

sample_test_questions.passage: Three key factors contributed to the sudden revival of the historical rail ______ low municipal fuel surcharges, widespread suburban housing sprawl, and targeted federal infrastructure subsidies.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
sample_test_questions.explanation:
To'g'ri javob: A (corridor:).

Grammatik qoida:
Jumla to'liq mustaqil gap bilan tugaydi ('Three key factors contributed to the sudden revival of the historical rail corridor') va undan keyin uchta omil sanab o'tiladi. SAT qoidalariga ko'ra, to'liq jumlaga ergashib keladigan ro'yxat yoki tushuntirish oldidan ikki nuqta (colon :) qo'yilishi shart.

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
B) Nuqtali vergul (;) faqat to'liq gaplarni ajratadi, ro'yxat oldidan qo'yilmaydi.
C) Vergul (,) ro'yxat ichidagi vergullar bilan qorishib ketadi va grammatik jihatdan noo'rin.
D) Belgisiz qoldirish xato.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ RO'YXAT VA IKKI NUQTA: Mustaqil gap orqasidan ro'yxat kelsa, uning oldiga ikki nuqta (:) qo'yiladi.

sample_test_questions.passage: Renowned biochemist Jennifer Doudna—along with French microbiologist Emmanuelle ______ received the 2020 Nobel Prize in Chemistry for pioneering the CRISPR-Cas9 genome editing technology.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
sample_test_questions.explanation:
To'g'ri javob: A (Charpentier—).

Grammatik qoida:
Jumla o'rtasida kirish bo'lak (parenthetical phrase) kelganda, agar u tire (em-dash —) bilan ochilgan bo'lsa ('—along with French microbiologist Emmanuelle Charpentier'), u albatta mos keluvchi ikkinchi tire bilan yopilishi shart: 'Charpentier—'.
Tire bilan ochib, vergul yoki boshqa belgi bilan yopib bo'lmaydi (unpaired punctuation xatosi).

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
B) Vergul - tire juftligi buziladi.
C) Nuqtali vergul - jumlani noo'rin ikkiga bo'lib yuboradi.
D) Belgisiz qoldirilsa, tire yopilmay qoladi.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ TIRE JUFTLIGI: Agar kirish bo'lak tire (—) bilan ochilgan bo'lsa, uni albatta tire (—) bilan yopish shart!

sample_test_questions.passage: The excavation site yielded thousands of Roman bronze ______ however, only a handful of silver denarii were recovered from the deepest strata.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
sample_test_questions.explanation:
To'g'ri javob: A (coins;).

Grammatik qoida:
Ikkita mustaqil gap o'rtasida 'however', 'therefore', 'furthermore' kabi bog'lovchi ravishlar (conjunctive adverbs) kelganda, ularning oldiga nuqtali vergul (;), orqasiga esa vergul (,) qo'yiladi:
'...Roman bronze coins; however, only a handful...'

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
B) 'coins, however,' - comma splice xatosi (faqat vergul bilan bog'lab bo'lmaydi).
C) Belgisiz - run-on xatosi.
D) Ikki nuqta (:) bu yerda mantiqan to'g'ri kelmaydi, chunki keyingi gap ro'yxat yoki izoh emas, ziddiyatli mustaqil gap.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ BOG'LOVCHI RAVISHLAR: [Gap 1]; however, [Gap 2]. Nuqtali vergul oldinda, oddiy vergul keyinda!

sample_test_questions.passage: The intricate mosaic of freshwater wetlands, tidal salt marshes, and barrier islands that ______ coastal Louisiana against seasonal hurricane storm surges has suffered catastrophic degradation over the past century.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
sample_test_questions.explanation:
To'g'ri javob: A (protects).

Grammatik qoida:
Ega-kesim moslashuvi (Subject-Verb Agreement).
Nisbiy olmosh 'that' oldidagi ot guruhiga e'tibor qaratamiz: 'The intricate mosaic of freshwater wetlands, tidal salt marshes, and barrier islands'.
Bu yerda asosiy ega (head noun) - 'mosaic' (birlikda). Oraliqdagi to'ldiruvchilar ('of freshwater wetlands...') ko'plikda bo'lsa-da, ega 'mosaic' birlikda bo'lgani sababli, fe'l ham birlikda bo'lishi kerak: 'protects'.

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
B) protect - ko'plik fe'l shakli (xato).
C) have protected - ko'plik fe'l shakli (xato).
D) are protecting - ko'plik fe'l shakli (xato).
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ ASOSIY OTNI TOPING: 'mosaic of [ko'plik otlar]' da ega faqat 'mosaic' (birlik). Fe'l ham birlikda bo'ladi: protects!

sample_test_questions.passage: Originating in the high Andean snowfields, ______ flowing over four thousand miles before emptying into the Atlantic Ocean.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

options.text: the Amazon River gathers runoff from hundreds of glacial tributaries,
hundreds of glacial tributaries feed the Amazon River,
runoff is gathered by the Amazon River from hundreds of tributaries,
the Atlantic basin absorbs the Amazon River after it gathers runoff,

sample_test_questions.explanation:
To'g'ri javob: A (the Amazon River gathers runoff from hundreds of glacial tributaries,).

Grammatik qoida:
Dangling modifier (osilib qolgan sifatdosh qurilma) qoidasi.
Jumla sifatdoshli ibora bilan boshlanmoqda: 'Originating in the high Andean snowfields...'. Ushbu xatti-harakatni bevosita bajarayotgan subyekt verguldan keyin darhol kelishi shart. And qorli tog'laridan boshlanadigan narsa bu — 'the Amazon River' (Amazonka daryosi).

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
B) 'hundreds of glacial tributaries' - barcha irmoqlar baland And tog'laridan boshlanmaydi, balki daryo o'zi.
C) 'runoff' (oqim) baland tog'lardan boshlanadi deb kelsa, modifier ma'nosi chalkashadi va passiv qurilma uslubni buzadi.
D) 'the Atlantic basin' (Atlantika havzasi) And tog'laridan boshlanmaydi.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ DANGLING MODIFIER: Verguldan keyingi birinchi so'z kirishdagi harakatni bevosita bajaruvchi bo'lishi shart!

sample_test_questions.passage: A team of behavioral economists conducted a multi-city field experiment to examine whether receiving text message reminders ______ household energy conservation during peak summer demand hours.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
sample_test_questions.explanation:
To'g'ri javob: A (influences).

Grammatik qoida:
Ergash gapdagi ega (gerund phrase): 'receiving text message reminders'. Gerund (harakat nomi) doimo birlik hisoblanadi ('receiving... influences'). Garchi 'reminders' ko'plikda bo'lsa ham, ega uning o'zi emas, balki eslatmalarni qabul qilish ('receiving') harakatidir.

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
B) influence - ko'plik shakli.
C) were influencing - ko'plik shakli.
D) have influenced - ko'plik shakli.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ GERUND HARAKAT NOMI: 'receiving ... reminders' da ega 'receiving' bo'lib doimo birlik hisoblanadi (influences)!

sample_test_questions.question: Which of the following is equivalent to the expression (9x^2 - 16) / (3x^2 + 7x - 20) for all values of x where the denominator is non-zero?
sample_test_questions.explanation:
Surat: 9x^2 - 16 = (3x - 4)(3x + 4).
Maxraj: 3x^2 + 7x - 20 = 3x^2 + 15x - 4x - 20 = 3x(x + 5) - 4(x + 5) = (3x - 4)(x + 5).
Umumiy ko'paytuvchi (3x - 4) ni qisqartiramiz: (3x + 4) / (x + 5) (B to'g'ri). A (3x - 4)/(x + 5) - noto'g'ri hadni qisqartirish xatosi; C va D esa algebraning noto'g'ri qoidalariga asoslangan chalg'ituvchi variantlardir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ DESMOS USULI: Desmosda asl kasrni y1 deb, variantlarni y2 deb kiriting. B varianti grafigi asl grafik ustiga 100% tushadi.

sample_test_questions.question: The quadratic function f is defined by f(x) = -2x^2 + 12x - 11. For what value of x does f(x) reach its maximum value, and what is this maximum value?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Parabola cho'qqisi (vertex) koordinatasini topamiz: x_v = -b / (2a) = -12 / (2 * (-2)) = -12 / (-4) = 3. Maksimal qiymatni topish uchun x = 3 ni funksiyaga qo'yamiz: f(3) = -2(3)^2 + 12(3) - 11 = -2(9) + 36 - 11 = -18 + 36 - 11 = 7. Demak, parabola x = 3 da o'zining maksimal qiymati 7 ga erishadi (A to'g'ri). B (-11) - y-kesma bilan adashtirish; C (-3) - ishoradagi xato; D esa 2a ga bo'lishni unutgandagi tuzoqdir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ DESMOS USULI: Desmosga f(x) = -2x^2 + 12x - 11 deb yozing va parabolaning eng yuqori cho'qqisini bosing: (3, 7) nuqtasi chiqadi. x = 3, max = 7!

sample_test_questions.question:
How many real solutions (x, y) does the system of equations have?
y = x^2 - 6x + 14
y = 2x - 2
sample_test_questions.explanation: Ikkala tenglamani tenglashtiramiz: x^2 - 6x + 14 = 2x - 2 => x^2 - 8x + 16 = 0. Bu to'la kvadrat: (x - 4)^2 = 0. Diskriminant: D = (-8)^2 - 4(1)(16) = 64 - 64 = 0. Diskriminant nolga teng bo'lgani sababli tenglama faqat bitta haqiqiy ildizga (x = 4, y = 6) ega. To'g'ri chiziq parabolaga urinadi, demak tizim aniq 1 ta yechimga ega (A to'g'ri). B (2 ta) va C (0 ta) diskriminantni xato hisoblagandagi tuzoqlardir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ DESMOS USULI: Ikkala tenglamani Desmosga kiriting. To'g'ri chiziq parabolaga bitta nuqtada (4, 6) urinib o'tishini vizual ko'rasiz. Aniq 1 ta yechim!

sample_test_questions.question: A laptop originally priced at $800 was on sale at a 25% discount. During a weekend promotion, an additional 10% was deducted from the discounted price. What was the final price of the laptop before tax?
sample_test_questions.explanation:
Ketma-ket foiz kamayishi:
1-chegirma: $800 ning 25% chegirmasi => 800 * (1 - 0.25) = 800 * 0.75 = $600.
2-chegirma: $600 ning 10% qo'shimcha chegirmasi => 600 * (1 - 0.10) = 600 * 0.90 = $540 (A to'g'ri).
B ($520) - 25% + 10% = 35% deb xato qo'shib, 800 * 0.65 = 520 qilgandagi klassik SAT tuzog'idir! C ($560) va D ($500) esa noto'g'ri ko'paytirish natijasidir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ SAT KETMA-KET FOIZ QOIDASI: Hech qachon foizlarni oddiy qo'shmang (25% + 10% != 35%)! Ketma-ket ko'paytiring: 800 * 0.75 * 0.90 = 540.

sample_test_questions.question: An athlete runs at a steady pace of 8.5 miles per hour. At this rate, how many minutes will it take the athlete to run 3.4 miles?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Vaqt = Masofa / Tezlik formulasi bo'yicha: T = 3.4 / 8.5 = 0.4 soat. Soatni daqiqaga aylantirish uchun 60 ga ko'paytiramiz: 0.4 * 60 = 24 daqiqa (A to'g'ri). B (20) va C (28) hisoblash xatolari; D (18) esa 8.5 dan 3.4 ni shunchaki ayirib qo'yishdagi xomxayol tuzoqdir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ BIRLIKLARNI O'GIRISH: (3.4 miles) / (8.5 miles / hour) = 0.4 hours. 0.4 * 60 = 24 minutes. Desmos kalkulyatoriga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri (3.4 / 8.5) * 60 deb yozing.

sample_test_questions.passage:
A survey asked 200 university students about their preferred study environment:
- Library: 45 STEM majors, 35 Humanities majors (Total: 80)
- Coffee Shop: 30 STEM majors, 50 Humanities majors (Total: 80)
- Home: 25 STEM majors, 15 Humanities majors (Total: 40)
Total STEM = 100, Total Humanities = 100.
sample_test_questions.question: If a student who prefers the Library is selected at random, what is the probability that the student is a Humanities major?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Shartli ehtimollik (Conditional Probability) savoli: 'If a student who prefers the Library is selected...' demak maxraj umumiy talabalar soni (200) emas, faqat kutubxonani tanlaganlar soni (80) bo'ladi! Kutubxona tanlaganlar orasida Humanities yo'nalishi talabalari 35 nafar. Shuning uchun ehtimollik 35 / 80 = 7/16 (A to'g'ri). B (35/100) - barcha Humanities talabalariga bo'lish xatosi; C (35/200) - shartli cheklovni inobatga olmasdan jami 200 ga bo'lish klassik tuzog'idir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ SHARTLI EHTIMOLLIK TUZOG'I: 'Given that...' yoki 'If a student who...' deb boshlangan guruh doimo yangi maxrajga aylanadi. Umumiy jami songa bo'lmang!

sample_test_questions.question: A dataset contains seven positive integers: 12, 14, 15, 18, 20, 22, and x. If the mean of the dataset equals the median, and x is the largest integer in the dataset, what is the value of x?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Agar x eng katta son bo'lsa, tartiblangan qator: 12, 14, 15, 18, 20, 22, x. 7 ta sonning medianasi 4-o'rindagi son, ya'ni 18 ga teng. O'rtacha arifmetik (mean) ham 18 ga teng bo'lishi kerak: (12 + 14 + 15 + 18 + 20 + 22 + x) / 7 = 18. Yig'indi: 101 + x = 7 * 18 = 126 => x = 126 - 101 = 25 (A to'g'ri). B (28), C (24) va D (30) o'rtacha qiymatni hisoblashdagi arifmetik xatolarga asoslangan chalg'ituvchi variantlardir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ STATISTIKA QOIDASI: Toq sondagi tartiblangan qiymatlarda mediana o'rtadagi sondir (bu yerda 18). Yig'indi = O'rtacha * Sonlar soni: 18 * 7 = 126.

sample_test_questions.passage: A research institute surveyed a representative random sample of 1,200 registered voters in a city. The survey found that 54% of respondents supported building a new public transit line, with a margin of error of 2.8% at a 95% confidence level.
sample_test_questions.question: Which of the following conclusions is most strongly supported by the survey results?

options.text: It is plausible that between 51.2% and 56.8% of all registered voters in the city support the transit line.
Exactly 54% of all registered voters in the city support the transit line.
Increasing the sample size to 2,400 would double the margin of error to 5.6%.
Every resident in the city supports the project with a 95% probability.

sample_test_questions.explanation: Xatolik chegarasi (Margin of error) 2.8% bo'lsa, ishonchlilik oraliq oralig'i: 54% - 2.8% = 51.2% dan 54% + 2.8% = 56.8% gacha bo'ladi. Demak, butun shahar saylovchilari orasida qo'llab-quvvatlash darajasi 51.2% va 56.8% oralig'ida bo'lishi haqiqatga eng yaqin xulosadir (A to'g'ri). B - tanlanma natijasi butun populyatsiyaga mutlaq aniq 'exactly' teng bo'la olmaydi; C - tanlanma hajmi oshsa, xatolik chegarasi kamayadi (ikki barobar oshmaydi); D - jami shahar aholisi haqida asossiz haddan ortiq umumlashtirishdir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ MARGIN OF ERROR QOIDASI: Margin of error (MOE) o'rtacha qiymat atrofida interval hosil qiladi [p - MOE, p + MOE]. SAT'da 'exactly' so'zi qatnashgan javoblar deyarli doimo xato bo'ladi!

sample_test_questions.question: A scatterplot displays the relationship between the number of hours spent practicing per week, h, and the score achieved on a competitive exam, S. The line of best fit is given by S = 28.5h + 410. What does the value 28.5 represent in this model?

options.text: The predicted increase in exam score for each additional hour spent practicing per week
The exam score achieved by a student who practices 0 hours per week
The total number of hours required to achieve a passing score
The maximum possible exam score that any student can achieve

sample_test_questions.explanation: Chiziqli model S = 28.5h + 410 da 28.5 burchak koeffitsienti (slope) hisoblanadi. Slope har doim erkli o'zgaruvchi (h) bir birlikka oshganda erksiz o'zgaruvchining (S) qanchaga o'zgarishini ko'rsatadi: har bir qo'shimcha mashg'ulot soati uchun ballning taxminiy 28.5 ballga oshishi (A to'g'ri). B - y-kesma (410) ma'nosi; C va D esa mutlaqo asossiz mantiqsiz talqinlardir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ SLOPE TALQINI: Chiziqli modelda nishablik (slope) = 'rate of change' (har bir qo'shimcha x birligi uchun y ning o'zgarishi).

sample_test_questions.question: A circle in the xy-plane has the equation (x - 4)^2 + (y + 7)^2 = 64. What are the coordinates of the center and the radius of the circle?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Aylana tenglamasining standart ko'rinishi: (x - h)^2 + (y - k)^2 = r^2. Bu yerda h = 4, k = -7 bo'lgani uchun markaz koordinatasi (4, -7). Radius r = sqrt(64) = 8. Shuning uchun to'g'ri javob A. B va D variantlarida markaz ishoralari almashtirib yuborilgan, C da esa radius ildiz ostiga olinmagan (64 qoldirilgan).
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ DESMOS USULI: Tenglamani to'g'ridan-to'g'ri Desmosga yozing: (x-4)^2 + (y+7)^2 = 64. Markaz nuqtasi (4, -7) ekanini va diametri 16 (radiusi 8) ekanini darhol ko'rasiz.

sat_mocks.title: Digital SAT Mock #29: College Board Bank Adaptive Mock 9

sample_test_questions.passage: The intricate mosaic of freshwater wetlands, tidal salt marshes, and barrier islands that ______ coastal Louisiana against seasonal hurricane storm surges has suffered catastrophic degradation over the past century.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
sample_test_questions.explanation:
To'g'ri javob: A (protects).

Grammatik qoida:
Ega-kesim moslashuvi (Subject-Verb Agreement).
Nisbiy olmosh 'that' oldidagi ot guruhiga e'tibor qaratamiz: 'The intricate mosaic of freshwater wetlands, tidal salt marshes, and barrier islands'.
Bu yerda asosiy ega (head noun) - 'mosaic' (birlikda). Oraliqdagi to'ldiruvchilar ('of freshwater wetlands...') ko'plikda bo'lsa-da, ega 'mosaic' birlikda bo'lgani sababli, fe'l ham birlikda bo'lishi kerak: 'protects'.

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
B) protect - ko'plik fe'l shakli (xato).
C) have protected - ko'plik fe'l shakli (xato).
D) are protecting - ko'plik fe'l shakli (xato).
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ ASOSIY OTNI TOPING: 'mosaic of [ko'plik otlar]' da ega faqat 'mosaic' (birlik). Fe'l ham birlikda bo'ladi: protects!

sample_test_questions.passage: Originating in the high Andean snowfields, ______ flowing over four thousand miles before emptying into the Atlantic Ocean.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

options.text: the Amazon River gathers runoff from hundreds of glacial tributaries,
hundreds of glacial tributaries feed the Amazon River,
runoff is gathered by the Amazon River from hundreds of tributaries,
the Atlantic basin absorbs the Amazon River after it gathers runoff,

sample_test_questions.explanation:
To'g'ri javob: A (the Amazon River gathers runoff from hundreds of glacial tributaries,).

Grammatik qoida:
Dangling modifier (osilib qolgan sifatdosh qurilma) qoidasi.
Jumla sifatdoshli ibora bilan boshlanmoqda: 'Originating in the high Andean snowfields...'. Ushbu xatti-harakatni bevosita bajarayotgan subyekt verguldan keyin darhol kelishi shart. And qorli tog'laridan boshlanadigan narsa bu — 'the Amazon River' (Amazonka daryosi).

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
B) 'hundreds of glacial tributaries' - barcha irmoqlar baland And tog'laridan boshlanmaydi, balki daryo o'zi.
C) 'runoff' (oqim) baland tog'lardan boshlanadi deb kelsa, modifier ma'nosi chalkashadi va passiv qurilma uslubni buzadi.
D) 'the Atlantic basin' (Atlantika havzasi) And tog'laridan boshlanmaydi.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ DANGLING MODIFIER: Verguldan keyingi birinchi so'z kirishdagi harakatni bevosita bajaruvchi bo'lishi shart!

sample_test_questions.passage: A team of behavioral economists conducted a multi-city field experiment to examine whether receiving text message reminders ______ household energy conservation during peak summer demand hours.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
sample_test_questions.explanation:
To'g'ri javob: A (influences).

Grammatik qoida:
Ergash gapdagi ega (gerund phrase): 'receiving text message reminders'. Gerund (harakat nomi) doimo birlik hisoblanadi ('receiving... influences'). Garchi 'reminders' ko'plikda bo'lsa ham, ega uning o'zi emas, balki eslatmalarni qabul qilish ('receiving') harakatidir.

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
B) influence - ko'plik shakli.
C) were influencing - ko'plik shakli.
D) have influenced - ko'plik shakli.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ GERUND HARAKAT NOMI: 'receiving ... reminders' da ega 'receiving' bo'lib doimo birlik hisoblanadi (influences)!

sample_test_questions.passage: Neither the lead engineer nor the laboratory technicians ______ able to calibrate the spectrophotometer before the overnight testing cycle commenced.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
sample_test_questions.explanation:
To'g'ri javob: A (were).

Grammatik qoida:
'Neither... nor...' qurilmasida fe'l o'ziga eng yaqin turgan ot (proximity rule) bilan moslashadi.
Bu yerda 'nor'dan keyin 'the laboratory technicians' (ko'plik) kelgan. Shuningdek, 'before the overnight testing cycle commenced' o'tgan zamon ekanini ko'rsatmoqda. Demak, o'tgan zamon ko'plik shakli: 'were'.

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
B) was - birlik shakli.
C) is - hozirgi zamon birlik.
D) are - hozirgi zamon ko'plik.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ NEITHER/NOR MOSLASHUVI: Fe'l 'nor'dan keyin turgan otga moslashadi: technicians (ko'plik) + o'tgan zamon = were!

sample_test_questions.passage: The historical archive contains hundreds of handwritten letters from nineteenth-century abolitionists, each of which ______ meticulously preserved in climate-controlled acid-free folders.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
sample_test_questions.explanation:
To'g'ri javob: A (is).

Grammatik qoida:
'each of which' birikmasida 'each' (har biri) doimo grammatik jihatdan birlik (singular) hisoblanadi. Shuning uchun fe'l birlikda bo'lishi kerak: 'each of which is meticulously preserved'.

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
B) are - ko'plik shakli.
C) were - ko'plik shakli.
D) have been - ko'plik shakli.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ 'EACH OF...' QOIDASI: 'Each' doimo birlik (singular) fe'lni talab qiladi: each is!

sample_test_questions.passage: To qualify for the regional symphony orchestra, candidates must demonstrate not only technical virtuosity on their chosen instrument ______ an intuitive sensitivity to ensemble tempo changes.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
sample_test_questions.explanation:
To'g'ri javob: A (but also).

Grammatik qoida:
Bog'lovchilar juftligi (Correlative Conjunctions).
Ingliz tilida 'not only' iborasi doimo 'but also' (yoki shunchaki 'but') bilan juftlashadi: 'not only X but also Y'. Boshqa birikmalar ('and also', 'as well as') grammatik jihatdan qabul qilinmaydi.

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
B) and also - noto'g'ri idiom.
C) as well as - 'not only' bilan juftlashmaydi.
D) along with - grammatik xato.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ BOG'LOVCHILAR JUFTI: 'Not only' ko'rdingizmi, jufti albatta 'but also' bo'ladi!

sample_test_questions.passage: By the time the James Webb Space Telescope reached its observational orbit at Lagrange Point 2 in January 2022, mission controllers ______ thousands of simulation maneuvers to ensure flawless primary mirror deployment.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
sample_test_questions.explanation:
To'g'ri javob: A (had executed).

Grammatik qoida:
Zamonlar moslashuvi (Past Perfect Tense).
'By the time + Past Simple' (reached its observational orbit...) formulasi o'tmishdagi ma'lum bir vaqtdan oldinroq tugallangan harakatni ifodalaydi. Shuning uchun bosh gapda Past Perfect ('had executed') ishlatilishi shart.

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
B) have executed - Present Perfect (o'tgan zamondagi 'reached' bilan mos kelmaydi).
C) will execute - kelasi zamon.
D) execute - hozirgi zamon.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ BY THE TIME + PAST: 'By the time ... reached' kelsa, ikkinchi qismda had + V3 (had executed) bo'ladi!

sample_test_questions.passage: The culinary instructor reminded the apprentices that searing meat at high temperatures requires patience, focus, and ______ with extreme caution.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
sample_test_questions.explanation:
To'g'ri javob: A (handling sharp knives).

Grammatik qoida:
Parallel tuzilma (Parallelism).
Ro'yxatdagi elementlar grammatik jihatdan bir xil turda bo'lishi kerak: 'requires patience [ot], focus [ot], and handling sharp knives [gerund/ot ibora]'. Bu yerda harakatlar 'patience, focus, and handling...' tarzida parallel tuziladi.

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
B) sharp knives handled - sifatdoshli noto'g'ri struktura.
C) to handle knives - infinitiv (oldingi otlar bilan parallel emas).
D) knives being handled - ortiqcha passiv konstruksiya.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ PARALLELLIK QOIDASI: Ro'yxatdagi barcha bo'laklar bir xil grammatik shaklda bo'lishi shart!

sample_test_questions.passage: Electric arc furnaces recycle scrap steel using roughly one-seventh of the energy required by traditional blast furnaces. ______, transitioning the entire domestic steel sector to electric arc technology will require massive upgrades to regional high-voltage electrical grids.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
sample_test_questions.explanation:
To'g'ri javob: A (Nevertheless).

Matn tahlili:
Birinchi jumla elektr pechlarining ulkan afzalligini aytadi: ular an'anaviy pechlarga qaraganda 7 barobar kam energiya sarflaydi (ijobiy fakt). Ikkinchi jumla esa butun po'lat sanoatini ushbu texnologiyaga o'tkazish uchun elektr tarmoqlarini ulkan miqyosda modernizatsiya qilish talab etilishini, ya'ni jiddiy qiyinchilik borligini ko'rsatadi (qarama-qarshi/chegaralovchi fakt). Shuning uchun ziddiyat bildiruvchi 'Nevertheless' (shunga qaramay) eng mos bog'lovchidir.

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
B) Furthermore - fikrni davom ettirish/qo'shish (ziddiyatni ifodalamaydi).
C) Consequently - natija (elektr tarmoqlarini yangilash kam energiya sarflashining bevosita oqibati emas).
D) Similarly - o'xshatish (bu yerda o'xshashlik yo'q).
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ ZIDDIYAT BOG'LOVCHISI: Ijobiy fakt (+ kam energiya) va qiyinchilik (- tarmoqni yangilash) o'rtasida 'Nevertheless' ishlatiladi.

sample_test_questions.passage: In polymer synthesis, adding carbon nanotubes increases tensile strength and thermal dissipation. ______, excessive nanotube concentrations cause agglomeration within the matrix, introducing microscopic shear planes that paradoxically weaken the composite.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
sample_test_questions.explanation:
To'g'ri javob: A (However).

Matn tahlili:
Birinchi gapda uglerod nanotrubkalarining mustahkamlikni oshirishi aytiladi (ijobiy). Ikkinchi gapda esa haddan tashqari ko'p qo'shilsa to'planib qolib, paradoksal ravishda materialni zaiflashtirishi ta'kidlanadi ('paradoxically weaken the composite'). Bu aniq ziddiyat (contrast) bo'lgani sababli 'However' to'g'ri tanlovdir.

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
B) Therefore - xulosa/natija.
C) For instance - misol keltirish (bu yerda mustahkamlikka emas, aksincha zaiflashishga misol emas, ziddiyat keltirilmoqda).
D) In other words - boshqacha aytganda (qayta ifodalash).
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ CONTRAST TRANZITSIYASI: Kuchayish (+) va zaiflashish (-) ziddiyatini 'However' bog'laydi.

sample_test_questions.question: For acute angles A and B in a right triangle, sin(A) = 7/25. What is the value of cos(B)?
sample_test_questions.explanation: To'g'ri burchakli uchburchakda ikkita o'tkir burchak yig'indisi 90 gradusga teng (A + B = 90°). Bir-birini 90° ga to'ldiruvchi burchaklar (complementary angles) uchun asosiy trigonometrik qoida: sin(A) = cos(90° - A) = cos(B). Shuning uchun sin(A) = 7/25 bo'lsa, cos(B) ham aynan 7/25 ga teng bo'ladi (A to'g'ri). B (24/25) - cos(A) ning qiymati; C - teskari kasr; D esa tangens qiymatidir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ OLTIN TRIGO QOIDASI: sin(A) = cos(B) agar A + B = 90° bo'lsa. Hech qanday hisob-kitobsiz bir zumda 7/25 ni belgilang!

sample_test_questions.question: A circle with radius 15 cm has a central angle of 72 degrees. What is the length, in centimeters, of the arc subtended by this central angle?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Aylanadagi yoy uzunligi formulasi: L = 2 * pi * r * (theta / 360). Bu yerda r = 15, theta = 72°. L = 2 * pi * 15 * (72 / 360) = 30 * pi * (1 / 5) = 6 * pi (A to'g'ri). B (3*pi) - diametr o'rniga radiusni 2 ga ko'paytirishni unutganda; C (12*pi) va D (30*pi) esa burchak ulushini xato olgandagi tuzoqlardir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ YOY UZUNLIGI: Aylananing to'liq perimetri = 2 * pi * 15 = 30*pi. 72 gradus bu to'liq aylananing 72/360 = 1/5 qismi. 30*pi / 5 = 6*pi.

sample_test_questions.question: A right circular cylinder has a height of 14 inches and a volume of 350*pi cubic inches. What is the radius, in inches, of the circular base of this cylinder?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Silindr hajmi formulasi: V = pi * r^2 * h. Qiymatlarni qo'yamiz: 350 * pi = pi * r^2 * 14. Ikkala tomonni pi ga bo'lamiz: 350 = 14 * r^2 => r^2 = 350 / 14 = 25. r = sqrt(25) = 5 dyuym (A to'g'ri). B (25) - r^2 ni radius deb adashish; C (10) - diametr qiymati; D (7) esa balandlikka asoslangan noto'g'ri variantdir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ FORMULA NAZORATI: Hajm = Asos yuzi * Balandlik. r^2 = V / (pi * h) = 350 / 14 = 25. Radius = 5.

sample_test_questions.question: The equation x^2 + y^2 - 10x + 6y + 9 = 0 represents a circle in the xy-plane. What is the radius of this circle?
sample_test_questions.explanation:
To'la kvadratga keltiramiz:
(x^2 - 10x + 25) + (y^2 + 6y + 9) = -9 + 25 + 9
(x - 5)^2 + (y + 3)^2 = 25
Demak, markaz (5, -3) va r^2 = 25 bo'lgani uchun radius r = sqrt(25) = 5 (A to'g'ri). B (25) - r^2 ni radius deb hisoblash tuzog'i; C va D esa to'la kvadratga qo'shilgan sonlarni xato muvozanatlash oqibatidir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ DESMOS USULI: Tenglamani xuddi o'zidek Desmosga yozing: x^2 + y^2 - 10x + 6y + 9 = 0. Aylana paydo bo'ladi. Uning chap va o'ng chegarasiga qarang: x = 0 dan x = 10 gacha (diametr = 10), demak radius = 5!

sample_test_questions.question: A cellular carrier offers two monthly roaming data plans. Plan X charges a $25 monthly fee plus $0.15 per megabyte of data used. Plan Y charges a $40 monthly fee plus $0.10 per megabyte of data used. For what number of megabytes of data used in a month will the total monthly charges for both plans be equal?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Ikkala tarif rejasi tenglashishi uchun chiziqli tenglama tuzamiz: 25 + 0.15m = 40 + 0.10m. O'zgaruvchilarni bir tomonga o'tkazamiz: 0.15m - 0.10m = 40 - 25. Natijada 0.05m = 15 bo'ladi. Ikkala tomonni 0.05 ga bo'lsak: m = 15 / 0.05 = 300 megabayt. To'g'ri javob: A (300). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (150) — ayirmani 0.10 ga bo'lishdagi hisoblash xatosi; C (250) — abonent to'lovlarini xato ayirishdagi chalg'ituvchi tuzoq; D (400) — oshiqcha yaxlitlash natijasidagi xato variant.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ DESMOS USULI: Desmosga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri ikkita chiziqni yozing: y = 25 + 0.15x va y = 40 + 0.10x. Kesishish nuqtasiga bosing: (300, 70). x = 300 darhol chiqadi!

sample_test_questions.question: Two water pumps, Pump A and Pump B, are filling a municipal reservoir. Pump A fills the reservoir at a constant rate of 120 gallons per minute, while Pump B fills it at a constant rate of 180 gallons per minute. If Pump A starts operating at 8:00 AM and Pump B starts at 8:30 AM, at what time will both pumps have contributed an equal total volume of water to the reservoir?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Pump A 8:00 dan 8:30 gacha 30 daqiqa yolg'iz ishlagan: 120 * 30 = 3600 gallon to'ldirgan. 8:30 dan keyingi vaqtni t daqiqa deb olamiz. Pump A ning jami suvi: 3600 + 120t. Pump B ning jami suvi: 180t. Ular tenglashishi kerak: 3600 + 120t = 180t => 60t = 3600 => t = 60 daqiqa (1 soat). Demak, 8:30 dan 1 soat o'tgach, ya'ni soat 9:30 AM da ikkala nasos teng suv quygan bo'ladi. To'g'ri javob: A (9:30 AM). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (9:00 AM) — yarim soat deb adashgandagi xato; C (10:00 AM) — 8:00 ga 2 soat qo'shib adashish tuzog'i; D (10:30 AM) — hisoblashdagi qo'pol xato variant.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ DESMOS USULI: Desmosga y = 120(x + 30) va y = 180x deb yozing. Kesishish nuqtasi x = 60 daqiqa bo'ladi. 8:30 + 60 daqiqa = 9:30 AM.

sample_test_questions.question: A truck rental company charges an initial reservation fee of $45 plus $0.80 per mile driven. An architect has a maximum budget of $225 for a one-day rental. What is the maximum number of miles the architect can drive without exceeding the budget?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Tengsizlik tuzamiz: Jami xarajat 45 + 0.80m <= 225 bo'lishi kerak, bu yerda m — bosib o'tilgan masofa. 45 ni ayiramiz: 0.80m <= 180. Ikkala tomonni 0.80 ga bo'lamiz: m <= 180 / 0.80 = 225 mil. Demak, eng ko'pi bilan 225 mil yurish mumkin. To'g'ri javob: A (225). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (200) — hisoblashda 0.8 o'rniga 0.9 ga bo'lish xatosi; C (270) — 45 ni ayirish o'rniga qo'shib yuborishdagi chalg'ituvchi tuzoq; D (250) — yaxlitlashdagi noo'rin xato natija.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ TEZ HISOBLASH: 180 / 0.8 = 1800 / 8 = 900 / 4 = 225. 5 soniyada tayyor!

sample_test_questions.question:
Consider the system of equations:
4x + 3y = 38
2x - y = 4
If (x, y) is the solution to the system, what is the value of the product x * y?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Ikkinchi tenglamadan y ni topamiz: y = 2x - 4. Buni birinchi tenglamaga qo'yamiz: 4x + 3(2x - 4) = 38 => 4x + 6x - 12 = 38 => 10x = 50 => x = 5. Endi y ni hisoblaymiz: y = 2(5) - 4 = 6. Savol x * y ko'paytmani so'ragan: 5 * 6 = 30. To'g'ri javob: A (30). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (11) — x + y yig'indini belgilab qo'yish tuzog'i; C (20) — x=4 deb yanglishgandagi xato; D (24) — y ni topishda adashish natijasidagi noto'g'ri variant.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ DESMOS USULI: Ikkala tenglamani Desmosga kiriting. Kesishish nuqtasi (5, 6) chiqadi. 5 * 6 = 30.

sample_test_questions.question:
The system of equations below has infinitely many solutions:
6x - 9y = 21
ax - 6y = b
where a and b are constants. What is the value of a + b?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Cheksiz ko'p yechimga ega bo'lishi uchun koeffitsiyentlar nisbati teng bo'lishi shart: 6 / a = -9 / (-6) = 21 / b. O'rtadagi nisbat: -9 / (-6) = 3 / 2. 1) 6 / a = 3 / 2 => 3a = 12 => a = 4. 2) 21 / b = 3 / 2 => 3b = 42 => b = 14. Yig'indi: a + b = 4 + 14 = 18. To'g'ri javob: A (18). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (14) — faqat b ning qiymatini belgilab qo'yish tuzog'i; C (10) — b - a ayirmani hisoblashdagi adashish; D (22) — ishorani noto'g'ri qo'llashdagi xato variant.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ PROPORSIONALLIK QOIDASI: 2-tenglamadagi y koeffitsiyenti (-6) 1-tenglamadagidan (-9) 2/3 barobar. Demak a = 6 * (2/3) = 4, b = 21 * (2/3) = 14. 4 + 14 = 18!

sample_test_questions.question: A carpenter manufactures wooden bookshelves and desks. Each bookshelf requires 4 hours of assembly and 2 hours of finishing, while each desk requires 6 hours of assembly and 5 hours of finishing. The workshop has at most 60 hours for assembly and at most 40 hours for finishing available each week. If the carpenter builds 6 desks in a week, what is the maximum number of bookshelves that can also be manufactured without exceeding either hourly limit?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Javonga b ta, stolga d ta deb belgilaymiz. Shart bo'yicha d = 6 ta stol yasalgan. Cheklovlar: 1) Yig'ish (assembly): 4b + 6(6) <= 60 => 4b + 36 <= 60 => 4b <= 24 => b <= 6. 2) Pardozlash (finishing): 2b + 5(6) <= 40 => 2b + 30 <= 40 => 2b <= 10 => b <= 5. Ikkala shart ham bajarilishi uchun b <= min(6, 5) = 5 bo'lishi kerak. Demak, eng ko'pi bilan 5 ta javon yasash mumkin. To'g'ri javob: A (5). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (6) — faqat yig'ish vaqtini hisoblab pardozlash vaqtidan oshib ketish (2*6+30 = 42 > 40) xatosi tuzog'i; C (4) — mumkin bo'lsa-da, maksimal emas; D (7) — ikkala vaqtdan ham oshib ketadigan xato variant.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ IKKALA CHEKLOVNI TEKSHIRISH: Ikkinchi shart b <= 5 ni talab qiladi. 6 qo'yilsa vaqt yetmaydi!

sat_mocks.title: Digital SAT Mock #30: College Board Bank Adaptive Mock 10

sample_test_questions.passage: The culinary instructor reminded the apprentices that searing meat at high temperatures requires patience, focus, and ______ with extreme caution.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
sample_test_questions.explanation:
To'g'ri javob: A (handling sharp knives).

Grammatik qoida:
Parallel tuzilma (Parallelism).
Ro'yxatdagi elementlar grammatik jihatdan bir xil turda bo'lishi kerak: 'requires patience [ot], focus [ot], and handling sharp knives [gerund/ot ibora]'. Bu yerda harakatlar 'patience, focus, and handling...' tarzida parallel tuziladi.

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
B) sharp knives handled - sifatdoshli noto'g'ri struktura.
C) to handle knives - infinitiv (oldingi otlar bilan parallel emas).
D) knives being handled - ortiqcha passiv konstruksiya.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ PARALLELLIK QOIDASI: Ro'yxatdagi barcha bo'laklar bir xil grammatik shaklda bo'lishi shart!

sample_test_questions.passage: Electric arc furnaces recycle scrap steel using roughly one-seventh of the energy required by traditional blast furnaces. ______, transitioning the entire domestic steel sector to electric arc technology will require massive upgrades to regional high-voltage electrical grids.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
sample_test_questions.explanation:
To'g'ri javob: A (Nevertheless).

Matn tahlili:
Birinchi jumla elektr pechlarining ulkan afzalligini aytadi: ular an'anaviy pechlarga qaraganda 7 barobar kam energiya sarflaydi (ijobiy fakt). Ikkinchi jumla esa butun po'lat sanoatini ushbu texnologiyaga o'tkazish uchun elektr tarmoqlarini ulkan miqyosda modernizatsiya qilish talab etilishini, ya'ni jiddiy qiyinchilik borligini ko'rsatadi (qarama-qarshi/chegaralovchi fakt). Shuning uchun ziddiyat bildiruvchi 'Nevertheless' (shunga qaramay) eng mos bog'lovchidir.

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
B) Furthermore - fikrni davom ettirish/qo'shish (ziddiyatni ifodalamaydi).
C) Consequently - natija (elektr tarmoqlarini yangilash kam energiya sarflashining bevosita oqibati emas).
D) Similarly - o'xshatish (bu yerda o'xshashlik yo'q).
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ ZIDDIYAT BOG'LOVCHISI: Ijobiy fakt (+ kam energiya) va qiyinchilik (- tarmoqni yangilash) o'rtasida 'Nevertheless' ishlatiladi.

sample_test_questions.passage: In polymer synthesis, adding carbon nanotubes increases tensile strength and thermal dissipation. ______, excessive nanotube concentrations cause agglomeration within the matrix, introducing microscopic shear planes that paradoxically weaken the composite.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
sample_test_questions.explanation:
To'g'ri javob: A (However).

Matn tahlili:
Birinchi gapda uglerod nanotrubkalarining mustahkamlikni oshirishi aytiladi (ijobiy). Ikkinchi gapda esa haddan tashqari ko'p qo'shilsa to'planib qolib, paradoksal ravishda materialni zaiflashtirishi ta'kidlanadi ('paradoxically weaken the composite'). Bu aniq ziddiyat (contrast) bo'lgani sababli 'However' to'g'ri tanlovdir.

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
B) Therefore - xulosa/natija.
