C) For instance - misol keltirish (bu yerda mustahkamlikka emas, aksincha zaiflashishga misol emas, ziddiyat keltirilmoqda).
D) In other words - boshqacha aytganda (qayta ifodalash).
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ CONTRAST TRANZITSIYASI: Kuchayish (+) va zaiflashish (-) ziddiyatini 'However' bog'laydi.

sample_test_questions.passage: Urban green roofs absorb storm runoff, lower rooftop ambient temperatures, and provide crucial nesting habitat for migratory birds. ______, they reduce indoor building cooling costs by up to 25 percent during peak summer months.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
sample_test_questions.explanation:
To'g'ri javob: A (In addition).

Matn tahlili:
Birinchi gap yashil tomlarning qator ijobiy afzalliklarini sanaydi (suvni yutadi, haroratni pasaytiradi, qushlarga makon bo'ladi). Ikkinchi gap yana bitta qo'shimcha afzallikni kiritadi: binolarning sovutish xarajatlarini 25% gacha qisqartiradi. Demak, qo'shimcha ma'lumot qo'shuvchi 'In addition' (bundan tashqari) to'g'ri javobdir.

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
B) Conversely - aksincha (ziddiyat yo'q).
C) Instead - o'rniga.
D) Otherwise - aks holda.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ QO'SHIMCHA MA'LUMOT: Ijobiy afzalliklarga yana yangi afzallik qo'shilganda 'In addition' ishlatiladi.

sample_test_questions.passage: Certain fungal endophytes produce alkaloid compounds that deter insect herbivores from feeding on host fescue grasses. ______, grasses colonized by these symbiotic fungi exhibit significantly higher survival rates in beetle-infested meadows.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
sample_test_questions.explanation:
To'g'ri javob: A (Consequently).

Matn tahlili:
Birinchi gap sababni keltirmoqda: zamburug'lar hasharotlarni qo'rqituvchi moddalar ishlab chiqaradi. Ikkinchi gap esa uning tabiiy natijasini (oqibatini) bayon qilmoqda: shuning uchun ushbu zamburug'li o'tlar hasharotlar ko'p bo'lgan yaylovlarda yuqoriroq tirik qolish ko'rsatkichiga ega. Sabab-oqibat bog'liqligi uchun 'Consequently' (oqibatda / natijada) ishlatiladi.

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
B) In contrast - taqqoslash/ziddiyat.
C) Meanwhile - ayni paytda (vaqt).
D) Earlier - ilgariroq.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ NATIJA BOG'LOVCHISI: Sababdan kelib chiquvchi to'g'ridan-to'g'ri natija uchun 'Consequently' tanlanadi.

sample_test_questions.passage: Geologists have long recognized that volcanic calderas collapse along ring fractures following massive explosive eruptions. ______, the precise subsurface magma withdrawal dynamics that trigger catastrophic caldera roof failure remain fiercely contested.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
sample_test_questions.explanation:
To'g'ri javob: A (Still).

Matn tahlili:
Birinchi gap geologlar vulqon kalderalarining qulashini azaldan bilishini ('have long recognized...') aytadi. Ikkinchi gap esa qulashni keltirib chiqaruvchi aniq dinamika hamon qizg'in bahslarga sabab bo'layotganini ('remain fiercely contested') bildiradi. Biror narsa ma'lum bo'lishiga qaramay, boshqa jihati noaniq ekanini ifodalash uchun qarshilantiruvchi 'Still' (shunday bo'lsa-da / biroq) bog'lovchisi to'g'ri keladi.

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
B) Accordingly - shunga muvofiq (natija).
C) Likewise - xuddi shunday (o'xshashlik).
D) Thus - shu sababli.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ QARSHILIK BOG'LOVCHISI: 'Still' / 'Yet' — ma'lum faktga qaramay boshqa narsa noaniqligini ko'rsatadi.

sample_test_questions.passage: Before presenting their final financial audit, the accounting committee reviewed thousands of digital invoices. ______, they interviewed department managers to reconcile lingering budgetary discrepancies.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
sample_test_questions.explanation:
To'g'ri javob: A (Subsequently).

Matn tahlili:
Bu yerda vaqt bo'yicha ketma-ketlik (chronological sequence) ifodalangan: hisobchilar avval minglab hisob-fakturalarni ko'rib chiqishgan, shundan so'ng / keyin ('Subsequently') noaniqliklarni hal qilish uchun bo'lim rahbarlari bilan suhbat o'tkazishgan.

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
B) Conversely - aksincha.
C) Rather - aksincha / uning o'rniga.
D) Nevertheless - shunga qaramay.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ VAQT KETMA-KETLIGI: Bir harakatdan keyingi navbatdagi harakat uchun 'Subsequently' (keyinchalik / shundan so'ng) ishlatiladi.

sample_test_questions.passage: Deep convolutional neural networks excel at extracting complex statistical patterns from vast datasets. ______, they frequently struggle to generalize when confronted with inputs that fall outside their initial training distributions.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
sample_test_questions.explanation:
To'g'ri javob: A (On the other hand).

Matn tahlili:
Birinchi gap neyrotarmoqlarning kuchli tomonini ta'kidlaydi ('excel at extracting complex statistical patterns'). Ikkinchi gap esa ularning asosiy kamchiligini ochib beradi ('struggle to generalize...'). Bu ikki tomonlama taqqoslash va ziddiyat bo'lgani sababli 'On the other hand' (boshqa tomondan) eng mantiqiy bog'lovchidir.

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
B) In conclusion - xulosa (umumiy xulosa chiqarilmayapti).
C) For example - misol (birinchi gapdagi muvaffaqiyatga misol emas, kamchilik aytilmoqda).
D) Similarly - o'xshashlik.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ IKKI TOMONLAMA TAQQOSLASH: Ijobiy ustunlik va unga qarama-qarshi kamchilik uchun 'On the other hand' mos keladi.

sample_test_questions.passage: To minimize aerodynamic drag, modern high-speed passenger trains feature tapered noses and enclosed undercarriages. ______, Japan's Shinkansen Series E5 incorporates a 15-meter streamlined nose specifically engineered to prevent sonic micro-booms inside mountain tunnels.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
sample_test_questions.explanation:
To'g'ri javob: A (Specifically).

Matn tahlili:
Birinchi gap poyezdlarda uchraydigan umumiy qoidani bayon qiladi ('modern high-speed passenger trains feature tapered noses...'). Ikkinchi gap esa ushbu umumiy qoidaning aniq va o'ziga xos bir misolini (Yaponiyaning Shinkansen Series E5 poyezdi 15 metrli burni) keltiradi. Umumiy qoidadan xususiy misolga o'tishda 'Specifically' (xususan / aynan aytganda) bog'lovchisi ishlatiladi.

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
B) Regardless - baribir / e'tibor bermasdan.
C) Instead - o'rniga.
D) Ultimately - oxir-oqibat.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ UMUMIYDAN XUSUSIYGA: Umumiy qoidadan aniq bitta poyezd misoliga o'tishda 'Specifically' tanlanadi.

sample_test_questions.passage:
While researching an extinct carnivore, a student took the following notes:
- The thylacine, commonly called the Tasmanian tiger, was an apex carnivorous marsupial.
- It possessed a pouch for carrying young, characteristic of Australian marsupials.
- Despite being a marsupial, its skull and body shape converged remarkably with placental canids like wolves.
- This resemblance is a textbook example of convergent evolution: unrelated species evolving similar physical traits to fill identical ecological niches.
- The last known captive thylacine died in a Hobart zoo in 1936.
sample_test_questions.question: The student wants to explain the biological significance of the thylacine's physical appearance. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.text: The thylacine's striking physical resemblance to placental wolves illustrates convergent evolution, wherein unrelated species independently develop similar traits to fill equivalent niches.
Commonly called the Tasmanian tiger, the thylacine was an Australian carnivorous marsupial whose last known captive individual died in 1936.
Although the thylacine possessed a pouch like other marsupials, it was hunted to extinction in the early twentieth century.
Convergent evolution occurs when two species live in identical habitats, as demonstrated by the extinction of the thylacine in Tasmania.

sample_test_questions.explanation:
To'g'ri javob: A.

Maqsad tahlili:
Talabaning maqsadi: 'explain the biological significance of the thylacine's physical appearance' (tilatsin tashqi ko'rinishining biologik ahamiyatini tushuntirish).
A variantda uning bo'rilarga o'xshash tashqi ko'rinishi ('physical resemblance to placental wolves') konvergent evolutsiyaning biologik ahamiyatini ('illustrates convergent evolution, wherein unrelated species independently develop similar traits...') to'liq va aniq ochib bergan.

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
B) Tashqi ko'rinishning biologik ahamiyati emas, yo'qolib ketgan yili aytilgan.
C) O'ldirib yo'q qilingani haqida gapiradi, biologik ahamiyat yo'q.
D) Konvergensiyani noto'g'ri ta'riflaydi va uning o'limi bilan bog'laydi.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ RITORIK MAQSAD: Savoldagi 'explain biological significance of physical appearance' talabiga to'g'ri keluvchi yagona variantni belgilang.

sample_test_questions.question: For what value of constant c does the quadratic equation 2x^2 - 8x + c = 0 have exactly one distinct real solution?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Kvadrat tenglama yagona haqiqiy yechimga ega bo'lishi uchun diskriminant nolga teng bo'lishi shart (D = 0): D = b^2 - 4ac = (-8)^2 - 4(2)(c) = 64 - 8c. 64 - 8c = 0 => 8c = 64 => c = 8. To'g'ri javob: A (8). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (16) — a=1 deb adashganda olinadigan tuzoq; C (4) — 64 ni 16 ga bo'lishdagi xato; D (-8) — ishorani teskari olishdagi xato variant.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ SAT FORMULASI: Yagona yechim uchun c = b^2 / (4a) = 64 / 8 = 8.

sample_test_questions.question:
Consider the nonlinear system of equations:
y = x^2 - 4x + 7
y = 2x - 1
If (x1, y1) and (x2, y2) are the two distinct solutions with x1 < x2, what is the value of y2 - y1?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Ikkala y ni tenglashtiramiz: x^2 - 4x + 7 = 2x - 1 => x^2 - 6x + 8 = 0. Ko'paytuvchilarga ajratamiz: (x - 2)(x - 4) = 0. Bundan x1 = 2 va x2 = 4 (chunki x1 < x2). Tegishli y qiymatlarni topamiz: y1 = 2(2) - 1 = 3; y2 = 2(4) - 1 = 7. Ayirma: y2 - y1 = 7 - 3 = 4. To'g'ri javob: A (4). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (2) — x2 - x1 ayirmani adashib belgilash tuzog'i; C (6) — arifmetik hisoblashdagi xato; D (8) — x1 va x2 ni qo'shib yuborishdagi xato variant.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ DESMOS USULI: Ikkala funksiyani kiriting. Kesishish nuqtalari (2, 3) va (4, 7). y koordinatalar ayirmasi: 7 - 3 = 4.

sample_test_questions.question: Which of the following is equivalent to the expression (3x^2 - 12) / (x^2 + 5x + 6) for all values of x > 0?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Surat va maxrajni ko'paytuvchilarga ajratamiz: Surat: 3(x^2 - 4) = 3(x - 2)(x + 2). Maxraj: (x + 2)(x + 3). Umumiy ko'paytuvchi (x + 2) ni qisqartiramiz: 3(x - 2) / (x + 3) = (3x - 6) / (x + 3). To'g'ri javob: A. Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B — suratdagi ishorani musbat deb adashish tuzog'i; C — x^2 larni noo'rin bekor qilib yuborishdagi qo'pol xato; D — 3 umumiy ko'paytuvchini yo'qotib qo'yishdagi xato variant.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ SON QO'YISH USULI: x = 1 qo'ying: Asl ifoda: (3 - 12)/(1 + 5 + 6) = -9/12 = -0.75. A variantda: (3 - 6)/(1 + 3) = -3/4 = -0.75. Mos keldi!

sample_test_questions.question: A sample of a radioactive isotope has an initial mass of 320 milligrams. The mass decays by half every 18 days. Which function M(d) models the remaining mass, in milligrams, after d days?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Yarim parchalanish eksponensial formulasi: M(d) = M0 * (0.5)^(d / davr). Bu yerda M0 = 320 mg va davr = 18 kun. Demak M(d) = 320 * (0.5)^(d/18). To'g'ri javob: A. Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B — davrni darajaga ko'paytirib qo'yish tuzog'i; C — asos va ko'paytuvchini almashtirish xatosi; D — boshlang'ich massani darhol 2 ga bo'lib 160 deb yozish xatosi.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ TEKSHIRISH: d = 18 da massa roppa-rosa 2 barobar kamayishi (160 mg) kerak. A da: 320 * (0.5)^1 = 160 to'g'ri chiqadi!

sample_test_questions.question: What is the set of all real solutions to the radical equation sqrt(4x + 9) = x - 3?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Ikkala tomonni kvadratga ko'taramiz: 4x + 9 = (x - 3)^2 = x^2 - 6x + 9. Hadlarni bir tomonga o'tkazamiz: x^2 - 10x = 0 => x(x - 10) = 0. Nomzod ildizlar: x = 0 va x = 10. Endi chet ildizlarni tekshiramiz: 1) x = 0: sqrt(9) = 3, lekin o'ng tomon 0 - 3 = -3. 3 != -3, demak x = 0 chet ildiz (noto'g'ri). 2) x = 10: sqrt(49) = 7, o'ng tomon 10 - 3 = 7. 7 = 7 to'g'ri. Shuning uchun yagona haqiqiy yechim {10}. To'g'ri javob: A ({10}). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B ({0, 10}) — chet ildizni tekshirmasdan belgilashdagi eng xavfli tuzoq; C ({0}) — faqat chet ildizni olish xatosi; D — haqiqiy yechim yo'q deb noto'g'ri xulosa chiqarish.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ CHET ILDIZ OGOHLANTIRISHI: Ildizli tenglamani kvadratga ko'targanda har doim o'ng tomon manfiy bo'lmasligini tekshiring: x - 3 >= 0 => x >= 3 bo'lishi shart! x = 0 bu shartni bajarmaydi.

sample_test_questions.question: When the polynomial P(x) = 2x^3 - 5x^2 + kx - 14 is divided by (x - 3), the remainder is 7. What is the value of the constant k?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Qoldiqli bo'lish teoremasi (Remainder Theorem) bo'yicha: P(3) = 7 bo'lishi kerak. x = 3 ni qo'yamiz: P(3) = 2(3)^3 - 5(3)^2 + k(3) - 14 = 2(27) - 5(9) + 3k - 14 = 54 - 45 + 3k - 14 = 3k - 5. Shart bo'yicha: 3k - 5 = 7 => 3k = 12 => k = 4. To'g'ri javob: A (4). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (-4) — ishorada adashganda kelib chiqadigan tuzoq; C (6) — arifmetik hisoblashdagi xato; D (8) — ozod hadni noto'g'ri o'tkazishdagi xato variant.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ POLINOM QOIDASI: P(x) ni (x - c) ga bo'lgandagi qoldiq P(c) ga teng. x=3 ni qo'yib 7 ga tenglang!

sample_test_questions.question: What is the minimum value of the quadratic function g(x) = 3x^2 - 24x + 55?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Parabolaning shoxlari yuqoriga qaragan (a = 3 > 0), shuning uchun uning eng kichik qiymati cho'qqisida (vertex) bo'ladi. Cho'qqining x koordinatasi: x = -b / (2a) = -(-24) / (2 * 3) = 24 / 6 = 4. Eng kichik qiymat g(4) ga teng: g(4) = 3(4)^2 - 24(4) + 55 = 3(16) - 96 + 55 = 48 - 96 + 55 = 7. To'g'ri javob: A (7). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (4) — minimum nuqtani (x koordinatani) qiymat deb adashib belgilash klassik tuzog'i; C (55) — y-kesishmasini minimum deb o'ylash xatosi; D (-7) — ishora xatosi natijasidagi noto'g'ri variant.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ DESMOS USULI: Desmosga y = 3x^2 - 24x + 55 ni kiriting va eng pastki nuqtani bosing: (4, 7). Minimum qiymat y = 7!

sample_test_questions.question: A survey of 200 university students recorded their major and mathematics course enrollment. Among the 80 Science majors, 60 enrolled in Statistics and 20 in Calculus. Among the 120 Humanities majors, 30 enrolled in Statistics and 90 in Calculus. If a student who enrolled in Statistics is selected at random, what is the probability that the student is a Science major?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Shartli ehtimollik formulasi: P(Science | Statistics) = N(Science va Statistics) / N(Jami Statistics). Statistics kursiga yozilganlar jami soni: 60 (Science) + 30 (Humanities) = 90 nafar. Ularning ichidan Science yo'nalishidagi talabalar soni: 60 nafar. Ehtimollik: 60 / 90 = 2/3. To'g'ri javob: A (2/3). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (3/4) — 60 / 80 deb Science talabalari ichidan hisoblash tuzog'i; C (3/10) — 60 / 200 deb butun talabalar soniga bo'lish xatosi; D (1/2) — guruhlarni teng deb faraz qilishdagi xato variant.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ SHARTLI EHTIMOLLIK KALITI: 'If a student who enrolled in Statistics...' so'zlari maxraj faqat Statistics olganlar (60+30=90) bo'lishini bildiradi!

sample_test_questions.question: An online retailer increased the price of a wireless keyboard by 25% in November. In January, the retailer discounted the new price by 20%. What was the overall percentage change from the original price?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Multiplikator usulini qo'llaymiz: Dastlabki narx P bo'lsin. 1) 25% oshish: P * 1.25. 2) 20% arzonlashish: yangi narx * (1 - 0.20) = P * 1.25 * 0.80. Ko'paytiramiz: 1.25 * 0.80 = 1.00. Demak yakuniy narx 1.00 * P ga teng, ya'ni narx o'zgarmagan (0% o'zgarish). To'g'ri javob: A. Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (5% increase) — 25% - 20% = +5% deb foizlarni oddiy ayirib yuboradigan eng mashhur SAT tuzog'i; C (5% decrease) — adashgan yo'nalish; D — noo'rin yaxlitlashdagi xato variant.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ QULAY SON TANLASH: Dastlabki narxni $100 deb oling: 25% oshsa $125 bo'ladi. $125 ning 20%i = $25. $125 - $25 = $100. Qaytib o'ziga keldi (0%)!

sample_test_questions.question: A research institute surveyed a random sample of 1,200 registered voters in a metropolitan area regarding a new transit tax. The survey found that 58% supported the tax, with a margin of error of 2.8% at a 95% confidence level. Which of the following is the most appropriate conclusion?

options.text: It is plausible that the true proportion of all registered voters in the metropolitan area who support the tax is between 55.2% and 60.8%.
Exactly 58% of all registered voters in the metropolitan area support the tax.
95% of all registered voters in the metropolitan area support the tax.
The true proportion of voters supporting the tax cannot be greater than 58%.

sample_test_questions.explanation: Ishonch oralig'i (confidence interval) hisoblanadi: 58% +- 2.8%, ya'ni [55.2%, 60.8%]. Bu butun populyatsiyadagi haqiqiy ulush ushbu oraliqda bo'lishi asosli (plausible) ekanligini bildiradi. To'g'ri javob: A. Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B — tanlanma natijasini butun aholi uchun qat'iy 'aynan 58%' deb e'lon qilish statistikaga zid tuzoq; C — 95% ishonchlilik darajasini qo'llab-quvvatlovchilar ulushi deb adashtirish xatosi; D — oraliq yuqori chegarasi 60.8% gacha borishini inkor etuvchi xato variant.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ SAT STATISTIKA QOIDASI: 'Margin of error' har doim interval beradi (58 - 2.8 dan 58 + 2.8 gacha). 'Exactly' yoki 'cannot' so'zlari bo'lgan variantlar deyarli har doim noto'g'ri!

sat_mocks.title: Digital SAT Mock #31: College Board Bank Adaptive Mock 11

sample_test_questions.passage: Deep convolutional neural networks excel at extracting complex statistical patterns from vast datasets. ______, they frequently struggle to generalize when confronted with inputs that fall outside their initial training distributions.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
sample_test_questions.explanation:
To'g'ri javob: A (On the other hand).

Matn tahlili:
Birinchi gap neyrotarmoqlarning kuchli tomonini ta'kidlaydi ('excel at extracting complex statistical patterns'). Ikkinchi gap esa ularning asosiy kamchiligini ochib beradi ('struggle to generalize...'). Bu ikki tomonlama taqqoslash va ziddiyat bo'lgani sababli 'On the other hand' (boshqa tomondan) eng mantiqiy bog'lovchidir.

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
B) In conclusion - xulosa (umumiy xulosa chiqarilmayapti).
C) For example - misol (birinchi gapdagi muvaffaqiyatga misol emas, kamchilik aytilmoqda).
D) Similarly - o'xshashlik.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ IKKI TOMONLAMA TAQQOSLASH: Ijobiy ustunlik va unga qarama-qarshi kamchilik uchun 'On the other hand' mos keladi.

sample_test_questions.passage: To minimize aerodynamic drag, modern high-speed passenger trains feature tapered noses and enclosed undercarriages. ______, Japan's Shinkansen Series E5 incorporates a 15-meter streamlined nose specifically engineered to prevent sonic micro-booms inside mountain tunnels.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
sample_test_questions.explanation:
To'g'ri javob: A (Specifically).

Matn tahlili:
Birinchi gap poyezdlarda uchraydigan umumiy qoidani bayon qiladi ('modern high-speed passenger trains feature tapered noses...'). Ikkinchi gap esa ushbu umumiy qoidaning aniq va o'ziga xos bir misolini (Yaponiyaning Shinkansen Series E5 poyezdi 15 metrli burni) keltiradi. Umumiy qoidadan xususiy misolga o'tishda 'Specifically' (xususan / aynan aytganda) bog'lovchisi ishlatiladi.

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
B) Regardless - baribir / e'tibor bermasdan.
C) Instead - o'rniga.
D) Ultimately - oxir-oqibat.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ UMUMIYDAN XUSUSIYGA: Umumiy qoidadan aniq bitta poyezd misoliga o'tishda 'Specifically' tanlanadi.

sample_test_questions.passage:
While researching an extinct carnivore, a student took the following notes:
- The thylacine, commonly called the Tasmanian tiger, was an apex carnivorous marsupial.
- It possessed a pouch for carrying young, characteristic of Australian marsupials.
- Despite being a marsupial, its skull and body shape converged remarkably with placental canids like wolves.
- This resemblance is a textbook example of convergent evolution: unrelated species evolving similar physical traits to fill identical ecological niches.
- The last known captive thylacine died in a Hobart zoo in 1936.
sample_test_questions.question: The student wants to explain the biological significance of the thylacine's physical appearance. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.text: The thylacine's striking physical resemblance to placental wolves illustrates convergent evolution, wherein unrelated species independently develop similar traits to fill equivalent niches.
Commonly called the Tasmanian tiger, the thylacine was an Australian carnivorous marsupial whose last known captive individual died in 1936.
Although the thylacine possessed a pouch like other marsupials, it was hunted to extinction in the early twentieth century.
Convergent evolution occurs when two species live in identical habitats, as demonstrated by the extinction of the thylacine in Tasmania.

sample_test_questions.explanation:
To'g'ri javob: A.

Maqsad tahlili:
Talabaning maqsadi: 'explain the biological significance of the thylacine's physical appearance' (tilatsin tashqi ko'rinishining biologik ahamiyatini tushuntirish).
A variantda uning bo'rilarga o'xshash tashqi ko'rinishi ('physical resemblance to placental wolves') konvergent evolutsiyaning biologik ahamiyatini ('illustrates convergent evolution, wherein unrelated species independently develop similar traits...') to'liq va aniq ochib bergan.

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
B) Tashqi ko'rinishning biologik ahamiyati emas, yo'qolib ketgan yili aytilgan.
C) O'ldirib yo'q qilingani haqida gapiradi, biologik ahamiyat yo'q.
D) Konvergensiyani noto'g'ri ta'riflaydi va uning o'limi bilan bog'laydi.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ RITORIK MAQSAD: Savoldagi 'explain biological significance of physical appearance' talabiga to'g'ri keluvchi yagona variantni belgilang.

sample_test_questions.passage:
While researching early cartography, a student took the following notes:
- The Waldseemüller Map, printed in 1507 by German cartographer Martin Waldseemüller, is a historic world map.
- It is famous for being the first map to depict and label the landmass 'America' in honor of explorer Amerigo Vespucci.
- It challenged Ptolemaic geography by showing the Americas separated from Asia by a vast western ocean.
- Only one original printed copy of the 1507 map survives today.
- In 2003, the Library of Congress acquired this sole surviving copy for $10 million.
sample_test_questions.question: The student wants to emphasize the revolutionary geographical claim made by the Waldseemüller Map. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.text: The 1507 Waldseemüller Map broke with Ptolemaic geography by charting the Americas as a distinct continent separated from Asia by a vast ocean.
Purchased by the Library of Congress for $10 million in 2003, the Waldseemüller Map is the only surviving printed copy from 1507.
Printed in 1507, the Waldseemüller Map was named after Martin Waldseemüller, who admired explorer Amerigo Vespucci.
The Waldseemüller Map is an exceptionally rare cartographic artifact, with only a single original copy known to exist today.

sample_test_questions.explanation:
To'g'ri javob: A.

Maqsad tahlili:
Talabaning maqsadi: 'emphasize the revolutionary geographical claim made by the Waldseemüller Map' (xaritadagi inqilobiy jo'g'rofiy da'voni ta'kidlash).
A variant aynan Ptolomey geografiyasidan voz kechib, Amerika qit'asini Osiyodan ulkan okean bilan ajralib turgan alohida qit'a sifatida ko'rsatgan inqilobiy da'voni aks ettiradi.

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
B) 10 million dollarga sotib olinganini ta'kidlaydi (iqtisodiy/nodirlik jihati).
C) Martin Waldseemüller nomi kelib chiqishini aytadi.
D) Faqat bitta nusxasi saqlanib qolganini ta'kidlaydi (kamyoblik jihati).
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ MAQSAD: 'emphasize revolutionary geographical claim' -> Ptolomey qarashini inkor etib, yangi qit'a ekanini ko'rsatgan variant (A).

sample_test_questions.passage:
While researching renewable energy sources, a student took the following notes:
- Geothermal energy harnesses heat stored beneath the Earth's crust to generate electricity.
- Iceland generates over 25 percent of its total electricity and 90 percent of its home heating from geothermal resources.
- Geothermal power plants produce minimal greenhouse gas emissions during operation.
- Unlike wind and solar power, geothermal energy provides reliable baseload power unaffected by weather conditions.
sample_test_questions.question: The student wants to contrast geothermal energy with solar and wind energy. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.text: Unlike solar and wind power, which fluctuate depending on weather conditions, geothermal energy supplies consistent, weather-independent baseload power.
Iceland derives 25 percent of its electricity and 90 percent of its heating from clean geothermal resources.
By harnessing heat trapped beneath the Earth's crust, geothermal power plants generate electricity with minimal carbon emissions.
Geothermal, wind, and solar systems are all renewable energy alternatives that reduce reliance on fossil fuel combustion.

sample_test_questions.explanation:
To'g'ri javob: A.

Maqsad tahlili:
Talabaning maqsadi: 'contrast geothermal energy with solar and wind energy' (geotermal energiyani quyosh va shamol energiyasi bilan qarama-qarshi qo'yish / farqini ko'rsatish).
A variantda ob-havoga bog'liq bo'lgan quyosh va shamoldan farqli o'laroq ('Unlike solar and wind power...'), geotermal energiya ob-havoga bog'liq bo'lmagan barqaror quvvat berishi aniq qarama-qarshi qilib ko'rsatilgan.

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
B) Faqat Islandiya statistikasini aytadi, taqqoslamaydi.
C) Geotermal energiya qanday hosil bo'lishini tushuntiradi, quyosh/shamol bilan taqqoslamaydi.
D) Ularni birlashtiradi, lekin farqini (contrast) ko'rsatmaydi.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ TAQQOSLASH (CONTRAST): 'contrast ... with solar and wind' -> 'Unlike solar and wind power...' bilan boshlanuvchi variant to'g'ri!

sample_test_questions.passage:
While researching deep-sea biodiversity, a student took the following notes:
- Deep-sea corals live in cold, dark oceanic waters at depths exceeding 200 meters.
- Unlike tropical reef corals, cold-water corals lack symbiotic photosynthetic algae (zooxanthellae).
- To obtain nutrients, they capture drifting zooplankton and organic particles directly from ocean currents using their tentacles.
- Lophelia pertusa is the most widespread cold-water reef-building coral species in the North Atlantic.
sample_test_questions.question: The student wants to highlight how cold-water corals nourish themselves without sunlight. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.text: Lacking photosynthetic algae, cold-water corals like Lophelia pertusa sustain themselves by capturing drifting organic particles and zooplankton with their tentacles.
Lophelia pertusa is a prominent cold-water coral species that forms extensive deep-water biogenic reefs throughout the North Atlantic.
Cold-water corals inhabit aphotic marine environments deeper than 200 meters, where sunlight cannot penetrate the ocean depths.
Unlike shallow tropical reef systems, cold-water corals thrive in frigid temperatures across deep oceanic waters.

sample_test_questions.explanation:
To'g'ri javob: A.

Maqsad tahlili:
Talabaning maqsadi: 'highlight how cold-water corals nourish themselves without sunlight' (sovuq suv marjonlari quyosh nurisiz qanday oziqlanishini ko'rsatish).
A variant fotosintez qiluvchi suvo'tlar yo'qligi sababli, ular organik zarralar va zooplanktonlarni paypaslagichlari (tentacles) bilan tutib oziqlanishini bevosita ochib beradi.

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
B) Shimoliy Atlantikada rif hosil qilishini aytadi, oziqlanishini emas.
C) 200 metrdan chuqurda yashashini aytadi, oziqlanish mexanizmini ko'rsatmaydi.
D) Harorat va chuqurlikni aytadi, oziqlanish usuli yo'q.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ MAQSAD: 'how corals nourish themselves without sunlight' -> 'sustain themselves by capturing ... with tentacles'.

sample_test_questions.passage:
While researching linguistic preservation, a student took the following notes:
- The Cherokee syllabary was invented by Cherokee polymath Sequoyah between 1809 and 1821.
- It represents spoken syllables rather than individual alphabetic phonemes, containing 85 distinct characters.
- Before its creation, Cherokee was an exclusively oral language with no writing system.
- Sequoyah was completely illiterate in English and other written languages when he developed the script.
- Within months of its introduction, the Cherokee Nation achieved a literacy rate exceeding 90 percent.
sample_test_questions.question: The student wants to emphasize the unprecedented speed with which Sequoyah's invention transformed Cherokee literacy. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.text: Sequoyah's syllabary transformed Cherokee from an exclusively spoken language into a written one whose community literacy rate soared past 90 percent within months.
Invented by Sequoyah between 1809 and 1821, the Cherokee syllabary consists of 85 characters that represent distinct spoken syllables.
Even though Sequoyah was illiterate in English, he spent over a decade designing an 85-character syllabary for his people.
The Cherokee writing system relies on syllabic characters rather than phonetic letters, distinguishing it from European alphabets.

sample_test_questions.explanation:
To'g'ri javob: A.

Maqsad tahlili:
Talabaning maqsadi: 'emphasize the unprecedented speed with which Sequoyah's invention transformed Cherokee literacy' (Sequoyah ixtirosi cheroki savodxonligini misli ko'rilmagan tezlikda o'zgartirganini ta'kidlash).
A variant aynan 'soared past 90 percent within months' (bir necha oy ichida 90 foizdan oshdi) degan muddat va natijani urg'ulaydi.

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
B) Bo'g'inlar soni va yaratilgan yillari aytilgan, savodxonlik tezligi yo'q.
C) Sequoyahning ingliz tilini bilmagani aytilgan.
D) Yevropa alifbolaridan farqi tushuntirilgan.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ MAQSAD: 'unprecedented speed' -> 'within months' degan muddat ko'rsatilgan variant (A)!

sample_test_questions.passage:
While researching an architectural landmark, a student took the following notes:
- The Crystal Palace was built in London to house the Great Exhibition of 1851.
- Designed by greenhouse architect Joseph Paxton, it was constructed almost entirely of prefabricated cast iron and sheet glass.
- Its modular design allowed the immense 990,000-square-foot structure to be assembled in just nine months.
- Paxton's use of mass-produced modular components set a historic precedent for modern skyscraper construction.
sample_test_questions.question: The student wants to emphasize the architectural legacy of Joseph Paxton's design. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.text: By successfully utilizing mass-produced, modular cast-iron components at the Crystal Palace, Joseph Paxton pioneered assembly methods that laid the foundation for modern skyscrapers.
Assembled in only nine months, London's Crystal Palace spanned an extraordinary 990,000 square feet to host the Great Exhibition of 1851.
Joseph Paxton, an experienced greenhouse architect, designed the Crystal Palace using prefabricated iron and sheets of glass.
The Great Exhibition of 1851 was held inside the Crystal Palace, an expansive London pavilion made of glass and iron.

sample_test_questions.explanation:
To'g'ri javob: A.

Maqsad tahlili:
Talabaning maqsadi: 'emphasize the architectural legacy of Joseph Paxton's design' (Joseph Paxton dizaynining me'moriy merosini / tarixiy ta'sirini ta'kidlash).
A variant uning modulli qismlardan foydalanishi zamonaviy osmono'par binolar qurilishi uchun poydevor qo'yganini ('laid the foundation for modern skyscrapers') aniq ko'rsatib, uning me'moriy merosini urg'ulaydi.

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
B) 9 oyda qurilgani va maydoni aytilgan, uzoq muddatli meros haqida emas.
C) Paxtonning issiqxona me'mori bo'lganini aytadi.
D) 1851-yilgi ko'rgazma haqida umumiy ma'lumot beradi.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ MEROS (LEGACY): 'architectural legacy' -> 'laid the foundation for modern skyscrapers'.

sample_test_questions.passage:
While researching space agriculture, a student took the following notes:
- In 2015, astronauts aboard the International Space Station (ISS) harvested and consumed space-grown 'Outredgeous' red romaine lettuce.
- The crops were cultivated inside NASA's Veggie plant growth chamber under red, blue, and green LED lights.
- Microbiological assays confirmed that the space lettuce was as nutritious and microbe-safe as Earth-grown counterparts.
- Cultivating fresh produce provides essential micronutrients and psychological well-being for crews on multi-year interplanetary missions.
sample_test_questions.question: The student wants to introduce NASA's Veggie growth chamber to an audience unfamiliar with it. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.text: NASA's Veggie plant growth chamber is an LED-powered system aboard the International Space Station designed to cultivate safe, nutritious produce like red romaine lettuce for astronauts.
Consuming fresh crops cultivated in space provides vital micronutrients and psychological benefits for crews traveling on long-duration spaceflights.
In 2015, astronauts aboard the International Space Station made history by harvesting and dining on fresh red romaine lettuce.
Microbiological assays verified that space-grown lettuce possesses nutritional levels identical to crops harvested on Earth.

sample_test_questions.explanation:
To'g'ri javob: A.

Maqsad tahlili:
Talabaning maqsadi: 'introduce NASA's Veggie growth chamber to an audience unfamiliar with it' (NASA ning Veggie o'simlik o'stirish kamerasini u bilan tanish bo'lmagan auditoriyaga tanishtirish).
A variant aynan 'NASA's Veggie plant growth chamber is...' deb boshlanib, uning nima ekanligini (ISS dagi LED tizimi) va maqsadi (astonavtlar uchun xavfsiz va to'yimli sabzavotlar yetishtirish)ni to'liq tushuntirib tanishtiradi.

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
B) Sabzavot iste'mol qilishning ruhiy va ozuqaviy foydalarini aytadi, apparatni tanishtirmaydi.
C) 2015-yilgi voqeani aytadi, lekin Veggie kamerasini tanishtirmaydi.
D) Mikrobiologik tahlil natijalarini bildiradi, apparat haqida umumiy tushuncha bermaydi.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ AUDITORIYAGA TANISHTIRISH: 'introduce ... to an audience unfamiliar' -> 'NASA's Veggie ... is an LED-powered system aboard ISS...'.

sample_test_questions.passage: During the mid-nineteenth century, steam locomotives revolutionized transcontinental shipping. Prior methods relied on horse-drawn wagons, which were notoriously sluggish and vulnerable to seasonal weather disruptions. The emergence of railroad networks rapidly transformed the commercial landscape, rendering long-distance freight delivery remarkably efficient.
sample_test_questions.question: As used in the text, what does the word 'sluggish' most nearly mean?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Matnda ot aravalari (horse-drawn wagons) poyezdlar bilan taqqoslanmoqda. Poyezdlar yuk yetkazishni 'tez va samarali' qilgan bo'lsa, avvalgi aravalar juda sekin va ob-havoga bog'liq bo'lgan. Shu sababli 'sluggish' so'zi bu kontekstda 'sekin harakatlanuvchi' (slow-moving) ma'nosini bildiradi. A varianti (lazy) shaxsiyatga xos bo'lib transport vositalariga nisbatan noto'g'ri ko'chma ma'nodir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ SAT READING HACK: Kontekstdagi qarama-qarshilikka qarang: 'sluggish' so'zi keyingi gapdagi 'efficient and rapid' so'zlariga ziddir.

sample_test_questions.question: A scatterplot displays the weekly practice hours x and test scores y for 20 students. The line of best fit is given by y_pred = 6.5x + 48. One student practiced for 6 hours and achieved an actual score of 92. What is the residual (actual score minus predicted score) for this student?
sample_test_questions.explanation: 1) Bashorat qilingan ballni hisoblaymiz: y_pred = 6.5(6) + 48 = 39 + 48 = 87. 2) Qoldiq (residual) = Haqiqiy ball - Bashorat qilingan ball = 92 - 87 = +5. To'g'ri javob: A (+5). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (-5) — ayirmani teskari (bashorat - haqiqiy) hisoblashdagi ishora tuzog'i; C (87) — bashorat qilingan ballning o'zini belgilash xatosi; D (92) — haqiqiy ballning o'zini qoldiq deb o'ylash xatosi.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ RESIDUAL QOIDASI: Residual = Actual - Predicted (y - y_hat). Nuqta chiziqdan yuqorida bo'lsa, musbat qoldiq bo'ladi!

sample_test_questions.question: A dataset contains 9 test scores: 72, 74, 76, 78, 80, 82, 84, 86, 88. An outlier with a score of 20 is added to the dataset. Which statement correctly compares the median and mean of the new 10-score dataset with the original 9-score dataset?

options.text: Both the mean and the median decrease, but the mean decreases by a greater amount.
Both the mean and the median decrease, but the median decreases by a greater amount.
The median remains unchanged, while the mean decreases.
The mean remains unchanged, while the median decreases.

sample_test_questions.explanation: Dastlabki 9 ta son simmetrik: mediana = 80, o'rtacha qiymat (mean) = 80. Yangi ro'yxat: 20, 72, 74, 76, 78, 80, 82, 84, 86, 88. 1) Yangi mediana = (78 + 80) / 2 = 79 (1 ga kamaydi). 2) Yangi o'rtacha qiymat = (720 + 20) / 10 = 74 (6 ga kamaydi). Ikkalasi ham kamayadi, lekin o'rtacha qiymat ancha ko'proq kamayadi (-6 ga qarshi -1). To'g'ri javob: A. Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B — medianani kutilmagan ko'rsatkichlarga ta'sirchan deb o'ylash xatosi; C va D — o'zgarishsiz qoladi deb noto'g'ri hisoblash tuzoqlari.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ SAT KONSEPSIYASI: O'rtacha qiymat (mean) anomal qiymatlarga (outliers) nihoyatda sezgir, mediana esa ancha mustahkam (resistant) turadi!

sample_test_questions.question: Account A starts with $1,000 and earns 8% interest compounded annually. Account B starts with $1,500 and earns $100 simple interest each year. After 15 years, which account has the greater total balance, and by approximately how much?
sample_test_questions.explanation: 1) Account A (murakkab foiz): 1000 * (1 + 0.08)^15 = 1000 * (1.08)^15. 1.08^15 taxminan 3.17217 ga teng => Balans = $3,172. 2) Account B (oddiy foiz): 1500 + 15 * 100 = 1500 + 1500 = $3,000. Account A ko'proq: $3,172 - $3,000 = $172. To'g'ri javob: A. Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B — Account B katta deb xato tanlash; C — dastlabki farqni $300 deb o'ylash tuzog'i; D — tenglashadi deb yanglishishdagi xato variant.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ DESMOS USULI: Desmosga 1000 * 1.08^15 va 1500 + 15*100 ni yozing. 3172.17 va 3000 chiqadi. Ayirmasi 172.17!

sample_test_questions.question: In the xy-plane, what is the radius of the circle defined by the equation x^2 + y^2 - 8x + 6y - 11 = 0?
sample_test_questions.explanation: To'la kvadratga ajratamiz: (x^2 - 8x + 16) + (y^2 + 6y + 9) = 11 + 16 + 9. (x - 4)^2 + (y + 3)^2 = 36. Aylananing standart tenglamasi: (x - h)^2 + (y - k)^2 = r^2. r^2 = 36 bo'lgani uchun radius r = sqrt(36) = 6. To'g'ri javob: A (6). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (36) — r^2 ni radius deb adashib belgilash klassik tuzog'i; C (4) — markazning x koordinatasi; D (11) — tenglamadagi ozod hadni olishdagi xato variant.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ RADUS TEZKOR FORMULASI: r = sqrt((d/2)^2 + (e/2)^2 - f) = sqrt(4^2 + (-3)^2 - (-11)) = sqrt(16 + 9 + 11) = sqrt(36) = 6.

sample_test_questions.question: A circular community garden has a diameter of 20 meters. A triangular floral sector formed by central radii OA and OB subtends a central angle of 72 degrees. What is the area of this sector, in square meters?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Diametr 20 metr bo'lsa, radius r = 20 / 2 = 10 metr bo'ladi. To'liq aylananing yuzi: S_doira = pi * r^2 = pi * (10)^2 = 100pi. 72 gradusli sektorning to'liq doiradagi ulushi: 72 / 360 = 1 / 5 qism. Sektor yuzi: S_sektor = (1 / 5) * 100pi = 20pi m^2. To'g'ri javob: A (20pi). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (40pi) — radius o'rniga diametrni (20) qo'yib yuborish tuzog'i; C (10pi) — yuzani noto'g'ri bo'lishdagi xato; D (80pi) — 400pi / 5 deb diametr bilan xato hisoblashdagi variant.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ TEZKOR NISBAT: 72° / 360° = 1/5. Doira yuzi pi*10^2 = 100pi. 100pi / 5 = 20pi!

sample_test_questions.question: In right triangle ABC, the measure of angle C is 90 degrees. If sin(A) = 7/25, what is the value of cos(B)?
sample_test_questions.explanation: To'g'ri burchakli uchburchakda o'tkir burchaklar yig'indisi 90 gradus: A + B = 90. Qo'shimcha burchaklar trigonometrik qoidasi (cofunction identity): sin(A) = cos(90 - A) = cos(B). Shuning uchun cos(B) ham aynan 7/25 ga teng bo'ladi. To'g'ri javob: A (7/25). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (24/25) — sin(B) yoki cos(A) ni hisoblab qo'yish tuzog'i; C (25/7) — kasrni to'ntarib qo'yish xatosi; D (7/24) — tangens qiymati bilan adashtirishdagi xato variant.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ SAT COFUNCTION QOIDASI: Har qanday to'g'ri burchakli uchburchakda sin(A) = cos(B) doimo tengdir!

sample_test_questions.question: Triangle PQR is similar to triangle XYZ, where vertices P, Q, and R correspond to X, Y, and Z, respectively. The length of side PQ is 6, and the length of corresponding side XY is 15. If the area of triangle PQR is 24 square centimeters, what is the area of triangle XYZ, in square centimeters?
sample_test_questions.explanation: O'xshashlik koeffitsiyenti k = XY / PQ = 15 / 6 = 5/2 = 2.5. O'xshash figuralarning maydonlari nisbati o'xshashlik koeffitsiyentining kvadratiga teng (k^2): Area(XYZ) = Area(PQR) * k^2 = 24 * (5/2)^2 = 24 * (25 / 4) = 6 * 25 = 150 sm^2. To'g'ri javob: A (150). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (60) — maydonni k ga (kvadratsiz) ko'paytirib qo'yishdagi klassik tuzoq (24 * 2.5 = 60); C (120) va D (240) — noto'g'ri ko'paytirishdagi chalg'ituvchi xato variantlar.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ MAYDON VA HAJM QOIDASI: Chiziqli o'lcham k marta kattalashsa, maydon k^2 marta, hajm esa k^3 marta ortadi!

sample_test_questions.question: A cylindrical water storage tank has a base diameter of 8 meters and a height of 10 meters. What is the total volume of the tank, in cubic meters?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Asos diametri d = 8 m bo'lsa, radiusi r = d / 2 = 4 m bo'ladi. Silindr hajmi formulasi: V = pi * r^2 * h = pi * (4)^2 * 10 = pi * 16 * 10 = 160pi m^3. To'g'ri javob: A (160pi). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (640pi) — radius o'rniga diametrni (8^2=64) qo'yib yuborish tuzog'i; C (80pi) — formuladagi r^2 o'rniga r*h deb adashish xatosi; D (40pi) — konus formulasini (1/3 yoki 1/4) noo'rin qo'llashdagi xato variant.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ DIQQAT: Diametr berilganda doimo birinchi ish uni 2 ga bo'lib radiusni (r = 4) topishdir!

sample_test_questions.question: In an equilateral triangle DEF, each side has a length of 14. What is the exact length of the altitude of triangle DEF?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Teng tomonli uchburchakning balandligi uni ikkita 30-60-90 to'g'ri burchakli uchburchakka ajratadi. Gipotenuza = 14, 30 gradus qarshisidagi katet (asosning yarmi) = 7. 60 gradus qarshisidagi balandlik: h = asos_kateti * sqrt(3) = 7 * sqrt(3). To'g'ri javob: A. Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B — 45-45-90 uchburchak bilan adashtirib sqrt(2) olish xatosi; C (7) — faqat asosning yarmini belgilash tuzog'i; D — gipotenuzaga sqrt(3) ni ko'paytirib qo'yishdagi xato variant.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ FORMULA: Tomoni s bo'lgan muntazam uchburchak balandligi h = s * sqrt(3) / 2 = 14 * sqrt(3) / 2 = 7*sqrt(3).

sample_test_questions.question: A drone logistics company charges an initial dispatch fee of $15 plus $1.25 per kilometer flown. A client has a maximum spending budget of $65 for a single package delivery. What is the maximum distance, in kilometers, the drone can fly without exceeding the client's budget?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Tengsizlik tuzamiz: Jami to'lov 15 + 1.25d <= 65 bo'lishi lozim, bu yerda d — masofa. Dastlabki to'lov 15 ni ayiramiz: 1.25d <= 50. Ikkala tomonni 1.25 ga bo'lamiz: d <= 50 / 1.25 = 40 km. Demak, eng ko'pi bilan 40 km uchish mumkin. To'g'ri javob: A (40). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (35) — hisoblashda 15 ni ikki marta ayirish xatosi; C (50) — bazaviy to'lovni hisobga olmaslik tuzog'i; D (45) — yaxlitlashdagi xato variant.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ TEZ HISOBLASH: 50 / 1.25 = 50 / (5/4) = 50 * 4 / 5 = 40. 3 soniyada tayyor!

sat_mocks.title: Digital SAT Mock #32: College Board Bank Adaptive Mock 12

sample_test_questions.passage:
While researching an architectural landmark, a student took the following notes:
- The Crystal Palace was built in London to house the Great Exhibition of 1851.
- Designed by greenhouse architect Joseph Paxton, it was constructed almost entirely of prefabricated cast iron and sheet glass.
- Its modular design allowed the immense 990,000-square-foot structure to be assembled in just nine months.
- Paxton's use of mass-produced modular components set a historic precedent for modern skyscraper construction.
sample_test_questions.question: The student wants to emphasize the architectural legacy of Joseph Paxton's design. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.text: By successfully utilizing mass-produced, modular cast-iron components at the Crystal Palace, Joseph Paxton pioneered assembly methods that laid the foundation for modern skyscrapers.
Assembled in only nine months, London's Crystal Palace spanned an extraordinary 990,000 square feet to host the Great Exhibition of 1851.
Joseph Paxton, an experienced greenhouse architect, designed the Crystal Palace using prefabricated iron and sheets of glass.
The Great Exhibition of 1851 was held inside the Crystal Palace, an expansive London pavilion made of glass and iron.

sample_test_questions.explanation:
To'g'ri javob: A.

Maqsad tahlili:
Talabaning maqsadi: 'emphasize the architectural legacy of Joseph Paxton's design' (Joseph Paxton dizaynining me'moriy merosini / tarixiy ta'sirini ta'kidlash).
A variant uning modulli qismlardan foydalanishi zamonaviy osmono'par binolar qurilishi uchun poydevor qo'yganini ('laid the foundation for modern skyscrapers') aniq ko'rsatib, uning me'moriy merosini urg'ulaydi.

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
B) 9 oyda qurilgani va maydoni aytilgan, uzoq muddatli meros haqida emas.
C) Paxtonning issiqxona me'mori bo'lganini aytadi.
D) 1851-yilgi ko'rgazma haqida umumiy ma'lumot beradi.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ MEROS (LEGACY): 'architectural legacy' -> 'laid the foundation for modern skyscrapers'.

sample_test_questions.passage:
While researching space agriculture, a student took the following notes:
- In 2015, astronauts aboard the International Space Station (ISS) harvested and consumed space-grown 'Outredgeous' red romaine lettuce.
- The crops were cultivated inside NASA's Veggie plant growth chamber under red, blue, and green LED lights.
- Microbiological assays confirmed that the space lettuce was as nutritious and microbe-safe as Earth-grown counterparts.
- Cultivating fresh produce provides essential micronutrients and psychological well-being for crews on multi-year interplanetary missions.
sample_test_questions.question: The student wants to introduce NASA's Veggie growth chamber to an audience unfamiliar with it. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.text: NASA's Veggie plant growth chamber is an LED-powered system aboard the International Space Station designed to cultivate safe, nutritious produce like red romaine lettuce for astronauts.
Consuming fresh crops cultivated in space provides vital micronutrients and psychological benefits for crews traveling on long-duration spaceflights.
In 2015, astronauts aboard the International Space Station made history by harvesting and dining on fresh red romaine lettuce.
Microbiological assays verified that space-grown lettuce possesses nutritional levels identical to crops harvested on Earth.

sample_test_questions.explanation:
To'g'ri javob: A.

Maqsad tahlili:
Talabaning maqsadi: 'introduce NASA's Veggie growth chamber to an audience unfamiliar with it' (NASA ning Veggie o'simlik o'stirish kamerasini u bilan tanish bo'lmagan auditoriyaga tanishtirish).
A variant aynan 'NASA's Veggie plant growth chamber is...' deb boshlanib, uning nima ekanligini (ISS dagi LED tizimi) va maqsadi (astonavtlar uchun xavfsiz va to'yimli sabzavotlar yetishtirish)ni to'liq tushuntirib tanishtiradi.

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
B) Sabzavot iste'mol qilishning ruhiy va ozuqaviy foydalarini aytadi, apparatni tanishtirmaydi.
C) 2015-yilgi voqeani aytadi, lekin Veggie kamerasini tanishtirmaydi.
D) Mikrobiologik tahlil natijalarini bildiradi, apparat haqida umumiy tushuncha bermaydi.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ AUDITORIYAGA TANISHTIRISH: 'introduce ... to an audience unfamiliar' -> 'NASA's Veggie ... is an LED-powered system aboard ISS...'.

sample_test_questions.passage: During the mid-nineteenth century, steam locomotives revolutionized transcontinental shipping. Prior methods relied on horse-drawn wagons, which were notoriously sluggish and vulnerable to seasonal weather disruptions. The emergence of railroad networks rapidly transformed the commercial landscape, rendering long-distance freight delivery remarkably efficient.
sample_test_questions.question: As used in the text, what does the word 'sluggish' most nearly mean?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Matnda ot aravalari (horse-drawn wagons) poyezdlar bilan taqqoslanmoqda. Poyezdlar yuk yetkazishni 'tez va samarali' qilgan bo'lsa, avvalgi aravalar juda sekin va ob-havoga bog'liq bo'lgan. Shu sababli 'sluggish' so'zi bu kontekstda 'sekin harakatlanuvchi' (slow-moving) ma'nosini bildiradi. A varianti (lazy) shaxsiyatga xos bo'lib transport vositalariga nisbatan noto'g'ri ko'chma ma'nodir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ SAT READING HACK: Kontekstdagi qarama-qarshilikka qarang: 'sluggish' so'zi keyingi gapdagi 'efficient and rapid' so'zlariga ziddir.

sample_test_questions.passage: In her critical monograph on avant-garde sculpture, art historian Evelyn Vance asserts that modernist installations cannot be appraised using classical geometric standards. Because modern sculptors deliberate to disrupt conventional symmetry, traditional frameworks are fundamentally ill-suited to capture the emotional resonance of their works.
sample_test_questions.question: As used in the text, what does the word 'appraised' most nearly mean?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Matnda modern san'at asarlarini klassik geometrik standartlar yordamida baholash yoki o'rganish mumkin emasligi aytilmoqda ('cannot be appraised using classical standards'). Demak, 'appraised' so'zi 'baholamoq' (evaluated) ma'nosida kelmoqda. A varianti (purchased - sotib olmoq) tijoriy baholash bilan adashtiruvchi tuzoqdir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ SAT VOCAB IN CONTEXT: 'Standards' (mezonlar) bilan bog'langan fe'l tahliliy baholashni (evaluate) talab qiladi.

sample_test_questions.passage: Physicist Clara Mendez notes that while quantum entanglement has been verified across microscopic distances, extrapolating these principles to macroscopic systems remains speculative. Any claims suggesting that everyday biological processes are governed by macro-entanglement must be regarded as _______, requiring rigorous experimental corroboration before gaining scientific consensus.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Matnda makroskopik tizimlarga kvant xossalarini tatbiq etish 'speculative' (taxminiy) ekani va jiddiy eksperimental isbot ('rigorous experimental corroboration') talab qilishi ta'kidlanmoqda. Demak, bunday da'volar tasdiqlanmagan, faraziy ya'ni 'conjectural' (taxminiy, farazga asoslangan) deb qaralishi lozim. A (shubhasiz) va D (o'zgarmas) mutlaqo teskari ma'noli variantlardir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ SAT CONTEXT CLUE: 'Speculative' va 'requiring corroboration' kalit so'zlari bo'shliqqa aniq 'conjectural' so'zini joylashtirishni talab qiladi.

sample_test_questions.passage: Ecologist Dr. Liam Park argues that introducing apex predators into fragmented nature reserves can sometimes yield _______ outcomes. While wolves in Yellowstone successfully restored riparian foliage by curtailing elk grazing, similar rewilding initiatives in smaller, arid habitats inadvertently triggered steep declines in endangered ground-nesting birds.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Matnda ikki xil muhitdagi oqibatlar taqqoslanmoqda: Yellowstone'da muvaffaqiyatli tiklanish yuz bergan, biroq kichikroq qurg'oqchil hududlarda qushlar populyatsiyasi keskin kamayib ketgan. Bu natijalar bir xil emas, balki bir-biridan butunlay farqli ('disparate' - contrasting/different) ekanini bildiradi. A va C variantlari qarama-qarshilikka zid.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ SAT CONTRAST CLUE: 'While X succeeded, Y triggered steep declines' strukturasi turlicha oqibatlarni (disparate outcomes) bildiradi.

sample_test_questions.passage: Although the treaty was intended to foster enduring geopolitical stability, its ambiguous clauses regarding territorial boundaries actually _______ diplomatic friction. Rather than cementing peace, the disputed wording provoked repeated border skirmishes throughout the subsequent decade.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Matndagi 'Although' bog'lovchisi kutilgan maqsad (barqarorlik) bilan haqiqiy natija (kelishmovchiliklarning kuchayishi, 'border skirmishes') o'rtasidagi ziddiyatni bildiradi. Noaniq bandlar diplomatik nizoni yumshatmagan, aksincha yanada og'irlashtirgan ('exacerbated' - worsened). B (yumshatmoq) va C (oldini olmoq) kontekstga ziddir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ SAT CLUE: 'provoked border skirmishes' natijasi bo'shliqda salbiy, vaziyatni yomonlashtiruvchi fe'l ('exacerbated') bo'lishini talab qiladi.

sample_test_questions.passage: Marine biologists discovered that deep-sea hydrothermal vents support remarkably robust ecosystems despite the extreme pressure and complete absence of sunlight. Bacteria thriving near the vents convert toxic sulfur compounds into usable metabolic energy, providing sustenance for complex organisms like giant tube worms.
sample_test_questions.question: As used in the text, what does the word 'robust' most nearly mean?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Chuqur dengizdagi haddan tashqari yuqori bosim va mutlaq qorong'ulik kabi og'ir sharoitlarga qaramay ('despite extreme pressure...'), ekotizimlar rivojlanmoqda va hayot davom etmoqda. Bunday chidamlilik va bardoshlilikni ifodalash uchun 'robust' so'zi 'resilient' (chidamliligi yuqori, yashovchan) ma'nosini bildiradi. A varianti (fragile - nozik) to'liq ziddir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ SAT CONTEXT: 'Thriving despite extreme conditions' sharoitida ekotizim 'resilient' (bardoshli) bo'ladi.

sample_test_questions.passage: Urban planners initially anticipated that opening a secondary highway bypass would alleviate morning traffic congestion in the downtown core. However, transportation economists noted that the new route merely induced additional automobile demand, leaving overall commute times essentially _______.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word?
sample_test_questions.explanation: 'However' bog'lovchisi kutilgan yengillik amalga oshmaganini ko'rsatadi. Yangi yo'l qo'shimcha talabni yuzaga keltirgani sababli, umumiy yo'l vaqti deyarli o'zgarishsiz qolgan ('unaltered' - unchanged). B (qisqargan) va C (yo'qolgan) kutilgan samara bo'lib, 'However' inkoriga to'g'ri kelmaydi.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ SAT LOGIC: 'merely induced additional demand' iborasi tiqilinch yechilmaganini, ya'ni vaqt o'zgarmay qolganini (unaltered) anglatadi.

sample_test_questions.passage: Historian Marcus Sterling contends that the prime minister's public persona of folksy simplicity was entirely _______; private archival diaries reveal a shrewd, calculating tactician who carefully orchestrated every public appearance to neutralize political rivals.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Matn bosh vazirning omma oldidagi sodda ko'rinishi (folksy simplicity) bilan shaxsiy kundaliklaridagi o'ta ayyor va hisob-kitobli taktikasi (calculating tactician) o'rtasidagi soxtalikni ochib beradi. Demak, uning sodda qiyofasi samimiy emas, balki ataylab to'qib chiqarilgan, sun'iy yaratilgan ('manufactured' - fabricated/contrived).
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ SAT CONTRAST CLUE: 'carefully orchestrated' va 'calculating' so'zlari ochiq qiyofaning 'manufactured' (sun'iy yasalgan) ekanini isbotlaydi.

sample_test_questions.question: An art gallery sells large canvas prints for $120 each and small prints for $45 each. A collector purchases a total of 14 prints and spends exactly $1,080. How many large canvas prints did the collector purchase?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Katta rasmlar L ta, kichiklari S ta bo'lsin. 1) L + S = 14 => S = 14 - L. 2) 120L + 45S = 1080. O'rniga qo'yamiz: 120L + 45(14 - L) = 1080 => 120L + 630 - 45L = 1080 => 75L = 450 => L = 6 ta katta rasm. To'g'ri javob: A (6). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (8) — kichik rasmlar sonini (S = 8) belgilab qo'yish tuzog'i; C (5) va D (9) — hisob-kitobdagi xato variantlar.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ DESMOS USULI: Desmosga x + y = 14 va 120x + 45y = 1080 ni kiriting. Kesishish nuqtasi (6, 8). Katta rasm x = 6!

sample_test_questions.question: The linear equation 8x - 12 = 2(kx + 5) has no real solution, where k is a constant. What is the value of k?
sample_test_questions.explanation: O'ng tomonni ochamiz: 8x - 12 = 2kx + 10. Chiziqli tenglama yechimga ega bo'lmasligi (no solution) uchun x oldidagi koeffitsiyentlar teng, ozod hadlar esa turli bo'lishi shart: 8 = 2k => k = 4. Ozod hadlar -12 != 10 bo'lgani uchun tenglama hech qachon bajarilmaydi. To'g'ri javob: A (4). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (-4) — ishorani adashtirish tuzog'i; C (8) — 2 ga bo'lishni unutish xatosi; D (2) — arifmetik yanglishishdagi xato variant.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ NO SOLUTION QOIDASI: x ning koeffitsiyentlari teng bo'lishi shart: 8 = 2k => k = 4!

sample_test_questions.question: A theater sells adult admission tickets for $14 each and student tickets for $9 each. A community group has a maximum budget of $150 and must purchase at least 12 tickets in total. If x represents the number of adult tickets and y represents the number of student tickets, which system of inequalities represents this scenario?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Masala tahlili va bosqichma-bosqich yechim: 1) Jami sarf 150 dollardan oshmasligi kerak (maximum budget): 14x + 9y <= 150. 2) Jami biletlar soni kamida 12 ta bo'lishi shart (at least 12): x + y >= 12. Bu shartlar A variantda aynan to'g'ri ifodalangan. Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B variantida tengsizlik ishoralari teskari qo'yilgan; C variantida x va y narxlari almashtirilgan; D variantida kamida 12 ta degan shart 'x + y <= 12' deb xato yozilgan.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ KALIT SO'ZLAR: 'at most / maximum' = <= ; 'at least / minimum' = >=.

sample_test_questions.question: What is the sum of all real solutions to the absolute value equation |4x - 6| = 18?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Ikkita holat: 1) 4x - 6 = 18 => 4x = 24 => x1 = 6. 2) 4x - 6 = -18 => 4x = -12 => x2 = -3. Ildizlar yig'indisi: x1 + x2 = 6 + (-3) = 3. To'g'ri javob: A (3). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (-18) — modul qiymati bilan adashish; C (6) — faqat bitta musbat ildizni belgilab qo'yish tuzog'i; D (9) — ildizlarni noto'g'ri ayirishdagi xato variant.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ MODUL SIMMETRIYASI: |ax - b| = c ning ildizlari b/a markaziga nisbatan simmetrik. Yig'indi doimo 2*(b/a) = 2*(6/4) = 3 bo'ladi!

sample_test_questions.question: The graph of a linear function f passes through points (2, 11) and (5, 23) in the xy-plane. What is the value of f(9)?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Chiziqli funksiya qiyaligi (slope): m = (23 - 11) / (5 - 2) = 12 / 3 = 4. Funksiya tenglamasi: f(x) - 11 = 4(x - 2) => f(x) = 4x + 3. Endi x = 9 ni qo'yamiz: f(9) = 4(9) + 3 = 36 + 3 = 39. To'g'ri javob: A (39). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (36) — ozod had 3 ni qo'shishni unutish xatosi; C (41) va D (43) — hisoblashdagi xato variantlar.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ BOSQICHMA-BOSQICH QADAM: x har 3 ga oshganda y 12 ga oshyapti (har 1 birlik x uchun +4 y). x = 5 dan x = 9 gacha +4 qadam: 23 + 4*4 = 39!

sample_test_questions.question: Line L1 passes through the points (1, 4) and (4, 13) in the xy-plane. Line L2 is parallel to line L1 and passes through the point (2, -1). What is the y-intercept of line L2?
sample_test_questions.explanation: L1 ning qiyaligi: m = (13 - 4) / (4 - 1) = 9 / 3 = 3. Parallel to'g'ri chiziqlarning qiyaliklari teng bo'ladi, shuning uchun L2 ning ham m = 3. L2 (2, -1) nuqtadan o'tadi: y - (-1) = 3(x - 2) => y + 1 = 3x - 6 => y = 3x - 7. y-kesishma nuqtasi (x = 0): (0, -7). To'g'ri javob: A. Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (0, 7) — ishorani teskari olishdagi tuzoq; C (0, -1) — berilgan nuqtani y-kesishma deb o'ylash xatosi; D (0, -5) — arifmetik xato.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ PARALLEL TO'G'RI CHIZIQ: m = 3. y = 3x + b da (2, -1) qo'ying: -1 = 6 + b => b = -7. Kesishma: (0, -7).

sample_test_questions.question: In the xy-plane, line j is defined by the equation 2x + 5y = 15. If line k is perpendicular to line j, what is the slope of line k?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Line j ni y = mx + b ko'rinishiga keltiramiz: 5y = -2x + 15 => y = (-2/5)x + 3. Line j ning qiyaligi m1 = -2/5. Perpendikulyar to'g'ri chiziqning qiyaligi teskari va qarama-qarshi ishorali bo'ladi (negative reciprocal): m2 = -1 / m1 = -1 / (-2/5) = 5/2. To'g'ri javob: A (5/2). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (-2/5) — parallel chiziq qiyaligini belgilash tuzog'i; C (-5/2) — ishorani almashtirishni unutish xatosi; D (2/5) — to'ntarishni unutishdagi xato variant.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ PERPENDIKULYAR QOIDASI: Kasrni to'ntaring va ishorasini teskari qiling: -2/5 -> +5/2!

sample_test_questions.question: Two cyclists start from the exact same trailhead at the same time and travel in opposite directions along a straight path. Cyclist A travels at a constant speed of 14 miles per hour, while Cyclist B travels at a constant speed of 18 miles per hour. After how many hours will the two cyclists be exactly 80 miles apart?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Qarama-qarshi yo'nalishda harakatlanayotgani sababli ularning bir-biridan uzoqlashish tezligi qo'shiladi: v_nisbiy = 14 + 18 = 32 mil/soat. Masofa 80 mil bo'lishi uchun vaqt: t = Masofa / v_nisbiy = 80 / 32 = 5 / 2 = 2.5 soat. To'g'ri javob: A (2.5). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (2.0) — tezliklarni ayirib hisoblash xatosi; C (3.0) va D (3.5) — noto'g'ri bo'lishdagi chalg'ituvchi variantlar.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ HARAKAT TENGLAMASI: 14t + 18t = 80 => 32t = 80 => t = 80/32 = 2.5 soat.

sample_test_questions.question: What is the maximum value of the quadratic function f(x) = -3(x - 4)^2 + 27?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Funksiya cho'qqi ko'rinishida (vertex form) berilgan: f(x) = a(x - h)^2 + k. Bu yerda a = -3 < 0 bo'lgani uchun parabola pastga qaragan va o'zining eng katta (maksimal) qiymatiga cho'qqisida erishadi: k = 27 (x = 4 bo'lganda). To'g'ri javob: A (27). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (4) — maksimum nuqtani (x koordinatani) qiymat deb adashib belgilash tuzog'i; C (-3) — a koeffitsiyenti; D (-27) — ishorani teskari olishdagi xato variant.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ VERTEX FORM: y = a(x - h)^2 + k da maksimum/minimum qiymat doimo k ning o'zidir (k = 27)!

sample_test_questions.question: The quadratic equation x^2 - 10x + 21 = 0 has two distinct real solutions, p and q, where p > q. What is the value of p - q?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Kvadrat tenglamani ko'paytuvchilarga ajratamiz: (x - 7)(x - 3) = 0. Ildizlar: x = 7 va x = 3. Shart bo'yicha p > q, demak p = 7 va q = 3. Ayirma: p - q = 7 - 3 = 4. To'g'ri javob: A (4). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (10) — ildizlar yig'indisini belgilash tuzog'i; C (7) — faqat bitta ildizni olish xatosi; D (21) — ozod hadni belgilashdagi xato variant.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ DESMOS USULI: Desmosda y = x^2 - 10x + 21 ni kiritib x-kesishmalarini ko'ring: (3, 0) va (7, 0). Masofa: 7 - 3 = 4.

sat_mocks.title: Digital SAT Mock #33: College Board Bank Adaptive Mock 13

sample_test_questions.passage: Marine biologists discovered that deep-sea hydrothermal vents support remarkably robust ecosystems despite the extreme pressure and complete absence of sunlight. Bacteria thriving near the vents convert toxic sulfur compounds into usable metabolic energy, providing sustenance for complex organisms like giant tube worms.
sample_test_questions.question: As used in the text, what does the word 'robust' most nearly mean?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Chuqur dengizdagi haddan tashqari yuqori bosim va mutlaq qorong'ulik kabi og'ir sharoitlarga qaramay ('despite extreme pressure...'), ekotizimlar rivojlanmoqda va hayot davom etmoqda. Bunday chidamlilik va bardoshlilikni ifodalash uchun 'robust' so'zi 'resilient' (chidamliligi yuqori, yashovchan) ma'nosini bildiradi. A varianti (fragile - nozik) to'liq ziddir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ SAT CONTEXT: 'Thriving despite extreme conditions' sharoitida ekotizim 'resilient' (bardoshli) bo'ladi.

sample_test_questions.passage: Urban planners initially anticipated that opening a secondary highway bypass would alleviate morning traffic congestion in the downtown core. However, transportation economists noted that the new route merely induced additional automobile demand, leaving overall commute times essentially _______.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word?
sample_test_questions.explanation: 'However' bog'lovchisi kutilgan yengillik amalga oshmaganini ko'rsatadi. Yangi yo'l qo'shimcha talabni yuzaga keltirgani sababli, umumiy yo'l vaqti deyarli o'zgarishsiz qolgan ('unaltered' - unchanged). B (qisqargan) va C (yo'qolgan) kutilgan samara bo'lib, 'However' inkoriga to'g'ri kelmaydi.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ SAT LOGIC: 'merely induced additional demand' iborasi tiqilinch yechilmaganini, ya'ni vaqt o'zgarmay qolganini (unaltered) anglatadi.

sample_test_questions.passage: Historian Marcus Sterling contends that the prime minister's public persona of folksy simplicity was entirely _______; private archival diaries reveal a shrewd, calculating tactician who carefully orchestrated every public appearance to neutralize political rivals.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Matn bosh vazirning omma oldidagi sodda ko'rinishi (folksy simplicity) bilan shaxsiy kundaliklaridagi o'ta ayyor va hisob-kitobli taktikasi (calculating tactician) o'rtasidagi soxtalikni ochib beradi. Demak, uning sodda qiyofasi samimiy emas, balki ataylab to'qib chiqarilgan, sun'iy yaratilgan ('manufactured' - fabricated/contrived).
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ SAT CONTRAST CLUE: 'carefully orchestrated' va 'calculating' so'zlari ochiq qiyofaning 'manufactured' (sun'iy yasalgan) ekanini isbotlaydi.

sample_test_questions.passage: In literary criticism, the term 'polyphonic' is often applied to novels where the narrator's perspective does not subordinate the viewpoints of other characters. Instead, diverse voices retain distinct autonomy, engaging in an open dialogue that remains unresolved by an authoritative narrative voice.
sample_test_questions.question: As used in the text, what does the word 'subordinate' most nearly mean?
sample_test_questions.explanation: Matnda aytilishicha, polifonik asarda hikoyachi boshqa qahramonlarning qarashlarini o'ziga bo'ysundirmaydi yoki bosib qo'ymaydi ('does not subordinate... instead characters retain distinct autonomy'). Demak, 'subordinate' bu yerda 'ustun kelmoq, bosib olmoq' (overpower / make secondary) ma'nosida ishlatilgan.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ SAT OPPOSITE CONTEXT: 'Does not subordinate... instead retain distinct autonomy' qarama-qarshiligi 'subordinate' = overpower ekanini ko'rsatadi.

sample_test_questions.passage: For decades, behavioral economists maintained that humans make consumer choices primarily based on rational utility calculations. In 2002, Daniel Kahneman presented empirical evidence demonstrating that cognitive heuristics and loss aversion consistently steer decision-makers away from purely mathematical optimization. Today, contemporary financial analysts increasingly integrate psychological profiling into risk management algorithms.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice best describes the overall structure of the text?

options.text: It outlines a longstanding theory, describes a pivotal empirical challenge to it, and explains its current disciplinary impact.
It presents an economic dilemma, proposes two incompatible resolutions, and endorses the more mathematically rigorous model.
It criticizes traditional psychological models, highlights their methodological flaws, and advocates for strict laboratory testing.
It traces the historical biography of an influential researcher and analyzes his most celebrated publication.

sample_test_questions.explanation: Matn uch bosqichli tuzilishga ega: 1) Ko'p yillik klassik ratsional model bayon qilinadi ('For decades...'); 2) Kahneman tomonidan keltirilgan tajribaviy e'tiroz va xulq-atvor omillari ko'rsatiladi ('In 2002, presented evidence...'); 3) Hozirgi kunda bu o'zgarishlar moliya sohasida qanday qo'llanilayotgani tushuntiriladi ('Today, analysts integrate...'). Bu A variantiga to'liq mos keladi.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ SAT TEXT STRUCTURE: Uch bosqichli xronologiyani ajrating: Past (For decades) -> Turning point (In 2002) -> Present (Today).

sample_test_questions.passage: Botanist Sarah Jenkins explores how mycorrhizal fungi networks facilitate resource exchange among mature forest trees. While skeptics initially dismissed the concept of inter-plant collaboration as romanticized teleology, Jenkins utilizes isotopic carbon tracing to unequivocally demonstrate that shaded understory seedlings receive vital carbohydrates from sunlit canopy trees via subterranean fungal threads.
sample_test_questions.question: What is the primary purpose of the text?

options.text: To introduce Jenkins's empirical findings as validation for an ecological hypothesis once met with skepticism
To caution researchers against relying on isotopic tracing when studying subterranean ecosystems
To argue that mature canopy trees prioritize their own survival over the nourishment of seedlings
To illustrate the chemical composition of carbohydrates generated through fungal photosynthesis

sample_test_questions.explanation: Matn Jenkinsning tajribaviy tadqiqoti (izotopik uglerod tekshiruvi) ilgari skeptiklar tomonidan inkor etilgan 'o'simliklararo resurs almashinuvi' gipotezasini qat'iy isbotlab berganini yoritish uchun yozilgan. A varianti ushbu asosiy maqsadni eng to'liq va aniq ifodalaydi. B varianti metodni rad etishni aytib matnga zid, C esa daraxtlar ko'chatlarga yordam berayotganiga teskari.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ SAT PURPOSE HACK: Skeptiklarning dastlabki shubhasini yenguvchi ilmiy dalilni taqdim etish matnning markaziy niyatidir.

sample_test_questions.passage: Geologists categorize rocks into three foundational groups: igneous, sedimentary, and metamorphic. Igneous rocks form directly from cooling molten magma or lava. Sedimentary rocks aggregate from compressed mineral particles and organic debris over millennia. Finally, metamorphic rocks result from pre-existing formations undergoing intense underground thermal and pressure transformations without completely melting.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice best describes the function of the second sentence in the text?

options.text: It provides a specific defining characteristic of one of the categories introduced in the opening sentence.
It challenges the conventional categorization presented by earlier mineralogists.
It summarizes the primary distinction between sedimentary and metamorphic specimens.
It explains why volcanic eruptions are necessary for sedimentary rock creation.

sample_test_questions.explanation: Birinchi gapda tog' jinslarining 3 ta turi (igneous, sedimentary, metamorphic) aytiladi. Ikkinchi gap esa ulardan birinchisi - magma/lavaning sovishidan hosil bo'ladigan vulqon (igneous) jinslarining xususiyatini ta'riflab beradi. Shuning uchun A varianti eng to'g'ri tahlildir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ SAT SENTENCE FUNCTION: 1-gap umumiy toifalarni sanaydi, 2-gap esa 1-toifaga (igneous) bevosita aniqlik kiritadi.

sample_test_questions.passage: In analyzing the sonnets of John Donne, literary critic Arthur Bloom notes that Donne's abrupt conversational openings simulate the immediacy of real-time speech. Rather than adopting the ornate, decorative phrasing characteristic of Elizabethan court poetry, Donne thrusts the reader into the midst of an intimate intellectual argument, thereby dismantling the polished facade traditionally expected in lyric verse.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice best states the primary function of the underlined claim regarding Elizabethan court poetry?

options.text: It establishes a conventional stylistic baseline against which Donne's innovative poetic technique is contrasted.
It demonstrates that Donne's contemporaries unanimously condemned his departures from tradition.
It proves that Elizabethan lyric verse was aesthetically superior to metaphysical poetry.
It provides historical evidence that Donne intended to mock the royal court's literary patrons.

sample_test_questions.explanation: Muallif Yelizaveta davri saroy she'riyatini ('ornate, decorative phrasing') Donnening yangicha, suhbatdoshlikka asoslangan uslubini solishtirish va uning o'ziga xosligini bo'rtirib ko'rsatish uchun an'anaviy fon (stylistic baseline) sifatida keltirmoqda. B, C va D matnda aytilmagan asossiz xulosalardir.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ SAT RHETORICAL FUNCTION: An'anaviy uslubni keltirishdan maqsad - yangi muallifning innovatsiyasini kontrast orqali yaqqol ko'rsatishdir.

sample_test_questions.passage:
Text 1
Astronomer David Kuan argues that the detection of atmospheric phosphine on Venus provides compelling indirect evidence of microbial life suspended in the planet's sulfuric cloud decks, as non-biological abiotic synthesis of phosphine under Venusian conditions is thermodynamically unfeasible according to known chemical pathways.

Text 2
Atmospheric chemist Elena Rostova contends that invoking extraterrestrial biochemistry to explain Venusian phosphine is prematurely speculative. Rostova's laboratory models show that deep-mantle volcanic plumes could vent volatile phosphide minerals into the upper atmosphere, where photolytic oxidation produces phosphine without any biological intervention.
sample_test_questions.question: Based on the texts, how would Rostova (Text 2) most likely respond to Kuan's claim in Text 1 regarding phosphine synthesis?

options.text: By arguing that Kuan overlooked viable abiotic mechanisms involving volcanic mineral venting
By conceding that microbial metabolism is the only plausible explanation for Venusian sulfur clouds
By asserting that telescopic instruments completely misidentified the spectroscopic signature of phosphine
By demonstrating that phosphine decomposes too rapidly in sulfuric acid to ever be detected

sample_test_questions.explanation: Kuan (Text 1) nobiologik (abiotic) sintez imkonsiz deb hisoblaydi va shuning uchun fosfin mikrobial hayot dalili deydi. Rostova (Text 2) esa buni inkor etib, o'z laboratoriya modellarida vulqon minerallari (abiotic) orqali hech qanday biologiyasiz fosfin hosil bo'lishini ko'rsatgan. Shuning uchun Rostova Kuan nobiologik vulqon mexanizmlarini hisobga olmagan deb e'tiroz bildiradi. A to'g'ri.
sample_test_questions.strategy: ⚡ SAT PAIRED TEXTS: Kuan: 'abiotic synthesis is unfeasible' <-> Rostova: 'laboratory models show abiotic volcanic plumes produce it'. To'g'ridan-to'g'ri A varianti.

sample_test_questions.passage:
Text 1
Historian Thomas Bennett argues that the collapse of the Western Roman Empire was fundamentally driven by external shocks: unprecedented nomadic migrations from Central Asia pushed Germanic confederacies across the Rhine and Danube frontiers, overwhelming Roman border defenses faster than administrative legions could redeploy.

Text 2
Classicist Nadia Al-Mansoor maintains that external migrations merely administered the final blow to an empire already hollowed out by centuries of internal economic decay. Rampant currency debasement, severe labor shortages caused by agrarian plagues, and endemic tax evasion by the senatorial aristocracy had effectively crippled the imperial treasury long before the crossing of the Rhine.
sample_test_questions.question: Which choice best describes how Al-Mansoor (Text 2) views Bennett's central thesis in Text 1?

options.text: As an accurate diagnosis that fully explains the collapse without needing economic factors
As mistaking an immediate catalytic event for the profound, underlying systemic causes of collapse
As fundamentally flawed because nomadic tribes were easily absorbed into Roman provincial governance
As an overestimation of the Roman imperial treasury's ability to finance frontier fortifications

sample_test_questions.explanation: Bennett tashqi bosqinlarni asosiy sabab deb biladi. Al-Mansoor esa tashqi bosqinlar faqatgina 'so'nggi zarba' (final blow) bo'lganini, imperiyaning haqiqiy va chuqur sababi ichki iqtisodiy inqiroz va xazinaning bo'shab qolishi ekanini ta'kidlaydi. Demak, u Bennettning qarashini asosiy sababni yuzaki turtki (catalytic event) bilan adashtirish deb baholaydi. B to'g'ri.
